domains.name: study
domains.description: Core operational domain managing clinical study protocols, design, phases, objectives, endpoints, inclusion/exclusion criteria, visit schedules, and study lifecycle from protocol development through database lock. Serves as the foundational blueprint for all trial activities and the authoritative source for study identifiers, timelines, amendments, and study-specific procedures.
domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); CDISC Protocol Representation Model

products.name: protocol
products.description: Master record for the clinical study protocol including all formal amendments (version history). Captures protocol number, version, title, phase, therapeutic area, indication, investigational product, study design parameters (allocation method, intervention model, masking details, primary purpose, number of arms, adaptive design flags), primary/secondary objectives summary, study population description, planned sample size, study duration, sponsor reference, IND/CTA number, protocol status (draft, approved, amended, final), amendment history (amendment number, date, type, rationale, regulatory submission status, IRB/IEC notification, impact assessment), and GCP/ICH compliance declarations. SSOT for protocol identity, design parameters, and amendment lifecycle. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Veeva Vault.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Protocol

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical study protocol record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the protocol data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Every protocol is conducted under an IND. This link is required for annual IND report generation, clinical hold management, and safety reporting obligation tracking. ind_cta_number is a denormalized t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which participants are assigned to study arms. 'Randomized' indicates use of RTSM/IRT for random assignment; 'non-randomized' indicates assignment by investigator or other non-random method. Drives RTSM configuration in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was formally issued or approved. Null for the original protocol version. Used to establish the amendment timeline and regulatory notification deadlines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the protocol amendment (e.g., Amendment 1, Amendment 2). Null for the original protocol version. Used to track the amendment history and link to regulatory submission records in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Variation Regulation

attributes.name: amendment_rationale
attributes.description: Formal justification for the protocol amendment describing the scientific, safety, or operational reasons for the change. Required for regulatory submissions and IRB/IEC notifications. Stored in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the protocol amendment per regulatory definitions. 'Substantial' amendments require prior regulatory authority and IRB/IEC approval before implementation; 'non-substantial' require notification only; 'administrative' are clerical corrections with no impact on study conduct or subject safety.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; MHRA Clinical Trials Regulations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol version received final sponsor and/or regulatory/IRB/IEC approval, making it the operative protocol for study conduct. Tracked in Veeva Vault quality management workflow. Establishes the effective date for GCP compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol record was first created in the source system or ingested into the lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ALCOA+ Data Integrity; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: dsmb_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol mandates the establishment of a Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent safety oversight and interim analysis review. Typically required for Phase III trials and studies with significant safety risks.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006); ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; EMA Guideline on DMC

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) number or Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) number assigned under EU CTR 536/2014. Required for all clinical trials conducted in the EU/EEA. Used for EMA regulatory tracking and public registry disclosure.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EudraCT/CTIS Registration; EMA Transparency Policy

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_declaration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol includes a formal declaration of compliance with ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. Required for all interventional clinical trials. Tracked in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP Regulations

attributes.name: ich_compliance_declaration
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Compliance Declaration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol formally declares compliance with applicable ICH guidelines (E6, E8, E9, E10, etc.). Distinct from GCP declaration; covers the broader ICH guideline framework including statistical and design standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8(R1); ICH E9(R1); ICH E10; FDA/EMA/PMDA ICH Implementation

attributes.name: intervention_model
attributes.description: Describes the strategy for assigning interventions to participants. Determines the statistical analysis plan (SAP) structure, number of arms, and eCRF design in Medidata Rave. Aligns with CDISC SDTM ARM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9(R1) Addendum; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) notification or approval for this protocol version or amendment. Tracks compliance with ethics review requirements across jurisdictions. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: is_adaptive_design
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study employs an adaptive design allowing pre-specified modifications to the trial or statistical procedures based on interim data analysis. Triggers additional regulatory review requirements and DSMB/DMC oversight obligations.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials (2019); EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: is_pediatric
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study includes a pediatric population (subjects under 18 years). Triggers Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) requirements under EMA and Pediatric Study Plan (PSP) under FDA PREA/BPCA, and specific ICF/assent requirements.
attributes.references: FDA PREA/BPCA; EMA Pediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; ICH E11(R1)

attributes.name: masking_type
attributes.description: Level of blinding applied to the study to minimize bias. Specifies which parties (participant, investigator, outcomes assessor, data analyst) are blinded to treatment assignment. Critical for RTSM/IRT configuration and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; CDISC SDTM IG; ClinicalTrials.gov; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: number_of_arms
attributes.description: Total count of treatment arms (groups) defined in the protocol. Drives RTSM randomization configuration, eCRF arm assignment, and statistical analysis plan (SAP) structure. Must be consistent with the intervention model.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: planned_duration_months
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the study in months from first subject first visit (FSFV) to last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL), as specified in the protocol. Used for timeline planning, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; Oracle Siebel CTMS Study Timeline

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL) as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for resource planning, regulatory submission timelines, and study close-out activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; WHO ICTRP Registration

attributes.name: planned_sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of subjects planned for enrollment across all study sites and arms as specified in the protocol. Derived from the statistical power calculation in the SAP. Used for site feasibility, patient recruitment planning, and IP supply forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of first subject first visit (FSFV) or study initiation as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for milestone tracking, site activation planning, and regulatory submission timelines in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; WHO ICTRP Registration

attributes.name: primary_endpoint
attributes.description: The principal outcome measure used to evaluate the primary objective of the study. Defines the variable, measurement method, timepoint, and population. Drives eCRF design in Medidata Rave and the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: primary_objective
attributes.description: Formal statement of the primary scientific objective of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes the main question the study is designed to answer. Directly linked to the primary endpoint and powers the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: primary_purpose
attributes.description: The primary reason for conducting the clinical study. Determines regulatory pathway, endpoint requirements, and IRB/IEC review criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: treatment|prevention|diagnostic|supportive_care|screening|health_services_research|basic_science|device_feasibility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, sponsor-assigned unique alphanumeric identifier for the clinical study protocol (e.g., ABC-2024-001). Used across all regulatory submissions, site documents, and operational systems as the primary business key. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; CDISC SDTM STUDYID

attributes.name: protocol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the protocol version. 'draft' indicates under development; 'approved' indicates IRB/IEC and sponsor approval obtained; 'amended' indicates a formal amendment is in effect; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'final' indicates study completed and protocol finalized; 'retired' indicates withdrawn. Sourced from Veeva Vault quality management workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: registry_identifier
attributes.description: Public clinical trial registry identifier such as ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number (e.g., NCT12345678) or WHO ICTRP identifier. Required by ICMJE for publication eligibility and by FDA/EMA for transparency. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ClinicalTrials.gov (42 CFR Part 11); ICMJE Clinical Trial Registration Policy; FDA FDAAA 801

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory authority submission for this protocol version or amendment (e.g., IND amendment to FDA, CTA variation to EMA/MHRA). Tracks compliance with regulatory notification and approval requirements. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; ICH E6(R2); MHRA Clinical Trials Regulations

attributes.name: short_title
attributes.description: Abbreviated or lay-language title of the clinical study used in operational communications, CTMS displays, patient-facing materials, and internal reporting. Distinct from the full regulatory title.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP Registration Data Set; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this protocol record was sourced. Primary sources are Oracle Clinical One (study design and protocol configuration) and Veeva Vault (eTMF and regulatory document management). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; EU Annex 11

attributes.name: source_system_identifier
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Oracle Clinical One study ID or Veeva Vault document ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: ICH-defined phase of clinical development for the investigational product. Determines regulatory requirements, sample size expectations, and study design complexity. 'Not Applicable' used for non-IND studies such as device or observational studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase II/III|Phase III|Phase IV|Not Applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.21; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the target patient population for the study, including disease characteristics, demographic parameters, and key eligibility criteria summary. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, regulatory filings, and patient recruitment materials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the study design indicating whether participants receive an intervention or are observed. Determines applicable regulatory framework, IRB review requirements, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full official title of the clinical study protocol as it appears on the protocol document and regulatory submissions. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, clinical trial registries, and the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; WHO ICTRP Registration Data Set; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this protocol record in the source system or lakehouse. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ALCOA+ Data Integrity; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the protocol document (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 3.1). Combined with protocol_number, uniquely identifies a specific iteration of the protocol. Incremented with each formal amendment. Sourced from Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

products.name: study_protocol_amendment
products.description: Tracks all formal amendments to an approved clinical study protocol. Records amendment number, amendment date, amendment type (substantial/non-substantial), description of changes, rationale, regulatory submission status per health authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA), IRB/IEC notification status, effective date, and impact assessment on ongoing subjects. Supports the protocol lifecycle from initial approval through database lock. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Veeva Vault.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) Protocol Amendment

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol amendment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: amendment_regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Protocol amendments are submitted as IND amendments or CTA variations filed in regulatory binders. study_protocol_amendment tracks fda_submission_date, ema_submission_date, pmda_submission_date. Linki
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amendment_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Each protocol amendment generates a TMF essential document (DIA TMF Zone 4). Amendment tracking and TMF completeness assessments require linking the amendment record to its filed TMF document. Inspect
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amendment_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.version. Business justification: Each protocol amendment produces a new document version in the eTMF. Regulatory binders and IRB/IEC submissions require amendment-to-document-version traceability. Role prefix 'amendment_' reflects th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: A study protocol amendment is by definition an amendment TO a specific protocol. While study_protocol_amendment already has study_id → study_study, it lacks a direct FK to the protocol it amends. This
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Regulatory affairs teams must link each internal study amendment record to its corresponding regulatory submission record in the regulatory domain. This is required for amendment implementation tracki
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this protocol amendment belongs. Links the amendment to the study master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: affected_sections
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or free-text enumeration of protocol section numbers and titles modified by this amendment (e.g., '5.1 Inclusion Criteria, 8.3 Visit Schedule, 10.2 Safety Monitoring'). Enables targeted review by site staff.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; Veeva Vault eTMF Document Metadata

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment was formally authored or finalized by the sponsor. This is the document date, distinct from submission or approval dates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing all changes introduced by this amendment, including modified sections, added or removed procedures, and updated criteria. Serves as the primary change log for regulatory and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the amendment within a given protocol (e.g., AM-001, AM-002). Used by sponsors, health authorities, and IRB/IEC to uniquely reference a specific amendment version. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the protocol amendment. Tracks progression from internal drafting through regulatory approval and implementation. 'Superseded' indicates a later amendment has replaced this one.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault Lifecycle States; Oracle Clinical One Amendment Workflow

attributes.name: amendment_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the primary purpose or scope of the amendment (e.g., 'Addition of New Safety Monitoring Criteria'). Used in regulatory submissions and internal tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment per regulatory definitions. 'Substantial' amendments require prior health authority and ethics committee approval before implementation. 'Non-substantial' amendments may be implemented with notification only. 'Administrative' covers clerical corrections with no scientific impact. Aligns with EU CTR 536/2014 and FDA guidance.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the sponsor representative (e.g., Chief Medical Officer, Head of Regulatory Affairs) who provided final internal approval for the amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; GCP SOP Requirements; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Primary category of change introduced by the amendment. Used for analytics, regulatory reporting, and impact triage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eligibility_criteria|dosing_regimen|visit_schedule|safety_monitoring|endpoint|statistical|icf|administrative|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC Protocol Representation Model; FDA Amendment Classification Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amendment record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: dsmb_dmc_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was triggered by a formal recommendation from the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). Requires documentation of the DSMB/DMC meeting minutes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: edc_configuration_updated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave) has been updated to reflect the protocol changes introduced by this amendment. Critical for data integrity and eCRF alignment.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the amended protocol becomes operative at clinical sites. Sites must implement protocol changes on or after this date. May differ from approval date if a transition period is granted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: ema_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment was submitted to the European Medicines Agency (EMA) or relevant national competent authority under EU CTR 536/2014. Null if no EU sites are involved.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: ema_submission_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory submission status with the European Medicines Agency (EMA) or relevant EU national competent authority for this amendment.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: fda_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment was submitted to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as an IND amendment. Null if the study is not conducted under a U.S. IND.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; IND Amendment Requirements

attributes.name: fda_submission_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory submission status with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). 'On_clinical_hold' indicates FDA has placed a hold pending resolution of safety concerns.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: icf_version_updated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Updated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment necessitates a new version of the Informed Consent Form (ICF). When true, a new ICF document version must be created and approved before re-consent activities begin.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; Clinpal eConsent System

attributes.name: impact_assessment_summary
attributes.description: Structured narrative summarizing the assessed impact of the amendment on study operations, subject safety, data integrity, site procedures, and timelines. Produced during the amendment review process.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments; GCP SOP Requirements

attributes.name: implementation_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which all active clinical sites must have fully implemented the amendment. Used for monitoring follow-up and escalation planning in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; GCP Monitoring Requirements; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead or central IRB/IEC granted approval for the amendment. For substantial amendments, implementation cannot proceed until this approval is received.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of this amendment. Required for GCP compliance at all participating sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations

attributes.name: irb_iec_status
attributes.description: Current review and approval status from the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). 'Approved_with_conditions' requires sponsor response before full approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: pmda_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment was submitted to Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA). Null if no Japan sites are involved.
attributes.references: PMDA Clinical Trial Notification Requirements; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: pmda_submission_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory submission status with Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) for this amendment.
attributes.references: PMDA Clinical Trial Notification Requirements; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: previous_protocol_version
attributes.description: The protocol version number that was in effect immediately before this amendment was applied. Enables version chain traceability for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Scientific, safety, or operational justification for the amendment. Required by health authorities to assess the necessity and appropriateness of protocol changes. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: reconsent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrolled subjects must provide updated Informed Consent Form (ICF) signatures due to material changes introduced by this amendment. Drives re-consent workflow in Clinpal eConsent.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: safety_driven_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was initiated primarily due to a safety signal, Serious Adverse Event (SAE), SUSAR, or DSMB/DMC recommendation. Safety-driven amendments may require expedited regulatory review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Safety Reporting Guidelines; DSMB Charter Requirements

attributes.name: sap_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires an update to the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Changes to primary/secondary endpoints, analysis populations (ITT, PP), or statistical methods trigger SAP revision.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1) Estimands; CDISC ADaM; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this amendment record was sourced (Oracle Clinical One for study design, Veeva Vault for document management, or manual entry). Supports data lineage in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor's internal governance (e.g., medical, regulatory, and legal sign-off) formally approved the amendment prior to external submission.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; GCP SOP Requirements

attributes.name: subject_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment has a direct impact on currently enrolled subjects (e.g., changes to dosing, visit schedule, eligibility criteria, or safety monitoring). True triggers mandatory re-consent assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance on Re-consent

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this amendment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Required for change data capture, audit trail, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_code
attributes.description: The document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF to the amendment document. Enables direct cross-reference to the source document management system for audit trail and TMF completeness tracking.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; TMF Reference Model

products.name: study
products.description: Top-level master entity representing a clinical trial as a business and operational unit. Captures the unique study identifier (sponsor study number, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number, EudraCT number), study title, acronym, therapeutic area, indication, development phase, study type (interventional/observational), blinding type, randomization flag, study status with full lifecycle history (planned, startup, active, on-hold, completed, terminated), planned and actual start/end dates, target enrollment, closure details (DBL date, CSR submission, TMF archival), sponsor reference, and CRO assignment. SSOT for study identity and lifecycle state across all domains. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
products.reference: CTMS Study Master / ClinicalTrials.gov Registration

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical study record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the study_study entity. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: study_study is the top-level master entity for a clinical trial; protocol is the master record for the study protocol. Adding protocol_id FK to study_study formalizes the authoritative link between th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: acronym
attributes.description: The short alphanumeric acronym or abbreviated name assigned to the clinical study for operational use across CTMS, EDC, and internal communications (e.g., APEX-HF, BRIGHT-2). Facilitates quick identification in dashboards, reports, and cross-system references.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS Study Object

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the last patient completed the last study visit (Last Patient Last Visit - LPLV). Recorded upon confirmation in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Triggers database lock preparation, CSR authoring, and TMF archival workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: actual_enrollment
attributes.description: The actual cumulative number of subjects enrolled (consented and randomized or assigned to treatment) across all study sites at the current point in time. Updated from Medidata Rave EDC enrollment data. Used for enrollment tracking KPIs and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ClinicalTrials.gov Reporting Requirements; FDAAA 801

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the first patient was enrolled or the first study procedure was performed (First Patient First Visit - FPFV). Recorded upon confirmation in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Used for regulatory reporting, timeline variance analysis, and KPI measurement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; WHO ICTRP Registration; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: The sequential count of protocol amendments issued since the original protocol approval. A value of 0 indicates the original protocol with no amendments. Increments with each approved protocol amendment. Used to track protocol evolution and regulatory submission history.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: The blinding (masking) classification applied to the clinical study indicating which parties are unaware of treatment assignment. Drives operational procedures for unblinding, DSMB/DMC oversight, and safety reporting. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2) Section 1.11; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the study record was first created in the source system (Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: csr_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Clinical Study Report (CSR) was submitted to the regulatory authority or sponsor. The CSR is the comprehensive document summarizing study methods, results, and conclusions per ICH E3 guidelines. Tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E3 Structure and Content of Clinical Study Reports; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: ctms_study_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Study Identifier
attributes.description: The native study identifier assigned by Oracle Siebel CTMS, the system of record for this entity. Enables direct traceability back to the source system record for audit, reconciliation, and data lineage purposes per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The date used as the data cutoff for interim or final analyses, defining the observation window for subject data included in the analysis dataset. Specified in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and used to generate SDTM/ADaM datasets in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM IG; SAS Drug Development; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: dbl_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical database was formally locked following completion of all data cleaning, query resolution, and medical coding activities. Database Lock (DBL) is a critical regulatory milestone that freezes the dataset for statistical analysis. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM IG; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: The methodological design classification of the clinical study (e.g., Parallel Group, Crossover, Single Arm, Factorial, Adaptive). Informs statistical analysis plan design, randomization schema, and protocol complexity. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One study design configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Parallel Group|Crossover|Single Arm|Factorial|Adaptive|Basket|Umbrella|Platform — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E8(R1); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: development_phase
attributes.description: The regulatory development phase of the clinical study per ICH and FDA/EMA classification (Phase I through Phase IV). Drives regulatory requirements, statistical analysis plan complexity, safety reporting obligations, and resource planning. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS Protocol Phase field.
attributes.value_regex: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase II/III|Phase III|Phase IV
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: edc_study_code
attributes.description: The study identifier assigned within the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave) used for clinical data collection. Enables cross-system traceability between the CTMS master record and the EDC operational system. Required for data lineage and audit trail purposes per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: The European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) registration number assigned by the EMA for clinical trials conducted in the EU/EEA (e.g., 2023-001234-56). Required for all interventional trials in EU member states under EU CTR 536/2014.
attributes.references: EMA EU CTR 536/2014; EudraCT Regulation (EC) No 536/2014

attributes.name: first_site_initiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the first investigational site was formally initiated (Site Initiation Visit completed) and authorized to enroll subjects. A key operational milestone tracked in Oracle Siebel CTMS for timeline KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; Oracle Siebel CTMS Milestone Management

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.description: The date of initial approval granted by the lead Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) for the study protocol. This is a prerequisite for study initiation and subject enrollment. Tracked in Oracle Siebel CTMS and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_randomized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinical study employs randomization to assign participants to treatment arms (True) or uses a non-randomized assignment method (False). Determines RTSM/IRT configuration requirements in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: nct_number
attributes.description: The ClinicalTrials.gov registry identifier assigned by the U.S. National Library of Medicine upon study registration (e.g., NCT12345678). Mandatory for studies subject to FDAAA 801 and ICMJE registration requirements. Used for public disclosure and regulatory cross-referencing.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; FDAAA 801; ICMJE Registration Policy; 42 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: number_of_arms
attributes.description: The total number of treatment arms or groups defined in the study protocol (e.g., 2 for a two-arm parallel study, 1 for a single-arm study). Drives RTSM/IRT configuration in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One randomization setup.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: planned_country_count
attributes.description: The planned number of countries in which the clinical study will be conducted. Drives regulatory strategy (multi-national submissions), country-level feasibility, and operational complexity assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EMA EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for last patient last visit (LPLV) or study completion as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for resource planning, site contract management, and regulatory timeline commitments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS Milestone Management

attributes.name: planned_site_count
attributes.description: The planned number of investigational sites to be activated for the clinical study as defined in the feasibility assessment and study protocol. Used for site selection planning, budget forecasting, and resource allocation in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; Oracle Siebel CTMS Site Management

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for first patient first visit (FPFV) or study initiation as defined in the study protocol and project plan. Used for timeline tracking, milestone management, and KPI reporting in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS Milestone Management; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: primary_regulatory_region
attributes.description: The primary regulatory jurisdiction governing the clinical study, determining the lead regulatory authority (e.g., US for FDA, EU for EMA, JP for PMDA). Drives applicable GCP guidelines, submission requirements, and safety reporting timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: sponsor_study_number
attributes.description: The sponsor-assigned unique alphanumeric identifier for the clinical study (e.g., ABC-1234-001). This is the primary business identifier used across all sponsor systems, regulatory submissions, and inter-organizational communications. Corresponds to the Protocol Number in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: The current operational lifecycle status of the clinical study. Drives workflow gating, resource allocation, regulatory reporting obligations, and system access controls across CTMS, EDC, and eTMF. This is the authoritative status field sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS. Transitions are tracked in the study status history product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Siebel CTMS Study Status

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: The fundamental classification of the clinical study design indicating whether participants receive an investigational intervention (Interventional), are observed without intervention (Observational), or receive investigational product outside a trial (Expanded Access). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks and GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; WHO ICTRP; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: target_enrollment
attributes.description: The planned total number of subjects to be enrolled across all study sites as specified in the approved protocol and statistical analysis plan (SAP). Drives site allocation, recruitment planning, and power calculations. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason for early termination of the clinical study when study_status is Terminated. Captures the primary rationale (e.g., Safety Concerns, Lack of Efficacy, Business Decision, Regulatory Hold, Enrollment Failure). Required for regulatory notifications and final CSR. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Safety Concerns|Lack of Efficacy|Business Decision|Regulatory Hold|Enrollment Failure|Sponsor Decision|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.44; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The complete official title of the clinical study as stated in the approved protocol document. Used in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC applications, informed consent forms, and the Trial Master File. Corresponds to the Protocol Title field in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; CDISC SDTM IG; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: tmf_archival_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Trial Master File (TMF) was formally archived following study close-out. The TMF must be retained for a minimum of 15 years (or longer per regional requirements) after study completion. Tracked in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the study record was most recently modified in the source system (Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

products.name: arm
products.description: Defines each treatment arm or cohort within a clinical study. Records arm name, arm code, arm type (experimental, active comparator, placebo comparator, sham comparator, no intervention, other), description of intervention, planned number of subjects per arm, randomization ratio, arm status, and CDISC SDTM ARM domain mapping. Supports multi-arm and adaptive trial designs. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM TA (Trial Arms) Domain

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each study arm record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the study_arm data product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: FK to study.investigational_product

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this arm belongs. Links the arm to its governing study protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Treatment arms can be added, modified, or removed by protocol amendments (e.g., adding a new dose arm in a dose-escalation study). Linking arm to study_protocol_amendment enables full amendment tracea
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adaptive_design_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this arm is part of an adaptive trial design where arm allocation, sample size, or continuation may be modified based on interim analysis results per a pre-specified adaptation rule.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs (2019); EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: arm_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the arm within the study. Maps directly to the ARMCD variable in the CDISC SDTM ARM domain and is used in randomization and data tabulation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM v3.3 ARM Domain; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: arm_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the study arm as defined in the protocol (e.g., 'Drug A 10mg QD', 'Placebo'). Maps to the ARM variable in the CDISC SDTM ARM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM v3.3 ARM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6

attributes.name: arm_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the study arm, reflecting whether the arm is planned, actively enrolling, suspended, closed to enrollment, or discontinued per protocol amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: arm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the arm per ClinicalTrials.gov and CDISC controlled terminology, indicating the nature of the intervention assigned to subjects in this arm. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Experimental|Active Comparator|Placebo Comparator|Sham Comparator|No Intervention|Other — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology; ICH E8(R1)

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Specifies the level of blinding applied to this arm: Open Label (no blinding), Single Blind (subject blinded), Double Blind (subject and investigator blinded), or Triple Blind (subject, investigator, and sponsor blinded).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; CDISC SDTM ARM Domain

attributes.name: clinical_one_arm_code
attributes.description: The native arm identifier assigned by Oracle Clinical One (the source system of record for study design and patient randomization). Used for system-of-record traceability and data lineage from source to lakehouse.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One Study Design Module; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this study arm record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_arm_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Arm Reference
attributes.description: The arm reference identifier as recorded in Oracle Siebel CTMS for site monitoring, visit tracking, and enrollment management. Supports cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early discontinuation of the study arm, if applicable (e.g., safety signal, futility, sponsor decision, regulatory hold). Required for regulatory reporting when an arm is terminated prior to planned completion.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014

attributes.name: dose_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the dose level and regimen for the investigational product in this arm (e.g., '10 mg once daily', '200 mg BID'). Supports dose-response analysis and protocol compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: dosing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of investigational product administration for subjects in this arm (e.g., QD - once daily, BID - twice daily, QW - once weekly). Aligns with CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSFRQ variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the study arm was closed to enrollment or treatment, either per protocol schedule or due to early termination. Null if the arm is still active.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: interim_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this arm is subject to one or more pre-specified interim analyses by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) during the study.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; DSMB Charter Requirements

attributes.name: intervention_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the intervention assigned to subjects in this arm, including drug name, dose, route of administration, and dosing schedule as specified in the study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4; CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: intervention_type
attributes.description: Category of the therapeutic intervention assigned to subjects in this arm. Aligns with ClinicalTrials.gov intervention type classifications and supports regulatory submission categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Drug|Biologic|Device|Procedure|Behavioral|Dietary Supplement|Radiation|Genetic|Combination|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment assignment for this arm is blinded to subjects, investigators, or both (double-blind). Supports blinding integrity tracking and unblinding event management.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: is_control_arm
attributes.description: Indicates whether this arm serves as the control arm (comparator) in the study design. True for placebo, active comparator, or sham comparator arms used as the reference group in statistical analyses.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); ICH E9(R1); CDISC SDTM ARM Domain

attributes.name: itt_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subjects enrolled in this arm are included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: max_subjects_count
attributes.description: The maximum allowable number of subjects that may be enrolled in this arm, including any over-enrollment buffer defined in the protocol. Distinct from planned_subjects_count which reflects the statistical target.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.7; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: min_subjects_count
attributes.description: The minimum number of subjects required in this arm to maintain statistical validity of the study, as defined in the SAP. Used for futility analysis and early stopping rule evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); SAP Requirements; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, clarifications, or protocol-specific instructions related to this arm that are not captured in structured fields. For internal use by study team.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_subjects_count
attributes.description: The planned (target) number of subjects to be enrolled and randomized into this arm as specified in the study protocol and statistical analysis plan (SAP).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.7; CDISC SDTM ARM Domain

attributes.name: pp_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subjects enrolled in this arm are included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Subjects with major protocol deviations may be excluded.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: randomization_ratio
attributes.description: The allocation ratio for randomization of subjects into this arm relative to other arms (e.g., '1:1', '2:1:1'). Used by the RTSM/IRT system (Medidata Rave RTSM) to control subject assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: randomization_ratio_numeric
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the allocation weight for this arm relative to total allocation (e.g., 0.50 for a 1:1 ratio arm). Supports quantitative analysis and reporting of enrollment balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC SDTM ARM Domain

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The route by which the investigational product is administered to subjects in this arm (e.g., Oral, Intravenous, Subcutaneous, Intramuscular). Aligns with CDISC SDTM EX domain EXROUTE variable and WHO-DD terminology.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; WHO-DD; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; NCI Thesaurus

attributes.name: safety_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subjects enrolled in this arm are included in the safety analysis population (all subjects who received at least one dose of study treatment), as defined in the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Statistical Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sdtm_arm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Arm Domain
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain identifier confirming this arm maps to the ARM domain in the SDTM submission dataset. Always 'ARM' per CDISC standard; included for regulatory submission traceability.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM v3.3 ARM Domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA CDISC Requirements

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number defining the display and processing order of arms within the study. Used for consistent ordering in reports, eCRFs, and SDTM datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the study arm became active and eligible for subject enrollment, as defined in the approved protocol or protocol amendment. Supports enrollment timeline tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: treatment_duration_days
attributes.description: Planned duration of treatment for subjects in this arm, expressed in days. Used for supply planning, visit schedule design, and protocol compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4; CDISC SDTM ARM Domain; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The username or system identifier of the user or process that last modified this study arm record. Required for audit trail compliance under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable) principle.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this study arm record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or system identifier of the user or process that created this study arm record. Required for audit trail compliance under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable) principle.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

products.name: endpoint
products.description: Defines the formal objectives and their associated endpoints (primary, secondary, exploratory) for a clinical study. Captures objective text, objective type, endpoint name, endpoint type (primary, secondary, exploratory, safety, PK, PD, biomarker), endpoint category (efficacy, safety, tolerability, PK/PD, quality of life), measurement instrument or scale, timepoint of assessment, statistical hypothesis (superiority, non-inferiority, equivalence), estimand definition per ICH E9(R1), objective-to-endpoint traceability, and CDISC ADaM parameter mapping. Provides the scientific rationale chain from objective through endpoint to SAP. Directly referenced by the biostatistics domain for analysis planning.
products.reference: ICH E9(R1) Estimands / CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: endpoint_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a study endpoint record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the study_endpoint data product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM/ADaM; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: ctcae_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.ctcae_grade. Business justification: Safety endpoints reference specific CTCAE grade thresholds (study_endpoint has ctcae_version and ctcae_grade as plain attributes). Linking to ctcae_grade supports SAP authoring, SDTM CTCAE domain mapp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: meddra_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.meddra_term. Business justification: study_endpoint has meddra_soc_code as a plain attribute — safety endpoints are defined using MedDRA terminology. Linking to meddra_term supports SDTM FATEST/CETERM mapping, signal detection alignment,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this endpoint belongs. Links the endpoint to its governing protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Endpoints are formally defined in the protocol and can be modified by amendments (e.g., changing a secondary endpoint to primary, adding exploratory endpoints). Linking endpoint to study_protocol_amen
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adam_parameter_code
attributes.description: The CDISC ADaM PARAMCD value (≤8 characters, uppercase) that uniquely identifies the analysis parameter corresponding to this endpoint within the ADaM dataset. Required for CDISC-compliant regulatory submissions to FDA and EMA.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: adam_parameter_name
attributes.description: The CDISC ADaM PARAM value — the full descriptive label for the analysis parameter corresponding to this endpoint (e.g., 'Overall Survival Time (Days)'). Displayed in analysis output tables and listings.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: alpha_level
attributes.description: The pre-specified Type I error rate (significance level) for this endpoint (e.g., 0.05 for two-sided, 0.025 for one-sided). Defined in the SAP and referenced in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: analysis_population
attributes.description: The analysis population to which this endpoint applies: Intent-to-Treat (ITT), modified ITT (mITT), Per Protocol (PP), safety, Pharmacokinetic (PK), or biomarker population. Defined in the SAP and referenced in the Clinical Study Report (CSR). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ITT|mITT|PP|safety|PK|biomarker — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: assessment_timepoint
attributes.description: The protocol-defined timepoint or window at which the endpoint is assessed (e.g., 'Week 24', 'End of Treatment', 'Month 6 ± 7 days'). Directly maps to the visit schedule and SDTM VISITNUM.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endpoint record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctcae_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Version
attributes.description: The version of the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) used to grade safety endpoints (e.g., '5.0', '4.03'). Applicable for oncology and safety-focused endpoints.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; ICH E2A

attributes.name: directionality
attributes.description: Specifies whether the statistical test for this endpoint is one-sided or two-sided. Determines the alpha allocation and critical value used in hypothesis testing.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this endpoint definition became effective, typically aligned with the protocol version approval date. Supports temporal versioning across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: The date on which this endpoint definition was superseded or retired, typically aligned with a subsequent protocol amendment. Null for currently active endpoints. Supports temporal versioning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: endpoint_category
attributes.description: Scientific domain category of the endpoint: efficacy (treatment effect), safety (harm characterisation), tolerability, Pharmacokinetics/Pharmacodynamics (PK/PD), quality of life (patient-reported outcomes), or biomarker. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: efficacy|safety|tolerability|PK_PD|quality_of_life|biomarker — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA PDUFA; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: endpoint_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this endpoint within the study (e.g., EP-PRI01, EP-SEC03). Used as the externally-known business identifier in SAP cross-references and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM PARAMCD conventions

attributes.name: endpoint_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the endpoint as defined in the study protocol, including the precise measurement, population, and timeframe. Directly referenced in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: endpoint_name
attributes.description: Short, human-readable name of the endpoint as it appears in the protocol and Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) (e.g., 'Overall Survival', 'Change from Baseline in HbA1c at Week 24').
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: endpoint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the endpoint definition: draft (under authoring), active (protocol-approved), amended (modified via protocol amendment), retired (removed from protocol), locked (post-Database Lock). Drives SAP version control.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: endpoint_type
attributes.description: Classification of the endpoint role within the study hierarchy: primary (confirmatory, drives sample size), secondary (supportive), exploratory, safety, Pharmacokinetic (PK), Pharmacodynamic (PD), or biomarker. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|exploratory|safety|PK|PD|biomarker — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: estimand_intercurrent_event_strategy
attributes.description: The strategy for handling intercurrent events per ICH E9(R1): treatment_policy (ignore occurrence), hypothetical (counterfactual), composite (incorporate into outcome), while_on_treatment (restrict to on-treatment period), or principal_stratum (condition on intercurrent event status).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands

attributes.name: estimand_population
attributes.description: The target population component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand, specifying the patient population to which the treatment effect applies (e.g., 'all randomised patients with baseline HbA1c ≥ 7.5%').
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands

attributes.name: estimand_population_level_summary
attributes.description: The population-level summary measure component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand (e.g., 'difference in means', 'hazard ratio', 'odds ratio'). Specifies how individual outcomes are aggregated to a treatment effect estimate.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands

attributes.name: estimand_treatment_condition
attributes.description: The treatment condition component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand framework, describing the treatment regimen of interest (e.g., 'randomised treatment regardless of adherence', 'treatment as prescribed').
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands

attributes.name: estimand_variable
attributes.description: The variable component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand, defining the outcome measure for each patient (e.g., 'change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24'). Directly corresponds to the ADaM analysis variable.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: measurement_instrument
attributes.description: The validated instrument, scale, or tool used to measure the endpoint (e.g., RECIST 1.1, HAMD-17, SF-36, CTCAE v5.0, EORTC QLQ-C30). Required for regulatory submission and biostatistical analysis planning.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Patient-Reported Outcomes; CTCAE v5.0; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code
attributes.description: The MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code associated with this endpoint when the endpoint relates to an adverse event or safety outcome. Enables standardised safety reporting per ICH M1.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; FDA/EMA MedDRA requirements

attributes.name: missing_data_strategy
attributes.description: The pre-specified strategy for handling missing data for this endpoint per the SAP: Last Observation Carried Forward (LOCF), Baseline Observation Carried Forward (BOCF), Multiple Imputation (MI), Mixed Model for Repeated Measures (MMRM), observed cases only, worst-case, or best-case imputation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LOCF|BOCF|MI|MMRM|observed_cases|worst_case|best_case — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); NRC Report on Missing Data in Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Missing Data

attributes.name: multiplicity_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a multiplicity adjustment (e.g., Bonferroni, Holm, Hochberg, gatekeeping procedure) is applied to this endpoint to control the family-wise error rate. Critical for confirmatory trial design and regulatory acceptance.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Multiple Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity

attributes.name: multiplicity_procedure
attributes.description: The specific statistical procedure used for multiplicity adjustment for this endpoint (e.g., 'Hochberg step-up', 'Bonferroni', 'Fixed-sequence testing', 'Graphical gatekeeping'). Populated only when multiplicity_adjustment_flag is True.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Multiple Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity

attributes.name: non_inferiority_margin
attributes.description: The pre-specified non-inferiority or equivalence margin (delta) for the endpoint, expressed in the unit of the primary outcome measure. Applicable only when statistical_hypothesis is non_inferiority or equivalence. Regulatory-critical value.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E10; FDA Guidance on Non-Inferiority Clinical Trials

attributes.name: objective_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study objective that this endpoint operationalises, enabling objective-to-endpoint traceability required by the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: The section number or heading in the study protocol document where this endpoint is formally defined (e.g., 'Section 3.2.1 Primary Endpoint'). Enables direct cross-reference to the Trial Master File (TMF).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sap_section_reference
attributes.description: The section number or heading in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) where the analysis method for this endpoint is specified. Provides the scientific rationale chain from objective through endpoint to SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain from which the source data for this endpoint is collected (e.g., AE, LB, EX, RS, TU, TR). Establishes the SDTM-to-ADaM data lineage chain required for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this endpoint within its objective type group (e.g., 1st primary, 2nd secondary). Used for hierarchical ordering in the SAP and regulatory submission tables.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this endpoint definition originates: Medidata Rave (EDC), Oracle Clinical One (study design), SAS Drug Development (biostatistical analysis), or manual entry. Supports data lineage and audit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system_endpoint_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this endpoint record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One endpoint object ID, SAS Drug Development analysis parameter ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and ETL lineage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: statistical_hypothesis
attributes.description: The formal statistical hypothesis framework applied to this endpoint: superiority (treatment better than control), non-inferiority (treatment not worse by a defined margin), equivalence (treatment within a symmetric margin), or descriptive (no formal hypothesis). Drives SAP design.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E10; FDA Guidance on Non-Inferiority Clinical Trials

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the endpoint outcome is expressed (e.g., 'months', 'mg/dL', 'mmHg', 'score', '%', 'events/patient-year'). Required for ADaM AVALU mapping and regulatory submission.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM/ADaM; UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure); FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endpoint record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change control requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: eligibility_criterion
products.description: Defines inclusion and exclusion criteria for subject enrollment in a clinical study. Records criterion number, criterion type (inclusion/exclusion), criterion text, criterion category (demographic, diagnosis, lab value, prior therapy, concomitant medication, reproductive status, other), protocol version applicability, amendment-driven change flag, CDISC SDTM IE domain mapping, and operational screening guidance notes. Authoritative source for site screening checklists and EDC eligibility modules.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM IE (Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria) Domain

attributes.name: eligibility_criterion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eligibility criterion record in the clinical study. Primary key for the eligibility_criterion data product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: meddra_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.meddra_term. Business justification: eligibility_criterion has meddra_pt_code and meddra_pt_name as plain attributes — inclusion/exclusion criteria referencing medical conditions are MedDRA-coded for SDTM IE domain mapping and regulatory
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: previous_criterion_eligibility_criterion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this criterion that was superseded by the current record. Enables full version history chain for audit trail and regulatory traceability of criterion evolution across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific protocol version under which this criterion was introduced or last modified. Supports amendment-driven criterion tracking.
