attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM IE Domain

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this eligibility criterion is defined. Links the criterion to its parent study protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: eligibility_criterion has amendment_number as a STRING and is_amendment_driven BOOLEAN flag but no FK to study_protocol_amendment. Eligibility criteria are frequently introduced or modified by protoco
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: applicable_population
attributes.description: Specifies the sub-population to which this criterion applies when it is not universally applicable to all subjects (e.g., reproductive status criteria apply to FEMALE_ONLY, pediatric dosing criteria apply to PEDIATRIC). Supports conditional screening logic.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E11 (Pediatric Studies); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: change_rationale
attributes.description: The documented scientific or operational rationale for introducing or modifying this criterion, particularly when driven by a protocol amendment. Required for regulatory submissions and IRB/IEC amendment packages.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this eligibility criterion record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: crf_page_reference
attributes.description: The page or section reference in the electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) where this eligibility criterion is assessed and documented. Used for site training, monitoring, and Source Data Verification (SDV) activities.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: criterion_category
attributes.description: Clinical or operational category classifying the nature of the criterion. Supports structured analysis and site training. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEMOGRAPHIC|DIAGNOSIS|LAB_VALUE|PRIOR_THERAPY|CONCOMITANT_MEDICATION|REPRODUCTIVE_STATUS|WASHOUT_PERIOD|CONSENT|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain (IESCAT); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: criterion_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to the criterion within its type (inclusion or exclusion) as it appears in the study protocol. Used for ordering and referencing in site screening checklists and EDC eligibility modules.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain (IESEQ); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: criterion_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or condensed label for the criterion used in EDC display, site training materials, and operational screening tools where full text is impractical. Maps to CDISC SDTM IE domain variable IETESTCD.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain (IETESTCD); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: criterion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility criterion. DRAFT indicates under review; ACTIVE indicates approved and in use; SUPERSEDED indicates replaced by an amended version; RETIRED indicates removed from the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: criterion_text
attributes.description: Full verbatim text of the eligibility criterion as written in the approved study protocol. This is the authoritative, protocol-exact wording used in site screening checklists, EDC eligibility modules, and regulatory submissions. Maps to CDISC SDTM IE domain variable IETEST.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain (IETEST); ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: criterion_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the criterion is an inclusion criterion (subject must meet) or an exclusion criterion (subject must not meet) for enrollment eligibility. Maps to CDISC SDTM IE domain variable IECAT.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain (IECAT); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: The display sequence order for this criterion within its type group (inclusion or exclusion) as it should appear in site screening checklists, EDC eligibility modules, and protocol documents. May differ from criterion_number when criteria are reordered by amendment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: edc_field_oid
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Field Object Identifier (OID)
attributes.description: The Object Identifier (OID) of the corresponding field in the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (e.g., Medidata Rave) eligibility module. Enables direct mapping between the protocol criterion and the EDC data collection form for data lineage and validation.
attributes.references: CDISC ODM (Operational Data Model); Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this criterion version became operationally effective for subject screening. Aligns with the IRB/IEC approval date of the applicable protocol version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board (IRB) / Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a change to this criterion requires formal IRB/IEC approval before implementation at sites. Typically True for all criteria changes driven by protocol amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 56

attributes.name: is_amendment_driven
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criterion was introduced or modified as a result of a protocol amendment. True when the criterion originated from or was changed by a formal protocol amendment. Critical for regulatory audit trails and amendment impact analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_critical_criterion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criterion is designated as critical, meaning a violation would constitute a major protocol deviation requiring immediate reporting to the sponsor and potentially the IRB/IEC. Critical criteria are typically safety-related or have significant impact on data integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM IE Domain

attributes.name: lab_test_code
attributes.description: The standardized laboratory test code (e.g., LOINC code or sponsor-defined code) for the lab parameter referenced in this criterion. Applicable for lab value criteria such as eGFR, hemoglobin, or platelet count thresholds.
attributes.references: LOINC; CDISC SDTM LB Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code
attributes.description: The MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code associated with the diagnosis, condition, or medical history referenced in this criterion. Enables standardized medical coding for regulatory submissions and cross-study analysis.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this eligibility criterion record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: numeric_threshold_comparator
attributes.description: The logical comparator defining the relationship between the subject's measured value and the numeric threshold (EQ=equal, NE=not equal, LT=less than, LE=less than or equal, GT=greater than, GE=greater than or equal). Used in conjunction with numeric_threshold_value.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ISO 11179

attributes.name: numeric_threshold_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the numeric threshold value (e.g., years, mL/min/1.73m², kg/m², mg/dL). Follows CDISC controlled terminology for units.
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology; CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ISO 11240

attributes.name: numeric_threshold_value
attributes.description: The quantitative threshold value associated with the criterion where applicable (e.g., age ≥ 18, eGFR ≥ 60, BMI ≤ 35). Used for lab value, vital sign, and demographic criteria that have a numeric boundary.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_version_first_applicable
attributes.description: The protocol version number (e.g., v1.0, v2.1) in which this criterion first became applicable. Used to determine which subjects enrolled under which protocol version were subject to this criterion.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IE Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_version_last_applicable
attributes.description: The protocol version number in which this criterion was last applicable before being superseded or retired. Null if the criterion is still active in the current protocol version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IE Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: requires_source_doc_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) is required for this criterion during monitoring visits. When True, the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) must verify the criterion assessment against source documents at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this criterion was retired or superseded. Null if the criterion remains active. Used to determine the applicable criterion set for subjects screened on a given date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: screening_guidance_notes
attributes.description: Operational guidance notes for site staff on how to assess and document this criterion during subject screening. May include clarifications, assessment methods, source document requirements, and common pitfalls. Sourced from the study's screening manual or site training materials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM IE Domain

attributes.name: sdtm_ie_testcd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Inclusion/Exclusion (IE) Test Code
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM-compliant short code for the criterion, conforming to the IE domain IETESTCD variable. Maximum 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters. Used for regulatory submission datasets and CDISC compliance validation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide IE Domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: The type of source document required to verify this criterion (e.g., medical records, laboratory report, imaging report, physician attestation, birth certificate). Used to guide site staff and CRAs during screening and monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this eligibility criterion record originated (e.g., Oracle Clinical One for study design, Medidata Rave for EDC eligibility module). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: source_system_criterion_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this criterion record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One criterion object ID, Medidata Rave field OID). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the source system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: time_window_unit
attributes.description: The unit of time for the time window associated with the criterion (e.g., DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, YEARS). Used for washout periods, prior therapy windows, and diagnosis recency requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: time_window_value
attributes.description: The numeric duration of the time window associated with the criterion (e.g., prior therapy washout period of 4 weeks, prior diagnosis within 6 months). Used in conjunction with time_window_unit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IE Domain

attributes.name: waiver_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation waiver or exception can be granted for this criterion on a per-subject basis. When True, a formal waiver request process is required and must be documented in the Trial Master File (TMF).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM IE Domain

attributes.name: waiver_authority
attributes.description: The body or role authorized to grant a waiver for this criterion (e.g., Medical Monitor, Sponsor Medical Director, IRB/IEC). Applicable only when waiver_allowed is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: who_dd_drug_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: World Health Organization Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) Drug Code
attributes.description: The WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) code for the medication referenced in this criterion, applicable for prior therapy or concomitant medication criteria. Enables standardized drug coding for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD); CDISC SDTM CM Domain

products.name: study_visit_schedule
products.description: Defines the planned Schedule of Events (SoE) for a clinical study including all visits and their required procedures. Captures visit name, visit number, visit type (screening, baseline, treatment, follow-up, unscheduled, end-of-study), planned study day/week, visit window tolerances, epoch association, and for each visit the specific procedures/assessments required (vital signs, lab draws, ECG, imaging, questionnaires, dosing, PK sampling, physical exam) with mandatory/optional flags, CDISC SDTM domain mappings, and eCRF form references. This is the master template for site operations, subject visit planning, and EDC configuration. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM TV (Trial Visits) Domain / Schedule of Events

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: cdisc_visit_reference
attributes.description: Standardized CDISC controlled terminology code or reference for the visit type, used to align the visit schedule with CDISC SDTM submission datasets and regulatory data packages (e.g., CDISC CT VISIT term).
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this visit schedule record was first created in the lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the visit schedule was superseded or retired, typically when a protocol amendment introduced a new schedule version. Null for the currently active schedule version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the visit schedule became effective for the study, typically aligned with protocol approval or amendment effective date. Supports temporal versioning of the Schedule of Events.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: fasting_duration_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the subject must fast prior to the visit, when fasting_required is True. Specified in the protocol and communicated to sites and subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; Protocol Schedule of Events

attributes.name: fasting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be fasting prior to this visit (e.g., for fasting lipid panels, glucose measurements, or PK sampling). Communicated to subjects via informed consent and visit reminder materials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; CDISC CDASH IG

attributes.name: is_dosing_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether investigational product (IP) administration or dosing occurs at this visit. Used by RTSM/IRT systems for drug supply planning, IP accountability tracking, and site operational scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 EX Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_in_itt_population
attributes.description: Indicates whether data collected at this visit contributes to the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Used by biostatisticians to configure ADaM datasets and analysis flags.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM IG; SAP

attributes.name: is_in_pp_population
attributes.description: Indicates whether data collected at this visit contributes to the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Supports biostatistical analysis dataset configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM IG; SAP

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the procedure is mandatory (True) or optional (False) at this visit per the protocol Schedule of Events. Mandatory procedures are required for protocol compliance; optional procedures may be performed at investigator discretion. Used in data completeness checks and query generation in EDC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: is_pk_sampling_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether Pharmacokinetics (PK) blood or urine sampling is required at this visit. Used by DMPK teams, central labs, and RTSM/IRT systems to plan sample collection kits and logistics.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 PC Domain; ICH M3(R2); FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: is_primary_endpoint_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this visit is a primary endpoint assessment visit as defined in the study protocol. Flags visits where the primary efficacy or safety endpoint data is collected, critical for data completeness monitoring and regulatory submission.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: is_randomization_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether subject randomization occurs at this visit via the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One, Medidata Rave RTSM). Critical for enrollment tracking, DSMB reporting, and regulatory milestone monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 DM Domain

attributes.name: is_unscheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this visit is an unscheduled visit (True) that occurs outside the planned Schedule of Events, typically triggered by a safety event, adverse event follow-up, or investigator decision. Unscheduled visits are tracked separately in CTMS and EDC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or footnotes associated with this visit or procedure as specified in the protocol Schedule of Events (e.g., 'Perform only if subject is female of childbearing potential', 'Collect within 30 minutes of dosing'). Captures protocol-specific instructions for site staff.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; Protocol Schedule of Events

attributes.name: planned_study_day
attributes.description: The planned study day on which this visit is scheduled to occur, relative to the study reference start date (Day 1 = first dose or randomization). Negative values indicate pre-treatment visits (e.g., Day -14 for screening). Aligns with CDISC SDTM VISITDY variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain VISITDY; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_study_week
attributes.description: The planned study week on which this visit is scheduled, derived from planned_study_day for reporting convenience. Used in study timelines, subject visit planning, and site management dashboards.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: procedure_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the clinical procedure or assessment. Drives CDISC SDTM domain mapping, EDC form routing, and operational planning for site staff. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vital_signs|laboratory|ecg|imaging|dosing|pk_sampling|physical_exam|questionnaire|biomarker|concomitant_medication|adverse_event|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: procedure_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific clinical procedure or assessment required at this visit (e.g., Vital Signs, 12-Lead ECG, Hematology Lab Panel, PK Blood Draw, Physical Examination, Patient-Reported Outcome Questionnaire, Study Drug Dosing). Each visit-procedure combination is a distinct record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: procedure_sequence
attributes.description: Ordering sequence of the procedure within a visit, defining the recommended order of assessments (e.g., vital signs before blood draw, ECG before dosing). Used for site operational workflow and EDC form ordering.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; CDISC CDASH IG; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: requires_central_lab
attributes.description: Indicates whether samples collected at this visit-procedure must be processed by the central laboratory (True) rather than a local laboratory. Drives sample kit logistics, central lab requisition, and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LB Domain

attributes.name: requires_local_lab
attributes.description: Indicates whether samples collected at this visit-procedure are to be processed by the site local laboratory. Used for safety lab monitoring where rapid turnaround is required (e.g., pre-dose safety labs).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LB Domain

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this Schedule of Events (SoE), aligned with the protocol amendment version (e.g., v1.0, v2.0, Amendment 1). Tracks iterative changes to the visit schedule over the study lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The two-letter CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) domain code to which data collected at this visit-procedure maps (e.g., VS for Vital Signs, LB for Laboratory, EG for ECG, EX for Exposure/Dosing, PC for Pharmacokinetics, QS for Questionnaires, PE for Physical Examination). Critical for regulatory submission data package preparation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this visit schedule record was sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, Oracle Clinical One). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across systems in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: source_system_visit_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this visit record in the originating operational system (Medidata Rave or Oracle Clinical One). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this visit schedule record was last modified in the lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: visit_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated duration of the visit in minutes as defined in the protocol or site operational plan. Used for site scheduling, resource planning, and subject burden assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS Site Management

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the clinical visit as defined in the protocol Schedule of Events (e.g., Screening, Baseline, Week 4, End of Treatment, Follow-Up 1). Aligns with CDISC SDTM VISIT variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6

attributes.name: visit_number
attributes.description: Sequential numeric identifier for the visit within the study schedule (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Used for ordering visits and aligns with CDISC SDTM VISITNUM variable. Unscheduled visits may use decimal values represented as separate records.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: visit_short_label
attributes.description: Abbreviated label for the visit used in EDC (Electronic Data Capture) systems, reports, and data listings (e.g., SCR, BL, W04, EOT, FU1). Configured in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One for eCRF navigation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; Medidata Rave Study Design

attributes.name: visit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this visit schedule record. Draft indicates under development; active indicates approved and in use; amended indicates modified by a protocol amendment; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; retired indicates no longer applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visit by its functional role in the study timeline. Drives site operational planning, subject visit tracking in CTMS, and CDISC SDTM epoch mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screening|baseline|treatment|follow_up|end_of_study|unscheduled|early_termination|safety — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: window_after_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the planned study day that the visit may occur and still be considered protocol-compliant (late visit tolerance). Used by sites and CTMS to flag out-of-window visits. Aligns with CDISC SDTM TVENRL variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain TVENRL; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: window_before_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the planned study day that the visit may occur and still be considered protocol-compliant (early visit tolerance). Used by sites and CTMS to flag out-of-window visits. Aligns with CDISC SDTM TVSTRL variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 TV Domain TVSTRL; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: visit_procedure
products.description: Defines the specific clinical procedures, assessments, and data collection activities required at each scheduled visit. Records procedure name, procedure category (vital signs, lab draw, ECG, imaging, questionnaire, dosing, PK sampling, physical exam, biopsy, ECOG assessment), visit association, whether the procedure is mandatory or optional, CDISC SDTM domain mapping for the procedure, and eCRF form reference in Medidata Rave. Enables the Schedule of Events matrix construction.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM Schedule of Events / eCRF Design

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific protocol version or amendment under which this visit procedure was defined. Enables tracking of procedure changes across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) to which this visit procedure belongs. Links the procedure to its parent study context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled visit (study visit) at which this procedure is to be performed. Establishes the visit-procedure association in the Schedule of Events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV (Trial Visits) Domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: adam_dataset
attributes.description: CDISC ADaM dataset name to which this procedure's data contributes for statistical analysis (e.g., ADLB, ADVS, ADEG, ADPC). Used by SAS Drug Development for biostatistical analysis and CSR generation.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: cdash_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization (CDASH) Domain
attributes.description: CDISC CDASH domain code that defines the data collection standard for this procedure's eCRF (e.g., VS, LB, EG, PE). Ensures the eCRF design in Medidata Rave aligns with CDASH standards for downstream SDTM mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH Implementation Guide v2.0; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: central_lab_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specimens collected by this procedure must be processed by the sponsor-designated central laboratory (as opposed to a local site laboratory). Drives sample kit supply chain and central lab requisition workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; Central Laboratory Agreement; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this visit procedure record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctcae_grading_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grading Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether CTCAE grading criteria apply to results collected by this procedure (e.g., laboratory abnormalities graded per CTCAE v5.0). Drives safety data review workflows and adverse event reporting linkage.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; ICH E2A; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this procedure definition was retired or superseded by a protocol amendment. Null for currently active procedures. Used to determine which procedure version applies to a given subject visit date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this procedure definition became effective in the study protocol. For amended procedures, reflects the date the amendment was approved and implemented at sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of clinical equipment or device required to perform this procedure at the site (e.g., 'Holter Monitor', 'Spirometer', 'Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry (DXA) Scanner', 'Electrocardiograph'). Used for site feasibility assessment and equipment qualification tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; ISO 14155; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to complete this procedure at the site. Used for visit duration planning, site burden assessment, and subject scheduling optimization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS Visit Planning; Protocol Feasibility Assessment

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure is required (mandatory) or optional at the associated visit per the study protocol. Mandatory procedures must be completed for the visit to be considered evaluable; optional procedures may be performed at investigator discretion.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; CDISC SDTM TV Domain

attributes.name: is_pk_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure involves pharmacokinetic (PK) sample collection or assessment. PK procedures require precise timing relative to dosing and specialized sample handling per the bioanalytical plan.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; ICH M10; CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains

attributes.name: is_primary_endpoint
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure collects data that directly contributes to the study's primary efficacy or safety endpoint. Used to prioritize monitoring, SDV, and data cleaning activities.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: is_safety_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure is designated as a safety assessment per the protocol (e.g., safety labs, ECG for QTc monitoring, vital signs for blood pressure monitoring). Drives safety data review workflows and DSMB/DMC reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; ICH E2A; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: local_lab_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether local site laboratory processing is permitted for this procedure (e.g., for safety monitoring labs that require rapid turnaround). May coexist with central_lab_required for procedures requiring both central and local processing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Protocol Laboratory Manual; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for protocol-specific instructions, special handling requirements, or clarifications related to this procedure that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., 'Collect sample within 2 hours of dosing', 'Perform in triplicate').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Protocol Schedule of Events Footnotes

attributes.name: oracle_clinical_one_task_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding task or activity in Oracle Clinical One study design module. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse visit procedure record and the Oracle Clinical One study build configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One Study Design Module; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: procedure_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the clinical procedure type used to group procedures in the Schedule of Events matrix and CDISC SDTM domain mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vital_signs|lab_draw|ecg|imaging|questionnaire|dosing|pk_sampling|physical_exam|biopsy|ecog_assessment|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the procedure within the study protocol (e.g., VITALS-01, LBDRAW-02, ECG-01). Used as the business identifier for the procedure in the Schedule of Events matrix and eCRF mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; Medidata Rave EDC Configuration

attributes.name: procedure_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the clinical procedure, including instructions, conditions, and any protocol-specific requirements (e.g., fasting requirements, timing relative to dosing, specimen handling instructions).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: procedure_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the clinical procedure or assessment (e.g., 'Vital Signs', '12-Lead ECG', 'Fasting Blood Draw', 'ECOG Performance Status Assessment'). Used in Schedule of Events displays and site training materials.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: procedure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the visit procedure definition within the study protocol. Draft procedures are under development; active procedures are in use; amended procedures have been modified by protocol amendment; retired procedures are no longer required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: qualified_personnel_required
attributes.description: Specifies the qualification or role required to perform this procedure (e.g., 'Phlebotomist', 'Radiologist', 'Cardiologist', 'Trained Study Nurse'). Used for site staff delegation log and training requirement planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Delegation of Authority Log

attributes.name: rave_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Medidata Rave eCRF form associated with this procedure (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Tracks form versioning to ensure data collected aligns with the correct protocol version and supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC Study Build Standards; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5

attributes.name: requires_fasting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be in a fasting state prior to this procedure (e.g., fasting lipid panel, fasting glucose). Drives subject instruction materials and visit scheduling constraints.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Protocol-specific laboratory manual; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: requires_unscheduled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure definition applies to unscheduled visits (e.g., safety follow-up, early termination). Distinguishes procedures that are only applicable at unscheduled visits from those in the planned Schedule of Events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV Domain; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain code to which this procedure's collected data maps (e.g., VS=Vital Signs, LB=Laboratory Test Results, EG=ECG Test Results, EX=Exposure, PE=Physical Examination). Drives SDTM dataset construction for regulatory submission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VS|LB|EG|IE|DS|AE|CM|EX|MH|PE|PR|SC|TU|RS|FA|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdv_requirement
attributes.description: Specifies the Source Data Verification (SDV) requirement level for data collected by this procedure. Drives risk-based monitoring plans and CRA visit scope. 100_percent requires full SDV; risk_based applies statistical sampling; critical_only limits SDV to primary endpoint data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of the procedure within the visit, defining the recommended execution sequence (e.g., 1=vital signs, 2=blood draw, 3=ECG). Used to generate the ordered Schedule of Events and site procedure checklists.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV Domain; ICH E6(R2) Section 6.4

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen collected during this procedure, if applicable (e.g., blood, urine, tissue biopsy, CSF). Drives laboratory supply chain planning, sample handling instructions, and CDISC SDTM LBSPEC mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|urine|csf|tissue|saliva|stool|plasma|serum|whole_blood|not_applicable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB Domain LBSPEC variable; WHO Laboratory Manual; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: specimen_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of biological specimen required for this procedure in millilitres (mL). Used for blood volume tracking per subject visit, laboratory supply planning, and protocol feasibility assessment (total blood volume per subject).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Blood Volume in Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: timing_reference
attributes.description: Specifies the timing reference point for procedure execution relative to a clinical anchor event (e.g., pre_dose, post_dose, fasting). Critical for PK sampling, vital signs, and lab draws where timing relative to dosing affects data interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_dose|post_dose|any_time|fasting|pre_meal|post_meal|bedtime|morning|evening — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EPOCH/TAETORD; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Guidance

attributes.name: timing_window_post_minutes
attributes.description: Allowable time window in minutes after the nominal procedure time point (positive offset). Defines the acceptable late execution window for protocol compliance assessment (e.g., +30 minutes for a post-dose PK sample).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.4; CDISC SDTM SUPPQUAL; FDA Protocol Deviation Guidance

attributes.name: timing_window_pre_minutes
attributes.description: Allowable time window in minutes before the nominal procedure time point (negative offset). Defines the acceptable early execution window for protocol compliance assessment (e.g., -30 minutes for a pre-dose PK sample).

Captures epoch name, epoch short name, epoch sequence number, epoch type, planned duration, and CDISC SDTM TE domain mapping. Epochs provide the temporal framework for visit scheduling, subject disposition, and SDTM dataset construction.

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a study epoch record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the study_epoch data product.

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific protocol version that defines this epoch. Epochs may be added, removed, or modified across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this epoch belongs. Links the epoch to its governing study protocol.

attributes.name: ae_reporting_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse event (AE) and serious adverse event (SAE) collection and reporting obligations are active during this epoch. Drives safety data collection rules in the EDC and Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding methodology applied during this epoch as specified in the protocol. Determines data access controls and unblinding procedures applicable to the epoch period.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this epoch record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail requirements under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.3

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this epoch definition version ceased to be effective, typically due to a protocol amendment superseding it. Null for the currently active epoch definition version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this epoch definition version became effective in the study protocol. Used for amendment tracking and determining which epoch definition applies to a given subject enrollment date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: epoch_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the epoch's purpose, activities, and clinical objectives as specified in the study protocol. Provides context for data reviewers and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: epoch_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the study epoch as defined in the protocol (e.g., 'Screening', 'Run-in', 'Treatment Period 1', 'Washout', 'Follow-up', 'Extension'). Maps to CDISC SDTM TE.EPOCH variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE Domain; CDISC Controlled Terminology CT v2023-09-29

attributes.name: epoch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the epoch definition within the study protocol. DRAFT indicates under development; ACTIVE indicates approved and in use; AMENDED indicates modified by protocol amendment; SUPERSEDED indicates replaced by a newer version; RETIRED indicates no longer applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: epoch_type
attributes.description: Controlled vocabulary classification of the epoch's functional purpose within the study design. Drives SDTM dataset construction and subject disposition analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SCREENING|RUN-IN|TREATMENT|WASHOUT|FOLLOW-UP|EXTENSION|BASELINE|OPEN-LABEL|DOUBLE-BLIND|SINGLE-BLIND|PLACEBO|OBSERVATION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology — Epoch Type (C99079); CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: extension_epoch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch is an optional or mandatory study extension period beyond the core treatment phase. Extension epochs may have separate regulatory approval requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Long-Term Extension Studies; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: follow_up_epoch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch is a post-treatment follow-up period for safety monitoring and long-term outcome assessment. Drives safety reporting timelines and subject disposition coding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: ip_administered
attributes.description: Indicates whether investigational product (IP) is administered to subjects during this epoch. Drives IP accountability tracking, supply chain planning, and SDTM exposure domain (EX) linkage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch record has been logically deleted (soft delete). True = record is logically deleted and should be excluded from active queries; False = record is active. Supports data retention compliance without physical deletion.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: itt_population_epoch
attributes.description: Indicates whether subject participation in this epoch contributes to Intent-to-Treat (ITT) population eligibility determination. Used in biostatistical analysis and SAP population definitions.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC ADaM IG

attributes.name: maximum_duration_days
attributes.description: Protocol-specified maximum number of days a subject may remain in this epoch before mandatory transition or discontinuation. Enforced by CTMS and EDC visit scheduling logic.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: minimum_duration_days
attributes.description: Protocol-specified minimum number of days a subject must remain in this epoch to be considered evaluable. Used for per-protocol (PP) population eligibility determination.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4

attributes.name: planned_duration_days
attributes.description: Protocol-specified planned duration of the epoch expressed in days. Used for visit scheduling, subject timeline calculations, and study feasibility planning. Maps to CDISC SDTM TE.TEDUR (ISO 8601 duration converted to days for analytics).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4

attributes.name: planned_duration_iso
attributes.description: Protocol-specified planned duration of the epoch expressed in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., 'P28D', 'P4W', 'P6M'). This is the authoritative CDISC SDTM TE.TEDUR value used for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE.TEDUR; ISO 8601 Duration Standard

attributes.name: planned_end_day
attributes.description: Protocol-defined study day on which this epoch is planned to end, relative to the study reference start date. Used for visit schedule construction and subject timeline alignment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4

attributes.name: planned_start_day
attributes.description: Protocol-defined study day on which this epoch is planned to begin, relative to the study reference start date (Day 1). Used for visit schedule construction and subject timeline alignment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.4

attributes.name: primary_endpoint_epoch
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary efficacy endpoint assessments are collected during this epoch. Used in statistical analysis plan (SAP) to define the primary analysis window.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.5

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section number or identifier within the study protocol document that defines this epoch (e.g., 'Section 6.2.1'). Enables traceability between the data model and the source protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: randomization_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether subject randomization occurs during this epoch. True = randomization event occurs within this epoch (e.g., Treatment Period 1 start); False = no randomization in this epoch.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; Oracle Clinical One RTSM

attributes.name: sdtm_epoch_code
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM controlled terminology code for the epoch as submitted in the Trial Elements (TE) domain ETCD variable. Must conform to CDISC CT epoch codelist (C99079). Used for regulatory submission dataset construction.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE.ETCD; CDISC Controlled Terminology C99079; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_te_domain_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC SDTM Trial Elements (TE) Domain Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch record is mapped and included in the CDISC SDTM Trial Elements (TE) domain for regulatory submission. True = included in TE domain; False = excluded (e.g., internal planning epoch not submitted).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE Domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of the epoch within the study timeline. Determines the chronological position of the epoch relative to other epochs. Maps to CDISC SDTM TE.TEPRNM variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE Domain

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or short label for the epoch used in data displays, visit schedules, and SDTM dataset headers (e.g., 'SCR', 'RUN', 'TRT1', 'WASH', 'FU'). Maps to CDISC SDTM TE.ETCD variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — TE Domain; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: source_system_epoch_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this epoch as recorded in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One study design module or Medidata Rave EDC). Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this epoch definition was sourced (e.g., Oracle Clinical One, Medidata Rave). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: treatment_arm_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch applies to a specific treatment arm only (True) or is common across all arms of the study (False). Relevant for crossover and multi-arm study designs.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this epoch record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.3

attributes.name: washout_epoch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch is a washout period during which prior treatment effects are expected to dissipate before the next treatment period. Used in crossover study design analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: window_after_days
attributes.description: Allowable number of days after the planned epoch start date within which the epoch transition is considered protocol-compliant. Used for protocol deviation assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: window_before_days
attributes.description: Allowable number of days before the planned epoch start date within which the epoch transition is considered protocol-compliant. Used for protocol deviation assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Medidata Rave EDC

Supports CTMS timeline tracking, sponsor reporting, and study performance analytics in Oracle Siebel CTMS.

attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this milestone belongs. Links the milestone to the study protocol and overall study lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.description: Reference to the protocol amendment that introduced or modified this milestone. Null if the milestone was defined in the original protocol. Supports change impact traceability per GCP requirements.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: achievement_confirmed_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual who formally confirmed and recorded the milestone as achieved in the CTMS. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: achievement_confirmed_timestamp

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the milestone was actually achieved. Null if the milestone has not yet been reached. Compared against planned_date to compute schedule variance for sponsor reporting and KPI tracking.

attributes.name: actual_enrollment_count

attributes.name: baseline_date

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, sponsor communications, or contextual information related to the milestone. Supports collaborative tracking and audit documentation in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: completion_criteria
attributes.description: Formal, measurable criteria that must be satisfied for the milestone to be considered achieved (e.g., '100% of target sites activated', 'All CRFs locked and queries resolved'). Supports objective milestone verification.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this milestone record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ctms_milestone_ref
attributes.description: Native milestone identifier from the Oracle Siebel CTMS source system. Preserved for cross-system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this milestone record originated (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS, Oracle Clinical One, manual entry). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Databricks Lakehouse

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: Type of scheduling dependency between this milestone and its predecessor (e.g., Finish-to-Start means the predecessor must finish before this milestone can start). Supports critical path method (CPM) scheduling in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: The current best-estimate date for milestone achievement, updated dynamically as study conditions evolve. Distinct from planned_date (baseline) and actual_date (confirmed). Supports rolling forecast reporting to sponsors.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_contractual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is tied to a contractual obligation with the sponsor (e.g., payment trigger, deliverable deadline). Contractual milestones are tracked for financial and legal compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone lies on the critical path of the study schedule. Critical path milestones directly impact the overall study completion date and receive heightened monitoring attention from the sponsor and CRO.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_regulatory_milestone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone has a direct regulatory reporting obligation (e.g., IND submission, first patient enrolled notification, DBL, NDA/BLA submission). Regulatory milestones trigger compliance tracking and health authority notifications.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lead_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of days of lead (negative) or lag (positive) applied to the dependency relationship with the predecessor milestone. Allows scheduling flexibility where a milestone can start before or must wait after its predecessor.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: milestone_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the milestone for portfolio-level reporting and sponsor dashboards. Distinguishes operational milestones (site activation, monitoring) from regulatory (IND, NDA/BLA submissions) and data management (DBL, CSR) milestones.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the milestone within the study (e.g., FPFV, LPLV, DBL, CSR_SUBMIT). Used as the business identifier in CTMS and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the milestone, including entry/exit criteria, acceptance conditions, and any special instructions. Provides context beyond the milestone_name for operational teams and auditors.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone (e.g., 'First Patient First Visit', 'Last Patient Last Visit', 'Database Lock', 'Clinical Study Report Submission'). Used in sponsor dashboards and CTMS timeline views.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the milestone indicating whether it has been achieved, is pending, is delayed relative to plan, has been waived, or cancelled. Core field for CTMS timeline tracking and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the milestone by its operational or regulatory function. Drives reporting groupings and critical path analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protocol_approval|site_activation|enrollment|data_collection|safety|regulatory_submission|database_lock|study_closeout|csr_submission|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether achievement of this milestone triggers a formal notification to the sponsor, health authority, IRB/IEC, or other stakeholder. Drives automated alert workflows in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the milestone achievement notification was dispatched to the relevant stakeholders. Null if notification has not yet been sent. Supports compliance audit trails for regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled calendar date by which this milestone was expected to be achieved, as defined in the study protocol or project plan. Used as the baseline for variance calculations and critical path analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: The organizational unit or role accountable for achieving this milestone (e.g., Sponsor, CRO, Site, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Used for accountability tracking and escalation routing in CTMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sponsor|cro|site|data_management|biostatistics|regulatory_affairs|safety|finance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this milestone within the study's overall milestone schedule. Defines the logical ordering of milestones for timeline visualization and Gantt chart rendering in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: Clinical development phase of the study at the time this milestone is defined (Phase 1, 2, 3, 4). Contextualizes the milestone within the drug development lifecycle for portfolio analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phase_1|phase_1_2|phase_2|phase_2_3|phase_3|phase_4|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E8; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: target_enrollment_count
attributes.description: For enrollment-type milestones (e.g., FPFV, 50% enrollment, LPLV), the target number of subjects to be enrolled at the time of milestone achievement. Provides quantitative context for enrollment milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this milestone record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the planned_date and the actual_date (or forecast_date if not yet achieved). Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion. Used for sponsor KPI reporting and study performance analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: variance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for any deviation between the planned and actual/forecast milestone date. Required when variance_days is non-zero. Supports root cause analysis and CAPA tracking per GCP requirements.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized coded classification of the variance reason to enable aggregate analysis across studies and portfolios. Complements the free-text variance_reason field. attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the authorized individual who approved the milestone waiver. Required when milestone_status is 'waived'. Supports GCP compliance and sponsor governance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Documented rationale for waiving a milestone when milestone_status is 'waived'. Required for regulatory audit trail and sponsor approval. Captures the business or scientific justification for the waiver decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+
