attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investigational product master record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ principles, and change management tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: who_dd_code
attributes.description: WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) drug code assigned to the investigational product for standardized drug coding in adverse event reporting, SDTM datasets, and regulatory submissions. Enables cross-study signal detection in Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM CM/EX domains; ICH E2B(R3)

products.name: dosing_regimen
products.description: Defines the dosing regimen for each investigational product within a study arm. Records regimen name, dose level, dose unit, dosing frequency, dosing route, dosing duration, dose escalation scheme (for dose-escalation studies), dose modification rules, maximum tolerated dose (MTD) flag, and CDISC SDTM EX (Exposure) domain mapping. Supports PK/PD modeling and safety dose-response analysis.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM EX (Exposure) Domain / ICH E4

attributes.name: dosing_regimen_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the dosing regimen record within the Clinical Trials data platform. Primary key for the dosing_regimen product in the study domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Regulatory approvals specify the approved dosing regimen on the product label. Post-approval change management and label reconciliation require tracing which dosing_regimen record was approved, enabli
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study arm (treatment group) to which this dosing regimen applies. A study may have multiple arms each with distinct regimens (e.g., active drug arm vs. placebo arm).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM ARM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.epoch. Business justification: A dosing regimen is active during a specific study epoch (e.g., a loading dose regimen during the Run-in epoch, a maintenance dose regimen during the Treatment epoch). dosing_regimen already has effec
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational product (IP) being administered under this dosing regimen. Supports traceability from regimen to supply chain and accountability logs.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXTRT; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study for which this dosing regimen is defined. Links the regimen to the study protocol and all associated study-level metadata.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: dosing_regimen has amendment_number as a STRING but no FK to study_protocol_amendment. Dosing regimens are introduced or modified by protocol amendments — this FK formalizes that traceability. No bidi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adam_adex_mapping_notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC ADaM Exposure (ADEX) Domain Mapping Notes
attributes.description: Notes describing how this dosing regimen maps to the CDISC ADaM ADEX (Analysis Dataset for Exposure) domain, including derivation rules for cumulative dose, dose intensity, and relative dose intensity calculations used in biostatistical analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADEX Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA Statistical Review Guidance; SAP

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding level applied to this dosing regimen as defined in the study protocol (e.g., 'double-blind' where neither subject nor investigator knows the treatment assignment). Impacts RTSM/IRT dispensing logic and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TI Domain; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: comparator_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regimen represents an active investigational product, placebo, vehicle control, sham procedure, or no-treatment arm. Critical for ITT and PP population definitions and regulatory benefit-risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E10 Choice of Control Group; CDISC SDTM TA Domain; FDA Guidance on Placebo Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dosing regimen record was first created in the data platform, conforming to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dose_escalation_step
attributes.description: Sequential step number within the dose escalation scheme (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Enables ordering of dose cohorts in escalation studies and supports dose-response curve construction in PK/PD modeling.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies; ICH E9

attributes.name: dose_form
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical form of the investigational product as administered (e.g., 'TABLET', 'CAPSULE', 'SOLUTION FOR INJECTION', 'PATCH'). Conforms to CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRM controlled terminology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TABLET|CAPSULE|SOLUTION FOR INJECTION|PATCH|POWDER|CREAM|SUPPOSITORY|INHALER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRM; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA NDA/BLA Labeling

attributes.name: dose_level
attributes.description: Numeric dose amount to be administered per dosing event as specified in the protocol (e.g., 10.0, 50.5, 100.0). Represents the planned dose per administration. Used in PK/PD modeling and dose-response analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSE; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: dose_modification_rules
attributes.description: Narrative description of protocol-defined rules for dose modifications, reductions, interruptions, or discontinuations based on toxicity or adverse events (e.g., 'Reduce by 25% for Grade 2 AE; discontinue for Grade 3 SAE'). Supports safety monitoring and CTCAE-based dose management.
attributes.references: CTCAE v5.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: dose_reduction_levels
attributes.description: Number of permitted dose reduction levels defined in the protocol (e.g., 2 levels: Level -1 and Level -2). Used in oncology studies to manage toxicity while maintaining therapeutic benefit. Supports safety dose-response analysis.
attributes.references: CTCAE v5.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Oncology Drug Dosing

attributes.name: dose_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the dose level (e.g., 'mg', 'mg/kg', 'mg/m2', 'mcg/kg'). Conforms to CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSU controlled terminology. Essential for PK/PD modeling and regulatory submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg|mg/kg|mg/m2|mcg|mcg/kg|IU|mL|g — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSU; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E9

attributes.name: dosing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of dose administration using standard clinical abbreviations (e.g., 'QD' = once daily, 'BID' = twice daily, 'QW' = once weekly, 'Q2W' = every two weeks). Conforms to CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRQ controlled terminology. Drives subject visit scheduling and PK sampling windows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QD|BID|TID|QID|QW|BIW|TIW|Q2W|Q4W|ONCE|PRN — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRQ; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E9

attributes.name: dosing_interval_days
attributes.description: Numeric interval between doses expressed in days (e.g., 1.0 for QD, 0.5 for BID, 7.0 for QW). Provides machine-readable precision for automated scheduling in RTSM/IRT systems and PK modeling when frequency alone is insufficient.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E9

attributes.name: dosing_route
attributes.description: Route by which the investigational product is administered (e.g., 'ORAL', 'INTRAVENOUS', 'SUBCUTANEOUS', 'INTRAMUSCULAR', 'TOPICAL', 'INHALATION'). Conforms to CDISC SDTM EX.EXROUTE controlled terminology. Critical for PK absorption modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORAL|INTRAVENOUS|SUBCUTANEOUS|INTRAMUSCULAR|TOPICAL|INHALATION|INTRANASAL|TRANSDERMAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXROUTE; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH M9 Biopharmaceutics Classification

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this dosing regimen version ceased to be effective (e.g., superseded by an amendment). Null for currently active regimens. Supports temporal versioning and historical audit of regimen changes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this dosing regimen version became effective in the study, typically aligned with protocol approval or amendment approval date. Supports temporal versioning of regimen changes across the study lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: escalation_scheme_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the dose escalation scheme applied in this regimen (e.g., '3+3 design', 'Accelerated Titration', 'BOIN design', 'mTPI-2'). Populated only when is_dose_escalation = True. Supports Phase I safety and PK/PD analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies; ICH E9; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: food_effect_instruction
attributes.description: Protocol-defined instruction regarding food intake relative to dosing (e.g., 'fasted' = at least 8 hours fasting before dose, 'fed' = standard high-fat meal before dose). Impacts PK absorption and bioavailability. Conforms to FDA food effect guidance.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Food-Effect Bioavailability Studies; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH M9

attributes.name: infusion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of intravenous or subcutaneous infusion in minutes, applicable when dosing_route is 'INTRAVENOUS' or similar. Null for non-infusion routes. Critical for PK modeling of IV drug exposure and site nursing procedure planning.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDUR; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: is_dose_escalation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regimen is part of a dose-escalation scheme (True) or a fixed-dose regimen (False). When True, the escalation_scheme_description and mtd_flag fields become operationally relevant. Common in Phase I oncology studies.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: is_mtd
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dose level has been designated as the Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD) by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or study team (True = MTD confirmed). Critical for Phase I dose-finding studies and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on MTD Determination; ICH E9; DSMB Charter; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: loading_dose_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days the loading dose is administered before transitioning to the maintenance dose. Null if no loading dose is defined. Supports PK/PD modeling of drug accumulation and steady-state calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; DMPK principles

attributes.name: loading_dose_level
attributes.description: Initial higher dose administered to rapidly achieve therapeutic drug concentrations before transitioning to the maintenance dose level. Expressed in the same unit as dose_unit. Null if no loading dose is specified in the protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; DMPK principles

attributes.name: maximum_dose_level
attributes.description: Maximum allowable dose level for this regimen as defined in the protocol (e.g., dose cap for safety). Expressed in the same unit as dose_unit. Used in dose modification rules and safety monitoring.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: pd_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pharmacodynamic (PD) biomarker assessments are required for subjects on this dosing regimen (True = PD assessments mandated per protocol). Supports PK/PD modeling and dose-response analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PD Studies; CDISC SDTM CE/FA Domains; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: pk_sampling_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pharmacokinetic (PK) blood sampling is required for subjects on this dosing regimen (True = PK sampling mandated per protocol). Drives PK visit scheduling, sample collection logistics, and DMPK analysis planning.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: planned_duration_days
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the dosing regimen expressed in days as specified in the study protocol (e.g., 84 days for a 12-week treatment period). Used for treatment period planning, supply forecasting, and CDISC SDTM EX.EXENDY derivation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXENDY; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol under which this dosing regimen was defined or last amended (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Enables traceability of regimen changes across protocol amendments. Supports TMF/eTMF document management and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: randomization_ratio
attributes.description: Allocation ratio for randomization to this arm/regimen expressed as a colon-separated ratio (e.g., '1:1', '2:1', '1:1:1'). Used in RTSM/IRT configuration and statistical analysis plan (SAP) for sample size and power calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM TA Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: regimen_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this dosing regimen within the study protocol (e.g., 'REG-001', 'ARM-A-DOSE-1'). Used in protocol documents, eCRFs, and CDISC SDTM EX submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regimen_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the dosing regimen as defined in the study protocol (e.g., 'Low Dose QD', 'High Dose BID', 'Placebo TIW'). Used in protocol documents, SAP, and CSR narratives.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regimen_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dosing regimen within the study. 'draft' indicates protocol development; 'active' indicates currently administered; 'suspended' indicates temporarily halted (e.g., pending safety review); 'discontinued' indicates permanently stopped; 'completed' indicates all subjects have completed this regimen.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sdtm_ex_mapping_notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC SDTM Exposure (EX) Domain Mapping Notes
attributes.description: Notes describing how this dosing regimen maps to the CDISC SDTM EX (Exposure) domain variables, including any derivation logic, controlled terminology mappings, or special handling required for regulatory submission datasets. Supports CDISC compliance and eCTD submission.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide EX Domain; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this dosing regimen record was sourced or is managed (e.g., 'Oracle Clinical One' for study design, 'Medidata Rave' for EDC-captured exposure data). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: starting_dose_level
attributes.description: Initial dose amount at the start of the regimen, particularly relevant for titration or escalation regimens where the dose changes over time. Expressed in the same unit as dose_unit. Supports PK/PD baseline modeling.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies

attributes.name: treatment_period_label
attributes.description: Label identifying the treatment period within the study to which this regimen applies (e.g., 'Period 1', 'Run-In', 'Maintenance', 'Extension'). Supports crossover and multi-period study designs. Maps to CDISC SDTM EX.EPOCH.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EPOCH; CDISC Study Design Model; ICH E9

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dosing regimen record was last modified in the data platform, conforming to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: washout_period_days
attributes.description: Duration of the washout period in days required between treatment periods in crossover studies, or between prior therapy and study treatment. Null for parallel-group designs. Supports PK carryover analysis and crossover study scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Guidance on Crossover Studies

products.name: objective
products.description: Formally documents the primary, secondary, and exploratory objectives of a clinical study as stated in the protocol. Captures objective number, objective type (primary, secondary, exploratory), objective text, associated endpoint references, ICH E9(R1) estimand linkage, and protocol version in which the objective was introduced or modified. Provides the scientific rationale traceability from objective to endpoint to SAP.
products.reference: ICH E9(R1) / ICH E6(R2) Protocol Objectives

attributes.name: objective_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a study objective record in the clinical trial data platform. Primary key for the study_objective entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice

attributes.name: primary_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary endpoint directly associated with this objective. Establishes the objective-to-endpoint traceability chain required by the SAP and regulatory submissions. Nullable for objectives that map to multiple endpoints.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this objective belongs. Links the objective to its governing protocol and study master record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM OI Domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Study objectives are formally stated in the protocol and can be modified by amendments (e.g., refining the primary objective, adding secondary objectives). Linking objective to study_protocol_amendmen
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adam_dataset_reference
attributes.description: CDISC ADaM dataset name(s) used for the primary analysis supporting this objective (e.g., ADEFF, ADTTE, ADAE). Provides direct linkage from objective to analysis-ready datasets in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA Data Standards Catalog; PMDA Data Standards

attributes.name: alpha_level
attributes.description: Pre-specified Type I error rate (significance level) allocated to this objective in the SAP. Typically 0.05 for primary objectives or a fraction thereof when multiplicity adjustments are applied. Drives sample size calculations and hypothesis testing.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this objective (as part of the protocol or amendment) received formal approval from the sponsor and/or IRB/IEC. Marks the transition from draft to active status and is required for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this study objective record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: csr_section_reference
attributes.description: Section number within the Clinical Study Report (CSR) where results for this objective are reported. Provides traceability from protocol objective through analysis to regulatory submission document per ICH E3 CSR structure.
attributes.references: ICH E3 Structure and Content of Clinical Study Reports; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; eCTD

attributes.name: ctd_section_reference
attributes.description: Module and section reference within the Common Technical Document (CTD) / electronic CTD (eCTD) where this objective's results contribute to the regulatory dossier (e.g., Module 5.3.5.1). Supports regulatory submission traceability.
attributes.references: ICH M4E(R2) CTD Efficacy; eCTD Specification; FDA NDA/BLA Submission Requirements

attributes.name: dsmb_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether interim results for this objective are to be reviewed by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) during planned interim analyses. Drives interim analysis planning and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the objective ceased to be effective, typically due to a protocol amendment superseding it. Null for currently active objectives. Supports temporal versioning of protocol objectives.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the objective became effective in the approved protocol. For original protocol objectives, this is the initial protocol approval date. For amended objectives, this is the amendment approval date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: hypothesis_type
attributes.description: Statistical hypothesis framework associated with this objective. Superiority objectives aim to demonstrate a treatment effect greater than control; non-inferiority objectives aim to show the treatment is not worse by a defined margin; equivalence objectives test for no meaningful difference; descriptive objectives have no formal hypothesis.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Non-Inferiority Clinical Trials; EMA Guideline on the Choice of Non-Inferiority Margin

attributes.name: intercurrent_event_strategy
attributes.description: ICH E9(R1) estimand attribute specifying the strategy for handling intercurrent events (post-randomization events that affect interpretation of the outcome) for this objective. Strategies include while-on-treatment, hypothetical, composite, principal stratum, and treatment policy.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum; EMA Reflection Paper on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Estimands

attributes.name: irb_iec_review_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Review Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a change to this objective requires IRB/IEC review and approval (e.g., substantial protocol amendment). Drives the amendment workflow and site notification process.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: multiplicity_adjustment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether statistical multiplicity adjustment (e.g., Bonferroni, Hochberg, hierarchical testing) is required for this objective due to multiple comparisons. Informs the SAP multiplicity control strategy.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Multiple Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity Issues

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or internal commentary related to this objective that does not fit structured fields. Used by data managers and biostatisticians during protocol development and SAP authoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: objective_number
attributes.description: Structured alphanumeric identifier for the objective within the protocol (e.g., P-1 for Primary Objective 1, S-2 for Secondary Objective 2). Used for cross-referencing in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; CDISC Protocol Representation Model

attributes.name: objective_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the study objective. Draft objectives are under authoring review; active objectives are in the approved protocol; amended objectives have been modified by a protocol amendment; superseded objectives have been replaced; retired objectives have been removed from the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC Protocol Representation Model

attributes.name: objective_text
attributes.description: Full verbatim text of the study objective as stated in the approved protocol. This is the authoritative scientific statement of what the study aims to demonstrate or evaluate, used verbatim in regulatory submissions and the CSR.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: objective_type
attributes.description: Classification of the study objective by its scientific hierarchy and regulatory weight. Primary objectives drive the primary endpoint and sample size calculation; secondary objectives provide supportive evidence; exploratory objectives generate hypotheses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|exploratory|safety|pharmacokinetic|pharmacodynamic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: population_description
attributes.description: Description of the analysis population to which this objective applies (e.g., Intent-to-Treat (ITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety Population). Aligns with the estimand population attribute per ICH E9(R1).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: population_type
attributes.description: Standardized code for the analysis population associated with this objective. Intent-to-Treat (ITT), modified ITT (mITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety, Pharmacokinetic (PK), or Pharmacodynamic (PD) population. Drives dataset selection in SAS Drug Development CDISC ADaM programming.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Section number within the study protocol document where this objective is formally stated (e.g., Section 2.1, Section 3.2). Enables direct navigation to the source text in the protocol and eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; CDISC Protocol Representation Model

attributes.name: regulatory_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this objective is a formal regulatory commitment (e.g., a post-marketing commitment to FDA or EMA, or a condition of approval). Regulatory commitment objectives require heightened change control and reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Commitments; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sap_section_reference
attributes.description: Section number or identifier within the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that addresses the analysis corresponding to this objective. Provides direct traceability from protocol objective to statistical methodology, as required for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Statistical Guidance on Reporting Results; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: scientific_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative justification for why this objective is scientifically important and how it contributes to the overall study goals. Supports regulatory review, protocol synopsis, and investigator brochure alignment.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Design; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sdtm_domain_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain Reference
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain(s) that contain the data supporting this objective (e.g., ADAE, ADEFF, ADTTE). Enables automated linkage between protocol objectives and SDTM/ADaM datasets in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA Data Standards Catalog

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this objective within its objective type group (e.g., first primary objective = 1, second primary objective = 2). Governs display order in the protocol, SAP, and CSR sections.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC Protocol Representation Model

attributes.name: short_title
attributes.description: Concise human-readable label for the objective used in dashboards, reports, and CTMS displays where the full objective text is too lengthy. Typically 10–15 words summarizing the scientific intent.
attributes.references: CDISC Protocol Representation Model; Oracle Clinical One Study Design Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this objective record was sourced or authored (e.g., Oracle Clinical One study design module, Veeva Vault protocol document). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this objective record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One objective GUID, Veeva Vault document section ID). Enables back-referencing and reconciliation with the system of record.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: summary_measure
attributes.description: Statistical summary measure used to quantify the treatment effect for this objective (e.g., difference in means, odds ratio, hazard ratio, response rate difference). Corresponds to the population-level summary attribute of the ICH E9(R1) estimand.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: testing_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the hierarchical testing procedure for this objective. Level 1 is tested first; subsequent levels are tested only if the preceding level achieves statistical significance. Implements the gatekeeping strategy defined in the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Multiple Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity Issues

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area or disease indication to which this objective is aligned (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Supports cross-study analytics and portfolio-level objective benchmarking.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC Therapeutic Area Data Standards; ICH E8(R1)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this study objective record in the data platform. Required for change tracking, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: variable_description
attributes.description: Description of the variable (outcome measure) used to address this objective, as defined in the ICH E9(R1) estimand framework. Specifies what is measured on each subject to evaluate the treatment effect.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum; CDISC Protocol Representation Model

domains.name: site

domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: investigational_site
products.description: Master record for each investigational site participating in clinical trials. This is the SSOT for site identity and profile across the clinical research enterprise, referenced by all study-site associations, feasibility assessments, and capacity records.
products.reference: CTMS Site Master

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each investigational site record in the clinical research enterprise. Primary key for the master site record referenced by all study-site associations, feasibility assessments, and capacity records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: local_lab_facility_id

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: FK to site.principal_investigator

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational site was formally activated and authorized to begin enrolling subjects into clinical trials. Marks the completion of all site initiation activities including IRB/IEC approval, regulatory submissions, and staff training.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4; Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the investigational site facility. Required for regulatory submissions, site visit logistics, and TMF documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.53; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the investigational site (suite, floor, building, department). Supplements the primary address for precise facility location identification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.53; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the investigational site is located. Used for geographic distribution analysis, patient recruitment planning, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.53; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: closeout_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational site was formally closed out, completing all study-related activities, resolving outstanding data queries, and returning or destroying unused investigational product. Triggers archival obligations per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the investigational site is located. Determines applicable regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada), GCP guidelines, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investigational site master record was first created in the system of record (Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) nine-digit identifier for the investigational site organization. Used for sponsor contracting, grant management, and financial due diligence.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: edc_system
attributes.description: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system deployed at the investigational site for eCRF data entry and clinical data management. Determines site training requirements, data integration pathways, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance approach.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; CDISC; Medidata Rave; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: eudract_site_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) site-level identifier assigned for EU-regulated clinical trials. Required for EMA regulatory submissions and EU CTR 536/2014 compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA EudraCT Database; EMA Guidance on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigational site by facility category, indicating the type of healthcare or research institution. Drives feasibility scoring, site selection criteria, and therapeutic area alignment assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Site Selection

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the investigational site, used for transmission of regulatory documents, IRB/IEC correspondence, and sponsor communications where electronic submission is not available.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.53

attributes.name: fda_fei_number
attributes.description: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Facility Establishment Identifier (FEI) number assigned to the investigational site. Required for FDA-regulated clinical trials and referenced in IND applications and NDA/BLA submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207; FDA FEI Registry; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: gcp_certification_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational site's current GCP certification expires. Triggers renewal workflow and site eligibility review. Sites with expired GCP certification are ineligible for new study activations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: gcp_certification_status
attributes.description: Current Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification status of the investigational site, reflecting compliance with ICH E6(R2) training and audit requirements. Sites must maintain active GCP certification to participate in sponsor-funded clinical trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; MasterControl

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current GCP compliance status of the investigational site based on the most recent monitoring visit, audit, or inspection findings. Drives risk-based monitoring intensity, CAPA requirements, and site eligibility for new study assignments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: has_dedicated_research_staff
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigational site employs dedicated clinical research staff (e.g., Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs), research nurses) exclusively for clinical trial conduct, as opposed to relying solely on general clinical staff.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.2; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Site Selection

attributes.name: has_local_laboratory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigational site has an on-site clinical laboratory certified to process and analyze clinical trial specimens. Relevant for protocol feasibility, sample logistics planning, and central vs. local lab decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; CLIA (42 CFR Part 493); CAP Accreditation; ISO 15189

attributes.name: has_pharmacy
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigational site has an on-site pharmacy capable of receiving, storing, dispensing, and accounting for investigational medicinal products (IMPs) per GCP and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU GMP Annex 13; Oracle Clinical One RTSM

attributes.name: iras_number
attributes.description: UK Integrated Research Application System (IRAS) project identifier assigned to the site for studies conducted under MHRA oversight. Required for UK clinical trial regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: MHRA Clinical Trials Regulation; UK SI 2004/1031; IRAS System

attributes.name: irb_iec_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Name
attributes.description: Name of the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) responsible for ethical oversight of clinical research conducted at this investigational site. Required for regulatory submissions and TMF documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56; ICH E6(R2) Section 3; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: irb_iec_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Registration Number
attributes.description: Official registration or accreditation number of the IRB/IEC overseeing the investigational site. Required for FDA OHRP registration verification and EU CTR ethics committee identification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.106; OHRP IRB Registration; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 9; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality assurance (QA) audit conducted at the investigational site by the sponsor, CRO, or regulatory authority. Used to track audit frequency and compliance with quality management plans.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive; MasterControl Audit Management

attributes.name: last_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site or remote monitoring visit conducted by a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) at the investigational site. Used to track monitoring frequency compliance and schedule next visit per the monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312.68; Oracle Siebel CTMS; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: max_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of subjects the investigational site can enroll and manage concurrently across all active clinical trials. Used for site capacity planning, feasibility assessments, and enrollment forecasting in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Site Selection; CDISC

attributes.name: next_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next monitoring visit at the investigational site, as scheduled in the CTMS monitoring plan. Supports CRA workload planning and ensures compliance with risk-based monitoring visit frequency requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance (2013); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: number_of_exam_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of dedicated examination or procedure rooms available at the investigational site for clinical trial subject visits. Informs site capacity assessments and feasibility scoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Site Feasibility Guidance

attributes.name: open_capa_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Count
attributes.description: Number of currently open Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) assigned to the investigational site resulting from monitoring visits, audits, or regulatory inspections. A key GCP compliance KPI tracked in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive; MasterControl CAPA Tracking

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investigational site within the clinical research enterprise. Drives site eligibility for new study assignments, monitoring visit scheduling, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|pending_activation|closed|suspended|in_feasibility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the investigational site facility. Used for CRA monitoring visit coordination, sponsor communications, and emergency contact during study conduct.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.53; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the investigational site. Used for geographic catchment area analysis, patient recruitment radius calculations, and regulatory address verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.53; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Sponsor- or CRO-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the investigational site within the clinical trial management system (CTMS). Used as the operational business key across Medidata Rave, Oracle Siebel CTMS, and Oracle Clinical One for site cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG (SITEID)

attributes.name: site_email
attributes.description: Primary institutional email address for the investigational site. Used for sponsor and CRO communications, regulatory correspondence, and eTMF document distribution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official legal or operating name of the investigational site facility (e.g., hospital, clinic, research center). Used for regulatory submissions, TMF documentation, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4; 21 CFR Part 312.53; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: site_tier
attributes.description: Sponsor or CRO-assigned tier classification reflecting the site's strategic importance, historical performance, enrollment capacity, and GCP compliance track record. Tier 1 represents highest-performing strategic sites; Tier 4 represents new or lower-performing sites.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Internal Site Qualification SOP

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the investigational site is located. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, IRB/IEC assignment, and geographic enrollment analytics.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.53; ICH E6(R2); Health Canada; MHRA

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the investigational site location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling monitoring visits, adverse event reporting timestamps, and cross-regional data reconciliation.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the investigational site master record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and ALCOA+ audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).

attributes.name: edc_system_access

attributes.name: edc_user_code

attributes.name: email

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: fax_number

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: financial_disclosure_date

attributes.description: Status of the site contact's financial disclosure form submission, required by FDA regulations for investigators to disclose financial interests that may affect study integrity. Mandatory for NDA/BLA submissions.

attributes.name: first_name

attributes.name: gcp_training_date

attributes.description: Date on which the site contact most recently completed GCP training. Used to determine training currency and trigger renewal reminders in compliance with ICH E6(R2) requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl

attributes.name: gcp_training_expiry_date

attributes.name: gcp_training_provider

attributes.name: gcp_training_status

attributes.name: human_subjects_training_expiry_date

attributes.name: human_subjects_training_status

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_ref

attributes.name: is_primary_contact

attributes.description: Indicates whether training on Investigational Product (IP) receipt, storage, dispensing, accountability, and return/destruction procedures was completed during the SIV.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR 312.61; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Site Initiation Visit (SIV) Action Item Count
attributes.description: Number of action items from the Site Initiation Visit that remain unresolved/open at the time of record update. A non-zero value may indicate a site activation risk.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study protocol training topic was covered and completed during the Site Initiation Visit. Protocol training is a mandatory SIV agenda item per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR 312.60

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_approval_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required national or regional regulatory authority approval (e.g., IND from FDA, CTA from EMA/MHRA) was confirmed as obtained prior to the Site Initiation Visit. A prerequisite for site activation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312 (IND); EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MHRA

attributes.name: rtsm_training_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Training Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) / Interactive Response Technology (IRT) system training was completed during the SIV. Required for sites to perform patient randomization and manage investigational product supply.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: safety_reporting_training_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety and Adverse Event (AE/SAE) Reporting Training Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether training on safety and Adverse Event (AE) / Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting procedures was completed during the SIV. Mandatory per GCP to ensure timely and accurate safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: scheduled_visit_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which the Site Initiation Visit is scheduled to occur, as recorded in the CTMS. Used for resource planning and site activation timeline tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: siv_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the SIV, typically generated by the CTMS (Oracle Siebel CTMS) and referenced in the Trial Master File (TMF). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: siv_signoff_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: Site Initiation Visit (SIV) Signed Off By
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the sponsor or CRO representative who provided formal sign-off on the Site Initiation Visit, confirming all objectives were met and the site is activated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic signatures); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: siv_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Site Initiation Visit received formal sign-off from the sponsor or CRO representative, confirming site readiness for first patient enrollment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: siv_signoff_status
attributes.description: Indicates the formal sign-off status of the Site Initiation Visit by the sponsor or CRO. Sign-off confirms that all SIV objectives were met and the site is authorized to enroll the first patient. Distinct from visit_status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this Site Initiation Visit record was sourced or integrated into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this SIV record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS visit ID). Enables reverse traceability from the lakehouse back to the system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this Site Initiation Visit record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: visit_end_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the Site Initiation Visit concluded. Used together with visit_start_time to calculate visit duration and assess adequacy of training time.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: visit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional observations, comments, or contextual information recorded by the CRA during or after the Site Initiation Visit. Supplements the structured visit report.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: visit_report_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Site Initiation Visit (SIV) Report Completion Date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA completed and finalized the Site Initiation Visit report. Regulatory guidelines typically require visit reports to be completed within a defined number of days post-visit (e.g., 10 business days). Filed in the eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.6; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA Guidance on TMF

attributes.name: visit_report_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Site Initiation Visit (SIV) Report Due Date
attributes.description: The contractually or procedurally defined deadline by which the SIV report must be completed and filed in the eTMF. Used to monitor CRA compliance with SOP timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Sponsor SOP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: visit_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the Site Initiation Visit commenced on the day of the visit. Used for duration calculation and audit trail purposes per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: visit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Site Initiation Visit. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. Used for CTMS workflow management and site activation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Site Initiation Visit was conducted on-site at the investigational site, remotely (e.g., via video conference), or as a hybrid combination. Relevant for regulatory acceptability and risk-based monitoring frameworks.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management; FDA Guidance on Remote Monitoring

products.name: enrollment_performance
products.description: Tracks actual vs. planned enrollment performance at the study-site level over time. Captures reporting period, planned enrollment target, actual subjects screened, subjects enrolled, screen failure count, screen failure rate, dropout count, and cumulative enrollment to date. Enables site-level enrollment forecasting and performance management. Sourced from CTMS enrollment tracking integrated with EDC subject data.
products.reference: CTMS Enrollment Tracker

attributes.name: enrollment_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each enrollment performance record at the study-site-reporting period level. Primary key for this data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: active_subject_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects currently active (enrolled and not yet completed or discontinued) at this site as of the end of the reporting period. Reflects current site workload and capacity utilization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: actual_enrolled_count
attributes.description: The actual number of subjects enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC and Oracle Clinical One randomization data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC; Oracle Clinical One; CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: actual_screened_count
attributes.description: The actual number of subjects who underwent screening procedures at this site during the reporting period, as captured in the EDC (Medidata Rave) and reconciled with CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: completed_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who completed all protocol-required study procedures and visits at this site during the reporting period. Used for PP population analysis and study close-out planning.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: cumulative_dropout_count
attributes.description: The total number of enrolled subjects who have discontinued participation at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Used for retention analysis and ITT/PP population tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: cumulative_enrolled_count
attributes.description: The total number of subjects enrolled at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Primary metric for tracking progress toward the site's enrollment target.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: cumulative_screened_count
attributes.description: The total number of subjects screened at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Enables longitudinal enrollment trend analysis and forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Indicates the originating system from which this enrollment performance record was sourced or integrated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between CTMS and EDC systems.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: dropout_count
attributes.description: The number of enrolled subjects who discontinued participation (withdrew consent, were lost to follow-up, or were discontinued by investigator) during the reporting period. Impacts ITT and PP population sizes.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: dropout_rate
attributes.description: The proportion of enrolled subjects who dropped out during the reporting period, expressed as a percentage (dropout_count / actual_enrolled_count × 100). Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS; used for retention risk assessment and site performance management.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: enrollment_rate_per_month
attributes.description: The average number of subjects enrolled per calendar month at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from CTMS enrollment tracking; used for enrollment forecasting and site performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

attributes.name: enrollment_target_achievement_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the site's total enrollment target achieved cumulatively as of the end of the reporting period (cumulative_enrolled_count / site_enrollment_target × 100). Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS for site performance dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS KPI framework

attributes.name: enrollment_variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual enrolled subjects and planned enrolled subjects for the reporting period (actual_enrolled_count - planned_enrolled_count). Negative values indicate under-enrollment; positive values indicate over-enrollment. Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS KPI framework

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_status
attributes.description: The current GCP compliance status of the site as assessed by the most recent monitoring visit or audit. Drives risk-based monitoring decisions and regulatory escalation. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; ISO 14155

attributes.name: icf_signed_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who signed the Informed Consent Form (ICF) at this site during the reporting period. ICF signature is the first step in the enrollment process and is tracked separately from screening and randomization per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current IRB/IEC approval for this study at this site expires. Sites must obtain renewal before this date to continue enrollment. Tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the study at this site from the governing Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Sites may not enroll subjects without valid IRB/IEC approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP; Veeva Vault regulatory module

attributes.name: next_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled monitoring visit at this site, as planned in the CTMS. Used for CRA workload planning and ensuring monitoring frequency meets the risk-based monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring schedule

attributes.name: open_query_count
attributes.description: The number of unresolved data queries (discrepancies or missing data flags) raised against this site's eCRF data in the EDC system as of the end of the reporting period. A key data quality indicator for site performance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment performance status of the site for the reporting period, indicating whether the site is meeting, exceeding, or falling short of its planned enrollment targets. Drives CRA escalation and site management actions in the CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; KPI framework

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date by which the site was expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, as defined in the site enrollment plan or study protocol timeline.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_enrolled_count
attributes.description: The target number of subjects planned to be enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Derived from the site-level enrollment plan agreed with the sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_screened_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects planned to be screened at this site during the reporting period, as defined in the site enrollment plan or feasibility agreement. Baseline for screen failure rate analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: projected_completion_date
attributes.description: The forecasted date by which the site is expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, based on current enrollment rate. Updated each reporting period in the CTMS for timeline management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_count
attributes.description: The number of protocol deviations recorded at this site during the reporting period. Includes both major and minor deviations as classified per the study deviation management plan. Sourced from CTMS deviation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: randomized_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who were randomized (assigned to a treatment arm via RTSM/IVRS) at this site during the reporting period. Distinct from enrolled count in studies where enrollment precedes randomization.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this enrollment performance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this enrollment performance record was most recently updated in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the enrollment performance reporting period. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the window for all enrollment metrics in this record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS enrollment tracking

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the enrollment performance reporting period (e.g., start of a monthly or weekly reporting window). Used to define the temporal boundary for all enrollment metrics in this record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS enrollment tracking

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the reporting period for this enrollment performance record. Determines the cadence at which site-level enrollment metrics are aggregated and reviewed.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sae_count
attributes.description: The number of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) reported at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety. Used to assess site safety profile and trigger risk-based monitoring escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: screen_failure_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who were screened but did not meet eligibility criteria and were therefore not enrolled during the reporting period. A key metric for site feasibility and protocol amendment decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: screen_failure_rate
attributes.description: The proportion of screened subjects who failed screening, expressed as a percentage (screen_failure_count / actual_screened_count × 100). Stored as a raw business metric captured from CTMS; used to assess site eligibility criteria adherence and protocol feasibility.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: site_capacity
attributes.description: The maximum number of subjects the site can concurrently manage based on staff, facilities, and resources, as assessed during site feasibility. Used to evaluate whether the site is operating within capacity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS site feasibility module

attributes.name: site_enrollment_target
attributes.description: The total number of subjects the site is contracted or planned to enroll over the full duration of the study, as agreed in the site initiation agreement or enrollment plan. Denominator for cumulative enrollment progress percentage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: site_number
attributes.description: The sponsor- or CRO-assigned unique site identifier code for the investigational site. Used as the externally-known business identifier for the site in regulatory submissions and CTMS reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS
