CTA (Clinical Trial Agreement) is the primary investigational site contract; CDA (Confidential Disclosure Agreement) governs pre-trial information sharing; Budget Amendment captures renegotiated financial terms; Site Budget Agreement formalizes per-patient and overhead fee structures; Letter of Intent signals site commitment prior to full execution.
attributes.value_regex: CTA|CDA|Budget Amendment|Site Budget Agreement|Letter of Intent
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR 312.53; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 46

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential amendment version number for this agreement record. A value of 0 indicates the original agreement; values ≥1 indicate successive amendments. Enables version tracking of negotiated changes over the study lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; Veeva Vault Document Management; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: closeout_fee
attributes.description: Fixed fee payable to the investigational site upon study close-out to cover archival, final monitoring visit support, and regulatory document finalization activities. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: confidentiality_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years for which confidentiality obligations under the agreement remain in force after the agreement's expiration or termination. Particularly relevant for CDA (Confidential Disclosure Agreement) components.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; GDPR Article 5; HIPAA; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this site agreement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cro_entity
attributes.description: Name of the Contract Research Organization (CRO) acting as the contracting party on behalf of the sponsor, if applicable. Captures the legal entity name when the CRO executes the agreement under delegated authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; FDA 21 CFR 312.52

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all financial terms within this site agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-country trials.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: data_privacy_addendum
attributes.description: Indicates whether a data privacy addendum (DPA) or data processing agreement is included as part of or annexed to this site agreement, addressing GDPR, HIPAA, or other applicable data protection obligations for patient data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; HIPAA 45 CFR 164; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site agreement becomes legally binding and operative. Marks the start of the contractual relationship between the sponsor/CRO and the investigational site. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 46

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required parties signed and fully executed the site agreement. May differ from the effective date when agreements are backdated or have a future effective date. Critical for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site agreement is scheduled to expire or cease to be operative. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow alerts in Veeva Vault. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; Veeva Vault Contract Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this site agreement. Critical for multi-national trial legal compliance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR; HIPAA; ICH E6(R2); ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: indemnification_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site agreement includes an indemnification clause protecting the investigational site and PI from third-party claims arising from the sponsor's negligence. Standard in CTA templates but may be absent in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement mandates that the sponsor or CRO maintain clinical trial insurance coverage for the duration of the study at this site. Regulatory requirement in many jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 76; ISO 14155

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the clinical trial insurance policy covering this site agreement. Populated when insurance_coverage_required is True. Used for regulatory inspection documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 76

attributes.name: ip_ownership_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site agreement contains an intellectual property ownership clause specifying that all study data, inventions, and results generated at the site are owned by the sponsor. Standard in CTA templates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval is a condition precedent to the agreement becoming operative. Relevant for agreements at sites in jurisdictions requiring ethics committee review prior to contract execution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; FDA 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4; OHRP

attributes.name: legal_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor's or CRO's legal team has completed their review and approved the final agreement text prior to execution. Part of the quality control workflow tracked in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; Veeva Vault Quality Management; SOX

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal review of the site agreement was completed and sign-off was granted. Populated when legal_review_completed is True. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal contract negotiation commenced between the sponsor/CRO and the investigational site. Used to calculate cycle time KPIs for site activation performance reporting in CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplementary notes, special conditions, deviations from standard templates, or negotiation context relevant to this site agreement. Supports audit trail and institutional knowledge retention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: overhead_rate_pct
attributes.description: Institutional overhead or indirect cost rate (expressed as a percentage) applied on top of direct site costs as negotiated in the site budget agreement. Typically charged by academic medical centers or hospital institutions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; SAP S/4HANA Finance; OMB Circular A-21 (US academic institutions)

attributes.name: payment_schedule_type
attributes.description: Defines the payment trigger mechanism agreed upon in the site budget agreement. Determines how and when invoices are generated and processed in SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice receipt within which payment must be remitted to the investigational site, as stipulated in the site agreement (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, Net 60). Drives accounts payable processing in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6

attributes.name: per_patient_fee
attributes.description: Agreed fee payable to the investigational site for each evaluable patient who completes the study per protocol. Core financial term in the site budget agreement. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; FDA 21 CFR 312.53

attributes.name: publication_rights_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site agreement includes a publication rights clause defining the investigator's right to publish study results and the sponsor's right to review manuscripts prior to submission. Relevant for academic site agreements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ICMJE Publication Guidelines; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37

attributes.name: site_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized representative of the investigational site (e.g., PI or institutional official) signed the agreement. May differ from the sponsor/CRO signature date in multi-party execution workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sponsor_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized representative of the sponsor or CRO signed the agreement. The later of site_signature_date and sponsor_signature_date typically defines the execution_date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: startup_fee
attributes.description: One-time fixed fee payable to the investigational site upon activation to cover site initiation activities such as staff training, IRB/IEC submission preparation, and regulatory document collection. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site agreement was early-terminated prior to its scheduled expiration. Populated only when agreement_status is 'Terminated'. Supports regulatory close-out documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR 312.64; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for early termination of the site agreement. Required for regulatory reporting and site performance analytics. Populated only when agreement_status is 'Terminated'.
attributes.value_regex: Mutual Consent|Sponsor Decision|Site Decision|Regulatory Action|Protocol Termination|For Cause
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR 312.64

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted budget value for this site agreement, inclusive of all per-patient fees, procedures, overhead, and any fixed fees. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. Used for financial forecasting and accrual management in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this site agreement record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: site_cra_assignment

Enables monitoring coverage planning, workload balancing, and visit scheduling within CTMS.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CRA assignment was formally approved by the responsible manager or clinical operations lead. Required for GCP compliance and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information relevant to this CRA-site assignment (e.g., site-specific access requirements, language considerations, sponsor preferences).
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the CRA assignment record as generated by the CTMS (e.g., CRA-ASGN-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reference, audit trails, and operational communication.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for creating or modifying this CRA assignment. Supports operational reporting and root cause analysis for assignment changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_assignment|replacement|coverage_gap|workload_rebalance|site_activation|escalation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOP for Site Monitoring

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CRA assignment. 'pending' = approved but not yet started; 'active' = currently monitoring; 'on_hold' = temporarily suspended; 'completed' = assignment concluded per plan; 'cancelled' = terminated before completion; 'transferred' = reassigned to another CRA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SOP for Site Monitoring

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the role of the CRA within the site monitoring coverage model. 'primary' indicates the main responsible monitor; 'backup' covers absence; 'co_monitor' indicates joint monitoring; 'lead' designates a senior oversight role; 'remote' indicates centralized/remote monitoring only.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; TransCelerate Monitoring Methodology

attributes.name: confidentiality_agreement_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned CRA has signed the required confidentiality or non-disclosure agreement (NDA) for this study prior to accessing study data. True = signed; False = pending. Regulatory and sponsor compliance requirement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 28; HIPAA; Veeva Vault; MasterControl

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CRA assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: ctms_assignment_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Assignment Reference
attributes.description: The native assignment identifier or record number from the source Oracle Siebel CTMS system. Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: delegation_log_entry_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CRA's monitoring responsibilities have been formally documented on the site's delegation of authority log, as required by GCP. True = confirmed on delegation log; False = pending confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA's monitoring responsibility for the assigned study-site combination is scheduled to conclude or was actually concluded. Null for open-ended active assignments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: estimated_travel_days_per_visit
attributes.description: The estimated number of travel days required per monitoring visit for this CRA-site assignment. Used for resource capacity planning, travel cost estimation, and CRA workload calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gcp_training_current
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Training Current Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned CRA holds a current, valid GCP training certification at the time of assignment. True = GCP training is current and valid; False = training expired or not on file. Regulatory compliance requirement per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; MasterControl

attributes.name: gcp_training_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Training Expiry Date
attributes.description: The date on which the assigned CRA's GCP training certification expires. Used to proactively manage compliance and ensure no lapse in qualified monitoring coverage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: geographic_territory
attributes.description: The geographic territory or region to which this CRA assignment belongs (e.g., 'Northeast US', 'Western Europe', 'APAC'). Used for territory-based workload planning, travel budgeting, and CRA deployment optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: handover_date
attributes.description: The date on which monitoring responsibility was formally transferred from the predecessor CRA to the current CRA. Relevant for assignment transfers and ensures no monitoring coverage gap.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SOP for CRA Handover

attributes.name: handover_visit_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal handover monitoring visit was conducted between the outgoing and incoming CRA at the site. True = handover visit completed; False = not yet completed or not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; SOP for CRA Handover; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: last_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent monitoring visit (on-site or remote) conducted by this CRA at the assigned site under this assignment. Used for visit scheduling, overdue visit tracking, and site oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: monitoring_approach
attributes.description: Defines the monitoring methodology applied by the CRA for this assignment. 'on_site' = traditional in-person SDV; 'remote' = off-site data review; 'hybrid' = combination; 'centralized' = statistical/data-driven central monitoring per risk-based monitoring (RBM) frameworks.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on RBM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Methodology

attributes.name: next_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: The date of the next planned monitoring visit (on-site or remote) for this CRA-site assignment as scheduled in the CTMS. Drives visit scheduling workflows and resource planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: open_action_items_count
attributes.description: The current number of unresolved monitoring action items or follow-up items outstanding for this CRA-site assignment. Supports site oversight, escalation management, and GCP compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally planned end date for the CRA assignment at the time of creation. Enables comparison against actual end date to track assignment duration variances and resource planning accuracy.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate Monitoring Methodology

attributes.name: protocol_training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned CRA has completed the required study protocol-specific training prior to initiating monitoring activities at the site. True = training completed; False = pending. Regulatory requirement per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_training_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA completed the study protocol-specific training required for this assignment. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; MasterControl; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: The risk classification of the assigned site as assessed under the risk-based monitoring (RBM) framework. Determines monitoring intensity, visit frequency, and SDV scope for this assignment. 'high' = intensive monitoring required.
attributes.references: FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on RBM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Methodology

attributes.name: sdv_rate_pct
attributes.description: The agreed or actual percentage of critical data fields subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) for this CRA-site assignment, as defined in the monitoring plan. Reflects risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.3; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBM; CDISC

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA's monitoring responsibility for the assigned study-site combination becomes effective. Used for coverage planning and workload scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for ending or cancelling the CRA assignment before or at its planned conclusion. Populated only when assignment_status is 'completed', 'cancelled', or 'transferred'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: study_completion|site_closure|cra_departure|reassignment|performance|sponsor_request|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOP for Site Monitoring

attributes.name: territory_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the primary country of the CRA's assigned territory (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports geographic reporting and regulatory jurisdiction tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: total_visits_completed
attributes.description: The cumulative count of monitoring visits (on-site and remote) completed by this CRA at the assigned site under this assignment. Used for performance tracking and monitoring coverage reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; TransCelerate RBM Metrics

attributes.name: travel_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether overnight or significant travel is required for the CRA to conduct on-site monitoring visits at this assigned site. True = travel required; False = local or remote only. Used for travel budget planning and CRA logistics.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CRA assignment record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: visit_frequency_planned
attributes.description: The planned frequency of on-site or remote monitoring visits for this CRA-site assignment as defined in the monitoring plan. Drives visit scheduling and resource forecasting in the CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: workload_allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the CRA's total available working capacity allocated to this specific study-site assignment. Used for workload balancing across multiple concurrent assignments. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; TransCelerate Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl CAPA; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan is required at this site based on findings identified during the close-out visit or cumulative monitoring. Triggers CAPA workflow in MasterControl.

attributes.name: closeout_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this close-out event, typically generated by the CTMS close-out workflow (e.g., CO-2024-0042). Used for cross-system referencing and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: closeout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site close-out process as tracked in the CTMS close-out workflow. Drives downstream regulatory notification and payment release actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: closeout_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason driving the site close-out. Distinguishes between normal study completion, early termination for safety or operational reasons, and sponsor-initiated decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned_completion|early_termination|protocol_amendment|sponsor_decision|regulatory_action|site_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which all close-out activities were formally completed and the site was officially closed. Marks the end of the site lifecycle for this study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site close-out record was first created in the CTMS close-out workflow. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: drug_accountability_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which investigational medicinal product (IMP) accountability reconciliation was formally completed and signed off at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: drug_accountability_status
attributes.description: Current status of investigational medicinal product (IMP) accountability reconciliation at the site. Confirms that all dispensed, returned, and destroyed drug quantities are fully accounted for per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: early_termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for early termination of the site, if applicable. Populated only when closeout_type is 'early_termination'. Supports regulatory reporting and sponsor decision documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: essential_doc_archival_date
attributes.description: Date on which all essential documents were confirmed as archived at the investigational site, satisfying ICH E6(R2) Section 8 requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: essential_doc_archival_status
attributes.description: Status of archival of all essential documents required by ICH E6(R2) Section 8 at the investigational site. Confirms that the site's Trial Master File (TMF) is complete and archived per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: final_payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the final payment disbursed to the investigational site at close-out, denominated in the contract currency. Represents the net amount after reconciliation of all advances and prior payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: final_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final payment to the investigational site was processed and confirmed, closing all financial obligations under the site budget agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: final_payment_status
attributes.description: Status of the final financial payment to the investigational site upon close-out, covering all outstanding per-subject fees, procedure fees, and close-out visit fees per the site budget agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Finance; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall GCP compliance assessment for the site at close-out, based on findings from the close-out visit and cumulative monitoring history. Informs the site's eligibility for future studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155

attributes.name: imp_return_date
attributes.description: Date on which unused investigational medicinal product (IMP) was returned to the sponsor/depot or destroyed on-site per the drug destruction protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: imp_return_status
attributes.description: Status of the return or on-site destruction of unused investigational medicinal product (IMP) at the site. Distinct from drug accountability reconciliation — this tracks the physical disposition of remaining IMP stock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal site close-out process was officially initiated in the CTMS, typically following LSLV confirmation and sponsor authorization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of study completion or early termination at this site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Status
attributes.description: Status of the formal notification to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) regarding study completion or early termination at this site, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: lslv_date
attributes.description: Date of the last protocol-required visit for the last subject enrolled at this site. LSLV is a critical clinical milestone that triggers the initiation of the close-out process and database lock activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for CRA or study manager notes regarding the close-out process, including any outstanding issues, special circumstances, or follow-up actions required after the close-out visit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: outstanding_queries_count
attributes.description: Number of unresolved data queries (discrepancies) remaining in the EDC system at the time of close-out visit. A non-zero value indicates data cleaning is incomplete and may delay database lock contribution.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the final site payment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency global trials.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: pi_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) formally acknowledged the close-out letter and confirmed all site obligations were fulfilled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: pi_acknowledgement_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) has formally acknowledged receipt of the close-out letter and confirmed completion of all close-out obligations, as required by ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_deviations_count
attributes.description: Total number of protocol deviations recorded at this site during the study. Summarized at close-out for site performance assessment and inclusion in the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicable regulatory authority was formally notified of the site close-out.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of notification to applicable regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) regarding site close-out, as required under applicable IND/CTA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sdv_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of critical and non-critical data fields that have been source data verified (SDV) at the site as of the close-out visit. Reflects data quality and monitoring completeness per the monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: site_file_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site's investigator file and essential documents were successfully transferred to the sponsor or CRO central archive.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: site_file_transfer_status
attributes.description: Status of the transfer of the site's investigator file and essential documents to the sponsor or CRO archive. Applicable when physical or electronic records must be transferred from the site to a central repository.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: subjects_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who completed all protocol-required visits and procedures at this site. Used to calculate site completion rate and assess protocol adherence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subjects_discontinued_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who discontinued from the study prior to completing all protocol-required activities at this site. Includes withdrawals, screen failures post-enrollment, and protocol deviations leading to discontinuation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subjects_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Total number of subjects who were enrolled (consented and randomized or assigned to treatment) at this site during the study. Used for final enrollment reconciliation at close-out.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this site close-out record in the CTMS. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) conducted the formal close-out monitoring visit at the investigational site. This is the principal real-world event date for the close-out transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

All subject-level transactional records in this domain reference this entity. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave EDC.

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study in which this subject is enrolled or screened. Links the subject to the parent study master record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — STUDYID; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this subject was screened or enrolled. Supports site-level enrollment analytics and monitoring.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SITEID; ICH E6(R2) GCP §4

attributes.name: age_at_enrollment
attributes.description: Subject's age in years at the time of enrollment or first dose, calculated from date of birth and enrollment date. Used for eligibility verification, demographic reporting, and subgroup analyses. Stored as a derived-at-source value from Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — AGE; ICH E6(R2); FDA Demographic Subgroup Analyses Guidance

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject completed all required study procedures per protocol, including end-of-study visit. Used for subject disposition reporting, CSR preparation, and database lock readiness assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDTC (completion); ICH E3 CSR Structure; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the investigational site where the subject is enrolled. Used for geographic stratification, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and multi-regional trial reporting. Corresponds to CDISC SDTM DM COUNTRY variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — COUNTRY; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trial subject record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: data_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's data has been locked as part of the Database Lock (DBL) process, preventing further modifications to the subject's eCRF data. True = subject data locked; False = data still open for entry or query resolution. Critical for CSR preparation and regulatory submission readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; CDISC DMP; Medidata Rave EDC lock functionality; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subject's date of birth used to calculate age at screening, enrollment, and key study milestones. Classified as restricted PHI/PII. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format. May be partially masked (year only) in certain jurisdictions per GDPR/HIPAA de-identification requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — BRTHDTC; HIPAA Safe Harbor De-identification; GDPR Article 9; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject met all inclusion and exclusion criteria as assessed during screening. True = all eligibility criteria confirmed met; False = one or more criteria not met. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Clinical One eligibility module; CDISC SDTM IE domain

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was formally enrolled in the study following confirmation of eligibility criteria. Distinct from screening date and randomization date. Used for enrollment tracking, site performance KPIs, and study timeline reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM; ICH E6(R2) §4.3; Oracle Siebel CTMS enrollment milestone tracking

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject within the study, reflecting their progression from screening through completion or withdrawal. Drives subject disposition reporting and ITT/PP population flags. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screened|enrolled|randomized|completed|withdrawn|screen_failed|discontinued|on_treatment|follow_up — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDECOD; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported ethnic origin as collected at screening, coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology. Distinct from race per FDA demographic reporting requirements. Used in regulatory demographic summary tables.
attributes.value_regex: HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT REPORTED|UNKNOWN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — ETHNIC; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: first_dose_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject received the first dose of investigational product. Used as the reference anchor for treatment-emergent adverse event (TEAE) analysis, PK sampling schedules, and per-protocol population definitions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain — EXSTDTC; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on TEAE Analysis; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: itt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). True = subject is in ITT population; False = excluded. Used in primary efficacy analyses per ICH E9 principles.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles §5.2; CDISC ADaM ADSL — ITTFL; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; SAP conventions

attributes.name: last_dose_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject received the last dose of investigational product. Used to define the end of the treatment-emergent window for adverse event analysis and to calculate treatment duration. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC exposure domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain — EXENDTC; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on TEAE Analysis

attributes.name: pp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Subjects may be excluded from PP due to major protocol deviations, insufficient drug exposure, or missing primary endpoint data.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles §5.2; CDISC ADaM ADSL — PPROTFL; FDA Guidance on Estimands; SAP conventions

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has at least one recorded protocol deviation during the study. True = one or more deviations recorded; False = no deviations. Summary flag for quick filtering; detailed deviations are tracked in the compliance.protocol_deviation product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; CDISC SDTM DV domain; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: race
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported racial category as collected at screening, coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology and FDA demographic reporting requirements. Used for regulatory demographic tables and diversity reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE|ASIAN|BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN|NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER|WHITE|MULTIPLE|UNKNOWN|NOT REPORTED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — RACE; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; 21 CFR Part 312.33; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: randomization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was randomized to a treatment arm via the IRT/RTSM system. Defines the start of the treatment period and is used as the reference date for TEAE analysis windows and ITT population inclusion. Null for screen-failed subjects.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — RANDFL; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: Unique number assigned to a subject at the point of randomization via the IRT/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One). Determines treatment arm assignment and links to investigational product supply allocation. Null for subjects who were screened but not randomized.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DM — RANDFL; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; RTSM system conventions

attributes.name: safety_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the safety analysis population (typically all randomized subjects who received at least one dose of investigational product). Used for adverse event incidence tables and safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles §5.2; CDISC ADaM ADSL — SAFFL; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Reason why a screened subject did not proceed to enrollment, coded per protocol-defined eligibility criteria categories (e.g., INCLUSION CRITERIA NOT MET, EXCLUSION CRITERIA MET, SUBJECT WITHDREW CONSENT, INVESTIGATOR DECISION). Populated only for subjects with enrollment_status = screen_failed.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2) §4.3; Oracle Clinical One eligibility assessment module

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject first underwent screening procedures for the study, including signing of the Informed Consent Form (ICF). Marks the start of the subject's participation timeline. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — DMDTC (screening); ICH E6(R2) §4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: screening_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a potential subject at the point of screening, prior to randomization or enrollment confirmation. Used to track pre-enrollment eligibility assessments. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SUBJID (screening phase); ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has experienced at least one Serious Adverse Event (SAE) during the study. True = one or more SAEs reported; False = no SAEs. Summary flag for subject-level safety profiling; detailed SAE records are managed in Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; CDISC SDTM AE domain — AESER

attributes.name: sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the subject as recorded at screening. Coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology (M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, UNDIFFERENTIATED). Used for demographic reporting, eligibility criteria verification, and PK/PD subgroup analyses.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — SEX; CDISC Controlled Terminology CT v2023-09-29; ICH E6(R2); FDA Demographic Subgroup Analyses Guidance

attributes.name: source_subject_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or identifier for this subject record in the originating operational system (e.g., Medidata Rave subject OID, Oracle Clinical One patient ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the source system for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; Medidata Rave EDC subject OID conventions

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned unique subject identifier within the study, typically formatted as site-subject (e.g., 001-0042). This is the primary operational identifier used across EDC, CTMS, and regulatory submissions. Corresponds to SUBJID in CDISC SDTM DM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this subject record was sourced or is mastered (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, Oracle Clinical One, Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ALCOA+ compliance tracing.
attributes.value_regex: Medidata Rave|Oracle Clinical One|Oracle Siebel CTMS
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18

attributes.name: unique_subject_identifier
attributes.description: Globally unique subject identifier combining sponsor, study, and subject number (e.g., SPONSOR-STUDY-001-0042). Mandatory CDISC SDTM variable used across all regulatory submission datasets to unambiguously identify a subject across studies and submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — USUBJID; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH E3

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trial subject record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject withdrew from the study or was discontinued, if applicable. Null for subjects who completed the study. Used in subject disposition analysis and survival/time-to-event analyses.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDTC (withdrawal); ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Missing Data in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for subject withdrawal or discontinuation from the study, per CDISC SDTM DS domain controlled terminology (e.g., ADVERSE EVENT, WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT, PROTOCOL DEVIATION, LOST TO FOLLOW-UP, PHYSICIAN DECISION, DEATH). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ADVERSE EVENT|WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT|PROTOCOL DEVIATION|LOST TO FOLLOW-UP|PHYSICIAN DECISION|DEATH|LACK OF EFFICACY|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDECOD; MedDRA; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Missing Data

Tracks screening date, enrollment date, randomization eligibility confirmation, enrollment status (screened, enrolled, randomized, withdrawn, completed), and the site and study context. Represents the lifecycle milestone from first contact through study entry. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS and Oracle Clinical One.

attributes.name: blinding_status
attributes.description: Indicates the blinding status of the subject's treatment assignment at the time of this record. 'blinded' = treatment assignment is masked; 'unblinded' = treatment assignment has been revealed (e.g., emergency unblinding or end-of-study unblinding); 'open_label' = study design is open-label.

attributes.name: cohort_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the study cohort or stratum to which the subject belongs, used in stratified randomization designs. Distinct from treatment arm — a cohort may span multiple arms.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.ACTARM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject completed all required study procedures and visits per the protocol. Populated only when enrollment_status = 'completed'. Used for study close-out and CSR reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFENDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Supports ALCOA+ auditability and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: eligibility_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has been confirmed as meeting all inclusion/exclusion criteria defined in the study protocol prior to enrollment. True = all criteria verified; False = criteria not yet confirmed or subject failed screening.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM IE domain

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was formally enrolled into the clinical study following confirmation of eligibility and completion of informed consent. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this enrollment transaction. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject within the enrollment process. Represents the subject's progression from initial screening through study completion or withdrawal. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.DSDECOD; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the enrollment event type. 'new' = first-time enrollment in this study; 're_enrolled' = subject re-enrolled after a protocol-allowed break; 'rollover' = subject rolled over from a preceding study; 'replacement' = subject enrolled as a replacement per protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: first_dose_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject received the first dose of investigational product (IP). Defines the start of the treatment-emergent period for TEAE analysis. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFXSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CTCAE

attributes.name: icf_signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject (or legally authorized representative) signed the Informed Consent Form (ICF), confirming voluntary agreement to participate. Must precede any study-specific procedures. Sourced from Clinpal eConsent.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP; HIPAA; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: icf_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) signed by the subject at enrollment. Critical for regulatory compliance to confirm the subject consented under the correct IRB/IEC-approved version. Sourced from Clinpal eConsent and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP; GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: itt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). True = subject is in the ITT population. Used by biostatistics for primary efficacy analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; SAP

attributes.name: last_dose_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject received the last dose of investigational product (IP). Defines the end of the treatment-emergent period. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFXENDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's most recent completed study visit. Used to assess subject engagement, identify lost-to-follow-up risk, and support study close-out activities. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFPENDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: pp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). True = subject meets all protocol compliance criteria for PP inclusion.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance; SAP

attributes.name: randomization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was randomized to a treatment arm via the IRT/RTSM system. Null if the subject has not yet been randomized or was screen-failed prior to randomization. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RANDDT; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: randomization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has been confirmed as eligible for randomization following completion of the run-in or screening period. True = subject meets all randomization criteria per protocol. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IE domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: safety_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the safety analysis population (typically all subjects who received at least one dose of study treatment). Used for adverse event and safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance; SAP

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Coded or free-text reason why a subject failed screening and was not enrolled into the study. Populated only when enrollment_status = 'screen_failed'. Used for site feasibility analysis and protocol amendment decisions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject first presented at the site and underwent initial screening procedures to assess eligibility for the study. Represents the first contact milestone in the subject lifecycle.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: screening_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the subject at the time of screening, prior to formal enrollment or randomization. Used to track subjects who may not proceed to enrollment. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this enrollment record was sourced. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer. Expected values: Oracle_Clinical_One, Oracle_Siebel_CTMS, Medidata_Rave.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Native primary key or record identifier from the originating operational system (Oracle Siebel CTMS or Oracle Clinical One) for this enrollment record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: stratification_factor_1
attributes.description: Value of the first stratification factor used in the randomization scheme (e.g., disease severity, geographic region, biomarker status). Captured at randomization from the IRT/RTSM system. Specific factor definition is protocol-dependent.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DM domain; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: stratification_factor_2
attributes.description: Value of the second stratification factor used in the randomization scheme (e.g., prior treatment history, age group, sex). Captured at randomization from the IRT/RTSM system. Null if the protocol uses fewer than two stratification factors.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DM domain; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the subject at the site level, typically formatted as site-number + sequential subject number (e.g., 001-001). This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER used in eCRFs, EDC, and regulatory submissions. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.SUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: unblinding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's treatment assignment was unblinded, if applicable. Populated only for emergency or end-of-study unblinding events. Null for blinded or open-label subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: unblinding_reason
attributes.description: Reason for unblinding the subject's treatment assignment. 'emergency' = medical emergency requiring knowledge of treatment; 'end_of_study' = routine unblinding at study completion; 'dsmb_request' = DSMB/DMC-directed unblinding; 'regulatory_request' = unblinding requested by a regulatory authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified in the data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Supports ALCOA+ auditability and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: visit_compliance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of required protocol visits completed by the subject relative to the total number of scheduled visits. Calculated as (completed visits / scheduled visits) × 100. Used for per-protocol population determination and site performance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance on Missing Data; SAP

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject withdrew from the study or was withdrawn by the investigator. Populated only when enrollment_status = 'withdrawn'.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason

attributes.name: dispensing_visit_number

attributes.name: irt_system_name

attributes.name: randomization_date

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RANDDT; ICH E9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: The statistical randomization method used to generate this assignment (e.g., 'block' for permuted block randomization, 'minimization' for minimization/adaptive biased-coin, 'adaptive' for response-adaptive, 'simple' for simple randomization, 'stratified_block' for stratified block). Captured from the RTSM configuration at time of assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique randomization code assigned to the subject by the IRT/RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One IRT) at the time of randomization. This is the business identifier referenced in eCRFs, regulatory submissions, and audit trails. Corresponds to RNDMNO or equivalent field in RTSM.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RANDFL; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: randomization_ratio
attributes.description: The allocation ratio applied at randomization (e.g., '1:1', '2:1', '1:1:1'). Represents the relative probability of assignment to each treatment arm as defined in the protocol and RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: randomization_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the subject was randomized as recorded by the IRT/RTSM system. This is the authoritative business event timestamp for the randomization transaction. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DM.RANDDT; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: re_randomization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is a re-randomization event (True) rather than the initial randomization (False). Re-randomization may occur in crossover designs, adaptive trials, or following a protocol deviation that necessitates re-assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: sdtm_randfl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Randomized Flag

attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or contextual notes related to the deviation that do not fit into structured fields. May include reviewer notes, sponsor feedback, or monitoring observations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the immediate corrective action taken to address the deviation and prevent recurrence at the subject or site level. Distinct from the formal CAPA process which is tracked separately in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deviation record was first created in the source system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation compromised the integrity of study data collected from the subject. Informs decisions on data exclusion, sensitivity analyses, and per-protocol (PP) population definitions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; CDISC

attributes.name: deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the deviation by severity and impact. 'Major' deviations significantly affect subject safety or data integrity; 'important' deviations may affect subject rights or study data; 'minor' deviations have minimal impact. Drives regulatory reportability and CAPA requirements per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific deviation that occurred, including what protocol requirement was not met, the circumstances, and any relevant context. Captured by the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) or Clinical Research Associate (CRA) in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the deviation record as assigned by the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) or MasterControl. Used for cross-system referencing, regulatory submissions, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the deviation record. Tracks progression from initial identification through review, resolution, and closure. Drives operational dashboards and compliance monitoring in Oracle Siebel CTMS and MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the deviation was first identified or discovered, which may differ from the occurrence date. Used to calculate detection lag and assess monitoring effectiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. Separate from regulatory authority reportability. True = must report to IRB/IEC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the date the deviation was identified or reported. Critical for ALCOA+ compliance and regulatory timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVSTDTC

attributes.name: pi_aware_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was informed of the deviation. Used to track compliance with site notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: pi_aware_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) at the site has been made aware of this deviation. True = PI has been informed. Required for GCP compliance as the PI bears ultimate responsibility for conduct of the trial at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; FDA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section, clause, or requirement number within the approved study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 6.3.2 - Inclusion Criteria'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA Protocol Deviation Guidance; CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), IRB/IEC, or sponsor per applicable regulations and the study protocol. True = reportable; False = not reportable. Drives regulatory submission workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as applicable. Used to track compliance with reporting timelines mandated by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally resolved and closed in the quality management system. Used to calculate time-to-resolution metrics and assess site responsiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Narrative description of the underlying root cause of the deviation as determined through investigation. Used to inform corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and systemic quality improvement. Captured in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trending and systemic analysis across deviations. Categories align with standard quality management frameworks used in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain to which this deviation maps for regulatory submission. Protocol deviations are mapped to the DV (Protocol Deviations) domain per CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this deviation record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. Primary sources are Oracle Siebel CTMS and MasterControl.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (Oracle Siebel CTMS or MasterControl). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the deviation. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this deviation. True = sponsor has been notified. Required per GCP obligations for sponsor oversight of investigational sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subject_continuation_decision
attributes.description: Decision regarding the subject's continued participation in the study following the deviation. Informs subject disposition tracking and intent-to-treat (ITT) and per-protocol (PP) population assignments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.3; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: subject_rights_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation affected the rights or well-being of the trial subject, including informed consent procedures, privacy protections, or voluntary participation rights.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 2; Declaration of Helsinki; OHRP; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation had an impact on subject safety. 'None' indicates no safety impact; 'potential' indicates possible but unconfirmed impact; 'confirmed' indicates a verified safety impact. Critical for regulatory reporting decisions and DSMB/DMC review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific type of protocol deviation (e.g., eligibility criteria violation, missed visit, incorrect dosing, prohibited medication use, consent procedure deviation). Sourced from the MasterControl deviation classification taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ELIG_CRIT|MISSED_VISIT|INCORRECT_DOSE|PROHIBITED_MED|CONSENT_PROC|RANDOMIZATION|SAMPLE_TIMING|WASHOUT|CONCOMITANT_MED|ENDPOINT_ASSESS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVCAT/DVTERM

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the deviation_type_code, providing a plain-language description of the deviation type for reporting and review purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVTERM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deviation record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

products.name: disposition
products.description: Transactional record capturing each formal disposition milestone of a subject through the study lifecycle (screened, enrolled, randomized, completed, discontinued, withdrawn, lost to follow-up, death). Represents the SDTM DS domain SSOT and drives CONSORT flow diagrams and CSR disposition tables. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.

attributes.description: Reference to the trial participant (subject/patient) whose formal disposition milestone is being recorded. Core PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC subject master.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ae_related_discontinuation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's discontinuation was due to an adverse event (AE) or serious adverse event (SAE). When True, links to the safety domain for AE-driven disposition analysis and regulatory safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM AE/DS Domains; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: analysis_population_itt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population based on disposition and protocol criteria. Drives primary efficacy analysis dataset inclusion. Determined by biostatistics per the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).
