attributes.name: analysis_population_pp
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population. Subjects with major protocol deviations affecting efficacy assessment are typically excluded. Determined by biostatistics per the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance on PP Analysis; SAP

attributes.name: analysis_population_safety
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Safety analysis population (subjects who received at least one dose of investigational product). Drives safety tabulations in the CSR and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA/EMA Safety Reporting Requirements; SAP

attributes.name: coded_reason
attributes.description: Standardized coded reason for discontinuation or withdrawal after medical coding against MedDRA or sponsor-specific dictionary. Corresponds to SDTM DSDECOD. Used in CSR disposition tables and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; MedDRA; ICH E3; FDA NDA/BLA Submission Requirements

attributes.name: data_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED — timestamp when the disposition record was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous data entry requirements and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: death_cause
attributes.description: Verbatim or coded cause of death for subjects with DEATH disposition. Used in safety narratives, CSR, and regulatory submissions. Coded against MedDRA when applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; MedDRA; FDA/EMA Safety Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: death_date
attributes.description: Date of subject death when the disposition term is DEATH. Required for survival analysis, time-to-event endpoints, and expedited safety reporting. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC death records and Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS/AE Domains; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) — the calendar date on which the formal disposition milestone occurred for the subject (e.g., date of randomization, date of last study visit, date of withdrawal). Corresponds to SDTM DSSTDTC (start date component). Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: LIFECYCLE_STATUS of this disposition record within the EDC/data management workflow. Indicates whether the record is the current active disposition, has been superseded by a correction, is pending data review, or has been cancelled. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC record status.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Full ISO 8601 timestamp of the disposition event when time-of-day precision is available. Supplements disposition_date for events requiring precise timing (e.g., time of death, time of last dose). Corresponds to SDTM DSSTDTC full datetime.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ds_seq
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the order of disposition records for a given subject within the study, corresponding to the SDTM DSSEQ variable. Supports multiple disposition milestones per subject (e.g., enrolled then discontinued).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain v3.3; FDA SDTM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: early_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject terminated study participation before completing all protocol-required activities. Distinct from study_completion_flag in that it specifically flags premature exit for operational tracking and site performance metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last known contact with the study team, including phone calls, remote visits, or any study-related communication. Used for lost-to-follow-up determination and survival analysis censoring.
attributes.references: ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; FDA Guidance on Missing Data in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: last_dose_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last administration of investigational product (IP) prior to or at the disposition milestone. Critical for calculating treatment duration, exposure windows, and safety follow-up periods. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC dosing records.
attributes.references: ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED — timestamp of the most recent modification to this disposition record in the EDC system. Supports audit trail requirements and data change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last scheduled or unscheduled study visit prior to or at the disposition milestone. Used to determine last study contact and assess visit compliance. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC visit records.
attributes.references: ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: meddra_pt
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) assigned to the coded discontinuation reason. Enables standardized cross-study analysis and regulatory reporting of disposition reasons. Populated by the medical coding process.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH M1; FDA/EMA Coding Requirements

attributes.name: meddra_soc
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) associated with the coded discontinuation reason Preferred Term. Supports regulatory tabulation and signal detection for disposition-related safety analysis.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH M1; FDA/EMA Coding Requirements

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding the disposition reason (e.g., 26.0, 26.1). Required for regulatory submission traceability and reproducibility of coded terms.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; FDA/EMA Submission Requirements

attributes.name: milestone_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of disposition milestone. Used to group disposition events for CONSORT flow diagram construction and CSR disposition tables. Aligns with SDTM DSCAT variable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SCREENING|ENROLLMENT|RANDOMIZATION|TREATMENT|FOLLOW_UP|COMPLETION|DISCONTINUATION|WITHDRAWAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CONSORT 2010 Statement

attributes.name: milestone_subcategory
attributes.description: Sponsor-defined subcategory further classifying the disposition milestone within its category (e.g., PROTOCOL DEVIATION, ADVERSE EVENT, SPONSOR DECISION under DISCONTINUATION). Corresponds to SDTM DSSCAT variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines

attributes.name: query_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is at least one open data discrepancy query against this disposition record in the EDC system. Supports data management oversight and database lock (DBL) readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: safety_followup_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end date of the post-discontinuation safety follow-up period. Populated when safety_followup_required is True. Used to track completion of safety obligations for discontinued subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; Protocol Safety Requirements

attributes.name: safety_followup_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject requires a post-discontinuation safety follow-up period per protocol requirements. True when the subject discontinued early and protocol mandates continued safety monitoring. Drives safety follow-up visit scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; Protocol Safety Requirements

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Reason why a screened subject failed to meet eligibility criteria and was not enrolled. Populated only for SCREEN FAILURE disposition. Used for site feasibility analysis and protocol amendment decisions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: sdtm_ds_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique record identifier from the CDISC SDTM DS (Disposition) domain dataset, enabling traceability between the Silver Layer lakehouse record and the regulatory submission dataset. Supports eCTD submission package linkage.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain v3.3; FDA SDTM Implementation Guide; eCTD Submission Requirements

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of source data verification (SDV) for this disposition record, indicating whether the CRA has verified the data against source documents. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring records. Supports GCP compliance and monitoring oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this disposition record was sourced. Primarily Medidata Rave EDC for disposition data. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: study_completion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject completed the study per protocol (True) or did not complete (False). Drives CONSORT flow diagram completion counts and CSR disposition summary tables.
attributes.references: CONSORT 2010 Statement; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: subject_number

attributes.name: term

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; MedDRA; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country where the subject was enrolled. Used for geographic subgroup analyses, regulatory reporting by region, and CDISC SDTM DM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.COUNTRY; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the demographic record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_entry_status
attributes.description: Current data entry and verification status of the demographic eCRF form in the EDC system. Tracks completeness and readiness for database lock (DBL) and SDTM submission.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.18

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the demographic data was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Plan (DMP)

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subject's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate age at key study milestones and to verify age-based eligibility criteria. May be partially masked (year only) per privacy regulations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.BRTHDTC; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: dm_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential record number within the DM domain for a given subject, per CDISC SDTM convention. Used to uniquely identify each demographic record when multiple records exist per subject (e.g., re-screening scenarios).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.DMSEQ

attributes.name: edc_subject_key
attributes.description: Source system record key for the subject's demographic record in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Enables traceability from the silver layer back to the source EDC record for SDV and audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: epoch
attributes.description: The study epoch (e.g., SCREENING, TREATMENT, FOLLOW-UP) during which the demographic data was collected, per CDISC SDTM Trial Epochs dataset. Used for temporal context in multi-epoch study designs.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.EPOCH; CDISC Trial Epochs Dataset

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported ethnic origin, coded per FDA and CDISC controlled terminology. Distinguishes Hispanic/Latino origin from non-Hispanic/Latino. Required for FDA demographic subgroup reporting in NDA/BLA submissions.
attributes.value_regex: HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT REPORTED|UNKNOWN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.ETHNIC; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; ICH E5

attributes.name: first_exposure_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's first exposure to the investigational product (IP). Defines the start of the treatment period and is the reference date for study day calculations in CDISC SDTM DM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFSTDTC; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported gender identity, distinct from biological sex. Collected per evolving FDA guidance on inclusion of gender identity in clinical trials. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MALE|FEMALE|TRANSGENDER MALE|TRANSGENDER FEMALE|NON-BINARY|PREFER NOT TO ANSWER|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Draft Guidance on Diversity Action Plans (2024); CDISC SDTM DM.GENDER

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Subject's height in centimeters measured at baseline/screening visit. Used for body surface area (BSA) calculations, dose determination, and baseline characteristic tables in the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM VS Domain (VSTEST=HEIGHT); CDISC ADaM ADSL HEIGHTBL

attributes.name: informed_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject signed the informed consent form (ICF) prior to any study-related procedures. Anchors the CDISC SDTM DM.RFICDTC reference date and is required for regulatory compliance and ALCOA+ data integrity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFICDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP 4.8; 21 CFR 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_exposure_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last exposure to the investigational product (IP). Used to define the end of the treatment period and calculate treatment duration for safety and efficacy analyses.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFENDTC; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lock_status
attributes.description: Lock status of the demographic eCRF record in the EDC system. LOCKED records cannot be modified without an audit-trailed unlock. FROZEN records are pending final database lock (DBL).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.18; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA DBL Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol in effect at the time the demographic data was collected. Ensures traceability of demographic assessments to the applicable protocol amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 8.2; CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR 312.62

attributes.name: query_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more open data queries (discrepancies) exist against this demographic record in the EDC system. True = at least one unresolved query; False = no open queries. Used for data cleaning tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: race
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported racial category, coded per FDA and CDISC controlled terminology (e.g., WHITE, BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN, ASIAN, AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE, NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER, MULTIPLE, UNKNOWN, NOT REPORTED). Required for FDA demographic subgroup analyses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WHITE|BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN|ASIAN|AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE|NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER|MULTIPLE|UNKNOWN|NOT REPORTED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RACE; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; 21 CFR 312.33

attributes.name: race_other_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of race when the subject selects 'OTHER' or 'MULTIPLE' as their racial category. Captures verbatim self-reported race for completeness in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RACEOTH; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data

attributes.name: reference_start_date
attributes.description: The protocol-defined reference start date for the subject, used as the anchor for study day (STUDYDAY) calculations across all SDTM domains. May differ from first_exposure_date in some study designs (e.g., observational studies).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.RFSTDTC; CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain code for this record. Always 'DM' for demographic records. Included to support automated SDTM dataset generation and regulatory submission pipelines.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of source data verification (SDV) for the demographic record, indicating whether the EDC data has been verified against source documents by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) during site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; ALCOA+

attributes.name: sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the subject as recorded at screening, coded per CDISC controlled terminology. M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, UNDIFFERENTIATED=Intersex or not classifiable. Used in safety analyses, PK/PD modeling, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.SEX; CDISC CT SDTM SEX; FDA Guidance on Sex as Biological Variable

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Site-assigned subject number used to identify the participant within the study site. Typically formatted as a numeric or alphanumeric code assigned at screening or enrollment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.SUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: unique_subject_identifier
attributes.description: Globally unique identifier for the subject across the study, constructed per CDISC SDTM convention (typically STUDYID-SITEID-SUBJID). Used as the primary cross-domain linkage key in SDTM submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM.USUBJID; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the demographic record in the silver layer lakehouse. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Subject's body weight in kilograms measured at baseline/screening visit. Used for dose calculations, PK/PD modeling, BMI derivation, and baseline characteristic tables in the CSR.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM VS Domain (VSTEST=WEIGHT); CDISC ADaM ADSL WEIGHTBL

products.name: medical_history
products.description: Records subject medical history and pre-existing conditions collected during screening, coded to MedDRA terms, with onset dates, resolution status, and relevance to study eligibility.

attributes.name: medical_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each medical history record in the clinical trial system. Primary key for the medical_history data product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: coding_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.coding_assignment. Business justification: Medical history conditions require MedDRA coding for SDTM MH domain submission. Linking medical_history directly to its coding_assignment record enables medical reviewers and data managers to verify c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.ecrf_form. Business justification: Medical history is captured on the MH eCRF form. Replacing the denormalized ecrf_form_name with a proper FK to ecrf_form supports SDV workflows, form version tracking, and SDTM MH domain generation —
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Medical history is collected during the screening and enrollment process as part of eligibility assessment. Linking medical_history to the specific enrollment record provides the enrollment-episode co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.principal_investigator. Business justification: Medical history collection and SDV is a PI-delegated activity per GCP. Delegation log audits and regulatory inspections require traceability of which PI or sub-investigator collected and verified base
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which this medical history record was collected. Links the record to the sponsoring protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the medical history was collected during screening or baseline assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM MH Domain

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Medical history is collected during screening visits. medical_history carries a denormalized screening_visit_number (STRING) that should be normalized via FK to subject_visit. Adding subject_visit_id
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose medical history is recorded. Core linkage to the trial_subject master record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA

attributes.name: ae_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medical history condition has been associated with or contributed to an adverse event (AE) reported during the study. Supports integrated safety analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE Domain; FDA Safety Reporting; EMA Pharmacovigilance

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical history was collected or assessed by the investigator or CRC during the screening visit. Corresponds to the eCRF data entry date for this record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: coding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the verbatim medical history condition was coded to a MedDRA term. Supports audit trail requirements for medical coding activities.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; MedDRA; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: coding_status
attributes.description: Current status of the MedDRA coding process for this medical history condition. Tracks whether the verbatim term has been coded, auto-coded, reviewed, or approved by the medical coder.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; MedDRA; FDA Data Standards

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or additional clinical context provided by the investigator regarding this medical history condition. May include relevant clinical details not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM MHCOMM; ALCOA+

attributes.name: concomitant_medication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is receiving concomitant medication for this medical history condition at the time of screening. Supports concomitant medication reconciliation and safety analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Concomitant Medications

attributes.name: condition_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of medical history entry. Corresponds to SDTM MHCAT variable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MEDICAL HISTORY|SURGICAL HISTORY|FAMILY HISTORY|PSYCHIATRIC HISTORY|ALLERGY|OBSTETRIC HISTORY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MHCAT; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current clinical status of the pre-existing medical condition at the time of data collection. Supports safety profiling and eligibility determination.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: condition_subcategory
attributes.description: Optional secondary classification of the medical history condition providing further granularity within the category (e.g., CARDIOVASCULAR within MEDICAL HISTORY). Corresponds to SDTM MHSCAT.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MHSCAT; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: condition_verbatim
attributes.description: The verbatim (as-reported) text of the pre-existing medical condition or medical history event as entered by the investigator or CRC in the eCRF. This is the raw, uncoded term prior to MedDRA coding.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MHTERM; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this medical history record was first created in the EDC system or lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: edc_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique record identifier assigned by the EDC system (Medidata Rave) for this medical history entry. Used for source data verification (SDV) and data reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: eligibility_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medical history condition is relevant to the study's inclusion/exclusion eligibility criteria. Used by the medical monitor and data management team to assess protocol compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; CDISC SDTM MH Domain

attributes.name: lock_status
attributes.description: Data lock status of this medical history record in the EDC system. Locked records cannot be modified without an authorized unlock procedure, supporting database lock (DBL) integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; ALCOA+

attributes.name: meddra_llt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Lowest Level Term
attributes.description: The MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) that most closely maps to the verbatim condition text. Provides the most granular level of MedDRA coding hierarchy.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM; ICH M1

attributes.name: meddra_pt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term
attributes.description: The MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) assigned to the verbatim medical history condition during medical coding. Used for standardized regulatory reporting and safety analysis.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM MHDECOD; ICH M1; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: meddra_soc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class
attributes.description: The MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) associated with the coded medical history condition. Used for aggregate safety reporting and tabulation by body system.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM MHSOC; ICH M1; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version
attributes.description: The version of the MedDRA dictionary used to code this medical history condition (e.g., 26.0). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coding.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM MHVERSION; ICH M1; FDA eCTD

attributes.name: mh_seq
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying each medical history record for a given subject within a study. Corresponds to the SDTM MHSEQ variable used in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain v3.3; FDA eCTD

attributes.name: ongoing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the medical history condition was ongoing at the time of the subject's screening or baseline assessment. True = condition is still active; False = condition has resolved. Corresponds to SDTM MHENRF or MHONGO.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pre-existing medical condition first began or was first diagnosed. May be partial (year only or year-month) per CDISC partial date conventions. Corresponds to SDTM MHSTDTC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MHSTDTC; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA; GDPR

attributes.name: pre_existing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the condition was present prior to the subject's first dose of investigational product. Distinguishes pre-existing conditions from treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) in safety analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MH Domain; ICH E2A; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance; CTCAE

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol in effect at the time this medical history record was collected. Ensures traceability of data to the applicable protocol amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: query_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is at least one open data query (discrepancy) against this medical history record in the EDC system. Supports data cleaning and database lock readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pre-existing medical condition resolved or ended. Null if the condition is ongoing at the time of assessment. Corresponds to SDTM MHENDTC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM MHENDTC; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain code for this record. For medical history records this is always 'MH'. Used during SDTM dataset generation for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Data Standards Catalog; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdv_date
attributes.description: The date on which source data verification was completed for this medical history record by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of source data verification for this medical history record. Indicates whether the CRA has verified the eCRF data against source documents at the investigational site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; ALCOA+

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Clinical severity grading of the pre-existing medical condition as assessed by the investigator. Supports safety profiling and eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: CTCAE; CDISC SDTM MHSEV; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this medical history record was sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this medical history entry in the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave record OID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse and the EDC.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this medical history record was last modified in the EDC system or lakehouse. Required for audit trail compliance and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: concomitant_medication
products.description: Records medications taken by subjects before and during the trial, including drug name, indication, dose, route, start/stop dates, and WHO-DD coding.

attributes.name: concomitant_medication_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each concomitant medication record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adverse event record that prompted initiation or modification of this concomitant medication, when ae_related_flag is True. Supports traceability between safety events and concomitant medication changes.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM CM Domain; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA Safety Reporting

attributes.name: coding_assignment_id

attributes.name: continuation_of_concomitant_medication_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on concomitant_medication (continuation_of_concomitant_medication_id)

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form ID
attributes.description: Reference to the specific eCRF form instance in Medidata Rave from which this concomitant medication record was sourced. Supports source data verification (SDV) and audit trail traceability per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Concomitant medications are collected within the context of a specific study enrollment. Adding enrollment_id to concomitant_medication properly scopes each medication record to its enrollment, enabli
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id

Regulatory submissions and inspection readiness require PI-level accountability for concomitant medic
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which this concomitant medication record was collected.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the concomitant medication was reported or collected.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM CM Domain

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Concomitant medications are recorded and assessed at study visits. concomitant_medication carries denormalized visit_name (STRING) and visit_number (INT) that should be normalized via FK to subject_vi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) for whom this concomitant medication is recorded.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: ae_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this concomitant medication was initiated or modified in response to an adverse event (AE). Supports causality assessment and safety narrative construction in Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM CM Domain; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA Safety Reporting

attributes.name: cm_seq
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying each concomitant medication record for a given subject within a study, used for SDTM CM domain sequencing (CMSEQ). Enables ordering of multiple medication records per subject.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain v3.3; FDA SDTM Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the investigator, CRC, or data manager regarding this concomitant medication record. May include clarifications on dose changes, interruptions, or special circumstances not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: concomitant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the medication was taken concomitantly (during the study treatment period) as opposed to only in the pre-study period. Supports classification of medications as prior vs. concomitant per SDTM CM domain conventions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Concomitant Medications

attributes.name: concomitant_medication_category
attributes.description: Sponsor-defined category grouping for the concomitant medication (e.g., PRIOR, CONCOMITANT, PROHIBITED, RESCUE). Corresponds to SDTM CMCAT. Used for protocol-specific medication classification and reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMCAT); ICH E6(R2); Study Protocol

attributes.name: data_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this concomitant medication record was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: dose
attributes.description: The numeric dose amount of the concomitant medication administered per dose event. Corresponds to SDTM CMDOSE. Must be interpreted in conjunction with dose_unit.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMDOSE); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dose_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical form of the concomitant medication (e.g., TABLET, CAPSULE, SOLUTION, PATCH, INJECTION). Corresponds to SDTM CMDOSFRM. Supports pharmacokinetic and bioavailability analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMDOSFRM); CDISC Controlled Terminology; WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD)

attributes.name: dose_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the concomitant medication is administered (e.g., QD, BID, TID, QID, PRN, weekly). Corresponds to SDTM CMDOSFRQ. Uses CDISC controlled terminology for standardized reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMDOSFRQ); CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: dose_route
attributes.description: The route by which the concomitant medication is administered (e.g., ORAL, INTRAVENOUS, SUBCUTANEOUS, TOPICAL, INHALATION). Corresponds to SDTM CMDOSROUTE. Uses CDISC controlled terminology.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMDOSROUTE); CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: dose_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the concomitant medication dose (e.g., mg, mcg, IU, mL). Corresponds to SDTM CMDOSU. Required for accurate dose interpretation and cross-study comparisons.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMDOSU); CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject stopped taking the concomitant medication. Corresponds to SDTM CMENDTC (date portion). Null if medication is ongoing at time of data collection. Used for duration calculations and temporal overlap analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMENDTC); ICH E6(R2); FDA Safety Reporting

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The clinical reason or medical condition for which the concomitant medication is being taken, as reported by the subject or investigator. Corresponds to SDTM CMINDC. Used for safety and drug-drug interaction analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMINDC); ICH E6(R2); MedDRA

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this concomitant medication record was most recently modified in the source EDC system. Required for audit trail compliance per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: modified_drug_name
attributes.description: Standardized or sponsor-modified version of the verbatim drug name after data cleaning, prior to WHO-DD coding. Corresponds to SDTM CMMODIFY. Used when the verbatim term is modified for coding purposes.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMMODIFY); WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD)

attributes.name: ongoing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concomitant medication was still ongoing at the time of the last assessment or data collection. Corresponds to SDTM CMONGO. True when end_date is not yet known or medication continues beyond the observation window.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMONGO); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: prior_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the medication was taken prior to the start of the study (pre-existing medication) as opposed to being initiated during the study. Corresponds to SDTM CMPRESP/CMOCCUR context. Supports prior therapy analysis in efficacy and safety assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; ICH E3 Clinical Study Report Guidelines

attributes.name: prohibited_medication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this concomitant medication is classified as a prohibited medication per the study protocol. A True value may trigger a protocol deviation review. Critical for protocol compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Study Protocol; CDISC SDTM CM Domain; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: query_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is at least one open data discrepancy query against this concomitant medication record in the EDC system. Supports data management workflow tracking and database lock (DBL) readiness assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DM Best Practices; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current data management status of the concomitant medication record in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Indicates whether the record is active, has been deleted, amended after lock, or locked for database lock (DBL).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: rescue_medication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medication was administered as a rescue therapy per the study protocol (e.g., for breakthrough pain, hypoglycemia rescue). Rescue medication use is a key efficacy endpoint in many trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Study Protocol; CDISC SDTM CM Domain; FDA Efficacy Endpoint Guidance

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain code for this record. Always 'CM' (Concomitant and Prior Medications) for records in this product. Used for SDTM dataset generation and regulatory submission via eCTD.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.3; FDA SDTM Submission Guidelines; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Current source data verification (SDV) status for this concomitant medication record, as tracked by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) in the CTMS. Indicates whether the data has been verified against source documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the source EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave internal record key) for this concomitant medication entry. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this concomitant medication record was extracted (e.g., MEDIDATA_RAVE, ORACLE_CLINICAL_ONE). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Best Practices

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject began taking the concomitant medication. Corresponds to SDTM CMSTDTC (date portion). Used to determine temporal overlap with investigational product exposure and adverse event onset.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMSTDTC); ICH E6(R2); FDA Safety Reporting

attributes.name: study_day_end
attributes.description: The study day on which the concomitant medication was stopped, calculated relative to the reference start date. Corresponds to SDTM CMENDY. Null if medication is ongoing. Used for duration and overlap calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMENDY); CDISC Study Day Calculation Rules; ICH E3

attributes.name: study_day_start
attributes.description: The study day on which the concomitant medication was started, calculated relative to the reference start date (Day 1 = first dose of investigational product). Corresponds to SDTM CMSTDY. Enables temporal analysis relative to IP exposure.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMSTDY); CDISC Study Day Calculation Rules; ICH E3

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Sponsor-defined subcategory for further classification of the concomitant medication within its category (e.g., ANALGESIC, ANTIBIOTIC, ANTIHYPERTENSIVE). Corresponds to SDTM CMSCAT. Enables granular therapeutic class reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMSCAT); Study Protocol; ICH E3

attributes.name: verbatim_drug_name
attributes.description: The medication name exactly as reported by the subject or investigator on the electronic Case Report Form (eCRF), prior to WHO-DD coding. Corresponds to SDTM CMTRT field. Preserved for source data traceability per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMTRT); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: whodb_atc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification Code
attributes.description: The Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code assigned by the WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) for the concomitant medication. Enables therapeutic class-level analysis and drug-drug interaction assessment.
attributes.references: WHO ATC Classification System; WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD); CDISC SDTM CM Domain

attributes.name: whodb_drug_name
attributes.description: The preferred drug name as coded against the WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD). Corresponds to SDTM CMDECOD. Enables standardized cross-study drug identification and safety signal detection.
attributes.references: WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD); CDISC SDTM CM Domain (CMDECOD); ICH E2B; FDA Pharmacovigilance

attributes.name: whodb_version
attributes.description: Version of the WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) used for coding this concomitant medication record. Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coded data.
attributes.references: WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD); CDISC SDTM CM Domain; FDA eCTD Submission Guidelines

domains.name: safety

Each AE may progress through multiple follow-up updates as clinical picture evolves, with version tracking for each update. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety and EDC (Medidata Rave). This is the SSOT for all AE occurrences and their temporal evolution across studies and subjects.

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) who experienced the adverse event. Core party reference linking the AE to the enrolled participant.

attributes.name: action_taken
attributes.description: Action taken with the investigational product in response to the adverse event, as recorded by the investigator. Drives dose modification tracking and safety signal analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AEACN; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: ae_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the adverse event record, reflecting whether the event is still active, has resolved, or resulted in death. Drives workflow routing in Oracle Argus Safety and expedited reporting decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM AEOUT; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: ae_term_verbatim
attributes.description: The exact verbatim text of the adverse event as reported by the investigator or subject on the eCRF, prior to MedDRA coding. Preserved for ALCOA+ compliance and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM AETERM; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: argus_case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known case identifier assigned by Oracle Argus Safety upon initial AE entry. This is the business-facing identifier used in regulatory submissions, safety narratives, and cross-system reconciliation with the source system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety; ICH E2B(R3); FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: awareness_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor (or CRO acting on behalf of the sponsor) first became aware of the adverse event. This is the clock-start date for regulatory expedited reporting timelines per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Argus Safety; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: causality_assessment
attributes.description: Investigator's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event. Determines whether the event qualifies as a suspected adverse reaction and drives SUSAR classification and expedited reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment; CDISC SDTM AEREL; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: concomitant_medication_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event may be related to concomitant medications taken by the subject, as assessed by the investigator. Supports differential causality analysis and confounding factor assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM AERELCON; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this adverse event record was first created in the source system (Oracle Argus Safety). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; Oracle Argus Safety; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctcae_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grade
attributes.description: Severity grade assigned per the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE), ranging from 1 (mild) to 5 (death). The primary severity measure used in oncology and other therapeutic areas for safety reporting and DSMB/DMC reviews.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; CDISC SDTM AETOXGR; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on CTCAE

attributes.name: dsmb_reported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adverse event has been reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent safety review. Supports DSMB/DMC meeting preparation and safety oversight documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Guideline on DMC; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: edc_subject_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Subject Sequence Number
attributes.description: The AE sequence number assigned within the EDC system (Medidata Rave eCRF) for the subject, used to reconcile the safety database record with the source eCRF entry during SDV and data review.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM AESEQ; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the most current version of the adverse event. Used to filter the latest state of each AE without requiring a MAX(version_number) query, supporting efficient reporting and analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: is_expected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event is listed in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or product labeling as an expected/anticipated reaction. Unexpected serious adverse reactions trigger SUSAR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM AEEXP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: is_serious
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event meets the regulatory definition of a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) per ICH E2A criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, or other medically important condition). Triggers expedited regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance; CDISC SDTM AESER

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adverse event has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), requiring expedited regulatory reporting to health authorities (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) within defined timelines (7 or 15 calendar days).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA EudraVigilance; MHRA

attributes.name: is_teae
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event is treatment-emergent, defined as an event that first occurred or worsened in severity after the first dose of investigational product. Used in TEAE incidence tables in the CSR and SAP-defined safety analyses.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM ADAE; SAP; SAS Drug Development; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting

attributes.name: meddra_llt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Lowest Level Term (LLT) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) numeric code assigned during medical coding, representing the most granular level of the MedDRA hierarchy closest to the verbatim term.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AELLTCD; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: meddra_llt_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Lowest Level Term (LLT) Name
attributes.description: MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) text description corresponding to the LLT code. Used in safety listings, narratives, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AELLT; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) numeric code, the primary level used for regulatory reporting, signal detection, and aggregate safety analysis.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEPTCD; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: meddra_pt_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Name
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) text description. The standardized medical term used in all regulatory submissions, DSMB/DMC reports, and safety narratives.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEDECOD; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) numeric code representing the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy. Used for aggregate safety tabulations by body system in CSRs and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AESOCCD; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: meddra_soc_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Name
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) text description. Used in safety tabulations, listings, and figures in the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AESOC; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding this adverse event (e.g., '26.0'). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coded terms across dictionary versions.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: medical_history_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event is considered related to or a continuation of a pre-existing medical history condition, as assessed by the investigator. Supports pre-existing condition confounding analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM AERELMH; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Free-text medical narrative describing the clinical course of the adverse event, including relevant medical history, treatment, and outcome. Required for SAE/SUSAR regulatory submissions and DSMB/DMC safety reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adverse event first began, as reported by the investigator. This is the principal real-world event date used for duration calculations, expedited reporting timelines, and TEAE determination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM AESTDTC; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final or current outcome of the adverse event as assessed by the investigator. Used in safety listings, aggregate safety tables, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AEOUT; Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: regulatory_report_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which an expedited safety report (e.g., SUSAR, IND Safety Report) must be submitted to the relevant health authority. Calculated from the date of first awareness per ICH E2A timelines (7-day for fatal/life-threatening, 15-day for other SUSARs).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA EudraVigilance; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the expedited safety report was submitted to the health authority. Used to calculate compliance with regulatory reporting timelines and track submission performance KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA EudraVigilance; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the initial AE report, a follow-up update with new clinical information, or the final report upon event resolution. Supports version history tracking as the clinical picture evolves.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); Oracle Argus Safety; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adverse event resolved or returned to baseline. Null if the event is ongoing. Used to calculate AE duration and determine outcome status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM AEENDTC; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: seriousness_criteria
attributes.description: Specific ICH E2A seriousness criterion or criteria met by this SAE (e.g., death, life-threatening, hospitalization required, persistent disability, congenital anomaly, medically significant). Multiple criteria may apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death|life_threatening|hospitalization|prolonged_hospitalization|disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; CDISC SDTM AESDTH/AESHOSP/AESLIFE/AESDISAB/AESCONG/AESMIE; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Descriptive severity classification of the adverse event as assessed by the investigator (mild, moderate, severe, life-threatening, fatal). Distinct from CTCAE grade; used in non-oncology studies and as a complementary severity descriptor per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AESEV; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this adverse event record was sourced (Oracle Argus Safety, Medidata Rave EDC, Oracle Clinical One, or manual entry). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; CDISC Data Management

attributes.name: study_day_onset
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Day of Adverse Event (AE) Onset
attributes.description: The study day (relative to first dose date) on which the adverse event began. Calculated per CDISC convention (Day 1 = first dose date). Used in time-to-event analyses and safety exposure-adjusted incidence calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM AESTDY; CDISC ADaM; ICH E9; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this adverse event record was most recently modified in the source system. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; Oracle Argus Safety; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this AE record, incremented with each follow-up update. Version 1 is the initial report; subsequent versions capture evolving clinical information. Enables temporal evolution tracking across the AE lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: EU SAEs are reported under the CTA framework. attributes.name: blinding_status

attributes.name: causality_assessment
attributes.description: The investigator's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the SAE. This is a critical regulatory field used to determine whether the event qualifies as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the SAE record was first created in Oracle Argus Safety. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field per canonical transaction header requirements. Conforms to 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: ctcae_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Severity Grade
attributes.description: The CTCAE severity grade assigned to the SAE, ranging from 1 (mild) to 5 (death). Grade 3 = severe, Grade 4 = life-threatening, Grade 5 = death. Used for oncology and other therapeutic area safety assessments.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; CDISC SDTM AE.AETOXGR; FDA Guidance on Adverse Event Reporting

attributes.name: dsmb_reported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAE was reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent safety review. Required for studies with an active DSMB/DMC charter.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006); EMA Reflection Paper on DMCs

attributes.name: expectedness
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE is expected (listed in the Investigator's Brochure or product labeling) or unexpected (not listed or differing in nature/severity). Unexpected + serious + related = SUSAR, triggering expedited regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: follow_up_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which follow-up report this record represents (0 = initial report, 1 = first follow-up, 2 = second follow-up, etc.). Used to track the evolution of the SAE case over time as new information becomes available.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: initial_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SAE was first reported to the sponsor or CRO by the investigational site. This is Day 0 for calculating regulatory reporting timelines (e.g., 7-day or 15-day expedited reporting clock).
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of the SAE. Required under GCP and local regulations to ensure ongoing ethical oversight of the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAE has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), requiring expedited regulatory reporting to health authorities (e.g., FDA 7/15-day reporting, EMA reporting). Derived from causality, expectedness, and seriousness criteria but stored as a business flag.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: meddra_llt_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) code that most closely matches the verbatim SAE term. The LLT is the most granular level of MedDRA coding and is used to preserve the original reported term in a coded format.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AELLT

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code assigned to the SAE. The PT is the primary level of MedDRA used for regulatory reporting and is the standard coded term submitted in ICSRs and clinical study reports.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AEDECOD; ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code assigned to the SAE during medical coding. Represents the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy, used for regulatory submissions and safety signal detection.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AESOC

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: The version of the MedDRA dictionary used to code this SAE (e.g., '26.0', '26.1'). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coding and compliance with current dictionary standards.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; ICH E2B(R3); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: The full medical narrative describing the SAE, including clinical course, relevant medical history, concomitant medications, investigational product details, and the investigator's assessment. This is the primary free-text field in the Argus Safety case and is included in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 6; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the serious adverse event first began or was first observed by the subject or investigator. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the SAE transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; CDISC SDTM AE.AESTDTC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The clinical outcome of the serious adverse event at the time of the most recent report. 'recovered_with_sequelae' indicates the subject recovered but with lasting effects. 'fatal' must align with seriousness_death = true.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) Element C.1.7; CDISC SDTM AE.AEOUT; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: regulatory_report_due_date
attributes.description: The calculated deadline by which the expedited regulatory report (e.g., IND Safety Report, SUSAR notification) must be submitted to the relevant health authority. Typically 7 calendar days for fatal/life-threatening SUSARs and 15 calendar days for other SUSARs.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of safety report generated for this SAE. 'expedited' = 7/15-day SUSAR or IND safety report; 'periodic' = included in DSUR/PSUR; 'spontaneous' = post-marketing spontaneous report; 'literature' = identified from published literature.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2C(R2) DSUR; EMA GVP Module VI; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: reporting_authority
attributes.description: The health authority or regulatory body to which the SAE/SUSAR report was submitted (e.g., 'FDA', 'EMA', 'MHRA', 'PMDA', 'TGA', 'Health Canada'). May contain multiple authorities if reported to more than one. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|ANVISA|CDSCO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GVP Module VI; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the serious adverse event resolved, stabilized, or the subject died. Null if the event is ongoing at the time of reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE.AEENDTC; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: sae_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SAE case in Oracle Argus Safety. 'initial' = first report received; 'follow_up' = additional information received; 'closed' = case fully resolved and closed; 'nullified' = case determined not to meet SAE criteria and voided.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: sae_term
attributes.description: The verbatim (as-reported) description of the serious adverse event as recorded by the investigator or site staff in the source document or eCRF. This is the raw, uncoded term prior to MedDRA coding.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE.AETERM; Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: seriousness_congenital_anomaly
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seriousness Criterion: Congenital Anomaly or Birth Defect
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of resulting in a congenital anomaly or birth defect in the offspring of the subject.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_death
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of resulting in death of the subject. One of the six ICH E2A seriousness criteria that must be captured individually.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_disability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of resulting in persistent or significant disability or incapacity.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_hospitalization
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of requiring inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_life_threatening
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of being immediately life-threatening (i.e., the subject was at immediate risk of death at the time of the event).
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_medically_important
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seriousness Criterion: Other Medically Important Condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of being an other medically important condition — events that may not be immediately life-threatening but may jeopardize the subject or require intervention to prevent one of the other serious outcomes.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: sponsor_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor (or CRO acting on behalf of the sponsor) received the complete minimum information required to process the SAE. This date starts the regulatory reporting clock per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The protocol-assigned subject identifier (e.g., site-subject number) for the patient who experienced the SAE. Restricted as it can be used to identify an individual participant in combination with study data.
