attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety; ICH E2A

attributes.name: awareness_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor (or CRO acting on behalf of the sponsor) first became aware of the SUSAR. This date starts the regulatory reporting clock for 7-day and 15-day expedited reporting obligations under ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: blind_break_date
attributes.description: Date on which the treatment blind was broken for this subject. Populated only when blind_broken is True. Required for audit trail and regulatory documentation of unblinding events.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: blind_broken
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment blind was broken for this subject in order to perform the causality assessment for this SUSAR. A blind break is a significant event requiring documentation and regulatory notification.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: blind_status
attributes.description: Blinding status of the study at the time of SUSAR reporting. Indicates whether the study was blinded, and if so, whether the blind was broken for this subject to determine treatment assignment for causality assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; ICH E9

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric case number assigned by the sponsor or CRO for this SUSAR, used in all regulatory submissions and correspondence. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: causality_assessment
attributes.description: Investigator's or sponsor's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the serious adverse reaction. A SUSAR requires a positive causality assessment (related or probably/possibly related) to the investigational product.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; WHO Causality Assessment; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SUSAR record was first created in Oracle Argus Safety. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this transaction header, supporting ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ctcae_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Severity Grade
attributes.description: CTCAE severity grade assigned to the adverse reaction (1=Mild, 2=Moderate, 3=Severe, 4=Life-threatening, 5=Death). Used for safety signal detection, DSMB/DMC reviews, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE domain

attributes.name: deadline_15day
attributes.description: Calculated deadline for 15-day expedited reporting to regulatory authorities for non-fatal/non-life-threatening SUSARs. Derived from the reporting clock start date plus 15 calendar days per ICH E2A and FDA 21 CFR 312.32.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c)(2); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: deadline_7day
attributes.description: Calculated deadline for 7-day expedited reporting to regulatory authorities for fatal or life-threatening SUSARs. Derived from the reporting clock start date plus 7 calendar days per ICH E2A and FDA 21 CFR 312.32.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c)(1); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: dose_at_onset
attributes.description: Dose of the investigational product administered to the subject at the time of the adverse reaction onset, including amount and unit (e.g., '100 mg'). Required for causality assessment and regulatory case narratives.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM EX domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32

attributes.name: dsmb_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this SUSAR. Populated only when dsmb_notified is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on DSMB

attributes.name: dsmb_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notification Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this SUSAR. Required for studies with an active DSMB/DMC per ICH E6(R2) and study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on DSMB; ICH E9

attributes.name: eudravigilance_number
attributes.description: Unique case identifier assigned by the EudraVigilance system upon submission of the SUSAR to the EMA. Used for tracking and referencing the case in EU regulatory correspondence and EudraVigilance database.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI; EudraVigilance

attributes.name: expectedness_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the serious adverse reaction is unexpected — i.e., not listed or not consistent with the nature, severity, or frequency described in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB). A SUSAR must be assessed as unexpected to qualify for expedited reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(a)(2); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: fatal_date
attributes.description: Date of subject death if the outcome of the SUSAR is fatal. Triggers the 7-day expedited reporting clock and is required for death narratives in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c)(1); CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: follow_up_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the follow-up report for this SUSAR case (e.g., 1 for first follow-up, 2 for second). Zero or null for initial reports. Tracks the version history of regulatory submissions for this case.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of this SUSAR. Populated only when irb_iec_notified is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; FDA 21 CFR 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of this SUSAR as required by GCP and local regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; FDA 21 CFR 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: meddra_llt_code
attributes.description: MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) code that most closely matches the verbatim adverse event term. Used for granular coding traceability and verbatim-to-PT mapping audit.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE domain

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code assigned to this SUSAR. The PT is the primary level of MedDRA used for regulatory reporting, signal detection, and aggregate safety analysis in IND/NDA/BLA submissions.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code assigned to this SUSAR during medical coding. Represents the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy and is required for regulatory submissions and aggregate safety reporting.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding this SUSAR (e.g., 26.0, 26.1). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coding and compliance with current MedDRA release requirements.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Medical narrative summarizing the SUSAR case, including patient demographics, event description, clinical course, causality assessment, and outcome. Required component of all expedited regulatory reports per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 6; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; CIOMS I Form

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject first experienced the serious adverse reaction. This is the principal real-world event time (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP) for the SUSAR and is the anchor for all regulatory reporting clocks per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; CDISC SDTM AE domain

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Clinical outcome of the serious adverse reaction at the time of reporting. Required for regulatory submissions and DSMB/DMC safety reviews. Tracks resolution status of the event.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: reporting_clock_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the regulatory reporting clock begins for this SUSAR. Typically the sponsor awareness date, but may be adjusted based on the date of unblinding or receipt of minimum reportable information per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: reporting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SUSAR regulatory reporting workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through submission to regulatory authority acknowledgement and case closure. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Route by which the investigational product was administered (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous). Required for regulatory case narratives and pharmacovigilance signal assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|intravenous|subcutaneous|intramuscular|topical|inhalation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM EX domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; WHO-DD

attributes.name: seriousness_criteria
attributes.description: ICH E2A seriousness criterion met by this adverse reaction that qualifies it as a Serious Adverse Event (SAE). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death|life_threatening|hospitalization|disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 1; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: submission_report_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SUSAR submission is an initial report, a follow-up report with additional information, or a final report closing the case. Regulatory authorities require tracking of report versions per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the SUSAR record in Oracle Argus Safety. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for this transaction header, supporting audit trail and data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: ae_meddra_coding
products.description: Stores the MedDRA coding assignment for each adverse event, capturing the verbatim term reported, the coded Lowest Level Term (LLT), Preferred Term (PT), High Level Term (HLT), High Level Group Term (HLGT), and System Organ Class (SOC). Tracks coding version, coder identity, coding date, and auto-code vs. manual-code flag. Enables standardized MedDRA-based safety queries and regulatory submissions. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety.
products.reference: MedDRA Hierarchy; MSSO MedDRA Browser

attributes.name: ae_meddra_coding_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each MedDRA coding record assigned to an adverse event. Primary key for the ae_meddra_coding data product in the safety domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent adverse event record for which this MedDRA coding assignment was made. Links the coding record back to the originating AE in Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE Domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32

attributes.name: coding_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.coding_assignment. Business justification: MedDRA coding reconciliation process requires matching safety-side ae_meddra_coding records with EDC-side coding_assignment records. Regulatory submissions (SDTM AE domain) depend on reconciled coding
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ctcae_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.ctcae_grade. Business justification: ae_meddra_coding stores ctcae_grade (INT) and ctcae_version (STRING). Adding ctcae_grade_id FK to the ctcae_grade reference table normalizes the grade reference and enables navigation to the full CTCA
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: discrepancy_query_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.discrepancy_query. Business justification: MedDRA coding discrepancies generate EDC queries that must be resolved before database lock. Linking ae_meddra_coding to discrepancy_query enables data managers to track open coding queries against sa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_field_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.ecrf_field. Business justification: MedDRA coding traceability requires identifying which specific eCRF field contained the verbatim AE term that was coded. This supports SDTM AE domain mapping and regulatory submission audit trails whe
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: meddra_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.meddra_term. Business justification: ae_meddra_coding is the MedDRA coding assignment table and should reference the authoritative meddra_term reference master. Adding meddra_term_id (pointing to the PT-level term) establishes referentia
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which the adverse event and its MedDRA coding were recorded. Supports study-level aggregate safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM TS Domain; FDA IND regulations 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: subject_visit_data_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.subject_visit_data. Business justification: AE MedDRA coding is performed on verbatim terms captured in subject visit data records. Medical coders need to trace each coding assignment back to the source visit data for coding quality review, rec
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: MedDRA coding of AEs requires visit context for SDTM AE domain mapping (VISITNUM, VISIT) and for reconciliation with EDC source data at the visit level. Data managers performing coding reconciliation
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) who experienced the adverse event being coded. Enables subject-level safety queries and MedDRA-coded AE listings.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: argus_case_reference
attributes.description: The case identifier from Oracle Argus Safety that corresponds to this MedDRA coding record. Serves as the source system business key for traceability back to the originating safety case in the system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety data model; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: argus_event_reference
attributes.description: The event-level identifier from Oracle Argus Safety for the specific adverse event record within a case that this MedDRA coding applies to. Enables precise traceability to the source system event record.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety data model; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: coded_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the MedDRA code was assigned to the verbatim adverse event term. Used for coding timeliness metrics and regulatory submission audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: coded_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the MedDRA code was assigned. Provides granular audit trail for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety system timestamp.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: coding_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment entered by the coder to document coding rationale, ambiguities, or special considerations for this MedDRA assignment. Supports coding consistency reviews and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DM Best Practices; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: coding_method
attributes.description: Indicates how the MedDRA code was assigned: 'auto' for system-generated auto-coding by Oracle Argus Safety, 'manual' for coder-assigned coding, 'auto_confirmed' for auto-coded and confirmed by a coder, 'recoded' for a previously coded term that was revised. Drives QC workflows and audit requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DM Best Practices; Oracle Argus Safety coding workflow; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: coding_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the MedDRA coding assignment. 'pending' indicates awaiting coding, 'coded' indicates a code has been assigned, 'confirmed' indicates QC-approved, 'rejected' indicates coding was rejected and requires rework, 'under_review' indicates currently in QC review. Drives coding workflow in Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DM Best Practices; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: confirmed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MedDRA coding assignment was confirmed (QC-approved) by a second reviewer or coding supervisor. Null if coding has not yet been confirmed. Supports dual-coder QC workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DM Best Practices; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: ctcae_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grade
attributes.description: Severity grade assigned to the adverse event using the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) scale (1=Mild, 2=Moderate, 3=Severe, 4=Life-threatening, 5=Death). Used in oncology and other therapeutic areas for standardized severity grading alongside MedDRA coding.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; CDISC SDTM AETOXGR; FDA Oncology guidance; ICH E3

attributes.name: ctcae_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Version
attributes.description: Version of the NCI CTCAE grading scale used for severity assessment (e.g., '5.0', '4.03'). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure consistent severity grading interpretation across study sites and time periods.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE; FDA Oncology guidance; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: dictionary_language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding (e.g., 'ENG' for English, 'JPN' for Japanese). Relevant for multi-regional studies where local language MedDRA versions may be used (e.g., PMDA submissions in Japan).
attributes.references: ICH M1; PMDA MedDRA/J requirements; ISO 639-2

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this MedDRA coding record version is considered effective. Used in conjunction with is_current_version and effective_to_date to implement SCD Type 2 versioning for coding history tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC DM Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this MedDRA coding record version is considered effective. Null for the current active record. Used with effective_from_date and is_current_version for SCD Type 2 coding history. Populated when a recoding event supersedes this record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC DM Best Practices

attributes.name: hlgt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: MedDRA High Level Group Term (HLGT) Code
attributes.description: Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the High Level Group Term (HLGT), which sits between the HLT and SOC in the MedDRA hierarchy. Used for broad safety grouping in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEHLGTCD

attributes.name: hlgt_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: MedDRA High Level Group Term (HLGT) Name
attributes.description: Descriptive text of the MedDRA High Level Group Term (HLGT) corresponding to hlgt_code. Supports broad-level safety grouping in aggregate analyses and CSR appendices.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEHLGT

attributes.name: hlt_code
attributes.description: Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the High Level Term (HLT) in the MedDRA hierarchy above the PT. Used for grouping related PTs in aggregate safety analyses and signal detection.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEHLTCD

attributes.name: hlt_name
attributes.description: Descriptive text of the MedDRA High Level Term (HLT) corresponding to hlt_code. Supports mid-level grouping in safety tabulations and DSMB/DMC review packages.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEHLT

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the current (active) MedDRA coding assignment for the associated adverse event. Set to false for superseded coding records retained for historical audit trail. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD Type 2) versioning in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC DM Best Practices

attributes.name: is_sae
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event associated with this MedDRA coding record meets the regulatory definition of a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) per ICH E2A criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, or other medically important condition). Drives expedited reporting timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; CDISC SDTM AESER

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adverse event has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), requiring expedited regulatory reporting (7-day or 15-day) to health authorities. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety case classification.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: llt_code
attributes.description: Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the Lowest Level Term (LLT) assigned to the verbatim adverse event term. The LLT is the most granular level of the MedDRA hierarchy and is the primary coding target. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety MedDRA dictionary.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AELLTCD

attributes.name: llt_name
attributes.description: Descriptive text of the MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) corresponding to llt_code. Provides the human-readable label for the most granular MedDRA coding level. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety MedDRA dictionary.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AELLT

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for this coding assignment (e.g., '26.0', '26.1'). Critical for regulatory submissions as coding must reference the specific MedDRA version in use at the time of the submission. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety dictionary configuration.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; FDA eCTD submission requirements; EMA MedDRA versioning policy

attributes.name: previous_pt_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA PT code that was previously assigned before a recoding event. Populated only when coding_method = 'recoded'. Enables before/after comparison for coding change impact analysis and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: previous_soc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) Code
attributes.description: The MedDRA SOC code that was previously assigned before a recoding event. Populated only when coding_method = 'recoded'. Enables assessment of whether a recoding changed the SOC-level classification, which may affect regulatory safety tables.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: primary_soc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOC assignment is the primary (true) or secondary (false) SOC for the PT. MedDRA PTs may be linked to multiple SOCs; the primary SOC is used for standard regulatory safety tables. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AESOCCD primary SOC convention

attributes.name: pt_code
attributes.description: Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the Preferred Term (PT) to which the LLT maps. The PT is the primary level used for regulatory reporting, safety queries, and signal detection. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AEPTCD; FDA Adverse Event Reporting

attributes.name: pt_name
attributes.description: Descriptive text of the MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) corresponding to pt_code. Used as the standard term in regulatory submissions, CIOMS forms, and safety narratives.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AEDECOD

attributes.name: recoding_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by the coder when a previously assigned MedDRA code is revised (coding_method = 'recoded'). Required for audit trail integrity and regulatory inspection readiness. Null when coding_method is not 'recoded'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC DM Best Practices

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this MedDRA coding record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this MedDRA coding record was last modified in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Tracks the most recent update for change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the System Organ Class (SOC), the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy. SOC is the primary axis for organizing adverse events in regulatory safety tables (e.g., Table 14.3.1 in ICH E3 CSR).
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; ICH E3; CDISC SDTM AESOCCD; FDA NDA/BLA safety tables

attributes.name: soc_name
attributes.description: Descriptive text of the MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) corresponding to soc_code. Used as the primary grouping header in all regulatory safety tabulations, PSUR/PBRER narratives, and DSMB reports.
attributes.references: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH M1; ICH E3; CDISC SDTM AESOC

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system from which this MedDRA coding record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer. Typically 'argus_safety' for records originating from Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC DM Best Practices; Data lineage governance

attributes.name: verbatim_term
attributes.description: The exact, unmodified adverse event term as reported by the investigator or subject in the source document or eCRF prior to MedDRA coding. Preserved for ALCOA+ compliance and audit trail. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety verbatim field.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AETERM; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

products.name: causality_assessment
products.description: Records the investigator and sponsor medical monitor causality assessments for each adverse event relative to the investigational product and concomitant medications. Captures assessor role, assessment date, causality category (unrelated, unlikely, possible, probable, definite), rationale narrative, and whether the assessment was revised. Supports regulatory reporting and signal detection workflows in Oracle Argus Safety.
products.reference: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Scale; CIOMS

attributes.name: causality_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each causality assessment record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adverse event record for which this causality assessment is being performed. Links the assessment to the parent AE in Oracle Argus Safety.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Causality assessment requires knowing the treatment arm to evaluate whether the investigational product caused the AE. Unblinded causality reviews by medical monitors and DSMB are conducted at the arm
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dispensing_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: Causality assessment requires authoritative dispensing data (exact dose, formulation, timing) per ICH E2A guidelines. causality_assessment.dose_at_onset and dose_unit are denormalized; FK to dispensin

attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment pertains to a concomitant medication (True) rather than the primary investigational product (False). Enables differentiation of IP-related versus concomitant drug-related assessments within the same AE case.

attributes.name: concomitant_medication_name
attributes.description: Name of the concomitant medication being assessed for causal relationship when concomitant_medication_flag is True. Populated from WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) preferred drug name.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this causality assessment record was first created in the source system (Oracle Argus Safety). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dechallenge_result
attributes.description: Outcome observed when the investigational product was withdrawn (dechallenged) following the adverse event. A positive dechallenge (AE resolved or improved upon withdrawal) supports a causal relationship. Captured per ICH E2A causality criteria.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria; CIOMS

attributes.name: dsmb_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Review Date

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on DMC

attributes.name: dsmb_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reviewed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment was reviewed by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) as part of a formal safety review. Supports DSMB/DMC meeting documentation and regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on DMC; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

attributes.name: expectedness
attributes.description: Determination of whether the adverse event is listed in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI) as a known effect of the investigational product. Drives SUSAR classification and expedited reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: expedited_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment triggers an obligation for expedited regulatory reporting (7-day or 15-day report) to health authorities such as FDA, EMA, or PMDA based on SUSAR classification.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_revised
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment is a revision of a previously submitted assessment. True when the assessor has changed their causality determination after initial submission, triggering regulatory follow-up reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: rationale_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text clinical narrative provided by the assessor explaining the reasoning behind the causality determination. attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: rechallenge_result
attributes.description: Outcome observed when the investigational product was re-administered (rechallenged) after the adverse event resolved. A positive rechallenge (AE recurred) provides strong evidence of causal relationship. Captured per ICH E2A causality criteria.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria; CIOMS

attributes.name: report_due_date

attributes.name: reporting_timeline_days
attributes.description: The applicable expedited reporting timeline in calendar days from the date of first awareness of the SUSAR (typically 7 days for fatal/life-threatening or 15 days for other serious unexpected reactions). Drives compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision version number for this causality assessment. Starts at 1 for the original assessment and increments with each revision. Enables audit trail tracking of assessment changes over the case lifecycle.

attributes.name: awareness_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Date of First Awareness (Clock Start Date)
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor or CRO first became aware of the adverse event meeting expedited reporting criteria. This is the regulatory clock start date (Day 0) from which all reporting deadlines are calculated, per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: causality_assessment
attributes.description: The investigator's or sponsor's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event. Causality is a key determinant of SUSAR classification and expedited reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2); WHO Causality Assessment; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this expedited report deadline tracking record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the submission exceeded the applicable regulatory deadline. Positive value indicates late submission; zero or null indicates on-time or not yet due. Used for CAPA tracking and regulatory risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; CAPA — MasterControl

attributes.name: days_to_submission
attributes.description: The number of calendar days elapsed between the awareness_date (clock start) and the actual submission_date. Populated only after submission. Used for compliance KPI reporting and trend analysis against ICH E2A timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: deadline_15_day
attributes.description: Calculated deadline date for 15-day expedited reporting, applicable to non-fatal/non-life-threatening unexpected SUSARs and other serious unexpected adverse reactions. Computed as awareness_date + 15 calendar days per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: deadline_7_day
attributes.description: Calculated deadline date for 7-day expedited reporting, applicable to fatal or life-threatening unexpected SUSARs. Computed as awareness_date + 7 calendar days per ICH E2A and FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: deadline_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the expedited report deadline. Pending = report not yet submitted and deadline not passed; Submitted_on_time = submitted within required days; Submitted_late = submitted after deadline; Overdue = deadline passed without submission; Waived = regulatory waiver granted; Not_applicable = reporting exemption applies.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason explaining why the expedited report was submitted after the applicable regulatory deadline. Required for CAPA documentation and regulatory inspection readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: incomplete_clinical_info|pending_causality_assessment|medical_review_delay|translation_required|system_outage|sponsor_approval_delay|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; CAPA — MasterControl; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: delay_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific circumstances that caused the expedited report to be submitted after the regulatory deadline. Supports CAPA documentation and regulatory inspection responses.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; GCP ICH E6(R2); CAPA — MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: dsmb_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notification Date
attributes.description: The date on which the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was formally notified of this expedited safety report.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; ICH E9

attributes.name: dsmb_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this expedited safety report. Required for studies with an active DSMB/DMC per the study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; ICH E9

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which a follow-up expedited safety report must be submitted to the regulatory agency with updated case information. Applicable when follow_up_required is True.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up expedited safety report is required to provide additional or updated information to the regulatory agency after the initial submission, per ICH E2A guidance.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: investigator_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was notified of the SUSAR or expedited safety report submission, as required by ICH E2A and GCP guidelines. Supports site-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of the SUSAR or expedited safety report, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: is_fatal_or_life_threatening
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event is classified as fatal or life-threatening, which triggers the 7-day expedited reporting requirement rather than the standard 15-day timeline per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: is_on_time
attributes.description: Indicates whether the expedited safety report was submitted on or before the applicable regulatory deadline. True = submitted within the required timeframe; False = submitted late or not yet submitted past deadline. Core compliance KPI.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_unexpected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event is unexpected (not consistent with the Investigator Brochure or current labeling), which is a key criterion for SUSAR classification and expedited reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which the expedited safety report must be submitted (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Determines the applicable reporting timeline and format requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|ANVISA|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: report_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deadline record pertains to an initial expedited report submission, a follow-up report with updated information, or a final report closing the case.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expedited safety report type. SAE = Serious Adverse Event report; SUSAR = Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction; USADE = Unexpected Serious Adverse Device Effect; IND_Safety = IND Safety Report; BLA_Safety = Biologics License Application Safety Report.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: reporting_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the jurisdiction in which the expedited report must be filed. Drives country-specific regulatory timeline requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E2A; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the adverse event by the investigator or CRO. May differ from awareness_date if the CRO received information before the sponsor. Relevant for sponsor-level clock start determination.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the expedited safety report was submitted to the regulatory agency. Null if the report has not yet been submitted. Used to calculate days-to-submission and determine on-time compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The electronic or paper-based method used to transmit the expedited safety report to the regulatory agency (e.g., eCTD via FDA ESG, E2B(R3) via EMA EVWEB, MedWatch 3500A, paper submission).
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); FDA ESG; EMA EVWEB; 21 CFR Part 11; eCTD

attributes.name: submission_reference_number
attributes.description: The acknowledgement or tracking number returned by the regulatory agency upon receipt of the expedited safety report submission (e.g., FDA ESG acknowledgement number, EMA EVWEB submission ID). Confirms successful receipt.
attributes.references: FDA ESG; EMA EVWEB; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the expedited safety report was electronically transmitted to the regulatory agency, including timezone offset. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E2A; FDA ESG (Electronic Submissions Gateway); EMA EVWEB

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this expedited report deadline tracking record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: waiver_granted

attributes.name: waiver_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or description of the regulatory waiver or exemption granted for this expedited report submission. Populated only when waiver_granted is True.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; ICH E2A
