attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which the specimen was collected. Links collection to the visit schedule.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV (Trial Visits) Domain; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) from whom the specimen was collected. Core party reference for this transactional event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM Subject Domain

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode or unique label identifier affixed to the specimen tube or container at the time of collection. Used for automated specimen tracking and laboratory information system (LIS) integration.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM SPDEVID; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number assigned to document the chain of custody for the specimen from collection through laboratory receipt. Ensures specimen integrity and traceability for regulatory and legal purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 58; ISO 15189; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: The clinical method or procedure used to collect the specimen from the subject (e.g., venipuncture, fingerstick, lumbar puncture, biopsy). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM LBMETHOD. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venipuncture|fingerstick|catheter|lumbar_puncture|biopsy|swab|urine_void|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBMETHOD Variable; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: collection_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this specimen collection event, typically generated by the EDC or CTMS (e.g., 'SC-0042-001'). Used for cross-system traceability and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SPDEVID; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: collection_site_anatomy
attributes.description: The anatomical location on the subject's body from which the specimen was collected (e.g., 'Left Antecubital Vein', 'Right Arm', 'Lumbar Region'). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM LBLOC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBLOC Variable; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specimen collection event. Indicates whether the collection was completed as planned, partially completed, missed, or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|collected|missed|cancelled|partial|failed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time at which the specimen was collected from the subject. This is the principal real-world event timestamp per ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) requirements. Distinct from scheduled collection time.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM LBDTC

attributes.name: collector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the CRC or phlebotomist who performed the specimen collection. Denormalized for audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness. Classified as confidential as it identifies site personnel.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specimen collection record was first created in the system. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: fasting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject was in a fasted state at the time of specimen collection, as required by certain protocol-defined laboratory assessments (e.g., lipid panels, glucose). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM LBFAST.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBFAST Variable; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: has_deviation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation or collection irregularity was recorded for this specimen collection event. True = deviation present; False = no deviation. Triggers downstream deviation management workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: hemolysis_grade
attributes.description: Visual or instrument-assessed grade of hemolysis (red blood cell rupture) in the collected blood specimen. Hemolysis can interfere with laboratory assay results and may require recollection.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP7-A2; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: is_unscheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specimen collection was an unscheduled (ad hoc) event not defined in the original study protocol visit schedule. True = unscheduled; False = protocol-scheduled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM VISITDY; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: lipemia_grade
attributes.description: Visual or instrument-assessed grade of lipemia (excess lipids causing turbidity) in the collected specimen. Lipemia can interfere with photometric assay results.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP7-A2; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: Protocol-defined nominal time point label for PK/PD sample collection (e.g., 'Pre-dose', '0.5h', '1h', '2h', '4h', '8h', '24h'). Used to align actual collection times to protocol-scheduled PK sampling windows.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PCTPTNOM Variable; FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: pre_analytical_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the pre-analytical processing instructions followed after collection (e.g., 'Centrifuge within 30 min at 2000 rpm', 'Store at -80°C', 'Protect from light'). Documents protocol compliance for sample integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: processing_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which pre-analytical processing of the specimen was completed at the collection site (e.g., centrifugation, aliquoting). Used to calculate processing turnaround time and assess sample integrity.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: recollection_reason
attributes.description: Reason why a repeat specimen collection is required. Populated when recollection_required = True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_volume|hemolysis|lipemia|clotted|mislabeled|lost_in_transit|expired_kit|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: recollection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a repeat specimen collection is required due to inadequate sample, collection deviation, or laboratory rejection. True = recollection needed; False = no recollection required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: sample_adequacy
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the collected specimen volume and quality are sufficient to perform all protocol-required laboratory analyses. Determined at the time of collection or upon receipt at the laboratory.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM LB Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: scheduled_collection_timestamp
attributes.description: The protocol-defined date and time at which the specimen collection was planned to occur per the study visit schedule. Used to calculate collection timing deviations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TV Domain; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this specimen collection record originated (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, Oracle Clinical One). Supports data lineage and integration traceability.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Classification of the biological specimen collected (e.g., 'Whole Blood', 'Serum', 'Plasma', 'Urine', 'CSF', 'Tissue Biopsy', 'Saliva'). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM LBSPEC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Whole Blood|Serum|Plasma|Urine|CSF|Tissue Biopsy|Saliva|Stool|Bone Marrow — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBSPEC Variable; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the specimen was stored at the collection site prior to shipment to the central laboratory. Deviations from protocol-specified storage conditions may compromise sample integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance

attributes.name: time_from_dose_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed time in hours between the subject's most recent investigational product dose and the specimen collection. Critical for PK (Pharmacokinetics) and DMPK (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics) sample timing analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain (Pharmacokinetics Concentrations); FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: tube_count
attributes.description: The total number of tubes, vials, or containers collected during this specimen collection event. Used for chain-of-custody tracking and sample accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specimen collection record was last modified. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: volume_collected_ml
attributes.description: Total volume of specimen collected from the subject, expressed in millilitres (mL). Critical for PK/PD studies and for verifying adequacy of sample for planned assays.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBVOL; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume collected. Typically mL for blood/urine, but may be µL for microsampling or g for tissue. Ensures unambiguous interpretation of volume_collected_ml.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBVOLU; CDISC Controlled Terminology; SI Units

products.name: specimen_shipment
products.description: Transactional record tracking the shipment of specimens from a clinical site to a central or reference laboratory. Captures shipment manifest ID, origin site, destination lab facility, courier name, tracking number, shipment date/time, expected arrival date, actual receipt date, temperature condition (ambient/refrigerated/frozen/dry ice), number of specimens, shipment status, and any temperature excursion flags. Supports chain of custody and specimen integrity tracking.
products.reference: IATA P650; CDISC SDTM SD Domain

attributes.name: specimen_shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specimen shipment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Cross-border specimen shipments require a valid CTA and import permit in the destination country. specimen_shipment.import_permit_number is a denormalized CTA reference. Regulatory operations teams mu
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.investigational_site. Business justification: Specimen logistics operations require direct linkage to the originating investigational site for courier scheduling, address resolution, and time-zone-aware pickup windows. origin_site_number is a den
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination central or reference laboratory facility receiving the shipment. Supports routing and receipt confirmation.
attributes.references: CLIA; CAP Accreditation; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which the specimens were collected and shipped. Links shipment to the sponsoring protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site (origin) from which the specimens were dispatched. Supports chain-of-custody traceability back to the collecting site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date and time at which the receiving laboratory confirmed physical receipt of the shipment. Used to calculate transit duration and assess specimen integrity against stability windows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC LAB

attributes.name: airbill_number
attributes.description: Air waybill or bill of lading number issued by the carrier for international or air freight shipments. Required for customs clearance and IATA dangerous goods documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IATA P650; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specimens included in this shipment were collected from study subjects. Used to calculate specimen age at receipt and assess stability compliance.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB domain; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or observations recorded by site staff, courier, or laboratory personnel regarding the shipment (e.g., packaging condition on arrival, partial delivery notes).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: courier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or courier service responsible for transporting the shipment (e.g., World Courier, FedEx Clinical, Marken). Supports vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: courier_service_level
attributes.description: Service tier selected for the shipment (e.g., overnight, two-day, international priority). Determines expected transit time and cost classification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this specimen shipment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customs_declaration_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the customs or import/export declaration filed for international specimen shipments. Required for cross-border regulatory compliance and specimen release at destination.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; Health Canada; TGA

attributes.name: destination_lab_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the receiving central or reference laboratory. Denormalized for manifest documentation and rapid chain-of-custody reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dry_ice_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of dry ice (in kilograms) included in the shipment package. Required for IATA dangerous goods declaration when dry ice is used as a refrigerant. Applicable only when temperature_condition = dry_ice.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Section 2.7; IATA P650

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes during which the shipment temperature was outside the acceptable range. Used by the laboratory to assess specimen viability and document deviation impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: excursion_max_temp_c
attributes.description: Highest temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded by the temperature monitor/data logger during transit. Populated only when a temperature excursion is detected. Supports specimen impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: excursion_min_temp_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded by the temperature monitor/data logger during transit. Populated only when a temperature excursion is detected. Supports specimen impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination laboratory, as agreed with the courier at time of dispatch. Used to trigger overdue alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains materials classified as hazardous (e.g., Category B biological substances, dry ice). True = hazardous declaration required; False = non-hazardous. Drives IATA dangerous goods documentation requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IATA P650; UN 3373 (Category B biological substances)

attributes.name: lab_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated contact person at the receiving laboratory responsible for accepting and processing the shipment. Used for courier delivery confirmation and discrepancy resolution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging used for the shipment, indicating the thermal protection and containment method. Relevant for regulatory compliance with IATA P650 and specimen integrity documentation.
attributes.references: IATA P650 (biological substances); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: protocol_visit_name
attributes.description: Name or label of the study protocol visit (e.g., Day 1, Week 4, End of Treatment) associated with the specimen collection event. Supports SDTM domain mapping and visit-level reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: receipt_confirmed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the laboratory staff member who confirmed receipt of the shipment. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: received_specimen_count
attributes.description: Actual number of specimens confirmed by the receiving laboratory upon opening the shipment. Compared against specimen_count to identify discrepancies or missing specimens.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the shipment was rejected at the receiving laboratory (e.g., temperature excursion, broken specimens, incorrect labeling, missing manifest). Populated only when shipment_status = rejected.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Date and time at which the shipment was handed over to the courier at the originating clinical site. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the specimen shipment. Drives chain-of-custody workflow and exception management. Values: pending (prepared, not yet dispatched), in_transit (with courier), delivered (courier confirmed delivery), received (lab confirmed receipt), rejected (refused at destination), cancelled (shipment voided).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment by its clinical purpose. Values: routine (standard scheduled collection), urgent (expedited for safety or protocol reasons), pk_sample (Pharmacokinetics samples requiring strict timing), biomarker (exploratory biomarker specimens), backup (duplicate aliquots for archival), reshipment (replacement for a failed prior shipment).
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: specimen_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual specimen tubes, aliquots, or containers included in this shipment as declared on the manifest. Used for reconciliation at receipt.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: subject_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct study subjects whose specimens are included in this shipment. Supports subject-level reconciliation and enrollment tracking at the laboratory.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB

attributes.name: temperature_condition
attributes.description: Required temperature storage and transport condition for the shipment as specified in the laboratory manual. Critical for specimen integrity. Values: ambient (15–25°C), refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C), dry_ice (-78°C), liquid_nitrogen (-196°C).
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); IATA P650 (biological substances); CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion (deviation outside the acceptable range) was detected during transit. True = excursion occurred; False = no excursion. Triggers specimen usability assessment workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable temperature range (in degrees Celsius) for this shipment as defined in the study laboratory manual. Used to evaluate temperature excursion severity.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable temperature range (in degrees Celsius) for this shipment as defined in the study laboratory manual. Used to evaluate temperature excursion severity.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_monitor_code
attributes.description: Serial number or identifier of the temperature data logger or indicator device placed in the shipment. Enables retrieval of the full temperature log for excursion investigation and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP accreditation; IATA P650

attributes.name: temperature_monitor_type
attributes.description: Type of temperature monitoring device included in the shipment. Data_logger provides continuous electronic recording; indicator_card provides a visual pass/fail indicator; none indicates no monitoring device was used.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP accreditation standards; IATA P650

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment package, enabling real-time logistics monitoring and proof-of-delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (for dry ice/biological specimens)

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations dangerous goods classification number for the shipment contents (e.g., UN3373 for Category B biological substances, UN1845 for dry ice). Required on shipping labels and documentation when hazardous_material_flag is True.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; UN Model Regulations; IATA P650

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this specimen shipment record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

products.name: reference_range
products.description: Master definition of laboratory reference ranges (normal ranges) for analytes, with full version history. Captures analyte/LOINC code, lower and upper normal limits, unit of measure, sex, age range, ethnicity applicability, specimen type, lab facility source, effective date range, version number, prior range values, reason for update (instrument change/reagent lot change/population recalibration), approval status, and whether the range is sponsor-defined or lab-standard. Used for out-of-range flagging and CTCAE grading in lab results. Maintains audit trail for reference range changes per GCP and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: PK sampling schedules are treatment-arm-specific (dose level, nominal timepoints). Direct FK to subject_randomization supports PK schedule compliance verification — confirming correct sampling windows
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled clinical visit during which this PK sample was collected. Enables linkage to visit-level data including dosing records and clinical assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM VISITNUM convention; Oracle Siebel CTMS visit tracking

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) from whom this PK sample was collected. Core party reference linking the sample to the enrolled participant record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM USUBJID convention; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA 45 CFR §164; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: actual_time_post_dose_hours
attributes.description: Calculated elapsed time in hours between the actual dose administration time and the actual sample collection time. Distinct from nominal_time_hours; used as the primary time variable in PK concentration-time profiles and non-compartmental analysis (NCA). Negative values indicate pre-dose collections.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC ATPT variable; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH E3 Section 11.4

attributes.name: analyte_name
attributes.description: The name of the drug compound, metabolite, or biomarker being measured in this PK sample (e.g., parent compound, active metabolite, total drug). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM PC.PCTEST. Multiple analytes per sample are handled at the result level; this field captures the primary analyte assignment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTEST; WHO-DD; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: The method used to collect the biological sample from the subject. Relevant for bioanalytical method validation and potential pre-analytical variability assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venipuncture|finger_prick|catheter|indwelling_cannula|spot_urine|timed_urine|dried_blood_spot|lumbar_puncture|buccal_swab — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCLOC; ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Guidance

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the PK sample was collected from the subject, recorded to the nearest minute. This is the principal real-world event timestamp and is critical for calculating actual time post-dose (ATPT) used in PK analysis. Must comply with ALCOA+ contemporaneous recording requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCDTC; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: The type of collection container or tube used for the PK sample. Determines anticoagulant/additive present, which affects matrix type (plasma vs serum) and bioanalytical method compatibility. Critical for pre-analytical quality control. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edta_tube|lithium_heparin_tube|sst_tube|plain_tube|urine_cup|cryovial|dbs_card — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTUBE; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this PK sample record was first created in the source system (EDC or LIMS). Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Represents the ALCOA+ 'contemporaneous' requirement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dose_administration_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time of the reference dose administration used to calculate actual time post-dose for this sample. Sourced from the dosing record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Required for accurate ATPT calculation per CDISC SDTM PC domain conventions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCRFTDTC; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: dose_number
attributes.description: The sequential dose number relative to which this PK sample was collected (e.g., 1 for first dose, steady-state dose number). Critical for distinguishing single-dose PK from multiple-dose/steady-state PK profiles in DMPK analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCRFTDTC reference dose; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: edc_form_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier of the eCRF form in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) where this PK sample collection event was recorded. Enables direct traceability from the silver-layer data product back to the source EDC record for SDV and audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave eCRF

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for excluding this PK sample from the primary analysis dataset. Populated only when sample_exclusion_flag is True. Examples include 'Outside sampling window', 'Haemolysed sample', 'Vomiting within 2h of dose', 'Bioanalytical failure'. Required for SAP-defined exclusion criteria documentation.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E9; Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: The number of freeze-thaw cycles the PK sample has undergone. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles can degrade analyte stability and invalidate bioanalytical results. Tracked against the validated freeze-thaw stability limit established during bioanalytical method validation.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018)

attributes.name: lab_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the PK sample was received and logged at the bioanalytical or central laboratory. Used to calculate total sample transit time and to verify cold-chain compliance. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: nominal_time_hours
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the nominal time point in hours relative to dose administration (e.g., -0.0833 for pre-dose, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0). Negative values indicate pre-dose collections. Used for PK modeling, NCA (non-compartmental analysis), and SDTM/ADaM dataset generation in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNUM; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance; ICH E3

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: The protocol-specified nominal time point for sample collection relative to dose administration (e.g., 'Pre-dose', '0.5h', '1h', '2h', '4h', '8h', '24h'). Used as the planned time point label in PK analysis and SDTM PC domain mapping. Stored as a string to accommodate mixed formats (pre-dose, fractional hours, day-relative).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNOM; ICH E3 Section 11.4; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: pre_dose_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample is a pre-dose (trough/baseline) collection. True = pre-dose sample; False = post-dose sample. Pre-dose samples are used to assess trough concentrations, baseline drug levels, and accumulation ratios in multiple-dose PK studies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPT; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing stage of the PK sample from collection through shipment to the bioanalytical laboratory. Distinct from sample_status (overall lifecycle); this tracks the physical processing workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|processed|centrifuged|aliquoted|frozen|shipped|received_at_lab|failed|destroyed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the sample was processed (e.g., centrifuged and aliquoted) after collection. Time from collection to processing is a critical pre-analytical variable that can affect analyte stability and bioanalytical results.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was associated with this PK sample collection event (e.g., collection outside the acceptable sampling window, incorrect tube used, missed collection). True = deviation present; False = no deviation. Triggers deviation reporting workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: sample_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the PK sample, typically printed on the sample tube label and used across CTMS, LIMS, and bioanalytical systems for chain-of-custody tracking. Corresponds to the specimen barcode or accession number.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCREFID; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: sample_condition_on_receipt
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the PK sample upon receipt at the bioanalytical laboratory. Conditions such as haemolysis, lipaemia, or temperature excursion may affect analyte measurement and trigger sample rejection or result flagging. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acceptable|haemolysed|lipemic|insufficient_volume|temperature_excursion|damaged|missing — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; CDISC SDTM PC Domain

attributes.name: sample_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PK sample has been excluded from the primary PK analysis dataset. True = excluded; False = included. Exclusions may be due to protocol deviations, sample integrity issues, or bioanalytical failures. Exclusion reason is captured in exclusion_reason.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC ANL01FL; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PK sample from scheduled collection through bioanalytical reporting. Drives workflow routing in LIMS and CTMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|collected|received|in_transit|received_at_lab|analyzed|reported|rejected|missing|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Medidata Rave specimen workflow; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: The biological matrix type of the PK sample. Determines the bioanalytical method applied and the reference range for analyte concentration. Plasma and serum are most common for small molecule PK; urine for renal clearance studies; CSF for CNS penetration studies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCSPEC; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: sampling_window_end_hours
attributes.description: The protocol-defined acceptable latest collection time in hours relative to dose for this nominal time point. Together with sampling_window_start_hours, defines the acceptable window for protocol compliance assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: sampling_window_start_hours
attributes.description: The protocol-defined acceptable earliest collection time in hours relative to dose for this nominal time point. Used to assess whether the actual collection time falls within the acceptable PK sampling window for protocol compliance determination.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain to which this PK sample record maps for regulatory submission. PC = Pharmacokinetics Concentrations; PP = Pharmacokinetics Parameters. Enables automated SDTM dataset generation in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA eCTD Technical Specifications; ICH M2

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: The temperature in degrees Celsius at which the PK sample is stored prior to shipment or analysis. Critical for analyte stability monitoring; deviations from protocol-specified storage conditions (e.g., -70°C, -20°C) must be documented and assessed for impact on sample integrity.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH Q1A Stability

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The protocol-assigned subject number (e.g., site-subject identifier such as 001-001) used to identify the participant in regulatory submissions and PK analysis datasets. Classified as restricted PII as it can be used to trace back to an individual participant.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SUBJID; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA 45 CFR §164; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this PK sample record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail and data integrity monitoring under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Used to detect unauthorized or unexplained data changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: volume_collected_ml
attributes.description: The actual volume of biological sample collected from the subject, expressed in millilitres. Used for sample sufficiency assessment, bioanalytical aliquoting planning, and protocol compliance verification against the required volume specified in the PK sampling schedule.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCVOL; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH M10

attributes.name: volume_required_ml
attributes.description: The protocol-specified minimum volume of sample required for the PK assay at this time point, expressed in millilitres. Used to assess whether the collected volume meets protocol requirements and to flag insufficient sample events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; ICH M10

attributes.name: within_sampling_window
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual sample collection time falls within the protocol-defined acceptable PK sampling window for this nominal time point. True = within window (compliant); False = outside window (potential protocol deviation). Used in PK analysis inclusion/exclusion decisions and protocol deviation reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E3 Section 11.4; 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: bioanalytical_assay
products.description: Master definition of a validated bioanalytical assay used to quantify drug concentrations, biomarkers, or immunogenicity in clinical trial samples. Captures assay name, analyte measured, assay type (LC-MS/MS, ELISA, ECL, PCR, flow cytometry), validation status (validated/qualified/exploratory), LLOQ, ULOQ, matrix type, regulatory submission reference, and responsible bioanalytical lab. Supports DMPK and PK/PD data generation.
products.reference: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the bioanalytical assay record in the lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a validated analytical method owned and managed by the bioanalytical laboratory.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018)

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: GLP/GCP bioanalytical assays must reference their validated method SOP. Regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA bioanalytical section) and FDA/EMA inspections require direct traceability from the assay record
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: FDA/EMA bioanalytical method validation guidance requires each validated assay to be linked to the specific IMP it measures. Regulatory submissions (NDA/MAA) require assay-to-drug traceability. DMPK t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Bioanalytical assays are validated to measure specific investigational products. Regulatory submissions (IND/NDA bioanalytical method validation sections) require tracing which validated assay measure
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A bioanalytical assay is validated and performed at a specific laboratory facility. The existing STRING columns responsible_lab_name and lab_accreditation_number are denormalized references to lab_fac
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sap_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sap. Business justification: The SAP governs bioanalytical methods, LLOQ/ULOQ thresholds, and acceptance criteria used in PK statistical analyses. Regulatory submissions require the SAP to reference the validated bioanalytical_as
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: validation_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Bioanalytical validation reports are TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 3, Section 3.2). Regulatory submissions require direct navigation from the assay record to the filed validation report.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Mean accuracy of the assay expressed as percent of nominal concentration (%Nominal) at QC levels during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically 85–115% (80–120% at LLOQ). Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: analyte_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the analyte type measured by the assay. Distinguishes small molecule drugs (PK), large molecule biologics, biomarkers (PD), immunogenicity (anti-drug antibodies), metabolites, and endogenous compounds. Drives regulatory submission strategy and validation requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: analyte_name
attributes.description: Name of the substance being measured by the assay (e.g., drug compound, metabolite, biomarker, anti-drug antibody). Directly links the assay to the pharmacokinetic (PK), pharmacodynamic (PD), or immunogenicity endpoint it supports.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the assay by the bioanalytical laboratory or sponsor (e.g., 'BA-LC-001', 'ELISA-TNF-003'). Used as the business identifier across CTMS, EDC, and regulatory submissions. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011)

attributes.name: assay_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the bioanalytical assay as used in study protocols, validation reports, and regulatory submissions (e.g., 'LC-MS/MS Assay for Compound XYZ in Human Plasma'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: assay_purpose
attributes.description: Primary scientific purpose the assay serves within the clinical or nonclinical program. PK (Pharmacokinetics) assays measure drug concentration over time; PD (Pharmacodynamics) assays measure biological effect; Immunogenicity assays detect anti-drug antibodies; DMPK (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics) assays support metabolite profiling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PK|PD|Immunogenicity|Safety Biomarker|Efficacy Biomarker|DMPK|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Analytical technology platform used to perform the assay. Common types include LC-MS/MS (Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry), ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay), ECL (Electrochemiluminescence), PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction), Flow Cytometry, and LBA (Ligand Binding Assay). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LC-MS/MS|ELISA|ECL|PCR|Flow Cytometry|LBA|HPLC|GC-MS|Western Blot|IHC|CLIA|RIA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: calibration_curve_model
attributes.description: Mathematical regression model used to fit the calibration curve for back-calculation of analyte concentrations from instrument response. Common models include Linear (1/x or 1/x² weighting), Quadratic, 4-Parameter Logistic (4PL), and 5-Parameter Logistic (5PL) for LBA methods.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: cdisc_test_code
attributes.description: Standardized test code from the CDISC Controlled Terminology for the SDTM PC (Pharmacokinetics Concentrations) or LB (Laboratory Test Results) domain. Enables direct mapping of assay results to CDISC SDTM datasets for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA SDTM Submission Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bioanalytical assay record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cut_point_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to establish the screening and confirmatory cut points for immunogenicity (anti-drug antibody) assays (e.g., 'Parametric 5th percentile', 'Non-parametric 5th percentile'). Applicable only to immunogenicity assays; null for PK/PD assays.
attributes.references: FDA Immunogenicity Testing Guidance (2019); EMA Guideline on Immunogenicity Assessment; ICH M10

attributes.name: dilution_integrity_factor
attributes.description: Maximum validated dilution factor that can be applied to samples exceeding the ULOQ while maintaining assay accuracy and precision within acceptance criteria. Samples requiring dilution beyond this factor must be flagged.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the assay validation is no longer considered current and re-validation or re-qualification is required. Relevant for long-running studies where assay reagents, reference standards, or critical reagents may expire.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: gcp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay is performed under Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards as required for clinical trial sample analysis. True = GCP-compliant; False = non-GCP. Distinct from GLP compliance — clinical samples require GCP; nonclinical samples require GLP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay was validated and is performed under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. GLP compliance is required for nonclinical safety studies submitted to regulatory agencies. True = GLP-compliant; False = non-GLP.
attributes.references: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); OECD Principles of GLP; EMA GLP Directive 2004/10/EC

attributes.name: inter_run_precision_cv
attributes.description: Between-run precision expressed as percent coefficient of variation (%CV) across multiple analytical runs during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically ≤15% (%CV). Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: internal_standard
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal standard (IS) used in the assay for quantification normalization (e.g., stable isotope-labeled analog, structural analog). Critical for LC-MS/MS and other chromatographic methods to correct for matrix effects and extraction variability.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: intra_run_precision_cv
attributes.description: Within-run precision expressed as percent coefficient of variation (%CV) at the QC concentration levels, as determined during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically ≤15% (%CV), or ≤20% at LLOQ. Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: lloq
attributes.description: Lower Limit of Quantification — the lowest analyte concentration that can be reliably quantified with acceptable accuracy and precision per the validated method. Expressed in the unit defined by lloq_uloq_unit. Critical for PK/PD data interpretation and regulatory submission. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM PC Domain

attributes.name: lloq_uloq_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the LLOQ and ULOQ values (e.g., 'ng/mL', 'pg/mL', 'µg/mL', 'nM'). Must be consistent with the unit reported in PK/PD concentration data submitted to regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: long_term_stability_days
attributes.description: Number of days for which analyte stability in the biological matrix at long-term storage conditions (typically -20°C or -70°C) has been validated. Samples stored beyond this period require re-validation of stability before results can be reported.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: matrix_effect_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether matrix effect (ion suppression/enhancement for LC-MS/MS; non-specific binding for LBA) was formally evaluated during validation. True = matrix effect experiments conducted; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Biological matrix in which the analyte is measured (e.g., plasma, serum, whole blood, urine, cerebrospinal fluid). The assay is validated specifically for the declared matrix; use in a different matrix requires re-validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Plasma|Serum|Whole Blood|Urine|CSF|Tissue|Saliva|Feces|Synovial Fluid|Bronchoalveolar Lavage|Dried Blood Spot — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: parallelism_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether parallelism (serial dilution of incurred samples producing results parallel to the calibration curve) was assessed. Relevant primarily for LBA and immunogenicity assays. True = parallelism assessed; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: reference_standard_lot
attributes.description: Lot number of the certified reference standard used to prepare calibration standards and quality control (QC) samples. Traceability of the reference standard lot is required for regulatory submissions and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); USP Reference Standards; ICH M10

attributes.name: sample_volume_required_ul
attributes.description: Minimum volume of biological matrix (in microliters) required per sample aliquot for a single assay run. Used for specimen collection planning, biobank management, and feasibility assessment of retrospective analyses.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM BS Domain

attributes.name: selectivity_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether selectivity (absence of interference from endogenous matrix components) was formally assessed during validation. True = selectivity experiments conducted and documented; False = not assessed. Required for full validation per FDA/EMA/ICH M10.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species for which the assay has been validated. Assays validated in human matrices may differ from those validated in preclinical animal species used in DMPK studies. Drives applicability to clinical vs. nonclinical programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Human|Rat|Mouse|Dog|Monkey|Rabbit|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: sponsor_assay_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned identifier for the assay as referenced in the study protocol, SAP, or regulatory submission. May differ from the CRO's internal assay code. Required for cross-referencing sponsor documents with CRO laboratory records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA IND (21 CFR Part 312); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: stability_freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles for which analyte stability in the biological matrix has been validated. Samples subjected to more freeze-thaw cycles than validated must be flagged or excluded from analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage temperature and conditions for samples analyzed by this assay (e.g., '-70°C ± 10°C', '-20°C', '2–8°C'). Defines the chain-of-custody storage requirement for clinical samples to maintain analyte integrity.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: superseded_by_assay_code
attributes.description: Assay code of the newer version that replaces this assay when it is retired or superseded. Supports version lineage tracking and ensures historical sample results can be linked to the correct assay version.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: uloq
attributes.description: Upper Limit of Quantification — the highest analyte concentration that can be reliably quantified within the validated dynamic range. Samples above ULOQ must be diluted and re-assayed. Expressed in the unit defined by lloq_uloq_unit.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bioanalytical method validation was formally completed and the validation report was approved. Marks the point from which the assay is considered fit for regulated use in clinical sample analysis.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory validation tier of the assay. 'Validated' indicates full GLP/GCP-compliant validation per FDA/EMA/ICH M10 guidelines; 'Qualified' indicates fit-for-purpose qualification; 'Exploratory' indicates early-phase research use only; 'In Validation' indicates validation in progress; 'Retired' indicates the assay is no longer in use. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the assay method (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Incremented when the assay undergoes method changes requiring partial or full re-validation. Enables traceability of which assay version was used for each study's sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: weighting_factor
attributes.description: Statistical weighting factor applied to the calibration curve regression to minimize heteroscedasticity (e.g., '1/x', '1/x²', 'none'). Documented in the validation report and applied consistently during sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

products.name: bioanalytical_result
products.description: Transactional record of a bioanalytical or biomarker assay result from a clinical trial PK/PD, DMPK, or exploratory biomarker sample. Captures assay run ID, sample ID, analyte/biomarker measured, concentration or categorical result value, unit/scale, assay platform (LC-MS/MS/ELISA/ECL/PCR/flow cytometry/NGS/IHC), calibration curve acceptance, QC sample performance, result status (reportable/non-reportable/repeat required), result category (PK concentration/biomarker/immunogenicity/exploratory), incurred sample reanalysis (ISR) flag, deviation from nominal time point, and data sharing consent flag. Feeds CDISC SDTM PC and PP domains. Consolidated SSOT for all specialized assay results beyond routine clinical lab testing.

attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) from whom the bioanalytical sample was collected. Enables subject-level PK/PD profiling and safety linkage.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA

attributes.name: actual_time_point
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time (in hours post-dose) at which the sample was collected, calculated from the dose administration timestamp and sample collection timestamp. Used in non-compartmental and compartmental PK analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA PK Guidance; ICH E14

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bioanalytical assay was performed and the result was generated by the laboratory instrument or system. Distinct from collection timestamp; used for audit trail and turnaround time tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: assay_platform
attributes.description: Analytical technology platform used to generate this result. Determines method-specific acceptance criteria and regulatory validation requirements. Values include LC-MS/MS (liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry), ELISA, ECL (electrochemiluminescence), PCR, FLOW_CYTOMETRY, NGS (next-generation sequencing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LC-MS/MS|ELISA|ECL|PCR|FLOW_CYTOMETRY|NGS|IHC|RIA|WESTERN_BLOT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; ICH Q2(R1)

attributes.name: assay_run_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the bioanalytical laboratory to the analytical run (batch) in which this sample was processed. Used to link results to calibration curve and QC sample performance for the run. Maps to PCRUNID in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCRUNID; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: calibration_curve_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the calibration curve for the analytical run met pre-defined acceptance criteria (e.g., ≥75% of calibrators within ±15% of nominal, ±20% at LLOQ). A failed calibration curve invalidates all results from the run.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: categorical_result
attributes.description: Qualitative or categorical result for assays that produce non-numeric outcomes (e.g., POSITIVE/NEGATIVE for immunogenicity, BELOW_LLOQ for concentrations below the lower limit of quantification). Null when numeric_result is populated. Maps to PCSTRESC in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESC; FDA Immunogenicity Guidance 2019

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the biological sample was collected from the subject. The principal real-world event time for this bioanalytical result record. Maps to PCDTC in CDISC SDTM PC domain. Conforms to ISO 8601 format.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCDTC; ISO 8601; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bioanalytical result record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The dilution factor applied to the sample prior to analysis when the original concentration exceeded the ULOQ. The reported result incorporates this factor. Maps to PCDILIND/PCDILUTN in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCDILUTN; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result has been excluded from the primary PK/PD analysis dataset (e.g., due to protocol deviation, sample integrity issue, or statistical outlier determination per the Statistical Analysis Plan).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for excluding this result from the PK/PD analysis dataset. Required when exclusion_flag is true. Examples: 'Sample collected outside protocol window', 'Hemolyzed sample', 'Calibration curve failure', 'Subject vomited within 2 hours of dose'.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; ICH E9(R1); FDA PK Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the sample underwent prior to analysis. Stability data from method validation defines the maximum allowable cycles; exceedance may invalidate the result.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: isr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample was selected for Incurred Sample Reanalysis (ISR), a regulatory requirement to demonstrate reproducibility of results in authentic study samples. ISR is mandatory for pivotal PK studies submitted to FDA and EMA.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; Crystal City IV Workshop

attributes.name: isr_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the Incurred Sample Reanalysis (ISR) assessment. PASS indicates the original and repeat results agree within ±20% of their mean for ≥67% of ISR samples. FAIL triggers investigation. NOT_APPLICABLE when isr_flag is false.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: lloq
attributes.description: The lowest concentration of analyte in a sample that can be quantitatively determined with acceptable precision and accuracy for this validated method and run. Used to flag results as BLQ (below limit of quantification). Maps to PCLLOQ in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCLLOQ; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Type of biological matrix from which the sample was derived and analyzed. Determines applicable method validation parameters and reference ranges. Maps to PCSPEC in CDISC SDTM PC domain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PLASMA|SERUM|WHOLE_BLOOD|URINE|CSF|TISSUE|SALIVA|FECES|SYNOVIAL_FLUID — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSPEC; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: The protocol-specified time point (in hours post-dose) at which the sample was scheduled to be collected (e.g., 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0, 24.0). Used as the reference for PK modeling and deviation calculation. Maps to PCTPTNUM in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCTPTNUM; ICH E14; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: numeric_result
attributes.description: Quantitative measured concentration or signal value for the analyte in this sample. Null when result is categorical (e.g., positive/negative for immunogenicity). Maps to PCSTRESN in CDISC SDTM PC domain. This is the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESN; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: qc_sample_performance
attributes.description: Overall acceptance outcome for the QC samples (low, medium, high QC) within the analytical run. PASS indicates ≥67% of QC samples within ±15% of nominal with at least 50% at each level passing. FAIL invalidates the run. MARGINAL triggers scientific review.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; ICH Q2(R1)

attributes.name: result_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the bioanalytical result type: PK_CONCENTRATION (pharmacokinetic drug/metabolite concentration), BIOMARKER (pharmacodynamic or disease biomarker), IMMUNOGENICITY (anti-drug antibody or neutralizing antibody), EXPLORATORY (hypothesis-generating biomarker), PD_MARKER (pharmacodynamic endpoint marker). Drives downstream CDISC domain routing (PC vs PP vs ADPC).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; ICH E16 Biomarker Qualification; FDA Biomarker Guidance

attributes.name: result_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment entered by the bioanalytical scientist or laboratory reviewer providing additional context for the result (e.g., instrument flags, unusual chromatography, sample appearance notes). Maps to PCORRES or PCCOMMENT in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: result_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validated bioanalytical result was formally reported and released by the laboratory to the sponsor or data management team. Marks the transition from laboratory-internal to reportable status.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the bioanalytical result indicating whether it is reportable for inclusion in the clinical database, requires repeat analysis, or has been invalidated. Drives data flow into EDC and CDISC SDTM datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: result_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the numeric result value (e.g., ng/mL, pg/mL, nM, U/mL). Standardized per CDISC controlled terminology. Maps to PCSTRESU in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology UNIT; CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESU; SI Units

attributes.name: sample_stability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample met stability criteria at the time of analysis based on validated short-term, long-term, and freeze-thaw stability data. False indicates a potential stability failure that may affect result validity.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) domain to which this result maps for regulatory submission. PC = Pharmacokinetics Concentrations, PP = Pharmacokinetics Parameters, MB = Microbiology, IS = Immunogenicity Specimen Assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; EMA CDISC Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this bioanalytical result was ingested into the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. LIMS refers to a Laboratory Information Management System.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Human-readable subject identifier (e.g., site-subject number such as 001-001) used in the clinical trial. Distinct from the surrogate subject_id; used for cross-system reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain USUBJID; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA Safe Harbor

attributes.name: time_deviation_hours
attributes.description: Deviation of the actual sample collection time from the nominal protocol-specified time point, expressed in hours (actual minus nominal). Positive values indicate late collection; negative values indicate early collection. Used to assess protocol compliance and flag samples for PK analysis exclusion.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: uloq
attributes.description: The highest concentration of analyte in a sample that can be quantitatively determined with acceptable precision and accuracy for this validated method and run. Results above ULOQ require dilution and re-analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bioanalytical result record. Required for audit trail compliance and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks silver layer.
