attributes.name: lab_type
attributes.description: Classification of the laboratory by operational role in the clinical trial (central laboratory, local/site laboratory, reference laboratory, bioanalytical laboratory, specialty laboratory). Determines applicable accreditation requirements and regulatory expectations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM LB domain; FDA Guidance for Industry: Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or accreditation body inspection of the laboratory facility. Used to assess compliance currency and to schedule re-inspections per regulatory requirements. [Moved from lab_facility: A single last_inspection_date on lab_facility cannot represent the fact that FDA, EMA, and PMDA each conduct independent inspections on different schedules. The inspection history per authority belongs on the association record.]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 58; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189:2022; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: last_inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent regulatory or accreditation inspection. Drives risk-based monitoring decisions, sponsor qualification status, and CAPA initiation for the facility. [Moved from lab_facility: Same rationale as last_inspection_date — a single outcome field cannot capture authority-specific inspection results. The inspection_outcome attribute on facility_accreditation provides per-authority granularity.]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 58; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189:2022; EMA GCP Inspection Procedures

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, context, or clarifications related to the accreditation record that do not fit structured fields (e.g., special conditions, interim arrangements, liaison contact details).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: previous_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number from the immediately preceding accreditation cycle. Supports continuity tracking and audit trail for regulatory submissions requiring historical accreditation evidence.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022; CAP; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: proficiency_testing_program
attributes.description: Name of the external proficiency testing or external quality assessment (EQA) program in which the laboratory participates (e.g., CAP PT, UKNEQAS, EQAS, RCPA QAP). Supports accreditation body verification.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 Subpart H; CAP Proficiency Testing; ISO 15189:2022; UKAS

attributes.name: proficiency_testing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the laboratory's external proficiency testing (PT) or external quality assessment (EQA) program participation. Proficiency testing is a mandatory component of CLIA and CAP accreditation and demonstrates ongoing analytical competency.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 Subpart H; CAP Proficiency Testing; ISO 15189:2022 Section 7.7; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: qualification_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CRO or sponsor conducted an internal laboratory qualification assessment (distinct from the accrediting body inspection). Supports vendor qualification and oversight requirements under GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: qualification_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the internal CRO or sponsor laboratory qualification assessment. Determines whether the laboratory may be activated for use in clinical trials managed by the organization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: recognition_type
attributes.description: The specific type of certification or regulatory recognition granted by this health authority to the facility (e.g., CLIA for FDA, GLP for EMA, GCP for PMDA). Sourced directly from detection-phase relationship_data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2), 21 CFR Part 58, OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory's accreditation record is currently eligible to be cited in regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, CTD/eCTD). Derived from accreditation status, expiry, and CAPA closure but stored as an explicit business flag for audit and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FDA IND 21 CFR Part 312; FDA NDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA MAA; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH M4 CTD; eCTD

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the renewal application must be submitted to the accrediting body to avoid a lapse in accreditation status. May differ from expiry_date based on accrediting body lead-time requirements.
attributes.references: CAP Accreditation Program; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the accreditation renewal process. Tracks whether the laboratory has initiated, submitted, or completed renewal prior to certificate expiry to ensure uninterrupted trial eligibility.
attributes.references: CAP Accreditation Program; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: scope_includes_dmpk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope Includes Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK)
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accreditation scope explicitly covers drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK) assays, relevant for early-phase and ADME studies.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: scope_includes_pk_pd
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accreditation scope explicitly covers pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) bioanalytical testing, which is required for studies with PK/PD endpoints.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinical trial sponsor formally approved the laboratory for use in their studies. Required for audit trail and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory has been formally approved by the clinical trial sponsor for use in their studies. Sponsor approval is a prerequisite for laboratory qualification in addition to regulatory accreditation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP; Sponsor SOPs

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR

products.name: lab_kit
products.description: Master record for laboratory collection kits supplied to clinical sites for specimen collection. Captures kit type, kit lot number, components list (tubes, containers, preservatives, requisition forms), storage requirements, expiry date, kit version, and associated lab panel. Supports kit inventory management at sites and ensures correct collection materials are used per protocol.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM SD Domain; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lab_kit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the laboratory collection kit master record. Primary key for the lab_kit entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Lab kits are arm-specific in blinded and dose-escalation trials (different tube types, volumes, or panels per treatment arm). Linking lab_kit to arm enables arm-level kit supply planning, blinded kit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Lab kits are prepared, stored, and used per SOPs governing collection procedures and chain of custody. GCP inspection readiness requires direct traceability from kit definition to its governing compli
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A laboratory collection kit is supplied by and associated with a specific central laboratory facility. The central_lab_code STRING column is a denormalized reference to lab_facility. Adding lab_facili
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory panel definition that this kit is designed to support. Ensures correct collection materials are used per protocol-specified assays.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Lab kits are designed and versioned per protocol specification (tube types, volumes, handling instructions). Regulatory inspections and GCP audits require tracing kit versions to the protocol that man
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: IRT/RTSM systems configure lab kit assignments directly against randomization schemes — kit availability, block structure, and dispensing rules are scheme-dependent. Lab kit setup in IRT requires this
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this kit is designated. Links the kit to a specific protocol and sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments that change specimen collection requirements trigger new kit versions. Tracing kit versions to the driving amendment is required for amendment impact tracking, site resupply planni
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site to which this kit is assigned or shipped. Supports site-level inventory tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Lab kit instruction leaflets are essential TMF documents filed per ICH E6 GCP requirements. lab_kit.instruction_leaflet_version indicates a versioned document exists; this FK links the kit record to i
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Lab kits are arm-specific in blinded trials — active and placebo arms use different collection kits (e.g., PK kits only for active arm, different tube types per arm). IRT systems assign kits by treatm
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the kit design and components list was formally approved by the sponsor or quality team for use in the study. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: biohazard_classification
attributes.description: IATA/UN biohazard classification for shipping the collected specimen (Category A UN2814, Category B UN3373, Exempt). Determines packaging and shipping documentation requirements for specimen transport.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations P650; UN Model Regulations; WHO Guidance on Regulations for the Transport of Infectious Substances

attributes.name: cdisc_lbspec_code
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM controlled terminology value for specimen type (LBSPEC variable), e.g., BLOOD, URINE, PLASMA, SERUM. Enables direct mapping to SDTM LB domain for regulatory submission datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: collection_timepoint
attributes.description: Specific timepoint within a visit at which the specimen should be collected (e.g., pre-dose, 1h post-dose, 4h post-dose). Particularly relevant for PK/PD sampling schedules.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBTPTNUM; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance

attributes.name: components_description
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of all components included in the kit (e.g., EDTA tubes, serum separator tubes, cryovials, dry ice packs, biohazard bags, requisition forms, instruction leaflets). Supports site training and deviation investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lab kit master record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for GCP compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the kit must not be used for specimen collection. Expiry is driven by the stability of collection tubes, preservatives, and reagents. Sites must discard or return kits past this date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; 21 CFR Part 211; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: fasting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be fasting prior to specimen collection using this kit. Fasting status affects reference ranges and result interpretation for metabolic and lipid panels.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBFAST; ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189

attributes.name: instruction_leaflet_version
attributes.description: Version number of the collection instruction leaflet included in the kit. Ensures site staff follow the correct collection procedure aligned to the current protocol version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_ancillary_kit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kit is an ancillary/backup kit (True) rather than a primary protocol-required kit (False). Ancillary kits are used for repeat collections or unscheduled assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: kit_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the kit indicating the scientific purpose of the specimen collection (e.g., Pharmacokinetics (PK), Pharmacodynamics (PD), safety labs, biomarker, genetic). Aligns kit to the study's analytical objectives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pk|pd|safety|biomarker|genetic|microbiome|dmpk|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBCAT; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: kit_label_language
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for the primary language of the kit label and instruction leaflet (e.g., en, fr, de, ja). Ensures regulatory compliance for multi-country trials requiring local language labelling.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA; Health Canada; ICH E6(R2); ISO 639

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the kit, typically printed on the kit label and used for chain-of-custody tracking. Corresponds to the kit barcode or label ID in RTSM/IRT systems such as Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: kit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit. Drives inventory management workflows and ensures expired or quarantined kits are not used for specimen collection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|assigned|shipped|received|used|expired|quarantined|destroyed|returned — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the kit by specimen matrix type (e.g., blood, urine, tissue). Determines the collection containers and preservatives included. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|urine|saliva|tissue|csf|stool|buccal_swab|plasma|serum|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBSPEC; ISO 15189

attributes.name: kit_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the kit design or configuration. Used to track protocol amendments that change collection requirements, ensuring sites use the correct kit version per the current protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: lab_accreditation_standard
attributes.description: Accreditation standard under which the central laboratory processing specimens from this kit is certified (e.g., ISO 15189, CAP, CLIA, GCLP). Required for regulatory submissions and sponsor quality oversight.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; GCLP Guidelines; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot number assigned by the kit supplier or central laboratory. Enables traceability for quality investigations, recalls, and regulatory inspections. Critical for ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 15189

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the kit was manufactured or assembled by the supplier. Used in conjunction with expiry date to calculate shelf life and manage inventory rotation.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: preservative_type
attributes.description: Type of preservative or additive included in the kit (e.g., EDTA, heparin, sodium fluoride, formalin, RNAlater). Critical for specimen stability and downstream analytical method compatibility.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI; CDISC SDTM LBMETHOD

attributes.name: protocol_visit_reference
attributes.description: Protocol-defined visit name or visit window for which this kit is intended (e.g., Screening, Day 1, Week 4). Ensures the correct kit type is used at the correct study visit per the protocol schedule of assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM VISITNUM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: quantity_per_shipment
attributes.description: Standard number of kits included in a single shipment to a site. Used for supply planning, purchase order generation, and site inventory management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: reorder_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of kits at a site below which a resupply order should be triggered. Supports proactive inventory management to prevent site stock-outs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: requisition_form_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a laboratory requisition form (paper or pre-printed label) is included in the kit. Requisition forms are required by central labs for specimen processing and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; ALCOA+

attributes.name: return_kit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the used kit or residual materials must be returned to the central laboratory or sponsor after specimen collection. Relevant for chain-of-custody and waste management compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this kit record originated (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One, Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements for the kit or collected specimen (e.g., protect from light, invert tube 8 times, centrifuge within 30 minutes, ship on dry ice). Critical for specimen integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA P650; CLSI

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Categorical storage condition required for the kit (e.g., refrigerated 2–8°C, frozen −20°C, room temperature). Complements the numeric temperature range with a human-readable label for site staff.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA P650

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the kit. Used alongside minimum temperature to define the acceptable storage range and trigger excursion alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the kit. Ensures cold-chain integrity and preservative efficacy. Deviations must be documented per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: supplier_kit_catalog_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own catalog or part number for this kit configuration. Used for reordering, purchase orders in SAP S/4HANA, and supplier quality documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement; ISO 15189; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or central laboratory that manufactured and supplied the kit. Used for procurement, quality investigations, and supplier qualification tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; SAP S/4HANA Procurement

attributes.name: tube_count
attributes.description: Total number of collection tubes included in the kit. Used for inventory reconciliation and to verify completeness of kit contents upon receipt at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189

attributes.name: tube_type
attributes.description: Type of collection tube(s) included in the kit (e.g., EDTA K2, SST, lithium heparin, sodium citrate, PAXgene). Determines anticoagulant or additive present, which is critical for assay validity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBSPEC; ISO 15189; CLSI GP44

attributes.name: tube_volume_ml
attributes.description: Nominal volume in millilitres of each collection tube in the kit. Used to confirm adequate sample volume for the required assays and to flag insufficient sample at processing.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI GP44; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lab kit master record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: lab_query
products.description: Transactional record of a data query raised against a laboratory result in the EDC (Medidata Rave) or LIMS. Captures query ID, query type (missing value/implausible result/unit mismatch/collection time deviation), query text, raised by (data manager/medical monitor), raised date, assigned to (site/lab), response text, resolution date, and query status (open/answered/closed/cancelled). Supports ALCOA+ data quality compliance for lab data.
products.reference: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Query Management; ALCOA+

attributes.name: lab_query_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the laboratory data query record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.adverse_event. Business justification: Lab queries with safety_relevance_flag=true are raised to resolve data discrepancies that affect AE reporting. Linking lab_query to adverse_event formalizes the safety data cleaning process, enabling
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bioanalytical_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_result. Business justification: Data queries in clinical trials can be raised against bioanalytical results (PK/PD, DMPK data) in the EDC, not only against standard lab results. The existing lab_result_id FK covers standard lab resu
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: database_lock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: Lab queries must be resolved before database lock. The database_lock_event tracks outstanding_query_count and pre-lock QC checklist completion. Linking lab_query to database_lock_event enables the pre
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific laboratory result record in the lab_result product that this query was raised against. Core linkage between the query and the underlying data point.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH LB domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: Lab data queries are frequently raised to document or resolve protocol deviations affecting lab data (e.g., wrong collection timepoint, incorrect tube). Direct traceability from lab_query to protocol_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: quality_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Lab queries that reveal systematic data issues (e.g., multiple sites with same anomaly, instrument calibration failure) escalate to formal quality events. Linking lab_query to quality_event enables es
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which this laboratory query was raised. Links the query to the parent protocol and sponsor context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site associated with the subject whose laboratory result triggered this query. Used for site-level query metrics and monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which the specimen was collected and the lab result was generated, providing temporal context for the query.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV/SE domains; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose laboratory result is the subject of this query. Supports subject-level data quality tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: assigned_to_party_type
attributes.description: Type of organizational party to whom the query is assigned for response — investigational site, central laboratory, local laboratory, sponsor, or CRO (Contract Research Organization). Determines routing and accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the query was cancelled, if applicable (e.g., query raised in error, duplicate query, data issue resolved through another mechanism). Required for cancelled queries to maintain ALCOA+ audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: corrected_value
attributes.description: The laboratory result value after correction, if a data change was made as a result of this query. Null if no correction was applied. Provides after-state for audit trail per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lab_query record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Audit trail field for data lineage and ALCOA+ compliance. Distinct from raised_datetime which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resolution of this query resulted in a data value change in the source EDC or LIMS record. True = a data correction was made; False = original data confirmed or query cancelled without change. Key metric for data quality reporting.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: dbl_blocking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this open query is blocking the Database Lock (DBL) for the study or subject. True = must be resolved before DBL can proceed; False = non-blocking. Critical for study close-out planning and timeline management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; DBL SOP

attributes.name: ecrf_field_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Field Name
attributes.description: Specific field name within the eCRF form that contains the queried laboratory data value (e.g., 'LBORRES', 'LBORRESU'). Enables precise identification of the data point in question for site response and EDC correction.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

attributes.name: ecrf_form_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form Name
attributes.description: Name of the eCRF form in the EDC (Medidata Rave) on which the queried laboratory data field resides (e.g., 'Laboratory Results', 'Hematology'). Supports EDC navigation and query routing to the correct data entry form.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

attributes.name: edc_query_code
attributes.description: Native query identifier assigned by the source EDC system (Medidata Rave) or LIMS. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC Query Management; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.4

attributes.name: escalation_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the query was formally escalated. Null if no escalation has occurred. Used for escalation cycle time analytics and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this query has been formally escalated to a higher authority (e.g., from CRA to Clinical Lead, or from site to sponsor medical monitor) due to non-response, SLA breach, or data criticality. Triggers escalation workflow in CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Sponsor-CRO escalation SOPs

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The laboratory result value as it existed at the time the query was raised, captured as a string to accommodate numeric, text, and coded values. Provides before-state for audit trail and data lineage per ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: query_category

products.name: panel_facility_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the formal Qualification contract between a lab_panel and a lab_facility in clinical trial laboratory operations. It captures the operational approval record confirming that a specific laboratory facility is certified and validated to perform a specific test panel, including qualification status, validity dates, facility-specific turnaround time SLAs, and the governing certification standard. Each record is the authoritative gating artifact used during specimen routing and protocol setup to confirm a facility is approved to process a given panel.. Existence Justification: In clinical trial laboratory operations, sponsors and CROs formally qualify specific laboratory facilities to perform specific test panels before specimen routing can occur. A single lab panel (e.g., a PK panel) may be qualified at multiple central lab facilities across different geographies, and a single facility holds qualifications for many different panels. This qualification relationship is actively managed, has a defined lifecycle (qualification, expiry, renewal), and is the operational gating mechanism for specimen routing decisions.

attributes.name: current_location_type

attributes.name: depot_receipt_timestamp

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: destroyed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was confirmed destroyed per the destruction certificate. Required for drug accountability reconciliation and regulatory close-out documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_number

attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dispensed_quantity

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: dispensed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this kit was physically dispensed to the subject by site staff. Captured in RTSM (Medidata Rave) as part of the chain-of-custody audit trail. Conforms to ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the investigational medicinal product within this kit as printed on the label. Kits must not be dispensed after this date. Used for expiry management, re-supply planning, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q1A Stability; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the physical randomization kit by the RTSM (Medidata Rave). This is the primary business identifier used in drug accountability logs, dispensing records, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: kit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit within the supply chain. 'available' = at depot or site, ready for assignment; 'assigned' = allocated to a subject via RTSM but not yet dispensed; 'dispensed' = physically given to subject; 'expired' = past expiry date; 'returned' = returned from site or subject; 'destroyed' = destruction confirmed; 'quarantine' = held pending investigation; 'lost' = unaccounted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|assigned|dispensed|expired|returned|destroyed|quarantine|lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the IMP label applied to this kit. Used to verify that the correct, IRB/IEC-approved label version was used at the time of dispensing and for regulatory label reconciliation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.6; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational medicinal product in this kit was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, batch traceability, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q7

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol under which this kit was dispensed or assigned. Ensures that kit dispensing is traceable to the correct protocol amendment for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject-kit pairing by the RTSM (IRT/IVRS) at the point of subject randomization. Links the kit to the randomization schedule for unblinding and accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM RANDO; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the kit must be retested or re-evaluated for continued use, particularly for products with conditional shelf-life extensions. Distinct from expiry_date; used for stability management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: The number of dosage units returned by the subject or site for this kit. Used in drug accountability reconciliation to calculate compliance and account for unused medication.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: returned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was returned by the subject or site to the depot or destruction facility. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail for drug accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: rtsm_kit_code

attributes.description: The source system identifier for this kit record as assigned by the RTSM module in Medidata Rave. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational RTSM system, and audit trail traceability.

attributes.name: depot_type

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the depot operational contact. Used for urgent logistics coordination and cold-chain incident escalation.

attributes.name: refrigerated_storage_capacity_m3

attributes.description: Indicates whether destruction of expired, returned, or quarantined IMP stock at this location has been formally authorized by the sponsor or designee. Required before physical destruction can proceed per GCP and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GCP

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date on which IMP units or kits were destroyed at or from this location. Required for regulatory accountability documentation and study close-out reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the IMP batch or kit stock held at this location, as stated on the product label. Used for expiry management, resupply planning, and to prevent dispensing of expired product to study subjects.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: imp_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to count IMP stock at this location (e.g., kit, vial, tablet, capsule, syringe, ampoule). Ensures consistent quantity reporting across different IMP formulations and packaging configurations.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: inventory_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this inventory position record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS system. Used in regulatory accountability documentation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this inventory position. 'active' indicates stock is available for dispensing; 'quarantined' indicates stock is held pending investigation or quality review; 'depleted' indicates zero usable stock; 'closed' indicates the position is no longer active post study close-out; 'suspended' indicates dispensing is temporarily halted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_dispensing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IMP or kit dispensing event occurred at this location. Used to monitor site dispensing activity and identify inactive sites that may require supply reallocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM dispensing records; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was conducted at this location for this IMP or kit type. Used to assess inventory data currency and schedule the next physical count per the accountability reconciliation plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_physical_count_qty
attributes.description: Actual physical count of IMP units or kits recorded during the most recent physical inventory count at this location. Compared against the system quantity to identify discrepancies requiring investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent inbound IMP or kit shipment was received and confirmed at this location. Used to track supply chain activity and assess time since last replenishment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM shipment module

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply chain node holding this inventory. Distinguishes between investigational sites (where IMP is dispensed to subjects), depots (regional or central storage), central pharmacies, and satellite depots. Drives resupply logic and accountability reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: maximum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum number of IMP units or kits permitted at this location to prevent overstocking, minimize expiry risk, and comply with storage capacity constraints. Used in supply planning and RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: minimum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Absolute minimum number of IMP units or kits that must be maintained at this location to ensure uninterrupted subject dosing. Falling below this level triggers an urgent resupply escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM supply parameters

attributes.name: qty_adjusted
attributes.description: Net inventory adjustment quantity applied to this position due to physical count discrepancies, data corrections, or reconciliation differences. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: qty_allocated
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently reserved or allocated to specific subjects or randomization slots via the RTSM but not yet physically dispensed. Reduces available-for-dispensing stock.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: qty_destroyed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits that have been destroyed at or from this location, including expired, damaged, or returned-and-destroyed stock. Required for regulatory accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: qty_dispensed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits dispensed to study subjects at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: qty_expired
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits that have passed their expiry date at this location and are no longer eligible for dispensing. Tracked separately for regulatory accountability and waste reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical count of IMP units or kits available at this location, excluding quarantined, allocated, and reserved stock. Represents the net usable inventory at the time of the last update. Used as the primary metric for resupply trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_quarantined
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently placed in quarantine at this location due to quality concerns, temperature excursions, damaged packaging, or pending investigation. These units are not available for dispensing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: qty_received
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits received at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from inbound shipment confirmations in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_returned
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits returned from subjects or from this site to the depot or sponsor for destruction or reconciliation. Used in accountability reconciliation calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IMP accountability reconciliation was completed and approved for this inventory position. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and study close-out documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ principles of contemporaneous data capture. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements under ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11, and enables change detection in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold at which a resupply request should be triggered for this IMP or kit type at this location. When qty_on_hand falls at or below this value, the RTSM or supply planner initiates a replenishment shipment.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP supply planning best practices

attributes.name: reorder_qty
attributes.description: Standard replenishment quantity to be shipped when a resupply is triggered for this location and IMP/kit type. Defined in the supply plan and used by the RTSM to generate resupply orders automatically.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: resupply_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent resupply request was initiated for this inventory position. Used to track supply chain responsiveness and expected delivery timelines.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: resupply_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active resupply request has been triggered for this inventory position. Set to True when qty_on_hand falls at or below the reorder_point and a resupply order has been initiated in the RTSM or supply management system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP supply planning

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the IMP batch must be retested to confirm continued stability and suitability for use. Applicable for products with defined retest periods rather than fixed expiry dates. Triggers stability testing workflows.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: rtsm_location_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Location Code
attributes.description: The location identifier assigned to this site or depot within the RTSM system (Medidata Rave). Used to reconcile inventory records between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational RTSM source system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the IMP or kit at this location, as specified in the Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier (IMPD) or protocol. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and compliance monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room_temperature|refrigerated|frozen|ultra_frozen|controlled_room_temperature|light_protected — promote to reference product if additional conditions are needed]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; USP <1079>

attributes.name: storage_condition_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current storage conditions at this location are compliant with the required storage condition specification for this IMP or kit type. Set to False when a temperature excursion or storage deviation is recorded, triggering quarantine and quality review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312; GCP

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of recorded temperature excursion events for this inventory position at this location. Used to assess cold-chain compliance history and inform quarantine or destruction decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.68; USP <1079>

Managed in coordination with sponsor supply teams and updated at defined planning cycles (typically monthly or per enrollment milestone).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply plan was formally approved by the sponsor supply team and/or CRO supply chain lead. Null if plan has not yet been approved.

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding configuration of the study as it affects supply planning. Double-blind studies require matched placebo kits; open-label studies have simpler kit structures. Impacts kit design and labeling requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: buffer_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Target buffer stock expressed in weeks of supply to be maintained at depot and/or site level. Ensures continuity of supply during manufacturing lead times and logistics delays.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport) throughout the supply chain. Drives depot selection, packaging specifications, and logistics provider requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO Technical Report Series 961; GDP guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destruction_plan_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply plan version includes a returns and destruction plan for expired, unused, or damaged IMP. Required for GMP compliance and accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: dropout_rate_pct
attributes.description: Assumed subject dropout/discontinuation rate (as a percentage) applied in demand forecasting calculations. Accounts for subjects who withdraw consent, are lost to follow-up, or are discontinued per protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP guidelines

attributes.name: expiry_management_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy applied for managing IMP expiry at depot and site level. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), manual review, or RTSM-managed automated expiry tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: forecasted_enrollment
attributes.description: Total number of subjects projected to be enrolled over the planning horizon, derived from enrollment projections and site feasibility assessments. Primary driver of IMP demand forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: horizon_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Typically extends to study completion or database lock (DBL) plus a buffer for returns and destruction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: horizon_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the beginning of the forecasted demand and manufacturing schedule window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply chain planners to document assumptions, constraints, protocol amendment impacts, or sponsor-specific instructions relevant to this supply plan version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: overage_pct
attributes.description: Planned overage percentage applied on top of net demand to account for wastage, damaged kits, protocol amendments, and supply chain uncertainties. Agreed with sponsor and documented in the supply agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: plan_date
attributes.description: The principal business date on which this supply plan was formally prepared or issued. Represents the real-world event date distinct from system audit timestamps.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the supply plan, typically formatted as SP-{StudyCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}. Used in sponsor communications, RTSM configuration, and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply plan. Draft indicates initial creation; under_review indicates sponsor/CRO review; approved indicates sign-off; active indicates currently governing supply operations; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; cancelled indicates plan was voided.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_manufacturing_batches
attributes.description: Total number of manufacturing batches planned to fulfill the forecasted IMP demand over the planning horizon, including buffer and overage quantities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: planning_cycle

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Randomization methodology used in the RTSM for kit assignment to subjects. Drives kit numbering, stratification factors, and supply allocation logic within Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: resupply_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity of kits or units to be shipped per resupply order when the resupply trigger threshold is reached. Defined per site tier and country in the supply plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: resupply_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum kit or unit quantity at depot or site level that triggers an automatic resupply order via RTSM (Interactive Response Technology). When inventory falls to or below this threshold, a resupply shipment is initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: rtsm_plan_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Plan ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding supply plan configuration record within the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Enables traceability between the lakehouse supply plan record and the operational RTSM configuration.

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the IMP in months from date of manufacture, as defined in the product specification and stability data. Critical for expiry management and resupply timing calculations.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: site_tier_scope
attributes.description: Site tier classification covered by this supply plan. Allows differentiated supply planning for high-enrolling versus low-enrolling sites, supporting optimized kit allocation and resupply strategies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Defines upper bound for cold-chain and ambient storage qualification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Used to define cold-chain logistics requirements and depot qualification criteria.

attributes.name: total_units_planned

attributes.name: treatment_arms_count

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the electronic temperature data logger or continuous monitoring device that recorded the excursion. Used for equipment traceability, calibration verification, and audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: The mechanism or system that first detected the temperature excursion: data_logger (electronic temperature logger device), continuous_monitor (real-time monitoring system), manual_check (routine manual temperature check), irt_alert (Interactive Response Technology system alert from Medidata Rave RTSM), courier_report (reported by logistics provider), site_report (reported by site staff).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor or QA team formally issued the disposition decision for the affected IMP kits. Required for regulatory audit trail and supply chain accountability reconciliation.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: The final disposition decision made by the sponsor or QA team following the impact assessment. Distinct from impact_assessment_outcome in that this represents the formal, authorized decision (which may differ from the initial assessment recommendation). Drives downstream supply replacement and accountability reconciliation actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from excursion start to excursion end. Populated once the excursion is closed. Used by QA and the sponsor to assess cumulative thermal exposure against stability data. Derived operationally from start/end timestamps but stored for audit and reporting efficiency.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: excursion_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) at which the temperature returned within the acceptable range, marking the end of the excursion event. Null if the excursion is still ongoing at time of record creation.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); 21 CFR Part 211.166; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: excursion_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the circumstances of the temperature excursion, including any contextual information provided by the site, depot, or courier at the time of detection. Supports GCP audit readiness and regulatory inspection documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: excursion_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this excursion event, used in sponsor communications, QA investigations, and regulatory audit trails. Typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS system (e.g., Medidata Rave or Oracle Siebel CTMS).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: excursion_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) at which the temperature excursion began — i.e., when the temperature first breached the defined threshold. This is the principal real-world event time for the excursion. Critical for duration calculation and impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); 21 CFR Part 211.166; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: excursion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the excursion event record. Drives QA workflow: open (newly detected), under_investigation (impact assessment in progress), pending_disposition (awaiting sponsor/QA decision), closed (disposition finalized), voided (false alarm or data entry error confirmed).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211.192; MasterControl CAPA workflow

attributes.name: excursion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the excursion by the nature of the breach: high_temperature (exceeded upper limit), low_temperature (fell below lower limit), freeze_thaw (frozen product that should not be), humidity (relative humidity breach), combined (multiple parameter breach simultaneously).
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: impact_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the scientific/QA impact assessment determining the usability of the affected IMP: use (product confirmed acceptable for continued use), quarantine (product held pending further evaluation), destroy (product deemed unusable and scheduled for destruction), pending (assessment not yet completed), return_to_sponsor (product to be returned to sponsor for evaluation). Critical for GCP compliance and patient safety.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q10

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorizes where in the cold-chain the excursion occurred: depot (central or regional IMP warehouse), site (investigational site pharmacy or storage), in_transit (during shipment between locations), courier_hub (third-party logistics hub), customs (held at customs/border control).
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: logger_calibration_date
attributes.description: The most recent calibration date of the temperature data logger at the time of the excursion. Required to validate the reliability of the recorded temperature data for GCP audit readiness and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: lower_threshold_c
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable storage temperature (in degrees Celsius) defined for the affected IMP, as specified in the kit definition or product stability data. Breach of this threshold constitutes a low-temperature excursion.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.166

attributes.name: max_temp_recorded_c
attributes.description: The highest temperature value (in degrees Celsius) recorded during the excursion event. Used to assess the severity of a high-temperature excursion against product stability specifications.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); USP <1079>; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: mean_kinetic_temp_c
attributes.description: The Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) in degrees Celsius calculated for the excursion period. MKT is the single calculated temperature that, if maintained over the storage period, would produce the same thermal stress as the actual temperature fluctuations. Used per USP <1079> and WHO guidelines for stability impact assessment.
attributes.references: USP <1079>; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; ICH Q1A(R2)

attributes.name: min_temp_recorded_c
attributes.description: The lowest temperature value (in degrees Celsius) recorded during the excursion event. Used to assess the severity of a low-temperature or freeze-thaw excursion against product stability specifications.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); USP <1079>; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: replacement_kits_required

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the person (e.g., CRC, CRA, site pharmacist, depot manager) who first reported or logged the temperature excursion into the system. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the excursion was formally reported or entered into the system. May differ from excursion_start_timestamp if there was a delay in detection or reporting. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneity assessment.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during the CAPA or investigation process: equipment_failure (refrigeration/monitoring device malfunction), process_failure (SOP not followed), human_error (incorrect handling), logistics_failure (carrier/transit failure), environmental (external weather or facility event), unknown (root cause not yet determined).
