attributes.description: Physical count of IMP units on hand at the site at the end of the reconciliation period, as verified by the site staff and/or CRA during the monitoring visit. This is the ground-truth inventory count.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); ISO 14155

attributes.name: adjusted_units
attributes.description: Net quantity adjustment applied to the reconciliation (positive or negative) to account for documented corrections such as data entry errors, kit relabeling, or sponsor-approved adjustments. Zero if no adjustments were made.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual notes entered by the CRA, site staff, or data manager regarding this reconciliation. Supplements the discrepancy_detail field for general narrative.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: cra_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA / monitor signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if cra_signoff_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cra_signoff_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Research Associate (CRA) Monitor Sign-Off Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) / monitor has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required at every monitoring visit per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destroyed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units destroyed at the site or returned to depot for destruction during the reconciliation period. Destruction must be documented per sponsor SOP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of individual discrepancy line items identified during this reconciliation (e.g., missing kit, unaccounted return, dispensing record mismatch). Distinct from discrepancy_units which measures total quantity variance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature, root cause, and resolution status of identified discrepancies. Captured by the CRA or site staff. Required when discrepancy_count > 0. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current resolution status of identified discrepancies. 'not_applicable' = no discrepancy found; 'open' = discrepancy identified, investigation not started; 'under_investigation' = root cause analysis in progress; 'resolved' = discrepancy explained and documented; 'escalated' = referred to sponsor QA or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: discrepancy_units
attributes.description: Quantity difference between expected_closing_balance_units and actual_closing_balance_units (actual minus expected). A non-zero value triggers discrepancy investigation. Positive = surplus; negative = shortage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dispensed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units dispensed to subjects at the site during the reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in Medidata Rave RTSM and eCRF dispensing logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: expected_closing_balance_units
attributes.description: Calculated expected closing balance: opening_balance_units + received_units - dispensed_units + returned_units - destroyed_units + adjusted_units. Used as the reference value against which the physical count is compared to identify discrepancies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: expired_units_count
attributes.description: Number of IMP units that had expired as of the reconciliation period end date. Expired units must be quarantined and destroyed per sponsor SOP; their presence in usable inventory constitutes a protocol deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date_earliest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earliest IMP Expiry Date on Site
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among all IMP units currently on hand at the site as of the reconciliation period end date. Used to flag impending expiry risk and trigger resupply or destruction actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record is fully compliant with GCP §8.3.13 requirements (both investigator and CRA sign-offs obtained, no unresolved discrepancies, all required fields populated). True = compliant; False = non-compliant or pending.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: inspection_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record and its supporting documentation are complete and ready for regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.). True = inspection-ready; False = documentation gaps exist. Supports eTMF completeness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: investigator_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if investigator_signoff_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: investigator_signoff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled due date for the next drug accountability reconciliation at this site for this IMP. Derived from the monitoring visit schedule or protocol-defined reconciliation frequency. Used for proactive compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS Visit Tracking

attributes.name: opening_balance_units
attributes.description: The quantity of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) on hand at the site at the start of the reconciliation period. Carried forward from the closing balance of the prior reconciliation period or from the initial receipt if this is the first period.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Defines the closing boundary for all IMP transactions included in this reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Together with period_end_date, defines the window of IMP activity (receipts, dispensing, returns, destruction) being reconciled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was identified during this reconciliation (e.g., expired IMP dispensed, incorrect kit dispensed, dispensing outside visit window). True = deviation identified; False = no deviation. Triggers deviation reporting workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: received_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units received at the site from the depot or sponsor during the reconciliation period. Sourced from shipment receipt records in Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was physically performed (i.e., the date of the physical count and record review). This is the principal business event date for this transaction, distinct from sign-off dates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this reconciliation record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS (e.g., RECON-SITE001-20240315). Used in monitoring reports, TMF filings, and regulatory inspection packages. Maps to the accountability record reference in Oracle Siebel CTMS and Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the reconciliation record. 'open' = in progress; 'reconciled' = balances confirmed with no discrepancy; 'discrepancy_flagged' = unresolved quantity mismatch requiring investigation; 'pending_review' = awaiting CRA or investigator sign-off; 'closed' = finalized and archived post-DBL.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation trigger. 'routine_monitoring' = performed at a scheduled CRA monitoring visit; 'pre_dbl' = required prior to Database Lock (DBL); 'site_closeout' = performed at study close-out; 'interim' = ad hoc between visits; 'triggered' = initiated due to a discrepancy or audit finding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: returned_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units returned from subjects to the site (unused or partially used) during the reconciliation period. Includes returns captured in Medidata Rave RTSM return logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: rtsm_reconciliation_ref
attributes.description: The reconciliation reference or transaction identifier assigned by the Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) system (Medidata Rave) for this accountability event. Enables traceability back to the source system record.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: source_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the physical or electronic source document (e.g., drug accountability log, dispensing record binder, eTMF artifact ID in Veeva Vault) that supports this reconciliation record. Required for SDV and regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §1.52; ALCOA+ principles; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any cold-chain temperature excursion was recorded for IMP stored at this site during the reconciliation period. True = at least one excursion event occurred; False = no excursion. Excursions may affect IMP usability and require sponsor assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which IMP quantities are counted and reconciled (e.g., kit, tablet, vial). Must be consistent with the dispensing unit defined in the kit definition and RTSM configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kit|tablet|capsule|vial|ampoule|syringe|patch|sachet — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain (EXDOSU); ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Tracks the last state change in the reconciliation lifecycle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles

Enables end-to-end resupply workflow tracking from trigger to delivery.

attributes.name: shipment_id

attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site or depot that triggered or is the destination of the resupply order. Identifies the requesting or receiving location in the supply chain.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IMP supply plan or forecast that this resupply order is fulfilling. Links operational orders back to strategic supply planning for variance analysis.

attributes.description: Reference to the study treatment arm for which the IMP kits are being resupplied. Ensures blinded or unblinded supply allocation aligns with randomization scheme.

attributes.name: accountability_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP kits in this resupply order have been reconciled in the drug accountability log at the receiving site or depot. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the resupply shipment was confirmed as received at the destination site or depot. Used to calculate fulfillment lead time and identify supply delays.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: blinding_level
attributes.description: Blinding status of the IMP kits in this resupply order. Determines handling, labelling, and access control requirements during supply chain operations.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the resupply order was cancelled. Populated only when order_status is 'cancelled'. Required for supply accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP kits in this resupply order require cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled transport and storage). Drives courier selection and packaging requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: courier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics provider or courier company assigned to transport the resupply shipment. Used for tracking, accountability, and vendor performance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this resupply order record was first captured in the system of record. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: expected_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the resupply order is expected to be delivered to the requesting site or depot, based on standard lead times and courier schedules.

attributes.name: expiry_date_earliest
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among the IMP kits included in this resupply order. Critical for expiry management to ensure kits will remain within shelf life for the expected dispensing window.

attributes.name: is_emergency_override

attributes.name: order_comments

attributes.name: quantity_unit

attributes.name: reconciliation_date

attributes.name: requesting_location_type

attributes.name: rtsm_order_reference

attributes.name: rtsm_trigger_rule

attributes.name: source_system_order_code

attributes.name: storage_condition

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this import permit is required. Links the permit to the specific trial protocol and IMP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Import permits are ICH GCP essential TMF documents (Zone 5 — Regulatory). Each import permit record must link to its filed TMF document for country-level regulatory compliance tracking and inspection
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal entity (CRO, sponsor, or local affiliate) that submitted the import permit application to the regulatory authority. May differ from the sponsor when a CRO acts as the applicant.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the import permit application was formally submitted to the issuing regulatory authority. Used to track regulatory lead times and application-to-approval cycle times.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally approved and issued the import permit. Null if the permit has not yet been approved. Used to calculate approval lead time and schedule shipments.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the import permit record was first created in the clinical supply management system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customs_declaration_number
attributes.description: Official customs entry or declaration number assigned by the customs authority upon import clearance. Links the import permit to the customs clearance record for audit and accountability purposes.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) registration number for the study. Required on EU import permits to link the IMP importation to the registered clinical trial.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA EudraCT; MHRA

attributes.name: export_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country from which the IMP is being exported. Required for bilateral import/export permit matching and customs documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH Q10; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: hs_tariff_code
attributes.description: World Customs Organization Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code for the IMP. Required for customs clearance and import duty determination. Typically 6-10 digits depending on the destination country.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: imp_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the IMP as stated on the import permit, including drug name, dosage form, strength, and any blinding information. Must match the IMP details on the permit document exactly for customs compliance.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: import_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the destination country into which the IMP is being imported. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and customs procedures.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) of the active pharmaceutical ingredient as recognized by the WHO. Used in regulatory submissions and customs declarations to identify the drug substance.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the regulatory authority that issued the permit (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, DEU). Identifies the jurisdiction of the issuing body.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the national regulatory authority or government body that issued the import permit (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada). Used for regulatory correspondence and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory or operational notes related to the import permit, such as special conditions imposed by the authority, customs broker instructions, or escalation details.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: permit_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the scanned or electronic copy of the import permit document stored in the eTMF (Veeva Vault). Enables direct retrieval of the official permit document for customs and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) TMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number assigned by the issuing regulatory authority. This is the externally-known identifier used in regulatory correspondence, customs declarations, and shipment documentation.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10; WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the import permit. Drives shipment release decisions and regulatory compliance tracking. Draft = in preparation; Submitted = application filed with authority; Approved = permit granted; Rejected = application denied; Expired = validity period elapsed; Revoked = permit withdrawn by authority.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the import permit by scope of authorization. Single_shipment covers one consignment; multi_shipment covers a defined number of shipments; blanket covers all shipments within a validity period; emergency is expedited authorization; re_export covers onward shipment to another country.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10; WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: permitted_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of IMP authorized for import under this permit. Expressed in the unit defined by permitted_quantity_unit. Enables supply planning and prevents over-shipment against permit limits.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: permitted_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the permitted_quantity field (e.g., units, vials, tablets, capsules, kg, g, mg, L, mL). Must align with the IMP dosage form and packaging configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: units|vials|tablets|capsules|kg|g|mg|L|mL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q10; CDISC SDTM; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: permitted_shipment_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of individual shipments authorized under this permit. Applicable for multi_shipment permit types. Null for single_shipment or blanket permits where shipment count is not restricted.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally rejected the import permit application. Populated only when permit_status is 'rejected'. Used to track regulatory response timelines and initiate resubmission.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the regulatory authority for rejecting the import permit application. Populated when permit_status is 'rejected'. Used to guide resubmission and CAPA activities.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before permit expiry that the renewal application must be submitted to the issuing authority. Used to trigger automated renewal reminders and prevent supply disruption.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this import permit requires periodic renewal before the study completes. Triggers proactive renewal workflow to prevent supply chain disruption due to permit expiry.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: requires_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics management during import (refrigerated, frozen, or ultra-frozen transport). Drives logistics planning and customs clearance prioritization.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority revoked a previously approved import permit. Populated only when permit_status is 'revoked'. Triggers immediate shipment hold and regulatory notification.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the regulatory authority for revoking a previously approved import permit. Populated when permit_status is 'revoked'. Triggers regulatory notification and supply chain hold.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the IMP as specified on the import permit and in the IMP dossier. Drives cold-chain logistics requirements during import and customs clearance. Must align with kit_definition storage conditions.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; GDP guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the import permit record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: utilized_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of IMP actually imported against this permit to date. Used to track permit utilization, remaining authorized quantity, and accountability reconciliation. Expressed in the same unit as permitted_quantity_unit.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: utilized_shipment_count
attributes.description: Number of shipments that have been made against this permit to date. Used to track permit utilization and determine remaining shipment capacity for multi_shipment permits.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the import permit is legally effective and shipments may be made under its authority. Typically coincides with or follows the approval date.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which the import permit expires and is no longer valid for authorizing IMP shipments. Critical for preventing shipment delays due to expired permits. Null for open-ended permits.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

products.name: depot_inventory
products.description: Tracks IMP and kit stock levels held at each depot, including quantities by batch, kit type, and storage condition zone. Records receipt date, current quantity on-hand, quantity allocated for pending shipments, quantity quarantined, quantity expired, and last physical inventory count. Distinct from site_inventory which tracks site-level stock; depot_inventory covers central and regional warehouse holdings.

attributes.name: accountability_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the drug accountability reconciliation process for this inventory record. Reconciliation confirms that all dispensed, returned, and destroyed quantities account for the total received, as required by GCP and regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Guidance on IND Safety Reporting

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned batch or lot number for the IMP stock held in this inventory record. Critical for GMP traceability, recall management, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q7; ISO 14155

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued by the manufacturer for this batch. The CoA confirms the batch meets specification and is required for QP release and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q7; ISO 14155

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the destruction certificate issued when qty_destroyed units were disposed of. Required for drug accountability reconciliation and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; DEA regulations

attributes.name: erp_material_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number from SAP S/4HANA corresponding to the goods receipt or inventory movement transaction for this batch. Supports financial reconciliation between supply chain and procurement/finance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM module; ICH E6(R2); SOX financial controls

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date assigned to this IMP batch by the manufacturer. Inventory with expiry_date in the past must be quarantined or destroyed per GMP requirements. Drives automated expiry alerts in RTSM.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q1A(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: import_permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory import permit or customs clearance number associated with this batch's receipt at the depot. Required for cross-border IMP shipments and regulatory inspection documentation.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; PMDA; Health Canada; TGA import regulations

attributes.name: inventory_record_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this depot inventory record as assigned by the RTSM or CTMS system (e.g., INV-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this depot inventory record. Drives supply availability calculations, RTSM allocation logic, and GMP disposition decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Available|Allocated|Quarantined|Expired|Destroyed|Returned|On_Hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IMP batch requires continuous cold-chain management throughout storage and distribution. Drives cold-chain logistics planning, temperature monitoring requirements, and qualified carrier selection.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; WHO TRS 961; ICH Q1A(R2); GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IMP batch is classified as a controlled substance requiring enhanced security, dual-custody handling, and DEA/national narcotics authority reporting for inventory accountability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1301 (DEA); EU Directive 2011/62/EU; UN Convention on Psychotropic Substances

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the kit contents held in this inventory record. Distinguishes IMP, comparator, placebo, rescue medication, ancillary supplies, and open-label kits for supply planning and accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was conducted at the depot for this batch/kit type. Supports GMP compliance scheduling and audit readiness.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this depot inventory record, whether from an RTSM transaction, physical count, or manual adjustment. Supports audit trail and data lineage per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IMP batch was manufactured. Used alongside expiry date to calculate remaining shelf life and support GMP batch traceability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q7

attributes.name: min_stock_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of available stock that must be maintained at this depot for this IMP/kit type before a replenishment order is triggered. Supports proactive supply planning and prevents stockouts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM supply planning; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply chain staff to record observations, discrepancy explanations, QP comments, or other contextual information relevant to this depot inventory record. Supports audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: physical_count_discrepancy
attributes.description: Difference between qty_last_physical_count and the system-recorded qty_on_hand at the time of the physical count. A non-zero value triggers a discrepancy investigation per GMP requirements.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: qp_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Qualified Person formally released this batch for clinical use. Null if release is pending or the batch has been rejected.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; EU Directive 2001/83/EC; EMA GMP guidelines

attributes.name: qp_release_status
attributes.description: Status of the Qualified Person (QP) batch release decision for this inventory. Only QP-released stock may be dispensed to clinical sites per EU GMP Annex 13 requirements.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; EU Directive 2001/83/EC; EMA GMP guidelines

attributes.name: qty_allocated
attributes.description: Number of kits or units reserved for pending outbound shipments or site replenishment orders that have been confirmed but not yet physically dispatched. Prevents double-allocation in RTSM.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: qty_available
attributes.description: Number of kits or units available for new allocation or shipment. Calculated as qty_on_hand minus qty_allocated minus qty_quarantined minus qty_expired. Represents the net usable stock for RTSM dispensing decisions.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: qty_destroyed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of kits or units destroyed at this depot for this batch. Supports drug accountability reconciliation and regulatory destruction certificate documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ICH E6(R2); DEA regulations (controlled substances)

attributes.name: qty_expired
attributes.description: Number of kits or units that have passed their expiry date and are no longer eligible for dispensing. Tracked separately to support destruction reconciliation and regulatory accountability reporting.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: qty_last_physical_count
attributes.description: Actual kit or unit count recorded during the most recent physical inventory count at the depot. Used to reconcile system-recorded quantities against physical stock and identify discrepancies.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Total number of kits or units of this IMP batch currently physically present at the depot, regardless of allocation status. The gross stock figure before netting allocated, quarantined, or expired quantities.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM inventory module

attributes.name: qty_quarantined
attributes.description: Number of kits or units placed under quarantine status due to quality investigations, temperature excursions, damaged packaging, or pending QP release. Quarantined stock is excluded from available supply.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q10; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: qty_returned
attributes.description: Number of kits or units returned from clinical sites to this depot. Returned stock is typically quarantined pending QP review before any disposition decision (reuse, destruction, or reconciliation).
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why stock was placed in quarantine status. Required for GMP deviation documentation and QP disposition decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Temperature_Excursion|Damaged_Packaging|QP_Hold|Recall|Stability_Failure|Pending_Release|Investigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q10; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which this batch/kit stock was physically received at the depot. Used for FIFO/FEFO inventory management, shelf-life calculations, and GMP receipt documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.122; ICH Q10

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depot inventory record was first created in the system, typically upon receipt of the batch at the depot. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity to be ordered when stock falls below the minimum threshold. Used by RTSM and supply planners to generate replenishment requests to the manufacturing site or central depot.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the IMP batch must be retested to confirm continued potency and stability before further use. Applicable for products with retest periods rather than hard expiry dates.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: rtsm_inventory_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Inventory ID
attributes.description: Identifier assigned to this inventory record within the RTSM system (Medidata Rave). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational RTSM source system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: storage_condition_zone
attributes.description: Temperature-controlled storage zone within the depot where this inventory is held (e.g., Ambient, Refrigerated 2–8°C, Frozen -20°C, Ultra-Low -80°C). Drives cold-chain logistics and compliance with IMP storage requirements.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q1A(R2) Stability; USP <1079>; WHO TRS 961

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion event has been recorded for this inventory batch during storage at the depot. A True value triggers quarantine and QP review before further use.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q1A(R2); WHO TRS 961; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The dispensing or counting unit used for all quantity fields in this inventory record (e.g., Kit, Vial, Tablet). Ensures consistent quantity interpretation across RTSM, ERP, and accountability reports. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Kit|Vial|Tablet|Capsule|Syringe|Bottle|Blister_Pack — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain; EU GMP Annex 13; ISO 11240 (UCUM)

attributes.name: critical_data_elements

attributes.name: critical_processes

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: data_privacy_requirements
attributes.description: Description of applicable data privacy and patient data protection requirements governing monitoring activities under this plan, including GDPR, HIPAA, and local data protection laws relevant to the study regions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the monitoring plan ceases to be operative, typically upon supersession by a new version or study close-out. Nullable for the currently active version.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the monitoring plan becomes operative and binding for study monitoring activities. Aligns with study initiation or amendment approval date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: escalation_trigger_criteria
attributes.description: Defined conditions or thresholds that trigger escalation of monitoring intensity, additional site visits, or Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) initiation. Examples include KRI breaches, repeated protocol deviations, or SAE under-reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: gcp_training_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether current Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training certification is a prerequisite for all Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) executing monitoring activities under this plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: high_risk_visit_frequency_days
attributes.description: Monitoring visit interval in calendar days applicable to sites classified as High risk tier. Typically shorter than the standard interval to ensure heightened oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: icf_review_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) Review Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether review of signed Informed Consent Forms (ICFs) for all enrolled subjects is a mandatory component of each monitoring visit under this plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Regulations; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: interim_visit_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard interval in calendar days between scheduled interim monitoring visits for an average-risk site. Actual frequency may be adjusted based on site risk tier and Key Risk Indicator (KRI) triggers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: ip_accountability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Investigational Product (IP) accountability checks (dispensing, return, destruction reconciliation) are mandated as part of on-site monitoring visits under this plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: kri_tolerance_limits
attributes.description: Narrative or structured description of the Key Risk Indicator (KRI) thresholds and tolerance limits defined in this monitoring plan. Specifies the upper/lower bounds for metrics such as query rate, protocol deviation rate, and enrollment rate that trigger escalation actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: low_risk_visit_frequency_days
attributes.description: Monitoring visit interval in calendar days applicable to sites classified as Low risk tier. Typically longer than the standard interval, reflecting reduced oversight requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: missing_data_threshold

attributes.name: monitoring_approach

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on RBM

attributes.name: plan_number

attributes.name: plan_status

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_threshold

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: query_rate_threshold

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: rbm_strategy

attributes.name: remote_monitoring_allowed

attributes.name: sdv_percentage_threshold

attributes.name: sdv_scope

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: site_initiation_visit_required

attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sdv_method
attributes.description: The SDV sampling strategy applied to this data point: 100% SDV (all data points verified), targeted (specific critical fields), risk-based (driven by RBM algorithm), or triggered (initiated by a specific risk signal or query). Supports RBM strategy documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management; ICH E6(R2) Addendum

attributes.name: sdv_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the SDV activity for this specific data point: verified (eCRF matches source), discrepancy_found (mismatch identified), not_verifiable (source document unavailable or illegible), or pending (SDV not yet completed). Core status field for ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: sdv_performed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the CRA performed the SDV activity for this specific data point. Principal business event timestamp. Supports ALCOA+ Contemporaneous principle and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sdv_reference_number

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sdv_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SDV was performed on-site at the investigational site, remotely via electronic access to source data, or as part of centralized statistical monitoring. Supports risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy tracking.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source document used for verification (e.g., medical record, lab report, ECG tracing). Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ Original principle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical_record|lab_report|ecg_tracing|imaging_report|pharmacy_record|nursing_notes|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_document_value
attributes.description: The value as recorded in the original source document (e.g., medical record, lab report, nurse notes) against which the eCRF field value was verified. Supports ALCOA+ Attributable and Original principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 1.52; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this SDV record as assigned by the originating system (Oracle Siebel CTMS or Medidata Rave). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail between the Silver Layer and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The protocol-assigned subject number (e.g., site-subject identifier such as 001-001) used to identify the subject in the context of the study without exposing personal identity. Classified as restricted due to potential re-identification risk under HIPAA and GDPR.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SDV record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: waiver_justification

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow must be initiated for this deviation. Typically True for major deviations and recurring minor deviations. Drives CAPA creation in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: classification_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deviation was identified and approved prospectively (before the deviation occurred, as a planned exception) or retrospectively (after the deviation occurred). Prospective deviations may be pre-approved by the sponsor or IRB/IEC; retrospective deviations require post-hoc review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; IRB/IEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or contextual notes related to the deviation finding that do not fit into structured fields. Captured by the CRA or data manager in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the deviation finding record was first created in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol deviation compromised the integrity or reliability of the clinical data collected for the affected subject or visit. Impacts subject's inclusion in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) or Per Protocol (PP) analysis populations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; CDISC SDTM DV Domain; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: The method by which the protocol deviation was identified. Supports risk-based monitoring (RBM) effectiveness analysis and helps identify whether centralized monitoring or on-site monitoring is more effective at detecting specific deviation types.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum Section 5.18.3; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the protocol deviation, including what occurred, which protocol section was deviated from, and the specific circumstances. Captured by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) in Oracle Siebel CTMS during monitoring visit documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; ALCOA+ Principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deviation finding record within the monitoring workflow. Drives CAPA initiation, sponsor notification, and regulatory reporting workflows in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the protocol deviation was first identified, either during an on-site monitoring visit, remote monitoring review, or data management query. Used to calculate detection lag and reporting deadline compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: identified_by
attributes.description: Name or role identifier of the person who identified the protocol deviation (e.g., CRA name, data manager, site staff). Supports accountability tracking and ALCOA+ attributability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Narrative assessment of the actual or potential impact of the deviation on subject safety, data integrity, and study validity. Informs the severity classification and determines whether regulatory reporting is required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: irb_iec_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation was formally reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Null if irb_iec_reportable is False or reporting is pending.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.7; FDA 21 CFR Part 56.108; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) per applicable regulations and the IRB/IEC-approved protocol. Drives automated notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.7; FDA 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the deviation finding record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred at the site. This is the real-world event date, distinct from the identification date. Critical for regulatory reporting timelines and IRB/IEC notification windows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: The specific section number or clause of the study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 6.3.2 - Visit Window'). Enables protocol-level deviation frequency analysis and supports regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; CDISC SDTM DV Domain (DVTERM); FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation represents a recurrence of a previously identified deviation of the same category at this site. Recurring deviations trigger escalated CAPA requirements and may indicate systemic site quality issues.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA) as an important protocol deviation (IPD) or substantial protocol amendment trigger. Applies primarily to major deviations affecting subject safety.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; EMA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation was formally resolved and closed in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Null if the deviation is still open or under review. Used to calculate deviation resolution cycle time KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the actions taken to resolve the protocol deviation, including immediate corrective actions implemented at the site. Distinct from the formal CAPA plan, this captures the immediate remediation steps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Narrative description of the identified root cause of the protocol deviation, as determined through investigation by the site or sponsor. Used to drive CAPA development and systemic issue identification across sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized categorical classification of the deviation root cause to enable cross-site and cross-study trending. Supports risk-based monitoring (RBM) signal detection and CAPA effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: sdtm_dv_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Protocol Deviation Category
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM DV domain category (DVCAT) for the deviation, used for regulatory submission dataset classification. Populated during CDISC data transformation in SAS Drug Development for NDA/BLA/MAA submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide DV Domain (DVCAT); FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_dv_term
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Protocol Deviation Term
attributes.description: The standardized CDISC SDTM DV domain term (DVTERM) describing the deviation, used for regulatory submission datasets. Enables direct mapping to SDTM DV domain for NDA/BLA/MAA submissions processed through SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide DV Domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH M8 eCTD

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Regulatory severity classification of the protocol deviation. 'major' deviations may affect subject safety or data integrity and typically require IRB/IEC and sponsor reporting. 'important_protocol_deviation' (IPD) is the EMA/EU CTR classification for deviations requiring regulatory notification. 'minor' deviations have no significant impact on subject safety or data integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; EMA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (Oracle Siebel CTMS) for this deviation finding. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: sponsor_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation was formally reported to the study sponsor. Null if sponsor_reportable is False or reporting is pending. Used to track compliance with sponsor notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: sponsor_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be formally reported to the study sponsor per the Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) and sponsor SOPs. All major deviations and important protocol deviations (IPDs) are typically sponsor-reportable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The site-assigned subject number (screening or randomization number) of the affected trial participant. This is the pseudonymized identifier used in clinical data systems per GDPR and HIPAA de-identification standards. Distinct from the internal subject_id surrogate key.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM DM Domain (SUBJID); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol deviation had an actual or potential impact on the safety of the affected subject. A True value typically triggers mandatory IRB/IEC notification and may require sponsor safety review.

products.name: risk_indicator
products.description: Centralized monitoring risk indicator (also known as Key Risk Indicator or KRI) defined within the RBM monitoring plan. Captures indicator name, category (enrollment, data quality, safety, protocol compliance, IP accountability), calculation method, threshold values (amber/red), data source, and current computed value per site. Supports centralized statistical monitoring (CSM) and site risk scoring in the RBM framework.
products.reference: Key Risk Indicator (KRI) / Risk-Based Monitoring (TransCelerate RBM, ICH E6(R2))

ICH E6(R2) and SAP-aligned monitoring plans require KRIs to be traceable to th

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this Key Risk Indicator (KRI) is defined. Links the KRI to its parent protocol and RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; Oracle Siebel CTMS Study entity

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site for which the KRI value is computed. A single KRI definition may produce one computed record per site, enabling site-level risk scoring within the RBM framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; Oracle Siebel CTMS Site entity

attributes.name: alert_status
attributes.description: Current risk alert status of the KRI for the site, derived by comparing the computed value against amber and red thresholds. Drives site risk scoring and monitoring intensity decisions in the RBM framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: amber_threshold
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value at which the KRI triggers an amber (warning) alert, indicating elevated risk requiring heightened monitoring attention. Defined in the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Formal description or formula specifying how the KRI value is computed (e.g., 'Number of screen failures / Number of subjects screened × 100'). Ensures reproducibility and auditability of centralized statistical monitoring (CSM) outputs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC ADaM; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) must be initiated in response to the KRI breach. Drives workflow integration with MasterControl CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: computation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the KRI value was most recently computed for the site. Used to assess data currency and trigger recomputation schedules in the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: computation_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which the KRI is recomputed for each site (e.g., weekly for enrollment KRIs, monthly for data quality KRIs). Defined in the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: computation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the KRI value was computed, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: computed_value
attributes.description: Current computed numeric value of the KRI for the associated site, derived from the source system data as of the last computation run. This is the principal quantitative fact of the risk indicator record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive computation cycles during which the KRI has remained at or above the amber or red threshold. Used to trigger escalation workflows and CAPA initiation per the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KRI record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the KRI input data is extracted for computation (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC for data quality KRIs, Oracle Argus Safety for safety KRIs, Oracle Siebel CTMS for enrollment KRIs).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: denominator_value
attributes.description: Raw denominator component of the KRI computation (e.g., total subjects screened, total expected data points, total SAEs reported). Stored alongside the numerator to enable independent verification of the computed value.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this KRI definition became active and applicable to the study and site. Supports versioning of KRI definitions when monitoring plan amendments are issued.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this KRI definition was superseded or retired. Null for currently active KRI definitions. Supports historical analysis and monitoring plan amendment tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current KRI alert status and breach history require formal escalation to the sponsor, Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB), or senior management per the RBM escalation procedure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: indicator_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of what the KRI measures, its business rationale, and how it supports risk detection within the RBM framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: indicator_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the KRI as defined in the RBM monitoring plan (e.g., 'Screen Failure Rate', 'Missing Data Rate', 'SAE Reporting Timeliness'). Used in dashboards, monitoring visit reports, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: indicator_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KRI definition within the monitoring plan. Active KRIs are computed and monitored; draft KRIs are under review; retired KRIs are no longer in use.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl Document Control; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: indicator_type
attributes.description: Quantitative type of the KRI value, indicating whether the computed metric is a rate, absolute count, percentage, ratio, or duration in days. Governs how the value is interpreted against thresholds.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Framework; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: is_centralized_monitoring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI is part of the Centralized Statistical Monitoring (CSM) program, as opposed to a site-level operational indicator. Supports differentiation of CSM KRIs from operational monitoring metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for CRA or data manager annotations regarding the KRI computation, alert status, or remediation context. Supports monitoring visit report narrative and sponsor communication.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: numerator_value
attributes.description: Raw numerator component of the KRI computation (e.g., number of screen failures, number of missing data points, number of overdue SAE reports). Stored to support audit and recomputation validation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: prior_computed_value
attributes.description: KRI computed value from the immediately preceding computation cycle for the same site. Enables trend analysis and detection of rapid deterioration or improvement in site risk profile.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: red_threshold
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value at which the KRI triggers a red (critical) alert, indicating a significant risk requiring immediate escalation and corrective action per the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: reference_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the data window used to compute the KRI value. Together with reference_period_start, defines the exact temporal scope of the KRI computation for reproducibility and audit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: reference_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the data window used to compute the KRI value (e.g., rolling 30-day window start, or study start date for cumulative KRIs). Defines the temporal scope of the computation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: risk_indicator_category
attributes.description: Business category classifying the domain of risk the KRI monitors. Supports stratified risk reporting across enrollment, data quality, safety, protocol compliance, and Investigational Product (IP) accountability domains.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: risk_score_contribution
attributes.description: Weighted contribution of this KRI to the overall site risk score, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Reflects the KRI's relative importance in the composite site risk scoring model.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: sdv_impact
attributes.description: Defines the impact of this KRI's alert status on the Source Data Verification (SDV) strategy for the site. A red alert may trigger targeted or increased SDV; a green status may support reduced SDV per the risk-adaptive monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: sponsor_defined
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI was defined by the sponsor (True) or by the CRO as part of its standard RBM methodology (False). Supports differentiation of sponsor-mandated versus CRO-standard risk indicators.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: threshold_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the KRI alert is triggered when the computed value exceeds (above) or falls below (below) the defined amber/red thresholds. Critical for correct alert logic in centralized statistical monitoring (CSM).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional trend of the KRI value compared to the prior computation cycle. Supports proactive risk management by identifying sites where risk is worsening before threshold breach.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the KRI value and thresholds are expressed (e.g., '%', 'days', 'count', 'ratio'). Ensures consistent interpretation of computed values across sites and studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this KRI record, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the KRI definition (e.g., v1.0, v2.1), incremented when the calculation method, thresholds, or data source is amended. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this KRI in the composite site risk scoring model, reflecting its relative importance compared to other KRIs in the monitoring plan. Used in weighted risk score calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Framework

products.name: site_risk_assessment
products.description: Periodic risk assessment of an investigational site within the RBM framework. Captures overall site risk score, individual KRI values and threshold breaches, risk tier classification (low, medium, high), assessment date, assessor, recommended monitoring intensity adjustment, and approval status. Drives adaptive monitoring visit frequency and SDV scope decisions in Oracle Siebel CTMS.

attributes.name: ae_reporting_timeliness_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of Adverse Events (AEs) reported within the protocol-defined and regulatory-required timeframes during the assessment period. A critical patient safety KRI.
