attributes.name: list_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the randomization list (e.g., v1.0, v2.0). Incremented when the list is regenerated or amended, supporting audit trail and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, amendment rationale, or regulatory comments associated with this randomization list.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: randomization_seed
attributes.description: The random number generator seed value used to produce this list. Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity. Required for reproducibility validation and regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: sap_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier or section reference in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that specifies the randomization methodology for this list. Ensures traceability to the approved statistical methodology.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this randomization list was sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Exchange Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_system_list_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this randomization list in the originating IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One). Used for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Exchange Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: stratification_factors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of stratification factors applied when generating this randomization list (e.g., 'site, disease_severity, age_group'). Reflects the protocol-defined stratification variables.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: superseded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization list was superseded by a newer version. Null if the list is still active. Supports version lifecycle audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: total_slots
attributes.description: Total number of randomization positions (slots) in this list, representing the maximum number of subjects that can be assigned using this list.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: treatment_arm_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct treatment arms (including placebo/control) covered by this randomization list. Validates alignment with the protocol-defined study design.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Defined procedure type for unblinding this randomization list. Governs when and how treatment assignments may be revealed (e.g., emergency unblinding, post-DBL unblinding). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_unblinding|scheduled_dbl_unblinding|dsmb_unblinding|regulatory_unblinding — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization list record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and quality control validation performed on this randomization list prior to activation. Ensures the list meets protocol specifications before use.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the randomization list completed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) validation. Null if validation has not yet been performed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5

products.name: rand_code
products.description: Individual randomization code (slot) within a randomization list. Each code represents a single subject allocation slot with its sequential position number, pre-assigned treatment arm, stratification cell membership, kit code linkage for IMP dispensing, blinded label visible to site staff, and assignment status (available, assigned, cancelled, replaced). The atomic unit consumed when a subject is randomized via IRT/RTSM — once assigned, the code is permanently linked to that subject. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.
products.reference: RTSM Randomization Code / Allocation Slot

attributes.name: rand_code_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each randomization code (slot) record in the Silver layer. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site to which this randomization code is allocated. Site-specific lists restrict code consumption to the assigned site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One Site Management

attributes.name: irt_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier generated by the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system at the moment of code assignment. Used for reconciliation between the EDC and RTSM systems.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One IRT; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: rand_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent randomization list from which this code slot was generated. A study may have multiple lists (e.g., per stratum or per site).
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RELREC; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: stratification_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.stratification_cell. Business justification: Each rand_code slot belongs to a specific stratification cell that determines its allocation. rand_code currently stores stratification_cell_code (STRING) and stratification_cell_description (STRING)
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) to which this randomization code belongs. Links the code to its parent study context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Each rand_code slot is allocated to exactly one treatment arm. rand_code currently stores treatment_arm_code (STRING) and treatment_arm_label (STRING) as denormalized references. Adding treatment_arm_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocation_ratio_denominator
attributes.description: Denominator of the randomization allocation ratio (e.g., 3 in a 2:1 ratio, representing total parts). Together with the numerator, documents the intended allocation balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: allocation_ratio_numerator
attributes.description: Numerator of the randomization allocation ratio for the treatment arm assigned to this code (e.g., 2 in a 2:1 ratio). Used to verify list balance and document the randomization scheme.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization code was consumed and assigned to a subject via the IRT/RTSM system. The principal business event timestamp for this entity. Null if not yet assigned.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM DM RANDDT; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this randomization code slot: available (not yet consumed), assigned (linked to a subject), cancelled (voided without assignment), replaced (superseded by a new code), reserved (held for a specific site/stratum), expired (past validity window). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|assigned|cancelled|replaced|reserved|expired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding scheme applied to this randomization code: double_blind (subject and investigator blinded), single_blind (subject only), open_label (no blinding), triple_blind (including sponsor). Governs access controls on treatment arm data.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: block_number
attributes.description: Block identifier within the randomization list to which this code belongs. Used for permuted-block randomization schemes to verify block completeness and balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; CDISC SDTM RANDBLK

attributes.name: block_size
attributes.description: Number of randomization slots in the block containing this code. For variable block size designs, records the actual block size assigned to this slot.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for cancellation of this randomization code (e.g., subject screen failure, site closure, protocol amendment). Required for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization code was cancelled or voided in the IRT/RTSM system. Null if the code was not cancelled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: code_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric randomization code identifier as generated by the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., 'RC-0042'). This is the business-facing code printed on the randomization schedule and referenced in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RANDT variable; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the site where this randomization code is allocated. Used for country-level stratification and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E9; CDISC SDTM DM COUNTRY

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization code record was first created in the source IRT/RTSM system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dispensing_visit_number
attributes.description: Protocol-defined visit number at which the IMP kit linked to this randomization code is to be dispensed to the subject. Aligns with the study schedule of assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this randomization code is no longer valid for assignment. Codes past expiry are automatically set to 'expired' status by the IRT/RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: irt_system_source
attributes.description: Identifies the IRT/RTSM system that generated and managed this randomization code (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Supports multi-system reconciliation and data lineage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: is_emergency_unblinding_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this randomization code is eligible for emergency unblinding by site staff via the IRT system (True) or requires sponsor/DSMB authorization (False). Governs site-level unblinding access controls.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: is_rescue_medication_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment arm assigned to this code permits rescue medication dispensing (True) or not (False). Drives IRT/RTSM dispensing logic for rescue kits.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM CM domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: is_unblinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment for this code has been formally unblinded (True) or remains blinded (False). Set to True upon emergency or end-of-study unblinding events.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: kit_code
attributes.description: Pre-assigned IMP kit code linked to this randomization slot for dispensing via IRT/RTSM. Connects the randomization event to the supply chain kit that must be dispensed to the subject.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; EU CTR 536/2014; Medidata Rave RTSM Supply Module

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to this randomization code record in the source system. Required for change tracking and ALCOA+ audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: list_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the randomization list from which this code was generated (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Tracks list amendments due to protocol changes and supports regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes or comments entered by the IRT/RTSM administrator regarding this randomization code (e.g., manual override justification, reconciliation notes).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_number
attributes.description: Protocol amendment version under which this randomization code was generated or last modified. Tracks list changes driven by protocol amendments for regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Statistical algorithm used to generate this randomization code (e.g., permuted_block, minimization, adaptive). Documented for regulatory submission and biostatistical validation.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: randomization_seed
attributes.description: Cryptographic seed value used by the randomization algorithm to generate this code list. Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity. Required for regulatory reproducibility validation.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 3.4; FDA Guidance on Randomization; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-defined geographic region code (e.g., 'NA', 'EU', 'APAC') associated with the site for this code. Used as a stratification factor in multi-regional trials.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM DM; FDA Guidance on Multi-Regional Clinical Trials

attributes.name: replacement_code_number
attributes.description: Code number of the replacement randomization slot issued when this code was cancelled or replaced. Enables traceability of code replacement chains in the audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sequence_position
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal position of this code within its randomization list. Determines the order in which codes are consumed during subject enrollment.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM RANDSEQ

attributes.name: source_system_code_reference
attributes.description: Native primary key or unique identifier of this randomization code record in the originating IRT/RTSM source system (Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One). Enables reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: unblinding_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for unblinding this randomization code, required for regulatory audit trail. Null if the code has not been unblinded.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: unblinding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the treatment arm assignment was formally unblinded. Null if the code remains blinded. Captured per ALCOA+ principles for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

products.name: treatment_arm
products.description: Master definition of each treatment arm within a clinical study. Captures arm name, arm code, arm type (experimental, active comparator, placebo, open-label extension), blinding role, target allocation percentage, and arm status. SSOT for treatment arm definitions referenced by randomization codes, subject assignments, and supply domain kit assignments.
products.reference: Treatment Arm / Study Arm

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Primary key for treatment_arm

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: randomization.treatment_arm is the operational implementation of study.study_arm (the protocol-defined arm). Linking them is required for SDTM ARM domain mapping, CSR reporting, and protocol complianc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Treatment arms are explicitly authorized under a CTA; different CTAs in different countries may authorize different arms. Regulatory inspectors verify that only CTA-authorized arms were randomized. Di
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: FK to study.investigational_product

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Treatment arms are added, modified, or removed via protocol amendments. Regulatory submissions and CDISC SDTM ARM datasets must reference the amendment that introduced or changed each arm. amendment_v
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study to which this treatment arm belongs. Links the arm definition to its parent study protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM ARM domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: allocation_ratio_denominator
attributes.description: Denominator component of the randomization allocation ratio for this arm (e.g., 3 in a 2:1 ratio where total parts = 3). Together with the numerator, defines the proportional allocation of subjects to this arm.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: allocation_ratio_numerator
attributes.description: Numerator component of the randomization allocation ratio for this arm (e.g., 2 in a 2:1 ratio). Used with the denominator to compute the target allocation percentage and configure the randomization schedule in IRT/RTSM systems.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM IG; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: analysis_population
attributes.description: Primary analysis population associated with this treatment arm for statistical reporting (e.g., Intent-to-Treat (ITT), Modified ITT (mITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety). Drives CDISC ADaM ADSL population flags and SAS Drug Development analysis programs.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM IG; SAP; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treatment arm definition received formal approval (e.g., sponsor sign-off, protocol approval, IRT/RTSM UAT sign-off). Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness. Managed via MasterControl or Veeva Vault workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: arm_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this treatment arm was closed to new randomizations or formally ended per protocol or protocol amendment. Nullable for arms that remain open. Used for enrollment closure tracking and database lock (DBL) preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: arm_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number defining the display order of this treatment arm in study reports, listings, and tables. Used for consistent ordering in CSR outputs, SDTM datasets, and regulatory submission documents.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E3 CSR; eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: arm_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this treatment arm became active and eligible for subject randomization, as defined in the protocol or IRT/RTSM configuration. Used for enrollment timeline tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: arm_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the treatment arm. Controls whether subjects can be randomized to this arm, whether supply kits can be assigned, and whether the arm is available for data entry in the EDC. Managed in Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: arm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treatment arm by its role in the study design. Drives regulatory reporting, safety analysis population definitions, and CDISC SDTM ARMCD mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: experimental|active_comparator|placebo|open_label_extension|run_in|follow_up — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology ARMCD; ICH E8 General Considerations for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: blinding_role
attributes.description: Blinding designation for this treatment arm indicating the level of masking applied. Critical for maintaining blinding integrity in the study. Restricted access to prevent unblinding of sponsor, investigator, or subject. Managed in Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA Guidance on Blinding in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treatment arm record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate). Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: crossover_sequence
attributes.description: For crossover study designs, defines the treatment sequence this arm represents (e.g., 'AB', 'BA', 'ABC'). Used in CDISC SDTM SEARM (Sequence Arm) variable and period-specific analysis in ADaM datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG SEARM variable; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Crossover Studies

attributes.name: dose_level
attributes.description: Dose level designation for the investigational product in this arm (e.g., '10mg', '50mg', '100mg', 'High Dose', 'Low Dose'). Used in dose-escalation studies, PK/PD analyses, and CDISC SDTM EX domain mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Dose-Response Studies

attributes.name: dosing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of investigational product administration for subjects in this arm (e.g., 'QD - Once Daily', 'BID - Twice Daily', 'QW - Once Weekly'). Mapped to CDISC Controlled Terminology FREQ variable in the EX domain.
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology FREQ; CDISC SDTM EX domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: edc_arm_code
attributes.description: Treatment arm code as configured in the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave EDC or Oracle Clinical One). Used for eCRF field population, data validation rules, and SDTM mapping. Ensures consistency between EDC and IRT arm definitions.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; Oracle Clinical One; CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain

attributes.name: irt_arm_code
attributes.description: Treatment arm code as configured in the Interactive Response Technology (IRT) / Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS) / Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) system (Medidata Rave RTSM). Used for kit assignment, supply reconciliation, and randomization code generation. May differ from the SDTM arm code.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM Configuration; CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_blinded_to_investigator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment is masked from the Principal Investigator (PI) and site staff. Critical for double-blind study integrity and GCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_blinded_to_subject
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment is masked from the study subject. Supports blinding integrity documentation required by ICH E9 and GCP. Distinct from investigator or sponsor blinding.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: is_control_arm
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treatment arm serves as the control arm (placebo or active comparator) in the study. Used in statistical analysis to define the reference group for primary and secondary endpoint comparisons.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM ADSL ACTARM; FDA Guidance on Control Groups

attributes.name: max_subject_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of subjects permitted in this treatment arm. Enforced by IRT/RTSM to prevent over-enrollment. May be set for adaptive designs or safety-driven enrollment caps.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; RTSM Configuration

attributes.name: min_subject_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of subjects required in this treatment arm to maintain statistical validity and meet protocol-defined endpoints. Used by DSMB/DMC for interim analysis decisions and by biostatistics for power calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; DSMB Charter; SAP

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this treatment arm record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Updated on every change to the record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, clarifications, or sponsor-specific instructions related to this treatment arm definition. Not used for regulatory submissions; intended for internal data management and CTMS operational use.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: planned_subject_count
attributes.description: Target number of subjects planned for enrollment and randomization into this treatment arm as defined in the study protocol and sample size calculation. Used for enrollment tracking, site feasibility, and supply planning.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section(s) of the study protocol document that defines this treatment arm (e.g., 'Section 5.2 - Treatment Arms and Dosing Regimen'). Supports traceability between the data model and the governing protocol document stored in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; Veeva Vault eTMF; TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Statistical randomization method used to allocate subjects to this treatment arm. Drives IRT/RTSM algorithm configuration in Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One. Documented in the SAP and protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM IG; FDA Guidance on Randomization in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treatment arm definition has been included in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or CTD). Used for submission readiness tracking and eCTD package assembly in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD; eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Route by which the investigational product is administered to subjects in this arm. Mapped to CDISC Controlled Terminology for the EX domain EXROUTE variable. Drives supply kit configuration and nursing/pharmacy instructions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|intravenous|subcutaneous|intramuscular|topical|inhalation|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology ROUTE; CDISC SDTM EX domain; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: sap_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) section that defines the analysis methodology for this treatment arm. Ensures traceability between arm definitions and the pre-specified statistical analysis approach used in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; SAP; CDISC ADaM IG

attributes.name: sdtm_arm_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) ARM Value
attributes.description: The exact ARM variable value as it will appear in the CDISC SDTM DM (Demographics) and ARM domains for regulatory submission. Must conform to CDISC Controlled Terminology and be consistent across all SDTM datasets submitted in the eCTD package.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 DM domain ARM variable; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this treatment arm definition was sourced or is mastered (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and Silver layer ETL audit in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Plan (DMP)

attributes.name: stratification_factors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of stratification factors applied during randomization to this arm (e.g., 'region, disease severity, prior treatment'). Defined in the protocol and SAP. Used to ensure balanced allocation across subgroups and configure IRT/RTSM stratification layers.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; SAP; CDISC SDTM STRATCD variable

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for temporary suspension of randomization to this treatment arm (e.g., safety signal, supply shortage, protocol amendment). Documented for regulatory compliance and DSMB/DMC review. Populated only when arm_status is 'suspended'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.17; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: target_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of randomized subjects to be allocated to this treatment arm as specified in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and protocol. Used for enrollment monitoring, supply forecasting, and IRT/RTSM configuration. Example: 33.33 for a 1:1:1 three-arm study.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; SAP; CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain

attributes.name: treatment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the investigational treatment, comparator, or placebo administered in this arm, including drug name, formulation, dose, route of administration, and dosing schedule as specified in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; ICH E3 CSR; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Description of the emergency unblinding procedure applicable to this treatment arm, including authorized personnel, system access method (e.g., IRT/IVRS emergency unblinding), and documentation requirements. Classified confidential to protect blinding integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA Guidance on Blinding; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: washout_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for washout between treatment periods for this arm in crossover or multi-period study designs. Defined in the protocol based on pharmacokinetic (PK) half-life data. Used for visit scheduling and IRT/RTSM period management.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; DMPK Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Crossover Studies

products.name: stratification_factor
products.description: Defines the stratification factors used in a randomization scheme, including factor name, factor code, data source (eCRF field reference), factor type (categorical, continuous-binned), enumerated levels (level code, label, sort order, active status), and optional minimization parameters (weight value, algorithm variant such as Pocock-Simon or weighted minimization). Each factor belongs to one randomization scheme and its levels define the axes of the stratification matrix. Owned by the biostatistics/RTSM team as part of scheme design.
products.reference: Stratification Factor

attributes.name: stratification_factor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the stratification factor record within the randomization scheme. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: ecrf_field_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.ecrf_field. Business justification: Stratification factors are collected via specific eCRF fields — the stratification_factor.ecrf_field_reference plain-text column is a denormalized reference to data.ecrf_field. A proper FK enables EDC
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: eligibility_criterion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.eligibility_criterion. Business justification: ICH E9(R1) requires traceability between randomization stratification factors and the eligibility criteria from which they derive (e.g., disease severity, prior therapy). SAP and protocol review depen
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent randomization scheme to which this stratification factor belongs. Each factor is owned by exactly one scheme.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM TA domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this stratification factor is defined. Enables direct study-level filtering without joining through the scheme.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: adam_variable
attributes.description: The CDISC ADaM variable name in the ADSL dataset corresponding to this stratification factor (e.g., 'STRAT1', 'BSEVSEV'). Used in primary and sensitivity analyses per the Statistical Analysis Plan.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this stratification factor configuration was formally approved by the biostatistics or RTSM team. Required for regulatory audit trail and TMF documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: covariate_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to adjust for this stratification factor in the primary analysis: 'ancova' for Analysis of Covariance, 'cmh' for Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test, 'logistic_regression' for binary endpoints, 'none' if not used as a covariate in analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Covariate Adjustment (2023); CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stratification factor record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_source_type
attributes.description: Identifies the system or method from which the stratification factor value is captured at randomization: 'ecrf' from the EDC eCRF, 'ivrs' from Interactive Voice Response System, 'irt' from IRT/RTSM, 'central_lab' from laboratory results, 'manual_entry' for site-entered values.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC/RTSM; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this stratification factor ceased to be effective for new randomizations, typically due to protocol amendment or study close-out. Null for currently active factors.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this stratification factor became effective for subject randomization, typically aligned with protocol approval or amendment effective date. Subjects randomized on or after this date are stratified using this factor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: factor_code
attributes.description: Short, system-level alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the stratification factor within the scheme (e.g., REGION, DISEASE_STAGE, GENDER). Used as the programmatic key in RTSM/IRT configuration and SDTM mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: factor_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the stratification factor, including its clinical rationale, how it is assessed, and its role in balancing treatment arms as documented in the Statistical Analysis Plan.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: factor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the stratification factor as displayed in the RTSM/IRT interface and statistical analysis plan (e.g., 'Geographic Region', 'Baseline Disease Severity', 'Prior Treatment Status').
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM; SAP (Statistical Analysis Plan)

attributes.name: factor_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the stratification factor within the scheme design workflow: 'draft' during initial configuration, 'approved' after biostatistics/RTSM sign-off, 'active' when live in the IRT system, 'suspended' during protocol amendment review, 'retired' when permanently decommissioned.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; MasterControl; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: factor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the factor's measurement scale: 'categorical' for nominal groupings (e.g., region), 'continuous_binned' for numeric ranges converted to categories (e.g., age groups), 'ordinal' for ranked categories (e.g., disease severity), 'binary' for two-level factors (e.g., yes/no prior treatment).
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization

attributes.name: irt_parameter_name
attributes.description: The exact parameter name as configured in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One) for this stratification factor. Used for system integration and UAT validation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification factor is currently active and in use for subject randomization (True) or has been deactivated via protocol amendment (False). Inactive factors are retained for historical traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stratification factor value is masked from unblinded personnel (True) or visible to all study team members (False). Relevant for double-blind studies where certain stratification criteria could reveal treatment assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: is_primary_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor is designated as a primary stratification factor (True) versus a secondary or exploratory factor (False) in the Statistical Analysis Plan. Primary factors are used in the primary efficacy analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization

attributes.name: is_used_in_primary_analysis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification factor is included as a covariate in the primary statistical analysis model (True) or is used only for randomization balance without inclusion in the primary analysis (False). Relevant for ANCOVA and CMH test specifications in the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Covariate Adjustment; CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: level_count
attributes.description: Total number of enumerated levels (strata) defined for this stratification factor. Drives the dimensionality of the stratification matrix and the number of randomization lists required. For example, a 3-region factor has level_count = 3.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: max_imbalance_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum allowable imbalance (as a percentage or absolute count, per unit_of_imbalance) between treatment arms within any stratum defined by this factor before a balancing action is triggered in the minimization algorithm.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: minimization_variant
attributes.description: Specific variant of the minimization algorithm applied for this factor: 'pocock_simon' for the Pocock-Simon method, 'weighted_minimization' for factor-weighted minimization, 'biased_coin' for biased-coin minimization, 'deterministic' for deterministic minimization, 'none' if minimization is not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock-Simon (1975); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: minimization_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this stratification factor in a minimization or weighted minimization algorithm (e.g., Pocock-Simon). Values typically range from 0.0 to 1.0, with higher weights indicating greater influence on treatment allocation balance. Null if minimization is not used.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock-Simon Minimization Algorithm; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: missing_value_handling
attributes.description: Defines the RTSM system behavior when the stratification factor value is missing or unknown at the time of randomization: 'block_randomization' to prevent randomization, 'assign_default_level' to use a pre-specified default level, 'flag_and_hold' to alert the site, 'exclude_from_minimization' to proceed without this factor.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; SAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, biostatistician comments, or RTSM configuration remarks related to this stratification factor that do not fit into structured fields. Not used for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section of the study protocol document that defines this stratification factor (e.g., 'Section 8.2.1 Stratification Factors'). Enables traceability from the data model to the governing protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: randomization_algorithm
attributes.description: The randomization algorithm applied in conjunction with this stratification factor: 'permuted_block' for block randomization within strata, 'minimization' for adaptive minimization, 'stratified_block' for stratified permuted block, 'dynamic_allocation' for covariate-adaptive methods.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: rtsm_factor_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this stratification factor within the source RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal factor ID or Oracle Clinical One factor GUID). Used for system integration, reconciliation, and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: rtsm_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) System
attributes.description: Identifies the RTSM/IRT/IVRS system in which this stratification factor is configured and operationalized for subject randomization and kit assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: sap_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section of the Statistical Analysis Plan that describes the use of this stratification factor in primary and sensitivity analyses (e.g., 'SAP Section 5.3 Stratification'). Supports regulatory audit traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: sdtm_variable
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM variable name that maps to this stratification factor for regulatory submission datasets (e.g., 'STRAT1', 'REGION1'). Used in SDTM TR/SUPPFA domains and ADaM ADSL derivations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Integer defining the display and processing sequence of this stratification factor within the randomization scheme. Lower values appear first in RTSM screens, SAP tables, and stratification matrix axes.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: unit_of_imbalance
attributes.description: Specifies whether the max_imbalance_threshold is expressed as a 'percentage' of subjects within the stratum or as an absolute 'subject_count'. Determines how the RTSM system evaluates balance during randomization.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; SAP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stratification factor record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks configuration changes and supports change control audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: validation_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or logical expression applied to validate the stratification factor value at the time of randomization (e.g., 'BMIBL >= 18 AND BMIBL < 30'). Prevents invalid factor assignments and ensures data integrity per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of this stratification factor definition, incremented with each protocol amendment or RTSM configuration change (e.g., '1.0', '2.0'). Supports change control and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; MasterControl

products.name: stratification_cell
products.description: Represents the unique combination of stratification factor levels that defines a single stratum cell within a randomization scheme. Stores the cell identifier, composite cell label, target subject count per arm within the cell, actual enrolled count, and cell balance status. Used to monitor enrollment balance across strata.
products.reference: Stratification Cell / Stratum Cell

attributes.name: stratification_cell_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a stratification cell record within the randomization scheme. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent randomization scheme under which this stratification cell is defined. Links the cell to its governing allocation algorithm.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain

attributes.name: stratification_factor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cell Factor Level - Stratification Factor Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the stratification factor that contributes a level to this cell definition.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this stratification cell is defined. Enables cross-study reporting and enrollment balance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the treatment arm associated with this stratification cell. Enables arm-level enrollment balance monitoring within each stratum.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM ARM domain; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: actual_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Current count of subjects who have been randomized and enrolled into this stratification cell. Updated in real time from the IRT/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM / Oracle Clinical One) upon each randomization event.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of subject allocation across treatment arms within this stratification cell (e.g., '1:1', '2:1', '1:1:1'). Defined in the protocol and SAP and configured in the RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; CDISC SDTM RAND domain

attributes.name: balance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage deviation from the target enrollment count before the cell is flagged as imbalanced. Defined in the SAP and used by the RTSM system to trigger balance alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: block_size
attributes.description: Size of the permuted block used for randomization within this stratification cell. A value of zero or null indicates variable block size or non-block-based methods. Stored as confidential to protect blinding integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cell_balance_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment balance status of this stratification cell relative to its target. 'balanced' indicates enrollment is within acceptable tolerance; 'under_enrolled' or 'over_enrolled' indicate deviation from target; 'closed' indicates the cell is no longer accepting subjects; 'suspended' indicates temporary halt.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: cell_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this stratification cell within the study randomization scheme. Used in IRT/IVRS/RTSM systems such as Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One for cell-level kit assignment and allocation tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM RAND domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: cell_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the stratification cell, including the clinical rationale for the factor level combination and any protocol-specific notes.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cell_label
attributes.description: Human-readable composite label describing the full combination of stratification factor levels that define this cell (e.g., 'Age>=65 / Male / ECOG 0-1'). Used in study reports, CSR tables, and enrollment dashboards.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization

attributes.name: cell_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this cell within the randomization scheme, used for consistent ordering in reports, listings, and IRT/RTSM system configuration.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM RAND domain; ICH E9

attributes.name: cell_status
attributes.description: Operational lifecycle status of the stratification cell within the randomization scheme. 'active' means the cell is open for randomization; 'inactive' means it has been deactivated; 'closed' means enrollment is complete; 'suspended' means temporarily halted; 'draft' means not yet activated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stratification cell record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: enrollment_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which this stratification cell was closed to further subject randomization, either due to reaching the enrollment cap or protocol-driven closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: enrollment_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which this stratification cell was opened for subject randomization and enrollment, as recorded in the RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: factor_level_code
attributes.description: The system-level alphanumeric code for the specific factor level assigned to this cell (e.g., 'MILD', 'M', 'NA'). Used for IRT/RTSM system configuration and programmatic identification of the level within the randomization engine.
attributes.references: IRT/RTSM system configuration

attributes.name: factor_level_value
attributes.description: The specific level value assigned to this stratification factor within this cell (e.g., 'Mild', 'Male', 'North America'). This is the core data element that defines the cell's position on this factor's axis and is required for SDTM STRATM variable mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM STRATM variable

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region stratification factor level associated with this cell (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific), when geography is used as a stratification factor. Supports regional enrollment balance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Multi-Regional Clinical Trials; EMA Guideline on Stratification

attributes.name: is_active_for_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification cell is currently open and accepting new subject randomizations. Controlled by the RTSM system and updated when enrollment caps or protocol amendments are applied.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment within this stratification cell is blinded to investigators and subjects. True for double-blind studies; False for open-label designs.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: is_primary_defining_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification factor is the primary axis used to define and label this cell within the randomization scheme. Used by biostatisticians to identify the dominant stratification dimension for reporting and SAP documentation purposes.
attributes.references: Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)

attributes.name: last_randomization_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent subject randomization event recorded within this stratification cell. Used to monitor cell activity and detect stalled enrollment.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: level_sequence_order
attributes.description: The ordinal position of this factor's contribution within the cell's composite label definition. Determines the display order of factor levels in the cell label (e.g., factor 1 = Disease Severity, factor 2 = Gender, factor 3 = Region) and is required for consistent RTSM cell label generation.
attributes.references: RTSM cell label specification

attributes.name: maximum_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of subjects permitted in this stratification cell per treatment arm. Enrollment is capped at this value to prevent over-representation of a stratum.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of subjects required in this stratification cell to maintain statistical validity of the study, as specified in the SAP. Triggers an alert if actual enrollment falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments regarding this stratification cell, such as enrollment challenges, protocol deviation impacts, or DSMB/DMC recommendations affecting cell management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol under which this stratification cell definition was established or last amended. Ensures traceability of cell definitions to specific protocol versions for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Randomization algorithm applied within this stratification cell (e.g., permuted block, minimization, dynamic allocation). Determines how subjects are allocated to treatment arms within the cell.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; CDISC SDTM RAND domain

attributes.name: randomized_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who have received a randomization code assignment within this stratification cell, which may differ from enrolled count if subjects are randomized but not yet dosed.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: rtsm_cell_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Cell Reference
attributes.description: External cell identifier as configured in the RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One IRT). Used for reconciliation between the data lakehouse and the operational RTSM system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: sap_version
attributes.description: Version of the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that defines the stratification factors, cell structure, and enrollment targets for this cell. Critical for regulatory audit traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: screened_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who have been screened and assessed for eligibility within this stratification cell, used to monitor the screening-to-enrollment funnel per stratum.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: sdtm_stratum_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Stratum Value
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM-compliant stratum value code for this cell, mapped to the STRATCD variable in the RAND domain. Required for regulatory submission datasets and SDTM-to-ADaM derivations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA CDISC Technical Conformance Guide; ICH M8

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this stratification cell record originated (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: target_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Protocol-specified target number of subjects to be enrolled in this stratification cell per treatment arm, as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and randomization schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that last modified this stratification cell record. Required for electronic records compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ attributability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this stratification cell record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawn_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who were enrolled in this stratification cell but subsequently withdrew or were discontinued, used to assess cell-level dropout impact on balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM DS domain; FDA Guidance on Missing Data

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that created this stratification cell record. Required for electronic records compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ attributability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: subject_randomization
products.description: Transactional record of a subject's randomization or re-randomization event. Captures the subject identifier, study site, randomization number assigned, treatment arm allocated, stratification cell, randomization timestamp, IRT/IVRS transaction reference, randomizing user (CRC/IRT system), randomization status (randomized, cancelled, re-randomized), and for re-randomization events: original randomization reference, re-randomization reason (screen failure re-entry, protocol deviation, IRT error), and authorizing protocol amendment. This is the SSOT for all subject-to-treatment-arm allocation events including initial and subsequent randomizations. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.
products.reference: Subject Randomization Event / IRT Randomization Transaction

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each subject randomization or re-randomization event record in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: blinding_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.blinding_config. attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Regulatory reporting to national competent authorities requires linking subject randomizations to the governi

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.epoch. Business justification: SDTM TE domain mapping and epoch-level enrollment reporting require direct epoch attribution on the randomization event. Subject randomization occurs within a specific epoch (typically treatment); dir
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ethics_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_approval. Business justification: GCP requires that each subject randomization occurs under a valid, current ethics approval. Linking subject_randomization to ethics_approval enables per-subject enrollment compliance verification, sup

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: US IND annual reports require subject enrollment and randomization counts per IND. subject_randomization already has clinical_trial_authorization_id for EU/global CTAs but lacks ind_application_id for
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: irt_transaction_id

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit at which the IMP kit was dispensed to the subject.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV/SV domains; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enrolled study subject who received the IMP kit. Links the kit assignment to the subject randomization record for IMP accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit assignment record, tracking the kit from initial assignment through dispensing, return, destruction, or loss. Essential for IMP accountability and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the reason for the kit assignment: initial dispensing at randomization, resupply at a subsequent visit, replacement of a damaged/lost kit, dose titration, or rescue medication dispensing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One RTSM module

attributes.name: blinding_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the kit assignment is blinded (treatment identity concealed), unblinded (treatment identity revealed, e.g., after emergency unblinding or study completion), or open-label. Critical for maintaining trial integrity and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for site staff or data management to record additional notes or observations related to the kit assignment event (e.g., reason for kit replacement, notes on subject compliance, dispensing anomalies).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject demonstrated acceptable dosing compliance for this kit assignment based on the quantity dispensed versus quantity returned. True if compliance meets protocol-defined threshold; False if a compliance issue is identified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; FDA Guidance on Compliance; SAP (Statistical Analysis Plan)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this kit assignment record was first created in the data system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) GCP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dispensing_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the kit dispensing has been confirmed and acknowledged in the IRT/RTSM system by the site staff. True when confirmed; False when pending confirmation. Supports site monitoring and data quality checks.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: dispensing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the IMP kit was physically dispensed to the subject at the investigational site. Corresponds to the CDISC SDTM EXSTDTC (Exposure Start Date) and is critical for dosing compliance and PK/PD analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: dispensing_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the IMP kit dispensing transaction was recorded in the IRT/RTSM system. Supports ALCOA+ compliance (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP contained in the kit (e.g., Tablet, Capsule, Injection). Aligns with CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSFRM and supports IMP accountability and regulatory submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Tablet|Capsule|Injection|Infusion|Patch|Oral Solution|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSFRM; ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development; FDA NDA/BLA requirements

attributes.name: dose_level
attributes.description: The protocol-defined dose level associated with the kit (e.g., 'Low Dose', 'High Dose', '10mg', '50mg'). Supports dose-response analysis and PK/PD modeling. May differ from treatment arm in dose-escalation or titration studies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSE; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Dose-Response Studies

attributes.name: irt_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system that generated and recorded the kit assignment transaction. Important for multi-system studies and audit trail traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: kit_batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing batch or lot number of the IMP kit. Required for IMP accountability, pharmacovigilance investigations, and regulatory submissions. Enables traceability from subject exposure back to the manufacturing batch.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: kit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the IMP kit as labeled by the manufacturer or packaging facility. Ensures that expired kits are not dispensed to subjects and supports IMP accountability and supply chain management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) kit by the RTSM/IRT system or packaging facility. Used for IMP accountability and reconciliation across the supply chain.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigational medicinal product kit indicating whether it contains active IMP, placebo, comparator drug, rescue medication, or is open-label or blinded. Critical for treatment arm integrity and blinding management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was associated with this kit assignment event (e.g., wrong kit dispensed, kit dispensed outside the protocol visit window, expired kit dispensed). True if a deviation is linked; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; CDISC SDTM DV domain

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: The number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, patches) dispensed to the subject as part of this kit assignment. Used for dosing compliance calculations and IMP accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSE; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: The number of IMP units returned by the subject from this kit assignment. Used to calculate compliance (quantity dispensed minus quantity returned) and for IMP accountability at site level.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject by the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system at the time of randomization. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the randomization event and the kit dispensing record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM RSUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject returned unused IMP units from this kit assignment to the investigational site. Null if no return has occurred or is not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current return status of the IMP kit: whether return is pending, the kit has been returned, the return requirement has been waived, or return is not applicable (e.g., fully consumed). Supports IMP accountability and site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The route by which the IMP in the kit is administered to the subject (e.g., Oral, Intravenous, Subcutaneous). Aligns with CDISC SDTM EX domain EXROUTE and is required for regulatory submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Oral|Intravenous|Subcutaneous|Intramuscular|Topical|Inhaled|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXROUTE; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA NDA/BLA; WHO-DD

attributes.name: stratification_factor_1
attributes.description: The value of the first stratification factor applied at randomization for this subject (e.g., 'Disease Severity: Mild', 'Region: North America'). Captured at the time of kit assignment to preserve the randomization context for statistical analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM STRATCD; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: stratification_factor_2
attributes.description: The value of the second stratification factor applied at randomization for this subject (e.g., 'Prior Treatment: Yes/No', 'Age Group: <65/≥65'). Null if fewer than two stratification factors are defined in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM STRATCD; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The study-assigned subject identifier (e.g., site number + sequential subject number) used to identify the subject in the EDC and RTSM systems. Classified as restricted PII as it can be used to trace back to an individual patient.

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion was reported for this kit prior to or during dispensing. True if a temperature excursion was recorded; False otherwise. Relevant for temperature-sensitive IMPs and IMP accountability.

attributes.name: unblinding_date

attributes.name: unblinding_reason

Governs who can see treatment assignments and under what conditions.

attributes.name: dsmb_unblinded

attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) has access to unblinded treatment data for interim safety reviews. True = DSMB operates with unblinded data.

attributes.name: edc_access_restricted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Access Restricted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave) enforces field-level or form-level access restrictions to prevent blinded users from viewing treatment assignment data in the eCRF.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this blinding configuration becomes binding and operationally enforced for the study, aligned with protocol version effective date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this blinding configuration ceases to be binding. Null indicates the configuration remains in effect indefinitely or until superseded.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: emergency_unblinding_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency unblinding is permitted at the site level for individual subjects in life-threatening situations, as governed by the protocol and IRB/IEC approval.

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data protection requirements apply to the blinding configuration and associated treatment assignment data, relevant for EU-based studies or EU subject data.

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable

attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: interim_analysis_unblinding
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment assignment data is unblinded for interim analysis purposes (e.g., for DSMB/DMC review or adaptive design decisions). True = unblinded interim analysis is planned.

attributes.name: investigator_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) and site staff are blinded to treatment assignment. True = investigator does not know the subject's treatment arm.

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date

attributes.name: irt_system_enforced

attributes.description: Indicates whether blinding access controls are enforced programmatically within the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM). True = system prevents unauthorized access to treatment codes.

attributes.name: kit_label_blinded

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.description: Indicates whether the randomization code (treatment arm identifier) is masked/encrypted in the RTSM and EDC systems for blinded users. True = treatment codes are not visible to blinded roles.

attributes.name: sponsor_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether sponsor personnel are blinded to treatment assignment. True = sponsor staff cannot access unblinded treatment data during the study.
