attributes.name: statistician_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biostatistician is blinded to treatment assignment during analysis. True = statistician works with blinded data until Database Lock (DBL) and unblinding per the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).

products.name: unblinding_request
products.description: Transactional record of a request to unblind a subject's treatment assignment, encompassing the full request-through-resolution lifecycle including multi-level approval steps. Captures requestor identity, requestor role, clinical justification (SAE, medical emergency, regulatory requirement, planned DBL unblinding, interim analysis), urgency level, request timestamp, approval chain (approver identity, role, decision, rationale, conditions, timestamp per approval step), final outcome (approved/rejected/escalated), unblinding timestamp, and the unblinded treatment arm revealed. Covers both emergency single-subject unblinding and planned study-level unblinding events. Critical for GCP compliance, 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail, and DSMB/DMC oversight. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave RTSM.

attributes.name: dsmb_dmc_referral_flag

attributes.name: final_outcome
attributes.description: The definitive resolution of the unblinding request after all approval levels have been completed. attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_timestamp

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_raised

attributes.name: request_number

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol that was in effect at the time of the unblinding approval decision. Required to confirm that the unblinding procedure followed the correct protocol version's unblinding SOP.

attributes.name: response_time_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed time in hours between the submission of the unblinding request and the rendering of this approval decision. Used for KPI monitoring of emergency unblinding response times and SOP compliance.

attributes.name: signature_timestamp

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.description: Date and time when this submission record was first created in the system of record (Veeva Vault). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: ctd_module_scope
attributes.description: Identifies which CTD module(s) are included in this submission (e.g., Module 1 - Administrative, Module 2 - Summaries, Module 3 - Quality, Module 4 - Nonclinical, Module 5 - Clinical). Supports dossier completeness tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: module_1|module_2|module_3|module_4|module_5|all_modules — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; ICH M8 eCTD; FDA CTD Guidance; EMA CTD Guidance

attributes.name: dossier_format
attributes.description: Technical format of the regulatory dossier submitted to the health authority: eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document), NeeS (Non-eCTD Electronic Submission), VNeeS (Veterinary NeeS), or paper. Determines validation and processing requirements.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Technical Specification; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: drug_product_name
attributes.description: The proprietary or non-proprietary name of the investigational drug, biologic, or device that is the subject of this regulatory submission. Provides direct product context for the submission record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; ICH M4 CTD; WHO-DD

attributes.name: ectd_operation
attributes.description: The eCTD lifecycle operation applied to documents in this submission sequence: new (first submission of a document), replace (supersedes a prior version), append (adds to an existing document), or delete (removes a document from the dossier). Governs dossier evolution per ICH M8.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Technical Specification; FDA eCTD Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: filing_fee_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicable regulatory filing fee (e.g., FDA PDUFA application fee, EMA fee) has been paid for this submission. Non-payment can result in refuse-to-file action.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.50; EMA Fee Regulation

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The specific disease, condition, or patient population for which the investigational product is being developed or for which approval is sought in this submission. Aligns with MedDRA preferred term coding.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M4 CTD; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.50; EMA SmPC

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: The WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) for the active substance that is the subject of this submission. Provides standardized global drug identification aligned with WHO-DD.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; WHO-DD; ICH M4 CTD; FDA 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is subject to an expedited review pathway (e.g., FDA Breakthrough Therapy, Priority Review, Accelerated Approval, EMA PRIME scheme). Drives prioritization in regulatory operations workflows.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance; EMA PRIME; ICH E8

attributes.name: is_resubmission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is a resubmission following a prior agency rejection, complete response letter (CRL), or refuse-to-file (RTF) action. Triggers specific regulatory review timelines under PDUFA.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110; FDA PDUFA Resubmission Timelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, internal commentary, or regulatory strategy notes associated with this submission event. Not transmitted to the agency; for internal regulatory operations use only.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions Module; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase associated with this submission (e.g., Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, Phase 4, pre-IND, post-approval). Contextualizes the submission within the drug development lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phase_1|phase_1_2|phase_2|phase_2_3|phase_3|phase_4|pre_IND|post_approval — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: prior_sequence_number
attributes.description: The eCTD sequence number of the immediately preceding submission in the dossier lifecycle that this submission amends, replaces, or responds to. Enables reconstruction of the full dossier evolution chain.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Technical Specification; FDA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Narrative or coded reason for this submission event (e.g., initial IND filing, protocol amendment for safety update, response to FDA information request, annual IND report, post-approval labeling change). Provides business context for the submission trigger.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.31; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_procedure_type
attributes.description: Specific regulatory procedure under which this submission is filed (e.g., standard review, priority review, accelerated approval, breakthrough therapy, orphan drug, centralized procedure, mutual recognition procedure, decentralized procedure). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_review|priority_review|accelerated_approval|breakthrough_therapy|orphan_drug|centralized|mutual_recognition|decentralized|rolling_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; EMA Centralized Procedure; ICH E8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resubmission_class
attributes.description: For FDA resubmissions following a complete response letter (CRL), the classification of the resubmission: Class 1 (2-month review goal) or Class 2 (6-month review goal), based on the nature of the response. Null or not_applicable for non-resubmissions.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110; FDA Guidance on Resubmissions

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Four-digit zero-padded sequence number identifying the specific eCTD submission sequence within a dossier lifecycle (e.g., 0000 for initial submission, 0001 for first amendment). Conforms to ICH M8 eCTD specification.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Technical Specification; FDA eCTD Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: submission_category
attributes.description: High-level regulatory category of the submission indicating the application type: IND (Investigational New Drug), NDA (New Drug Application), BLA (Biologics License Application), MAA (Marketing Authorization Application), CTA (Clinical Trial Authorization), or IND amendment, protocol amendment, safety report, etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IND|NDA|BLA|MAA|CTA|IND_amendment|protocol_amendment|safety_report|annual_report|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 312, 314, 601; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the submission was transmitted or delivered to the target health authority. This is the principal real-world event date for regulatory timeline calculations and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); PDUFA

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The technical method by which the submission was delivered to the health authority (e.g., electronic gateway such as FDA ESG or EMA eSubmission Gateway, physical media, agency portal, email, or paper). Relevant for audit trail and compliance with agency technical requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway; EMA eSubmission Gateway; ICH M8

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for this submission as assigned by the health authority or internal tracking system (e.g., IND number, NDA number, sequence number within an eCTD dossier). Used for cross-referencing with agency correspondence.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Specification; ICH M8

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the submission: draft (being prepared), pending (awaiting dispatch), submitted (sent to agency), validated (passed technical validation), accepted (agency acknowledged receipt), rejected (agency refused), or withdrawn (sponsor retracted). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending|submitted|validated|accepted|rejected|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions; FDA eCTD Validation Criteria; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the submission was electronically transmitted to the health authority gateway. Used for exact regulatory deadline compliance and audit trail purposes per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EMA eSubmission Gateway; ICH M8

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Classification of the submission event in the dossier lifecycle: original (first submission), amendment (change to an approved application), supplement (post-approval change), response (reply to agency query or complete response letter), or withdrawal (retraction of a prior submission).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: target_action_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which the health authority is expected to take action on the submission (e.g., PDUFA goal date for FDA NDA/BLA reviews, EMA opinion deadline). Critical for regulatory milestone tracking and resource planning.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; EMA Procedural Timelines; ICH M4

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The clinical or disease area that the investigational product targets (e.g., oncology, cardiology, neurology, infectious disease, rare disease). Used for portfolio analytics and regulatory strategy segmentation.
attributes.references: MedDRA SOC Classification; ICH E8; FDA CDER/CBER Division

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this submission record was most recently modified in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Technical validation outcome of the eCTD dossier package against agency-published validation criteria (e.g., FDA eCTD Validation Criteria, EMA eCTD Specification). Indicates whether the submission passed automated technical checks prior to or upon agency receipt.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Validation Criteria; EMA eCTD Specification; ICH M8

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault (eTMF/Regulatory Submissions module) to the submission package or primary dossier document. Enables direct traceability to the source system of record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions Module; 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: application
products.description: Master record for regulatory applications (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, CTA, IMPD) filed with health authorities. Tracks application number, application type and subtype, therapeutic area, indication, sponsor reference, lead agency, application status (active, approved, withdrawn, refused), initial filing date, approval date, lifecycle phase, and type-specific attributes including IND number/type/annual report dates for investigational applications and PDUFA goal date/priority review/breakthrough therapy/orphan drug designations for marketing applications. Parent entity for all submissions, correspondence, approvals, and commitments under a given regulatory dossier. SSOT for the complete regulatory application lifecycle.
products.reference: IND/NDA/BLA/MAA/CTA Application (21 CFR Part 312/314, EU CTR 536/2014)

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the regulatory application record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for all downstream joins to submissions, correspondence, approvals, and commitments under this dossier.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: accelerated_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application is approved or being reviewed under the FDA Accelerated Approval pathway, based on a surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoint reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit. Requires post-approval confirmatory trials.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H; 21 CFR Part 601 Subpart E; FDA Accelerated Approval guidance

attributes.name: agency_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the health authority jurisdiction (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, CAN, AUS). Supports multi-regional dossier tracking and jurisdiction-specific compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH M4 CTD; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: agency_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the health authority officially acknowledged receipt of the application. May differ from initial_filing_date if the agency issues a receipt acknowledgment letter after a validation check.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA Acknowledgment Letter guidance; EMA validation procedures under EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: annual_report_last_submitted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: IND Annual Report Last Submitted Date
attributes.description: Date the most recent IND Annual Report was submitted to FDA. Used to calculate the next due date and to confirm compliance with 21 CFR 312.33 annual reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.33 (IND Annual Report); FDA IND Annual Report guidance

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned application number issued by the health authority (e.g., IND 123456, NDA 210001, BLA 761234, EMA/H/C/004321, CTA-2024-001). This is the official dossier identifier used in all agency correspondence and is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23 (IND); 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory application. 'active' = application is open and under review or in use; 'approved' = marketing authorization or IND in good standing with approval; 'withdrawn' = sponsor voluntarily withdrew; 'refused' = agency issued a refuse-to-file or complete response letter with no resubmission; 'on_clinical_hold' = FDA-issued clinical hold per 21 CFR 312.42; 'inactive' = IND placed in inactive status.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42 (clinical hold); 21 CFR Part 314.110 (complete response); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 14; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory application by submission type. IND = Investigational New Drug; NDA = New Drug Application; BLA = Biologics License Application; MAA = Marketing Authorization Application; CTA = Clinical Trial Authorization; IMPD = Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); EU CTR 536/2014 (CTA/IMPD); ICH M4 CTD (MAA)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health authority granted marketing authorization or IND approval. Null for applications that have not yet been approved. Critical milestone for commercial launch planning and post-approval commitment tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.105 (NDA approval); 21 CFR Part 601.4 (BLA approval); EMA Decision date; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy
attributes.description: Indicates whether FDA has granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) for this application, enabling intensive FDA guidance and rolling review. Granted when preliminary clinical evidence shows substantial improvement over available therapy for serious conditions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.300; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation guidance; FDASIA Section 902

attributes.name: clinical_hold_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FDA issued the clinical hold order for this application. Null if no clinical hold has been imposed. Used to track hold duration and response timelines.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold guidance

attributes.name: clinical_hold_status
attributes.description: Current clinical hold status issued by FDA under 21 CFR 312.42. 'none' = no hold; 'partial' = hold on specific studies or patient populations; 'full' = all clinical investigations halted; 'lifted' = hold previously issued but now removed.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42 (Clinical Hold); FDA Clinical Hold guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory application record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: ctd_module
attributes.description: Indicates which CTD modules are included in this application. M1=Regional Administrative; M2=Summaries; M3=Quality; M4=Nonclinical; M5=Clinical. 'full' indicates all modules are present. Supports dossier completeness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; ICH M8 eCTD; FDA CTD guidance; EMA CTD guidance

attributes.name: dossier_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code of the primary language in which the regulatory dossier is submitted (e.g., ENG for English, JPN for Japanese, DEU for German). Relevant for multi-regional submissions requiring translation.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; EMA language requirements; PMDA submission guidelines; ISO 639-2

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the application became legally effective and binding. For INDs, this is 30 days after FDA receipt unless a clinical hold is issued. For approved applications, this is the date the approval letter takes effect.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40 (IND 30-day rule); 21 CFR Part 314.105; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 8

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the application or authorization expires, if applicable. Relevant for CTAs with fixed authorization periods and some national approvals. Null for open-ended authorizations such as US NDA/BLA approvals.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 14; ICH E6(R2); Health Canada CTA regulations

attributes.name: fast_track_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether FDA has granted Fast Track Designation for this application, facilitating development and expediting review of drugs to treat serious conditions and fill unmet medical needs. Enables rolling review and more frequent FDA interactions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.300; FDA Fast Track guidance; FDAMA Section 112

attributes.name: ind_annual_report_due_date
attributes.description: Next due date for the IND Annual Report submission to FDA, calculated as 60 days before the anniversary of the IND effective date. Tracks compliance with mandatory annual reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.33 (IND Annual Report); FDA IND Annual Report guidance

attributes.name: ind_number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned IND serial number for investigational applications (e.g., IND 123456). Populated only for IND-type applications. Used in all FDA correspondence, annual reports, and safety reporting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA IND numbering system

attributes.name: ind_type
attributes.description: Subclassification of the IND by purpose. Commercial IND is sponsor-held for drug development; Research IND is investigator-initiated; Treatment IND allows expanded access; Emergency IND is for single-patient emergency use.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.310 (Treatment IND); 21 CFR Part 312.310(d) (Emergency IND); FDA IND guidance

attributes.name: initial_filing_date
attributes.description: Date the application was first submitted to the health authority. For INDs, this is the date the IND package was received by FDA. For NDAs/BLAs, this is the date of original submission. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23 (IND receipt); 21 CFR Part 314.101 (NDA filing); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 5

attributes.name: lead_agency
attributes.description: Primary regulatory health authority to which this application is filed. Determines the regulatory pathway, submission format, and review timelines applicable to this dossier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|Health Canada|TGA|ANVISA|NMPA|Other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 312/314/601; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD; PMDA Pharmaceutical Affairs Law (Japan); MHRA UK Regulations

attributes.name: lifecycle_phase
attributes.description: Current development phase associated with this regulatory application. Tracks the application from pre-IND through post-approval lifecycle. Supports portfolio planning and regulatory strategy alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_ind|phase_1|phase_2|phase_3|nda_bla_maa|post_approval|discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E8 General Considerations for Clinical Studies; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA PDUFA VI Commitment Letter

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional regulatory context, strategic notes, or agency-specific instructions not captured in structured fields. Used by regulatory affairs teams for internal documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault RIM notes field

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA Office of Orphan Products Development (OOPD) or EMA Committee for Orphan Medicinal Products (COMP) has granted Orphan Drug Designation for this application. Confers 7-year market exclusivity (FDA) or 10-year (EMA) and fee waivers.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316 (Orphan Drug); Orphan Drug Act; EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

attributes.name: pdufa_goal_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) Goal Date
attributes.description: FDA-assigned PDUFA action date by which the agency commits to completing its review of an NDA or BLA. Applicable only to marketing applications under PDUFA. Drives internal milestone planning and commercial readiness timelines.
attributes.references: PDUFA VI Commitment Letter; 21 CFR Part 314.101; FDA PDUFA performance goals

attributes.name: priority_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Priority Review designation to this NDA or BLA, reducing the standard review clock from 12 months to 6 months. Applicable to drugs offering major advances in treatment or providing treatment where no adequate therapy exists.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.510; FDA Priority Review guidance; PDUFA VI

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Name of the drug, biologic, or device covered by this application. May be the INN (International Nonproprietary Name), proprietary brand name, or code name at the investigational stage.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(3); ICH M4Q CTD Quality Module

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigational or approved product by modality. Determines the applicable regulatory pathway, CMC requirements, and review division assignment at the agency.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 (drugs/biologics); 21 CFR Part 820 (devices); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q6A/Q6B

attributes.name: rolling_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health authority has granted rolling review, allowing submission and review of completed sections of the dossier before the full application is submitted. Applicable under FDA Fast Track and EMA PRIME/rolling review procedures.
attributes.references: FDA Fast Track Rolling Review guidance; EMA Rolling Review procedure; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor's designated regulatory contact as listed on the application cover sheet (e.g., FDA Form 1571 for INDs). This individual is the official point of contact for agency communications.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(1); FDA Form 1571; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1

attributes.name: submission_format
attributes.description: Technical format used for dossier submission to the health authority. eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document) is the standard for FDA, EMA, PMDA; NeeS (Non-eCTD Electronic Submission) is a transitional format; paper submissions are legacy.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD guidance; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Further classification within the application type. Examples for IND: Commercial, Research, Treatment, Emergency; for NDA: 505(b)(1) Full, 505(b)(2), 505(j) ANDA; for BLA: Original, Supplement, Efficacy Supplement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Commercial|Research|Treatment|Emergency|505(b)(1)|505(b)(2)|505(j)|Original|Supplement|Efficacy Supplement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.310 (Treatment IND); 21 CFR Part 314.50 (NDA subtypes); FDA PDUFA guidance

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Broad disease or medical specialty area covered by the application (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease, Immunology). Used for portfolio segmentation, resource allocation, and regulatory strategy reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MedDRA SOC classification; FDA CDER/CBER therapeutic area taxonomy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory application record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: veeva_vault_dossier_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this application record to the corresponding eTMF/regulatory dossier in Veeva Vault (the system of record for regulatory submissions and document management). Enables traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

products.name: health_authority
products.description: Reference master for global health authority organizations (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada, TGA, ANVISA, NMPA, etc.). Stores agency code, full name, country/region, regulatory framework, submission portal URL, eCTD gateway identifier, contact division, applicable regulatory procedures, and fee schedules. Used as a foreign key lookup across all submission, application, correspondence, and authorization records in the regulatory domain.
products.reference: Health Authority Registry (ICH, WHO ICTRP)

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the health authority record in the regulatory reference master. Primary key for all downstream FK references across submission, application, correspondence, and authorization records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: acronym
attributes.description: Widely recognized abbreviation for the health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, HC). Used in reporting dashboards, regulatory tracking systems, and internal communications.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD; WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: agency_code
attributes.description: Short, standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, HC, TGA, ANVISA, NMPA). Used as a business key in regulatory workflows, submission routing, and eCTD gateway configuration.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD; FDA ESG; EMA eSubmission Gateway

attributes.name: agency_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the health authority record. Active indicates the agency is currently accepting submissions; inactive indicates it is no longer operational; merged indicates it has been absorbed into another agency; superseded indicates it has been replaced by a successor body.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: annual_safety_report_type
attributes.description: Type of periodic safety report required by this health authority for ongoing clinical trials (e.g., DSUR - Development Safety Update Report per ICH E2F for EMA/MHRA, IND Annual Report per 21 CFR 312.33 for FDA, PBRER for post-marketing). Drives safety reporting schedule configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E2F (DSUR); 21 CFR Part 312.33 (IND Annual Report); ICH E2C(R2) (PBRER)

attributes.name: authority_type
attributes.description: Classification of the health authority by its jurisdictional scope: national (single country, e.g., FDA, PMDA), supranational (multi-country, e.g., EMA), regional (sub-national or regional body), or reference_agency (recognized reference authority used by other agencies for reliance procedures).
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: clinical_trial_registry_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health authority requires mandatory registration of clinical trials in a public registry (e.g., ClinicalTrials.gov for FDA, EU Clinical Trials Register for EMA, JAPIC for PMDA) as a condition of authorization or publication. Drives trial registration workflow in CTMS.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ICMJE; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014 Art. 81; FDAAA 801

attributes.name: contact_division_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory division or office within the health authority responsible for receiving submissions and correspondence for the sponsor's therapeutic area (e.g., FDA CDER Office of New Drugs, EMA Human Medicines Division, PMDA New Drug Division). Used to address regulatory correspondence and meeting requests.
attributes.references: FDA CDER; EMA Human Medicines; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Official email address for regulatory correspondence with the health authority's primary contact division. Used for submission cover letter addressing, meeting request submissions, and regulatory query responses.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Official telephone number for the health authority's primary regulatory contact division. Used for urgent regulatory communications, inspection notifications, and meeting coordination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction in which the health authority operates (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, BRA, CHN). Drives country-level regulatory strategy and submission planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ICH M8 eCTD

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this health authority record was first created in the regulatory reference master. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles for regulatory data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctd_format_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health authority mandates submission of dossiers in the ICH Common Technical Document (CTD) format. True for ICH member agencies (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada); may be false for non-ICH jurisdictions with proprietary submission formats.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; ICH M8 eCTD

attributes.name: data_privacy_framework

attributes.name: ectd_gateway_code

attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the health authority's eCTD submission gateway endpoint (e.g., FDA ESG sender ID, EMA DUNS number for eSubmission). Required for configuring automated eCTD transmission via Veeva Vault and validating submission acknowledgement receipts.

attributes.name: ectd_specification_version

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Authority Record Effective From Date

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: electronic_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health authority mandates electronic submission (eCTD or equivalent) for regulatory applications. True for FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA; may be false for agencies still accepting paper or hybrid submissions. Governs Veeva Vault submission package configuration.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_effective_date

attributes.name: full_name

attributes.name: gcp_guideline_version

attributes.name: ich_member

attributes.name: ind_application_type

attributes.name: ind_review_clock_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational New Drug (IND) / Clinical Trial Authorization (CTA) Review Clock (Days)
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the health authority has to review and respond to a clinical trial authorization application before the sponsor may proceed (e.g., 30 days for FDA IND, 30 days for EMA CTA under EU CTR). Critical for study start-up timeline planning.

attributes.name: ind_submission_fee_amount

May be zero for agencies that do not charge IND/CTA fees (e.g., FDA does not charge IND fees). Used for regulatory budget planning.

attributes.name: inspection_authority

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014 Art. 78; MHRA GCP Inspection

attributes.name: local_language_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health authority requires submission documents (or portions thereof) to be translated into the local national language in addition to English. True for agencies such as PMDA (Japanese), NMPA (Chinese), ANVISA (Portuguese). Drives translation cost and timeline planning.

attributes.name: mailing_address

attributes.name: mutual_recognition_agreements

attributes.name: nda_application_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Drug Application (NDA) / Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) Type
attributes.description: Local equivalent marketing authorization application type for this health authority (e.g., NDA/BLA for FDA, MAA for EMA, J-NDA for PMDA, ANDS for Health Canada). Used to configure submission workflows, fee schedules, and review clock tracking in Veeva Vault. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NDA|BLA|MAA|J-NDA|ANDS|ARTG — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: nda_submission_fee_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Drug Application (NDA) / Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) Submission Fee Amount
attributes.description: Standard regulatory submission fee amount charged by this health authority for a full marketing authorization application (NDA/BLA/MAA) in the currency specified by submission_fee_currency. Used for regulatory budget planning and SAP S/4HANA accounts payable. Updated annually per agency fee schedules.

attributes.name: non_fatal_sadr_reporting_clock_hours

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: paper_submission_accepted

attributes.name: priority_review_clock_days

attributes.name: agency_response_date

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment per regulatory definitions: substantial (requires prior regulatory/ethics approval), non-substantial (notification only), administrative (clerical corrections), or urgent_safety (immediate safety measure). attributes.name: amendment_version
attributes.description: Version label of the amended protocol document (e.g., v2.0, v3.1) as tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory binder. Distinct from amendment number — version reflects the resulting protocol document version after the amendment is applied.

attributes.name: change_summary
attributes.description: Concise narrative summary of all changes introduced by this amendment, including additions, deletions, and modifications to protocol text. Included in the amendment cover letter submitted to health authorities and IRB/IEC.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: ethics_approval_date

attributes.name: ethics_submission_date

attributes.name: global_submission_flag

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was operationally implemented at clinical sites, including updated procedures, training, and revised eCRF forms in Medidata Rave. Must be on or after all required regulatory and ethics approvals.

attributes.name: planned_implementation_date

attributes.name: prior_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires prior approval from the health authority before implementation (true for substantial amendments) versus notification-only (false for non-substantial/administrative amendments).
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: reconsent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrolled subjects must provide updated informed consent (ICF re-consent) as a result of this amendment. Triggers ICF version update workflow in Clinpal and site notification via Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance; GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: review_deadline_date
attributes.description: Calculated or mandated deadline by which the health authority must respond to the amendment submission per applicable regulations (e.g., 30-day FDA IND amendment review window, EMA assessment timeline). Used for escalation and follow-up tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.30(b); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; EMA Procedural Guidance

attributes.name: safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol amendment has a direct impact on subject safety, risk-benefit profile, or safety monitoring procedures. Triggers expedited regulatory review and DSMB/DMC notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: site_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which clinical sites were formally notified of the approved protocol amendment and required to begin implementation, including updated training and revised procedures. Tracked in Oracle Siebel CTMS.

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_name

attributes.name: subject_impact_flag

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.description: Version identifier of the meeting briefing document submitted to the health authority, as tracked in Veeva Vault document management. Enables traceability of the exact document version reviewed by the agency.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: confirmed_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date confirmed by the health authority for the meeting to take place. This is the operationally binding date used for scheduling, briefing document preparation, and attendee coordination.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: confirmed_meeting_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone) confirmed by the health authority for the meeting, used for scheduling teleconferences and videoconferences across global time zones.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this agency meeting record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage purposes per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: etmf_section_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Section Reference
attributes.description: The eTMF section or zone reference where the agency meeting documents (request, briefing document, minutes) are filed, per the DIA Reference Model for the TMF. Ensures regulatory inspection readiness and document traceability.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: follow_up_submission_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the sponsor must submit any follow-up regulatory documents or responses to the health authority as agreed during or after the meeting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: follow_up_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency meeting outcome requires a follow-up regulatory submission (e.g., protocol amendment, IND amendment, additional data package) as a result of agency feedback or commitments made during the meeting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required documentation for this agency meeting (request, briefing document, minutes, action items) is complete and filed in the eTMF, making the record inspection-ready for FDA, EMA, or other health authority audits.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: meeting_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The planned or actual duration of the agency meeting in minutes, as agreed with the health authority. Typically 60–90 minutes for FDA Type B meetings.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: meeting_format
attributes.description: The format in which the agency meeting is conducted. Face-to-Face = in-person at agency or sponsor site; Teleconference = audio-only call; Videoconference = video-enabled remote meeting; Written Response Only = agency responds in writing without a live meeting.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally generated unique reference number for the meeting request, as tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module and referenced in agency correspondence (e.g., FDA meeting request number).
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; 21 CFR Part 312.47

attributes.name: meeting_objectives
attributes.description: Free-text description of the primary scientific, regulatory, or strategic objectives for the agency meeting, as stated in the meeting request. Captures the key questions and discussion topics the sponsor seeks to resolve.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: meeting_stage
attributes.description: The clinical development stage at which the agency meeting is requested, indicating the regulatory milestone context (e.g., Pre-IND, End-of-Phase 2, Pre-NDA/BLA submission). Aligns with FDA Type B meeting sub-categories.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.47; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agency meeting. Planned = internally identified need; Requested = formal meeting request submitted to agency; Granted = agency has agreed to hold the meeting; Scheduled = date and format confirmed; Completed = meeting has occurred; Cancelled = meeting cancelled by either party; Denied = agency declined the meeting request; On Hold = meeting paused pending additional information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Planned|Requested|Granted|Scheduled|Completed|Cancelled|Denied|On Hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products (2017)

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting per agency-defined categories. FDA meetings are classified as Type A (urgent/critical), Type B (pre-IND, end-of-Phase 2, pre-NDA/BLA), or Type C (other). EMA meetings are classified as Scientific Advice. PMDA meetings as Consultation. Written Response Only indicates no face-to-face or teleconference meeting is held.
attributes.value_regex: Type A|Type B|Type C|Scientific Advice|Consultation|Written Response Only
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: minutes_draft_date
attributes.description: The date on which the draft meeting minutes were prepared by the sponsor following the agency meeting. FDA requires sponsors to submit draft minutes within 30 days of the meeting.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); 21 CFR Part 312.47

attributes.name: minutes_finalized_date
attributes.description: The date on which the meeting minutes were finalized and agreed upon by both the sponsor and the health authority. Finalized minutes represent the official record of agency agreements and commitments.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); 21 CFR Part 312.47; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: minutes_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor submitted the draft meeting minutes to the health authority for review and comment.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); 21 CFR Part 312.47

attributes.name: nda_bla_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Drug Application (NDA) / Biologics License Application (BLA) Number
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned NDA or BLA application number if the meeting is related to a marketing application. Applicable for pre-NDA/BLA, post-approval, or labeling meetings.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); FDA Regulations

attributes.name: open_action_items_count
attributes.description: Number of action items from the agency meeting that remain open or unresolved. Used for regulatory follow-up tracking and inspection readiness monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: outcome_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the overall outcome of the agency meeting with respect to the sponsor's objectives. Agreement Reached = agency aligned with sponsor's proposed approach; Partial Agreement = some questions resolved; No Agreement = agency did not concur; Pending Agency Response = written response awaited; Information Only = meeting was informational with no formal positions taken.
attributes.value_regex: Agreement Reached|Partial Agreement|No Agreement|Pending Agency Response|Information Only
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: pdufa_response_deadline
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which the FDA must respond to the meeting request under Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) commitments. Type A: 30 days; Type B: 70 days; Type C: 90 days from receipt of meeting request.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The name of the investigational medicinal product or biological entity that is the subject of the agency meeting. May be a proprietary name, INN (International Nonproprietary Name), or internal code name. Classified as confidential due to competitive sensitivity.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; FDA IND/NDA/BLA Regulations; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: proposed_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date proposed by the sponsor in the meeting request for when the meeting should occur. May differ from the agency-confirmed date.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: questions_submitted_count
attributes.description: The number of formal questions submitted to the health authority in the meeting request or briefing document. Used to track scope and complexity of the meeting agenda.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal meeting request was submitted to the health authority. This is the principal business event timestamp that initiates the regulatory clock for agency response timelines under PDUFA commitments.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; 21 CFR Part 312.47; EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease indication relevant to the meeting (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for regulatory strategy analytics and agency workload tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this agency meeting record was last modified, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF/regulatory submissions module for the meeting request package, briefing document, or meeting minutes. Enables direct traceability to the source document management system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: ctd_dossier

Also manages individual content units (documents, datasets, study reports) with CTD section references (e.g., Module 2.7.3, Module 5.3.5.1), document metadata, file format, lifecycle operations, and Veeva Vault document IDs. Serves as the structural backbone for all submission content and enables dossier gap analysis.

attributes.name: dossier_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CTD dossier (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented with each major revision or amendment cycle.

attributes.name: drug_name

attributes.name: dtd_version

attributes.name: last_compiled_date

attributes.name: open_gap_count

attributes.name: overall_completeness_status

attributes.name: planned_submission_date

attributes.name: dosage_form

attributes.name: drug_name

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: inn_code

attributes.name: irb_iec_reference

attributes.name: is_conditional_approval

attributes.name: is_renewal_required

attributes.name: letter_date

attributes.name: letter_reference

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: mah_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) as registered with the health authority. May differ from the sponsor name if the MAH is a subsidiary, licensee, or partner organization. Applicable primarily to NDA/BLA/MAA approvals.
attributes.references: EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.72; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory context, internal commentary, or supplementary information about this approval that does not fit into structured fields. Used by regulatory affairs teams for operational notes.

attributes.name: post_marketing_commitments

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the sponsor must submit a renewal application or annual report to maintain the validity of this approval. Null if renewal is not required. Critical for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: review_pathway

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of IND amendments (protocol amendments, information amendments, safety reports) submitted to the FDA under this IND. Tracks the volume of regulatory activity and dossier complexity.

attributes.name: application_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this application is filed (e.g., USA for FDA, GBR for MHRA, JPN for PMDA). Enables multi-country regulatory portfolio analytics.

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Breakthrough Therapy designation for the investigational product under this IND. Breakthrough Therapy designation provides intensive FDA guidance and rolling review for drugs showing substantial improvement over existing therapies.

attributes.name: clinical_hold_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA issued a clinical hold order on this IND, halting enrollment or dosing of subjects. Nullable for INDs not on clinical hold. Triggers mandatory sponsor response within 30 days.

attributes.name: clinical_hold_lifted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA lifted the clinical hold and authorized resumption of clinical trials under this IND. Nullable for INDs that have never been on clinical hold or where the hold remains active.

attributes.name: clinical_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the FDA's stated reason for imposing a clinical hold on this IND. Captures the safety concern, protocol deficiency, or regulatory non-compliance issue cited by the agency. Nullable for INDs not on clinical hold.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this IND application record was first created in the lakehouse data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for audit trail and data lineage purposes. Conforms to 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form of the investigational product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, infusion, patch). Captured from the IND CMC section and used for supply chain and regulatory tracking.

attributes.name: drug_substance_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or chemical name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) covered under this IND. Used for regulatory cross-referencing and WHO-DD coding.

attributes.name: ectd_submission_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Submission Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IND application is submitted in eCTD format via the FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway. True indicates eCTD format; False indicates paper or non-eCTD electronic submission. FDA mandates eCTD for most IND submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA eCTD Guidance; ICH M8

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IND became effective and clinical trials were authorized to commence. Under 21 CFR Part 312.40, an IND becomes effective 30 days after FDA receipt unless FDA places a clinical hold. This is the EFFECTIVE_FROM date for the IND agreement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: equivalent_application_number
attributes.description: The application number assigned by a non-FDA regulatory agency for an equivalent authorization (e.g., EMA CTA number, MHRA CTA reference, PMDA CTN). Used to cross-reference the IND with parallel international submissions.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA CTA Regulations; PMDA Regulations

attributes.name: fast_track_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Fast Track designation for the investigational product under this IND. Fast Track facilitates development and expedites review of drugs treating serious conditions with unmet medical need.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.82; FDA Fast Track Guidance; FDAMA Section 112

attributes.name: fda_application_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA officially acknowledged receipt of the IND application. Starts the 30-day review clock per 21 CFR Part 312.40. May differ from the initial submission date if there were transmission delays.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: fda_division
attributes.description: The FDA Center and Division responsible for reviewing this IND application (e.g., CDER/Division of Oncology Products 1, CBER/Division of Vaccines). Determines the regulatory review team and applicable FDA guidance documents.
attributes.references: FDA CDER/CBER Organizational Structure; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IND was placed into inactive status, either by sponsor notification or FDA action. Nullable for active INDs. Represents the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL boundary for the active IND period.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.45; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: ind_number
attributes.description: Official IND number assigned by the FDA upon receipt of the IND application. This is the externally-known regulatory identifier used in all agency correspondence, safety reports, and annual reports. Format is a numeric string up to 6 digits as assigned by FDA.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: ind_serial_number_latest
attributes.description: The most recent serial number assigned to the latest IND submission sequence (original or amendment). IND submissions are numbered sequentially starting from 0000. Used to track the current version of the IND dossier in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA IND Submission Numbering

attributes.name: ind_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IND application by its intended purpose. Commercial INDs are filed by pharmaceutical/biotech sponsors for drug development. attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.20; 21 CFR Part 312.310; 21 CFR Part 312.315

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The specific disease, condition, or patient population for which the investigational product is being studied under this IND. Aligns with the MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) for the target indication.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(3); MedDRA PT; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: initial_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original IND application was first submitted to the FDA. This is the principal business event date for the IND lifecycle and triggers the 30-day FDA review clock per 21 CFR Part 312.40.

attributes.name: investigational_product_code

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: The name of the investigational drug, biologic, or compound covered under this IND application. May be a code name, generic name, or proprietary name as designated by the sponsor. Corresponds to the investigational product tracked in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One.

attributes.name: last_annual_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last IND Annual Report Submission Date

attributes.name: nda_bla_number

attributes.description: The NDA or BLA application number to which this IND is expected to transition upon successful completion of clinical development. Nullable for early-phase INDs where the downstream marketing application has not yet been filed.

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation

attributes.name: phase

attributes.name: planned_date

attributes.name: priority_designation
attributes.description: Special regulatory designation granted by the agency that may affect review timelines and milestone dates (e.g., FDA Priority Review, Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, Accelerated Approval, Orphan Drug). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|priority_review|breakthrough|fast_track|accelerated_approval|orphan|prime|conditional_approval|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.82; EMA PRIME; EMA Conditional Marketing Authorization

attributes.name: probability_of_success_pct

attributes.name: regulatory_strategy_notes
attributes.description: Confidential free-text field capturing regulatory strategy considerations, agency meeting outcomes, or scenario planning assumptions relevant to this milestone. Classified as confidential due to commercially sensitive strategic content.

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Type of agency review cycle applicable to this milestone, which determines the review clock duration: standard (12-month FDA standard review), priority (6-month FDA priority review), rolling (rolling review during development), accelerated (EMA accelerated assessment).

attributes.name: revised_planned_date

attributes.name: scenario_label
attributes.description: Label identifying the planning scenario under which this milestone date was projected, supporting regulatory timeline scenario planning and what-if analysis: base_case (most likely), optimistic (best case), pessimistic (worst case), risk_adjusted (probability-weighted).
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Project Management; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this milestone record was sourced or last updated (e.g., Veeva_Vault for eTMF/regulatory submissions, Siebel_CTMS for project plan milestones, Manual for direct data entry).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: data_lock_date
attributes.description: The date on which the safety database was locked for the purpose of generating this periodic safety report. No new safety data is included after this date. Equivalent to the reporting period end date for periodic reports.

attributes.name: dibd
attributes.description: Development International Birth Date (DIBD) — the date of the first authorization to conduct a clinical trial with the investigational product in any country. Used as the anchor date for calculating DSUR submission deadlines (due 60 days after DIBD anniversary).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the safety report must be submitted to the health authority. For expedited SUSAR/IND safety reports this is typically 7 or 15 calendar days from initial awareness; for DSURs it is 60 days from the Development International Birth Date (DIBD).

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) number assigned to the clinical trial, used for EMA and EU member state safety report submissions. Format: YYYY-NNNNNN-CC.

attributes.name: expedited_report_timeline_days
attributes.description: Regulatory reporting timeline in calendar days applicable to this expedited submission (typically 7 days for fatal/life-threatening unexpected SARs or 15 days for other unexpected serious adverse reactions). Null for periodic reports.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, ICH E2A, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: Name of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or drug substance that is the subject of this safety report. Aligns with the IND/CTA product designation.

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety report is an expedited submission (True) subject to 7-day or 15-day reporting timelines, as opposed to a periodic report. Expedited reports include SUSARs and IND safety reports for unexpected serious adverse reactions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, ICH E2A, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: is_follow_up
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is a follow-up (True) to a previously submitted safety report for the same event or reporting period, as opposed to an initial/original submission (False). Follow-up submissions provide updated or additional information.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2B(R3), 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: listedness_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the adverse reaction is listed (expected) or unlisted (unexpected) in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI). Unlisted/unexpected reactions meeting seriousness criteria trigger SUSAR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VI, 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.description: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) code for the primary adverse reaction or event described in this safety report. Standardizes event terminology for regulatory submissions and signal detection.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities), ICH E2B(R3), EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.description: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) code associated with the primary adverse reaction in this safety report. Used for aggregate safety analysis and tabulation in periodic reports.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities), ICH E2B(R3), CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: regulatory_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the regulatory action required or taken as a result of this safety report submission (e.g., IB update, protocol amendment, clinical hold notification, Dear Investigator Letter). Populated when regulatory_action_required is True.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: regulatory_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety report submission has triggered or requires a regulatory action such as a protocol amendment, IB update, informed consent revision, or clinical hold. Supports inspection readiness and CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VII, ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety report being submitted. IND_SAFETY_REPORT = expedited IND safety report (15-day/7-day); DSUR = Development Safety Update Report; PSUR_PBRER = Periodic Safety Update Report / Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report; SUSAR = Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction; IND_ANNUAL_REPORT = annual IND progress report; CIOMS = Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences line listing.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VII, EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the safety report document (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 1.1 for amendments). Tracks original submissions versus follow-up or amended versions submitted to the same agency.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), EMA GVP Module VII, 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the data collection period covered by this safety report, also known as the data lock point (DLP). Defines the cut-off date for safety data included in the report.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the data collection period covered by this safety report (e.g., the beginning of the DSUR or PSUR/PBRER data lock window). Applicable to periodic reports; may be null for expedited reports.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: seriousness_criteria
attributes.description: ICH E2A seriousness criterion that triggered the expedited reporting obligation for this submission. Applicable to SUSAR and IND safety reports. FATAL = resulted in death; LIFE_THREATENING = immediately life-threatening; HOSPITALIZATION = required or prolonged inpatient hospitalization; DISABILITY = persistent or significant disability/incapacity; CONGENITAL_ANOMALY = congenital anomaly/birth defect; MEDICALLY_SIGNIFICANT = other medically important condition.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2D, 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: submission_country_code

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_status

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required

attributes.name: member_state_code

attributes.name: modification_scope

attributes.name: national_portal_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier assigned by the national regulatory portal (e.g., MHRA IRAS number, BfArM reference, ANSM reference, Health Canada CTD number) for this CTA. Complements the CTIS trial ID for country-specific tracking.
attributes.references: MHRA; BfArM; ANSM; Health Canada; TGA; PMDA

attributes.name: planned_subject_count
attributes.description: Number of trial subjects planned to be enrolled in the member state under this Clinical Trial Authorization, as declared in the approved protocol. Used for site capacity planning and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework under which this Clinical Trial Authorization was granted (e.g., EU CTR 536/2014, national regulation, ISO 14155 for medical devices). Determines applicable procedural and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Trial Authorization application was formally submitted to the national competent authority. Used to calculate regulatory review timelines and track compliance with submission deadlines.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 5; EMA CTIS; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: substantial_modification_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for substantial modifications to the original CTA, as assigned by the sponsor or NCA. Populated only for authorization_type = substantial_modification. Enables tracking of the amendment history chain.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Articles 15-19; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Trial Authorization was suspended by the national competent authority or voluntarily by the sponsor. Null if the CTA has never been suspended. Triggers safety and compliance escalation workflows.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 77; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative reason for the suspension of the Clinical Trial Authorization, as communicated by the national competent authority or sponsor. Populated only when suspension_date is not null.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 77; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area or disease indication covered by the clinical trial authorized under this CTA (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for portfolio analytics and regulatory reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: EMA; ICH E8; MedDRA; WHO-DD

attributes.name: trial_phase
attributes.description: Regulatory phase of the clinical trial covered by this authorization (Phase I through Phase IV), as defined by ICH E8 and applicable NCA guidelines. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, safety reporting thresholds, and monitoring intensity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase IIa|Phase IIb|Phase III|Phase III/IV|Phase IV — promote to reference product]
attributes.value_regex: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase IIa|Phase IIb|Phase III
attributes.references: ICH E8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this Clinical Trial Authorization record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the national competent authority confirmed the CTA application was formally valid and complete for review. Marks the start of the regulatory assessment clock under EU CTR 536/2014.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 6; EMA CTIS Guidance

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault (eTMF/regulatory submissions module) for the CTA authorization letter or dossier. Enables direct linkage from this master record to the source regulatory document in the eTMF system of record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; EU CTR 536/2014; TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Trial Authorization was formally withdrawn, either by the sponsor or by the national competent authority. Null if the CTA has not been withdrawn.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Narrative reason for the withdrawal of the Clinical Trial Authorization. Populated only when withdrawal_date is not null. Required for regulatory reporting and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); EMA

Supports long-range regulatory planning.

attributes.name: agency_interaction_plan

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Management; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) has been requested or granted for this program, enabling intensive FDA guidance and rolling review benefits.
attributes.references: FDA FDASIA Section 902; FDA Guidance on Breakthrough Therapy Designation

attributes.name: competitive_landscape_notes
attributes.description: Confidential notes on the competitive regulatory landscape including competitor approval timelines, orphan drug designations, patent cliffs, and market exclusivity considerations that influence the regulatory strategy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory strategy record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
