attributes.name: ctd_ectd_format_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Technical Document / Electronic Common Technical Document (CTD/eCTD) Format Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission dossier must be prepared in CTD/eCTD format as required by ICH M4 and the target agencies. True for most major agency submissions (FDA, EMA, PMDA); may be False for certain early-phase or regional submissions.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Requirements

attributes.name: development_phase
attributes.description: Clinical development phase covered by this regulatory strategy. Determines the regulatory requirements, agency interaction types, and submission milestones applicable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phase_1|phase_1_2|phase_2|phase_2_3|phase_3|phase_4|pre_ind|nda_bla_maa — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Clinical Development

attributes.name: dossier_format
attributes.description: Format of the regulatory submission dossier planned under this strategy: eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document), NeeS (Non-eCTD Electronic Submission), paper, or regional format for specific agencies.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the regulatory strategy is operationally effective and binding for the program team. Supports version-controlled strategy lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the regulatory strategy is superseded or retired. Null for the currently active version. Enables historical strategy version tracking.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: fast_track_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether FDA Fast Track Designation has been requested or granted, enabling more frequent FDA interactions and eligibility for rolling review of the NDA/BLA.
attributes.references: FDA FDAMA Section 112; 21 CFR Part 312.82; FDA Fast Track Guidance

attributes.name: health_authority_scientific_advice_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal scientific advice or protocol assistance from a health authority (e.g., EMA Scientific Advice, FDA Formal Meeting) is planned as part of this regulatory strategy.
attributes.references: EMA Scientific Advice Procedure; FDA Formal Meetings Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: key_regulatory_risks
attributes.description: Narrative summary of identified regulatory risks that could impact approval timelines or probability of success (e.g., unresolved safety signals, insufficient efficacy data, CMC concerns, precedent gaps). Supports risk-based regulatory planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; FDA Guidance on Risk Assessment; EMA Risk Management

attributes.name: meddra_indication_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Indication Code
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code corresponding to the target indication, enabling standardized cross-study and cross-agency reporting and signal detection alignment.
attributes.references: MedDRA v26+; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether orphan drug designation has been sought or granted for this program by FDA (ODD) or EMA (OMP), which confers market exclusivity and fee waivers. True if designation is active or planned.
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act 21 CFR Part 316; EU Regulation 141/2000; EMA OMP Guidance

attributes.name: pediatric_investigation_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pediatric Investigation Plan (EMA PIP) or Pediatric Study Plan (FDA PSP) is required as part of this regulatory strategy, per pediatric regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: EMA Pediatric Regulation EC 1901/2006; FDA PREA 21 CFR Part 314.55; ICH E11

attributes.name: planned_approval_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of regulatory approval from the lead agency based on standard or expedited review timelines. Used for commercial launch planning and portfolio milestone tracking.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; EMA Review Timelines; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: planned_ind_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Investigational New Drug (IND) Submission Date
attributes.description: Target date for submission of the IND application to the FDA as planned in this regulatory strategy. Drives pre-IND meeting scheduling and CMC/nonclinical package readiness timelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: planned_nda_bla_maa_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned New Drug Application / Biologics License Application / Marketing Authorization Application (NDA/BLA/MAA) Submission Date
attributes.description: Target date for submission of the marketing authorization application (NDA, BLA, or MAA) as planned in this regulatory strategy. Key milestone for program planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314/601; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: prime_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether EMA PRIME (PRIority MEdicines) designation has been requested or granted, providing enhanced EMA support for medicines that target unmet medical needs.
attributes.references: EMA PRIME Scheme; EU Regulation 726/2004; EMA Guideline on PRIME

attributes.name: regulatory_pathway
attributes.description: Global regulatory pathway designation for this strategy. Captures whether the program pursues standard review, accelerated approval (FDA), Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, PRIME (EMA), Conditional Marketing Authorization, or adaptive pathway. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|accelerated|breakthrough|fast_track|prime|adaptive|conditional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Expedited Programs; EMA PRIME Scheme; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_precedents
attributes.description: Summary of relevant regulatory precedents from previously approved products in the same therapeutic class or indication that inform the strategy (e.g., approved comparators, agency guidance documents, advisory committee outcomes).
attributes.references: FDA Approved Drug Products (Orange Book); EMA EPAR; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: rems_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) is anticipated or required by FDA as a condition of approval, based on the safety profile of the investigational product.
attributes.references: FDA REMS Guidance; 21 CFR Part 314.520; FDAAA 2007

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall regulatory risk classification for this strategy based on the risk assessment of approval probability, data package adequacy, and agency precedent. Drives escalation and mitigation planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: rolling_review_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether a rolling review submission strategy is planned, allowing completed sections of the dossier to be submitted to the agency before the full application is complete. Applicable for FDA Fast Track and EMA Rolling Review.
attributes.references: FDA Fast Track Rolling Review Guidance; EMA Rolling Review Procedure; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to this regulatory strategy document within the Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module (e.g., REG-STR-2024-0042). Used for cross-system referencing and TMF indexing.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory strategy document. Tracks progression from initial drafting through internal review, formal approval, and eventual supersession or retirement when a new version is issued.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Management; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: submission_sequence_strategy
attributes.description: Planned sequencing approach for multi-regional submissions: simultaneous (all agencies at once), sequential lead-first (lead agency then others), rolling (submit sections as available), or staggered (phased by region). Drives submission timeline planning.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; FDA Guidance on Parallel Scientific Advice; EMA Procedural Guidance

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Primary regulatory submission type targeted by this strategy (e.g., IND - Investigational New Drug, NDA - New Drug Application, BLA - Biologics License Application, MAA - Marketing Authorization Application, CTA - Clinical Trial Authorization). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IND|NDA|BLA|MAA|sNDA|sBLA|CTA|amendment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312/314/601; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: target_agencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all global health authorities targeted for submission under this strategy (e.g., 'FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada'). Supports multi-regional submission planning and sequencing.
attributes.references: FDA; EMA; PMDA; MHRA; Health Canada; TGA; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the regulatory strategy document, summarizing the development program, indication, and regulatory pathway scope (e.g., 'Global NDA/MAA Regulatory Strategy for Drug X in Indication Y Phase III').
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this regulatory strategy record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for audit trail and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF/Regulatory Submissions module where the approved regulatory strategy document is stored. Enables direct traceability from this data record to the source document.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the regulatory strategy document following major.minor versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented upon each approved revision to support document lifecycle management in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

Supports proactive inspection preparation.

attributes.description: The actual date on which the inspection concluded, including the closeout meeting. Used to calculate inspection duration and track report receipt timelines.

attributes.description: The actual date on which the inspection commenced on-site or remotely. May differ from scheduled_date due to rescheduling. Used for cycle time and compliance metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inspecting authority formally notified the site, sponsor, or CRO of the upcoming inspection. Used to calculate preparation lead time and assess readiness adequacy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: capa_response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the sponsor or site must submit a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan in response to the inspection findings. Typically defined by the inspecting authority in the inspection report or cover letter.

attributes.description: Actual date on which the CAPA plan was submitted to the inspecting authority in response to inspection findings. Compared against capa_response_due_date to assess timeliness of regulatory response.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection readiness record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical (most severe) findings identified during the inspection. Critical findings indicate practices that may have a direct impact on subject safety or data integrity. Drives CAPA prioritization and regulatory escalation decisions.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the inspection lasted from actual_start_date to actual_end_date. Indicates inspection intensity and is used for resource planning and benchmarking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; FDA BIMO Program

attributes.name: focus_areas
attributes.description: Free-text or semi-structured description of the specific areas, processes, or systems targeted by the inspection (e.g., informed consent process, SAE reporting, randomization procedures, data integrity, TMF completeness). Supports targeted readiness preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: inspection_category
attributes.description: Categorizes the trigger or purpose of the inspection: Routine (scheduled surveillance), For-Cause (triggered by a specific concern or complaint), Pre-Approval (prior to NDA/BLA/MAA approval), Pre-License (prior to license issuance), or Follow-Up (verifying CAPA closure from a prior inspection).
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inspection_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection was conducted on-site (inspectors physically present at the facility), remotely (conducted via electronic document review and virtual meetings), or as a hybrid of both modalities. Relevant post-COVID regulatory practice.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; FDA BIMO Program; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the inspection event by the inspecting authority or the sponsor/CRO tracking system (e.g., FDA EIR number, EMA inspection reference). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inspection_scope
attributes.description: Defines the organizational scope of the inspection: Site (investigational site/PI), Sponsor (sponsor organization), CRO (Contract Research Organization), Laboratory (central or local lab), or System (IT/data management system).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inspection event: Planned (scheduled but not yet announced), Announced (authority has notified the site/sponsor), In-Progress (inspection is actively underway), Completed (inspection activities finished, report pending), Closed (report received and all CAPAs resolved), Cancelled (inspection withdrawn by authority or sponsor).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection by regulatory discipline. GCP (Good Clinical Practice) covers clinical trial conduct; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) covers drug manufacturing; GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) covers non-clinical studies; Pharmacovigilance covers safety reporting systems; BIMO (Bioresearch Monitoring) is FDA-specific; Systems covers IT/data integrity audits.
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2); OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: inspector_count
attributes.description: Total number of regulatory inspectors participating in the inspection. Indicates the scale and intensity of the inspection and informs resource planning for the host organization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: is_repeat_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection is a follow-up or repeat inspection of the same site or sponsor, typically triggered by unresolved findings from a prior inspection (True = repeat; False = first inspection).
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_unannounced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection was conducted without prior notice to the site or sponsor (True = unannounced/for-cause; False = announced). Unannounced inspections typically indicate heightened regulatory scrutiny.
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lead_inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead regulatory inspector assigned by the inspecting authority. Used for correspondence tracking and relationship management with regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major findings identified during the inspection. Major findings indicate significant non-compliance with GCP or regulatory requirements that could affect subject safety or data reliability but are not immediately critical.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor (other) findings identified during the inspection. Minor findings represent deviations from GCP or regulatory requirements that are unlikely to have a significant impact on subject safety or data integrity.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, observations, or internal commentary about the inspection event, readiness activities, or authority interactions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Official outcome classification issued by the inspecting authority upon completion: Satisfactory (no significant findings), VAI (Voluntary Action Indicated — minor deficiencies requiring voluntary corrective action), OAI (Official Action Indicated — significant deficiencies requiring mandatory corrective action), No Action Indicated (FDA-specific: no objectionable conditions), or Pending (outcome not yet issued).
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: readiness_status
attributes.description: Tracks the internal preparation state for the upcoming inspection: Not Started, In Preparation (readiness activities underway), Ready (all preparation activities completed), Conditionally Ready (ready with known gaps being managed), or Overdue (preparation milestones missed). Distinct from inspection_status which tracks the actual inspection event lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal regulatory affairs contact or liaison responsible for managing communications with the inspecting authority for this inspection event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: report_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the official inspection report (e.g., FDA Establishment Inspection Report, EMA GCP Inspection Report) was received from the inspecting authority. Triggers the CAPA response timeline.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The planned or announced date on which the inspection is scheduled to begin, as communicated by the inspecting authority or agreed upon internally. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for planning purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: total_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of all inspection findings across all severity levels (critical + major + minor). Provides a single summary metric for inspection severity assessment and benchmarking across studies and sites.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2); FDA BIMO Program

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection readiness record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault (eTMF/regulatory submissions module) for the official inspection report, CAPA correspondence, or inspection readiness package. Enables direct traceability to the source document management system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

products.name: commitment
products.description: Tracks post-approval regulatory commitments and post-marketing requirements imposed by health authorities as conditions of approval. Captures commitment type (post-marketing study, label update, REMS, risk minimization measure), commitment description, due date, completion date, status (pending, in progress, fulfilled, overdue), agency-assigned commitment number, and reporting frequency. Ensures compliance with approval conditions.
products.reference: Post-Marketing Commitment / PMR (21 CFR 314.81, EMA Post-Authorization Obligations)

attributes.name: commitment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for commitment

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory application (IND/NDA/BLA/MAA) under which this commitment was imposed as a condition of approval.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: Post-approval commitments frequently originate from compliance inspections (e.g., FDA Form 483 observations). Linking commitment to the originating inspection enables traceability from inspection find
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: Post-approval regulatory commitments are imposed by specific health authorities (FDA, EMA). The agency and agency_country_code STRING fields on commitment are denormalized references to health_authori
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Post-approval commitments (e.g., pediatric study requirements, confirmatory trials) reference specific protocol versions. Regulatory affairs teams track which protocol fulfills each commitment for FDA
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Post-approval regulatory commitments are imposed as conditions of a specific regulatory approval (e.g., post-marketing studies required as conditions of accelerated approval). Linking commitment to th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the post-marketing clinical study or trial being conducted to fulfill this commitment, where applicable (e.g., a post-marketing required study or confirmatory trial).
attributes.references: FDA FDAAA 2007; ICH E6(R2); EMA Post-Authorization Studies

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Post-marketing commitment reports and pediatric study plans are TMF documents filed with the agency. Linking commitment records to TMF documents enables inspection-ready retrieval of commitment fulfil
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accelerated_approval_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment is a confirmatory trial required as a condition of accelerated approval (True) or a standard post-approval commitment (False). Accelerated approval conditions carry heightened regulatory scrutiny.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H; FDA FDORA 2022; EMA Conditional Marketing Authorization

attributes.name: agency_commitment_number
attributes.description: The official commitment or post-marketing requirement number assigned by the health authority (e.g., FDA PMR/PMC number, EMA obligation number) at the time of approval. Used for regulatory correspondence and agency tracking.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the health authority granted product approval and formally imposed this commitment. Establishes the baseline for commitment timelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Decision Letter; ICH M4

attributes.name: commitment_category
attributes.description: Regulatory category distinguishing legally binding Post-Marketing Requirements (PMR) mandated by the FDA versus voluntary Post-Marketing Commitments (PMC), or conditions of approval imposed by other agencies such as EMA or PMDA.
attributes.references: FDA FDAAA Section 901; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: commitment_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the regulatory commitment as stated in the approval letter or agency decision document. Captures the exact obligation language including scope, objectives, and deliverables required by the health authority.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory commitment. Tracks progression from pending through active execution to fulfillment or overdue state. Deferred indicates agency-approved extension; released indicates the agency has waived the obligation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|fulfilled|overdue|deferred|released|terminated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: commitment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory commitment imposed by the health authority. Indicates whether it is a post-marketing study (PMR/PMC), label update, Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS), risk minimization measure, pediatric study, confirmatory trial, or other obligation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: post_marketing_study|label_update|rems|risk_minimization_measure|pediatric_study|confirmatory_trial|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; FDA FDAAA 2007; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations; ICH E2C(R2)

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the regulatory commitment was fulfilled and the required deliverable was submitted to or accepted by the health authority. Null if not yet completed.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory commitment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record provenance per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; EU Annex 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: ctd_module
attributes.description: The CTD module to which the deliverable for this commitment will be submitted (e.g., Module 5 for clinical study reports, Module 1 for labeling updates). Aligns commitment deliverables with eCTD dossier structure.
attributes.references: ICH M4; ICH M8 eCTD; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: deferral_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for any agency-approved deferral or extension of the commitment due date. Documents the justification submitted to and accepted by the health authority.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the regulatory commitment must be fulfilled or the required deliverable (e.g., final study report, label update, REMS implementation) must be submitted to the health authority. Drives overdue status calculation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations; FDAAA 2007

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The approved therapeutic indication or disease area for which the product received approval and to which this commitment is specifically tied.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA CHMP Guidelines; MedDRA

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) of the active substance subject to this commitment. Provides a globally standardized identifier for the drug substance independent of brand name.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; ICH M4; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether documentation and evidence for this commitment has been reviewed and confirmed as inspection-ready (True) for potential health authority inspection or audit. Supports regulatory inspection preparedness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Guidelines; MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: is_binding
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment is legally binding (True = Post-Marketing Requirement mandated by law, e.g., FDA PMR under FDAAA) or voluntary (False = Post-Marketing Commitment, e.g., FDA PMC). Critical for prioritization and enforcement risk assessment.
attributes.references: FDA FDAAA 2007 Section 901; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81

attributes.name: is_pediatric
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment involves a pediatric study required under the Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA) or EMA Paediatric Regulation. Enables filtering and reporting on pediatric obligations.
attributes.references: FDA PREA; EMA Paediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; ICH E11

attributes.name: last_report_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent progress report or status update for this commitment was submitted to the health authority. Used to calculate next reporting due date.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: milestone_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent commitment milestone was achieved or is targeted. Used in conjunction with milestone_description to track incremental progress toward fulfillment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Description of the current or most recent milestone achieved in fulfilling this commitment (e.g., protocol submitted, enrollment complete, interim analysis submitted, final report submitted). Supports granular progress tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: next_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next scheduled progress report or status update on this commitment must be submitted to the health authority. Calculated based on reporting frequency and last submission date.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or operational notes related to this commitment that do not fit into structured fields. Used by regulatory affairs teams for tracking nuances and agency communication history.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: original_due_date
attributes.description: The initial due date as specified in the original approval letter or agency decision, before any agency-approved extensions or deferrals. Preserved for audit trail and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Internal priority classification assigned to this commitment based on regulatory risk, binding nature, and proximity to due date. Drives resource allocation and escalation decisions within the regulatory affairs function.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; FDA CAPA Guidance; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Proprietary or brand name of the drug product or biologic to which this regulatory commitment applies, as registered with the health authority.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH M4

attributes.name: release_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why the health authority released or waived this commitment (e.g., scientific evidence no longer supports the requirement, alternative data satisfied the obligation). Populated only when commitment_status is released.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations

attributes.name: rems_program_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program Name
attributes.description: Name of the FDA-required Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) program associated with this commitment, if the commitment type is REMS. Null for non-REMS commitments.
attributes.references: FDA FDAAA 2007 Section 505-1; FDA REMS Guidance

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which progress updates or status reports on this commitment must be submitted to the health authority (e.g., annual, semi-annual, quarterly, one-time final report). Drives scheduling of regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Post-Authorization Obligations; ICH E2C(R2)

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor's designated regulatory affairs contact responsible for managing and tracking this commitment. Business-confidential operational data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title of the regulatory commitment as referenced in the approval letter or agency correspondence. Used for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FDA Approval Letter; EMA Decision Letter; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory commitment record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; EU Annex 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault (eTMF/regulatory submissions module) for the approval letter, agency decision document, or commitment tracking record associated with this commitment. Enables direct traceability to the source regulatory document.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11

products.name: special_designation
products.description: Tracks special regulatory designations granted to investigational products by health authorities. Includes designation type (Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, Accelerated Approval, Priority Review, Orphan Drug, PRIME, Adaptive Pathways, SAKIGAKE), granting agency, request date, grant date, expiry date, designation conditions, and associated application. Enables tracking of expedited development pathways and associated obligations.
products.reference: Breakthrough Therapy / Orphan Drug / PRIME Designation (21 CFR 312.82, EMA PRIME, FDA Orphan Drug Act)

attributes.name: special_designation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a special regulatory designation record in the Clinical Trials lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent regulatory application (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or CTA) under which this special designation was requested or granted.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; 21 CFR Part 314; EMA PRIME Regulation; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Reference to the granting health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada) that issued or manages this special designation.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; EMA PRIME; PMDA SAKIGAKE; ICH M4

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary clinical study that provided the evidence base for the designation request (e.g., the pivotal Phase 2 study supporting a Breakthrough Therapy designation request).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Clinical One Study Management

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory submission record through which the designation request was filed or through which the designation was referenced in a marketing application (e.g., the NDA/BLA submission citing the Breakthrough Therapy designation).
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions; 21 CFR Part 314; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Special designation letters (orphan drug, breakthrough therapy, fast track) are TMF essential documents. Regulatory teams file agency designation letters in the TMF; this FK supports TMF completeness
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the health authority reviewer or project manager assigned to this designation at the agency (e.g., FDA CDER Rare Diseases Program contact, EMA PRIME rapporteur). Used for regulatory relationship management.
attributes.references: FDA CDER Rare Diseases Program; EMA PRIME Rapporteur Assignment; PMDA SAKIGAKE Consultation

attributes.name: agency_letter_date
attributes.description: Date of the official agency letter communicating the designation decision (grant, denial, or revocation). Used for regulatory correspondence tracking and TMF filing in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); FDA Correspondence Guidance; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: agency_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health authority officially acknowledged receipt of the designation request. Triggers the formal review clock for the agency's response timeline.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VI Performance Goals; EMA PRIME Guidance EMA/CHMP/671361/2015

attributes.name: agency_reference_number
attributes.description: Internal reference or tracking number assigned by the health authority to the designation request or correspondence (e.g., FDA CDER tracking number, EMA EMEA procedure number). Distinct from the designation number issued upon grant.
attributes.references: FDA CDER Tracking System; EMA PRIME Procedure Number; PMDA Consultation Reference

attributes.name: annual_report_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the next mandatory annual progress report to the health authority as required under the designation conditions (e.g., FDA Orphan Drug annual report per 21 CFR Part 316.27). Null if no annual reporting obligation applies.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.27; FDA Orphan Drug Annual Report Guidance; EMA PRIME Annual Update

attributes.name: confirmatory_trial_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-approval confirmatory clinical trial is required as a condition of the designation or approval pathway (e.g., mandatory for FDA Accelerated Approval under 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H). Drives post-marketing commitment tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.510 (Accelerated Approval Confirmatory Trial); FDA Omnibus Reform Act 2022; EMA Conditional Marketing Authorisation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this special designation record was first created in the Clinical Trials lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: denial_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the health authority formally denied the designation request. Null if the designation was not denied. Used to track agency response timelines and inform resubmission strategy.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.25; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance; EMA PRIME Refusal Guidance

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Summary of the health authority's stated rationale for denying the designation request. Captured from the agency's denial letter to inform resubmission strategy and regulatory intelligence. Null if not denied.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.25; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Denial Guidance; EMA PRIME Refusal Assessment Report

attributes.name: designation_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, post-designation obligations, or commitments attached to the granted designation by the health authority (e.g., annual progress reports, specific clinical milestones, post-marketing studies for Accelerated Approval). Critical for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.27 (Orphan Drug Annual Report); FDA Accelerated Approval 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H; EMA PRIME Obligations

attributes.name: designation_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned unique reference number issued by the health authority for this special designation (e.g., FDA Orphan Drug designation number OD-XXXXXX, Breakthrough Therapy designation reference). Serves as the official business identifier for tracking and correspondence.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316 (Orphan Drug); FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance; EMA PRIME Guidance

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the special designation. Tracks the progression from initial request through agency review to grant, denial, withdrawal, or revocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Requested|Granted|Denied|Withdrawn|Expired|Revoked|Under Review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance 2018; EMA PRIME Guidance EMA/CHMP/671361/2015; 21 CFR Part 316.24

attributes.name: designation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the special regulatory designation granted by the health authority. Determines the expedited development pathway and associated regulatory obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Breakthrough Therapy|Fast Track|Accelerated Approval|Priority Review|Orphan Drug|PRIME|Adaptive Pathways|SAKIGAKE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21st Century Cures Act; 21 CFR Part 312.82 (Fast Track); 21 CFR Part 316 (Orphan Drug); EMA PRIME Regulation (EU) No 726/2004; PMDA SAKIGAKE Designation; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the special designation expires or lapses, if applicable. Relevant for time-limited designations such as PRIME (EMA) or SAKIGAKE (PMDA) where the designation has a defined validity period. Null for perpetual designations such as FDA Orphan Drug.
attributes.references: EMA PRIME Guidance; PMDA SAKIGAKE Designation Criteria; EC Regulation No 141/2000

attributes.name: fee_waiver_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the special designation confers eligibility for a regulatory fee waiver or reduction (e.g., FDA Orphan Drug designation entitles sponsors to a waiver of the NDA/BLA application user fee under PDUFA). True if fee waiver applies.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.31; PDUFA User Fee Waiver for Orphan Drug; FDA FDARA 2017

attributes.name: grant_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the health authority officially granted the special designation. Null if the designation has not yet been granted. This is the principal business event date for the designation lifecycle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.24; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance 2018; EMA PRIME Decision Date

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Specific disease, condition, or patient population for which the special designation is requested or granted. Aligns with the MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) or Lowest Level Term (LLT) used in the regulatory submission.
attributes.references: MedDRA PT/LLT; 21 CFR Part 316.3 (Orphan Disease Definition); EMA PRIME Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) for the active substance of the investigational product. Used for standardized identification across regulatory submissions and health authority correspondence.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; ICH Q6A; EMA Guideline on INN

attributes.name: market_exclusivity_years
attributes.description: Number of years of market exclusivity conferred by the designation upon product approval (e.g., 7 years for FDA Orphan Drug, 10 years for EU Orphan Medicinal Product). Null for designations that do not confer market exclusivity (e.g., Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.31 (7-year US Orphan Exclusivity); EC Regulation No 141/2000 Article 8 (10-year EU Orphan Exclusivity); PMDA SAKIGAKE Priority Review

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory context, internal commentary, or strategic notes related to this special designation (e.g., agency meeting outcomes, key discussion points, competitive intelligence). Not for official regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Internal Regulatory Affairs SOP; Veeva Vault Regulatory Notes

attributes.name: orphan_disease_prevalence
attributes.description: Stated prevalence or incidence of the rare disease or condition as submitted to the health authority in support of an Orphan Drug Designation request (e.g., 'fewer than 200,000 patients in the US' per 21 CFR Part 316, or '≤5 in 10,000 in the EU' per EC Regulation 141/2000). Applicable only to Orphan Drug designation type.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.3(b)(13); EC Regulation No 141/2000 (EU Orphan Medicinal Products); EMA COMP

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Proprietary or working name of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) for which the special designation is sought or granted. May differ from the INN (International Nonproprietary Name) at early development stages.
attributes.references: ICH M4Q (CTD Quality Module); FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on IMP

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the sponsor formally submitted the designation request to the health authority. Marks the start of the agency review clock for expedited designation programs.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA Performance Goals; 21 CFR Part 312.82; EMA PRIME Guidance

attributes.name: resubmission_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor plans to resubmit the designation request following a denial or withdrawal. Drives regulatory planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance 2018; 21 CFR Part 316.25; EMA PRIME Resubmission Procedure

attributes.name: resubmission_target_date
attributes.description: Planned date for resubmitting the designation request to the health authority after a denial or withdrawal. Null if resubmission is not planned or not yet scheduled.
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Planning Guidance; EMA PRIME Resubmission Timeline

attributes.name: rolling_review_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation enables rolling review of the marketing application (submission of completed CTD modules before the full dossier is ready). Applicable to FDA Fast Track and EMA PRIME designations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.82 (Fast Track Rolling Review); EMA PRIME Rolling Review; FDA Guidance on Fast Track 2018

attributes.name: surrogate_endpoint_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation was granted or the approval pathway relies on a surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoint rather than a traditional clinical outcome endpoint. Relevant for Accelerated Approval and Breakthrough Therapy designations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H (Accelerated Approval); FDA Guidance on Surrogate Endpoints 2018; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: tax_credit_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation qualifies the sponsor for the Orphan Drug Tax Credit (50% of qualified clinical testing expenses in the US under IRC Section 45C). Applicable only to FDA Orphan Drug designations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 45C (Orphan Drug Tax Credit); 21 CFR Part 316; FDA Orphan Drug Act

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Broad medical or scientific domain in which the investigational product is being developed (e.g., Oncology, Rare Disease, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for portfolio analytics and regulatory strategy alignment.
attributes.references: MedDRA SOC Classification; ICH E8(R1); FDA CDER Therapeutic Area Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this special designation record. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault (eTMF/Regulatory module) for the designation request package, agency grant letter, or related regulatory correspondence. Enables direct traceability to the source document in the electronic Trial Master File.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) Section 8 (Essential Documents); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: assigned_owner_name

attributes.name: assigned_team
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory affairs team or functional group responsible for this action item (e.g., 'Global Regulatory Strategy', 'Submissions Team', 'Safety Reporting'). Supports team-level workload reporting and capacity planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the action item was fully completed and closed. Nullable until the item reaches 'closed' status. Used to calculate cycle time and measure regulatory responsiveness KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this regulatory action item record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: finding_classification

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, interim progress updates, or commentary on the action item that does not fit structured fields. Supports operational communication within the regulatory affairs team.

attributes.name: open_date

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: is_searchable_pdf

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: leaf_identifier

attributes.name: prior_leaf_identifier
attributes.description: Leaf ID of the previously submitted content unit that this document replaces, appends, or deletes. Required for eCTD lifecycle operations to maintain document lineage across submission sequences.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: publishing_tool
attributes.description: Name of the eCTD publishing software used to compile and validate this content unit within the submission package (e.g., Lorenz docuBridge, Extedo eCTD Manager, Certus). Required for technical conformance documentation.

attributes.name: publishing_tool_version
attributes.description: Version of the eCTD publishing software used to compile this content unit. Tracked for technical conformance and reproducibility of the submission package.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; ICH M8 eCTD Specification

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the regulatory affairs reviewer who performed quality check on this content unit prior to submission. Supports QC accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Guideline

attributes.name: target_agency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the health authority for which this content unit is specifically prepared or applicable (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|HC|TGA|ANVISA|NMPA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: validation_error_message

attributes.name: validation_status

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference

domains.name: document

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_artifact. Business justification: Every TMF document is classified under a specific DIA TMF Reference Model artifact. The tmf_artifact STRING column in tmf_document is a denormalized reference to the tmf_artifact taxonomy table. Repla

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was formally approved by the authorized approver(s) within the document control workflow in Veeva Vault. Distinct from the effective date and the version date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: The date on which this document was formally transferred to the long-term archive. Null if the document has not yet been archived.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: archive_location
attributes.description: The physical or electronic location identifier where the archived document is stored (e.g., archive facility name, vault path, or storage reference code). Required for document retrieval during regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, filing instructions, quality review findings, or other contextual remarks associated with this document record. Not part of the document content itself.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: confidentiality_classification
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to this document per the organization's information security policy. Restricted = highest sensitivity (e.g., patient data, proprietary formulations); Confidential = sponsor/CRO sensitive; Internal = internal use only; Public = publicly disclosable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 27001

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code indicating the country for which this document is applicable (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'JPN'). Relevant for country-specific regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC approvals, and site-level documents.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA; EMA; PMDA; Health Canada; TGA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this TMF document record was first created in the source system (Veeva Vault). Represents the audit trail creation event per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known, human-readable unique document identifier assigned within the eTMF or document control system (e.g., DOC-2024-00123). Used for cross-referencing in regulatory submissions and inspections.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: document_origin
attributes.description: Identifies the originating party or organization type that produced this document (e.g., Sponsor, CRO, Site, Regulatory Authority, Laboratory, Vendor). Used for document provenance tracking and TMF completeness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sponsor|cro|site|regulatory_authority|laboratory|vendor|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The functional category of the document as defined by the DIA TMF Reference Model artifact taxonomy (e.g., Protocol, Informed Consent Form, Investigator Brochure, Site Initiation Visit Report, SAE Report). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Protocol|Informed Consent Form|Investigator Brochure|Monitoring Visit Report|SAE Report|Regulatory Approval|Laboratory Certificate|Financial Disclosure|Training Record|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this document version is considered operative and binding for the study. For regulatory documents, this is the date the document enters force (e.g., protocol amendment effective date, IB effective date).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this document expires or is no longer valid (e.g., IRB/IEC approval expiry, laboratory accreditation certificate expiry, financial disclosure expiry). Null for documents with no defined expiry.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: The electronic file format of the document (e.g., PDF, DOCX, XLSX, XML). PDF is the standard for finalized TMF documents per eCTD and regulatory submission requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PDF|DOCX|XLSX|XML|CSV|TXT|JPG|PNG|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance; 21 CFR Part 11; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current filing completeness status of this document against its expected TMF artifact placeholder. Expected = document is anticipated but not yet received; Filed = document has been received and filed; Overdue = document is past its expected filing date; Not Applicable = artifact does not apply to this study/site; Placeholder = temporary placeholder filed.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: is_archived
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document has been formally transferred to long-term archival storage per the study close-out and archival process. Archived documents are read-only and subject to retention period controls.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: is_essential_document
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is classified as an essential document per ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8 (Trial Master File). Essential documents are those that individually and collectively permit evaluation of the conduct of a trial and the quality of the data produced.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: is_gcp_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is mandated by ICH GCP guidelines as a required TMF document. Used for TMF completeness assessment and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: is_inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document has been reviewed and confirmed as inspection-ready (complete, legible, attributable, and filed correctly per ALCOA+ principles). Used for regulatory inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) indicating the language in which the document is written (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja', 'zh-CN'). Required for multi-country studies with translated documents.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the document within its controlled lifecycle as managed in Veeva Vault. Drives document control workflows: draft → in_review → approved → effective → superseded/archived. Superseded indicates a newer version exists; archived indicates end-of-life retention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|effective|superseded|archived|obsolete — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: The total number of pages in the document. Used for document completeness verification, quality control checks, and archival metadata.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: quality_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent quality control review of this document was completed. Used for tracking QC cycle times and scheduling periodic re-reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: quality_review_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the quality control review performed on this document to verify completeness, accuracy, and compliance with ALCOA+ principles and GCP requirements. Drives inspection readiness and CAPA workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: quality_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who performed the most recent quality control review of this document. Supports audit trail requirements under GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: retention_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated date on which the mandatory retention period for this document expires, after which the document may be eligible for destruction per the approved destruction authorization process.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: The mandatory retention period in years for this document as required by applicable regulations and sponsor policy (e.g., 15 years post-study completion per ICH E6(R2), or as specified by the sponsor). Drives archival scheduling and destruction authorization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; EMA GCP

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this document record originates (e.g., 'Veeva Vault', 'Medidata Rave', 'MasterControl'). Supports data lineage and multi-system TMF integration scenarios.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: sponsor_document_reference
attributes.description: The sponsor's own document reference number or identifier for this document, as assigned by the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor. Used for cross-referencing between CRO eTMF and sponsor document management systems.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The full descriptive title of the TMF document as it appears in the eTMF system (e.g., 'Protocol Amendment 2 - Study XYZ-001'). Primary human-readable identifier for the document.

attributes.name: tmf_document_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the document's content, purpose, or scope. Provides additional context beyond the document title for search, classification, and review purposes.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: tmf_section

attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this TMF document record was most recently modified in the source system. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: vault_document_reference

attributes.name: vault_library

attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: version_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current version of the document was authored or formally dated, as stated on the document itself. Distinct from the approval date or effective date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.description: Official DIA TMF Reference Model name for the artifact type (e.g., 'Protocol', 'Investigator Brochure', 'Informed Consent Form'). This is the human-readable identity label used in TMF completeness reports, inspection readiness dashboards, and eTMF system configuration.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: artifact_status

attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: document_owner_role
attributes.description: Standard organizational role responsible for generating, maintaining, and filing documents of this artifact type (e.g., 'Sponsor', 'Principal Investigator', 'CRA', 'CRC', 'Biostatistician', 'Regulatory Affairs'). attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this artifact definition became effective and applicable for use in TMF filing and completeness assessments. attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: expected_timing

attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA TMF Guidance

attributes.name: ich_gcp_reference

attributes.description: Specific ICH E6(R2) GCP guideline section(s) that mandate or reference this artifact type (e.g., 'ICH E6(R2) Section 8.2.1', 'ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3.6'). attributes.name: is_country_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this artifact type requires a separate instance per country in which the trial is conducted (True) or is filed at the global trial level (False). Drives country-level TMF completeness calculations and supports multi-jurisdictional regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_essential_document
attributes.description: Indicates whether this artifact type is classified as an Essential Document per ICH E6(R2) Section 8 (True). Essential documents are those that individually and collectively permit evaluation of the conduct of a trial and the quality of the data produced. This flag drives the core TMF completeness index calculation.

attributes.name: is_inspection_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this artifact type is considered critical during regulatory inspections by FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or other health authorities (True).
