attributes.name: signature_method
attributes.description: Authentication method used to apply the electronic signature. Determines the technical compliance pathway under 21 CFR Part 11 (biometric vs. non-biometric). Required for regulatory inspection to demonstrate identity verification rigor.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.200; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 25

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the electronic signature record. Pending = awaiting signer action; Applied = successfully executed; Voided = invalidated due to document revision or administrative action; Superseded = replaced by a newer signature; Rejected = signer declined to sign.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault Workflow Status

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: Classification of the signature type per applicable regulatory framework. Electronic = standard 21 CFR Part 11 e-signature; Wet Ink Scanned = paper signature digitized; Advanced Electronic = eIDAS AES; Qualified Electronic = eIDAS QES with qualified certificate.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU eIDAS Regulation 910/2014; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: signed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the electronic signature was applied by the signer. This is the principal real-world event timestamp for the signature transaction. Must be system-generated and tamper-evident per 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: signer_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual who applied the electronic signature, captured at the time of signing. Stored as a point-in-time snapshot to preserve the audit trail even if the user record changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA §164.312

attributes.name: signer_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or company the signer represents at the time of signing (e.g., sponsor company name, CRO name, investigative site institution). Supports multi-party trial agreements and sponsor delegation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the signer within the document workflow at the time of signing. Determines the legal weight and workflow position of the signature. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: author|reviewer|approver|sponsor_representative|quality_assurance|investigator|regulatory_affairs|data_manager — promote to reference product if additional roles are required]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50(a); DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signer_title
attributes.description: Professional title or job designation of the signer at the time of signing (e.g., Principal Investigator, Medical Monitor, Sponsor Representative, Biostatistician). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this signature record was sourced (primarily Veeva Vault eTMF module). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and multi-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Governance; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10

attributes.name: source_system_signature_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of the signature record in the originating source system (e.g., Veeva Vault internal signature object ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer and the operational system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault API

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier representing the local timezone of the signer at the time of signing (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Required to accurately interpret the signed_timestamp in multi-national trial contexts and for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); IANA Time Zone Database; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_number
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model artifact number identifying the document type being signed (e.g., 01.01.01 for Protocol, 06.02.01 for Informed Consent Form). Enables artifact-level signature completeness tracking.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.x; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model Zone classification of the document to which this signature belongs (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 02 - Central Trial Documents, Zone 03 - Regulatory). Supports TMF completeness metrics and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.x; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp of the most recent modification to the signature record (e.g., status change, void action). Required for audit trail completeness and change detection in the Silver Layer ETL pipeline.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the signature was voided or invalidated. Required when signature_status = 'voided' to maintain a complete and auditable record of signature lifecycle events per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable)

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was voided or invalidated. Supports the complete lifecycle audit trail for the signature record and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: workflow_step_name
attributes.description: Name of the document workflow step within which this signature was collected (e.g., 'Author Review', 'QA Approval', 'Sponsor Sign-Off'). Maps to the Veeva Vault workflow configuration and supports workflow analytics and bottleneck identification.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Workflow; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: workflow_step_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position of this signature step within the overall document approval workflow. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full signature chain for regulatory inspection and audit trail review.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Workflow; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10

products.name: site_file
products.description: Master entity representing the Investigator Site File (ISF) or Regulatory Binder maintained at each investigational site. Captures site file ID, associated study, associated site, file type (ISF, regulatory binder, pharmacy binder), physical or electronic location, custodian (PI or CRC), completeness status, last review date, and inspection readiness status. Tracks the site-level essential document collection required by ICH GCP Section 8.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 5

attributes.name: site_file_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Investigator Site File (ISF) or Regulatory Binder record in the lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Site files must contain the CTA approval for the country where the site operates — a TMF essential document requirement. Linking site files to their governing CTA enables verification that the correct
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study with which this site file is associated. Links the ISF to its parent protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this site file is maintained. Ties the ISF to a specific site entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site file was formally activated and made available for document filing, coinciding with or following site initiation. Marks the start of the file's active lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: applicable_gcp_guideline
attributes.description: The specific GCP guideline version or regulation that governs the conduct of this site file. Determines essential document requirements, retention obligations, and inspection readiness criteria.
attributes.value_regex: ICH E6(R2)|ICH E6(R3)|21 CFR Part 312|EU CTR 536/2014|ISO 14155
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E6(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155

attributes.name: archival_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site file was transferred to long-term archival storage per ICH GCP and sponsor retention requirements. Typically 15 years post-study completion for IND studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: archival_location
attributes.description: Physical or electronic location where the site file has been archived post-study closure (e.g., sponsor archive facility name, Veeva Vault archive vault path, or third-party archive vendor name).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site file was formally closed following site close-out activities. After this date, no new documents should be filed except for archival or regulatory response purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.4; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Numeric percentage (0.00–100.00) representing the proportion of expected essential documents that are present and current in the site file. Calculated at the time of the last completeness review. Used for KPI reporting and inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: completeness_status
attributes.description: Overall completeness assessment of the site file relative to the expected essential documents per ICH GCP Section 8 and the DIA TMF Reference Model. Drives inspection readiness scoring and CRA monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the site file record was first created in the system of record (Veeva Vault or CTMS). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: custodian_role
attributes.description: Role of the designated custodian responsible for the site file. PI (Principal Investigator) is the accountable party per GCP; CRC (Clinical Research Coordinator) typically manages day-to-day file maintenance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: delegation_log_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Delegation of Authority Log On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current, signed Delegation of Authority (DoA) log is present in the site file, documenting all site staff authorized to perform study-related tasks and their qualifications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1.5; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: electronic_vault_path
attributes.description: Folder path or document library location within Veeva Vault eTMF where the electronic site file is stored. Used for direct navigation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site file is maintained electronically (eTMF via Veeva Vault), in paper form at the site, or as a hybrid of both. Drives inspection readiness procedures and retrieval workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: file_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this site file, used in regulatory correspondence, inspection readiness tracking, and eTMF cross-referencing. Typically generated by the CTMS or Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: file_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site file. Active indicates the file is in use during the study; Under Review indicates a quality or completeness review is in progress; Archived indicates post-study archival; Closed indicates the site has been closed out; Pending Activation indicates the file is being set up prior to site initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: file_type
attributes.description: Classification of the site file by its regulatory and operational purpose. ISF (Investigator Site File) is the primary site-level essential document collection; Regulatory Binder holds IRB/IEC submissions and approvals; Pharmacy Binder tracks investigational product accountability; Laboratory Binder holds lab certifications and normal ranges; Investigator Binder holds PI-specific documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: financial_disclosure_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether signed financial disclosure forms for the investigator and sub-investigators are present in the site file, as required by FDA regulations to identify potential conflicts of interest.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 54; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.11

attributes.name: icf_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current, IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.2.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the site file's readiness for regulatory inspection by authorities such as FDA, EMA, or MHRA. Ready indicates the file meets all GCP and regulatory requirements; Needs Remediation indicates minor gaps requiring correction; Critical Gaps indicates significant deficiencies that must be resolved before inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA Inspection Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: investigator_cv_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigator Curriculum Vitae (CV) On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current, signed curriculum vitae (CV) for the Principal Investigator and all sub-investigators is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.2.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.10; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current, valid IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval letter is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.2.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: lab_certification_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether current laboratory certifications (e.g., CLIA, CAP) and normal reference ranges for the site's clinical laboratory are present in the site file, as required by ICH GCP Section 8.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other authority) at which this site file was reviewed. Used for inspection history tracking and readiness planning.
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome classification of the most recent regulatory inspection of the site file. NAI (No Action Indicated), VAI (Voluntary Action Indicated), and OAI (Official Action Indicated) are standard FDA classification categories. Drives CAPA requirements and sponsor oversight actions.
attributes.value_regex: No Action Indicated|Voluntary Action Indicated|Official Action Indicated|Pending|Not Applicable
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Classification Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent completeness review or quality check of the site file was performed, typically by a CRA (Clinical Research Associate) during a monitoring visit or central review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: missing_document_count
attributes.description: Number of essential documents identified as missing or outstanding from the site file at the time of the last review. Drives follow-up actions and inspection readiness remediation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Site File Review Date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next completeness review or quality check of the site file. Used for scheduling CRA monitoring visits and proactive inspection readiness management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or observations related to the site file that are not captured in structured fields. Examples include inspection preparation notes, custodian handover comments, or archival instructions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.description: Number of outstanding action items or findings related to the site file that have not yet been resolved. Derived from monitoring visit findings and quality reviews. Used for inspection readiness and site risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: physical_location
attributes.description: Description of the physical storage location of the site file at the investigational site (e.g., room number, cabinet, shelf). Applicable for paper or hybrid files. Required for inspection readiness and retrieval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signed and dated study protocol (and all applicable amendments) is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority with jurisdiction over the investigational site and its site file requirements. Determines applicable GCP guidelines, retention periods, and inspection standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; MHRA GCP Guidance; PMDA GCP Ordinance; TGA GCP Guidelines; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mandatory regulatory retention period for the site file expires, after which the file may be destroyed per applicable regulations. Calculated based on study completion date and jurisdiction-specific retention requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: sponsor_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor or CRO has completed a formal review of the site file for completeness and GCP compliance. Required as part of sponsor oversight obligations under ICH GCP Section 5.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50

attributes.name: sponsor_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor or CRO completed the most recent formal review of the site file. Supports audit trail and oversight documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50

attributes.name: tmf_section
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model section code within the assigned zone (e.g., 06.01 for Site Initiation). Provides granular classification for document filing and completeness tracking.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model zone classification under which this site file's documents are organized. Zones provide a standardized taxonomy for essential document categorization across the TMF.
attributes.value_regex: Trial Management|Investigational Product|Site Management|Subject Information and Consent|Study Procedures
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: total_expected_documents
attributes.description: Total count of essential documents expected to be present in the site file based on the study protocol, applicable regulations, and DIA TMF Reference Model requirements for this site and study phase.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: total_filed_documents
attributes.description: Actual count of documents currently filed and verified within the site file. Used in conjunction with total_expected_documents to derive completeness metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the site file record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles for data integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF to the site file container or root document object. Enables direct cross-system traceability between the lakehouse record and the source eTMF system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

products.name: tmf_completeness
products.description: Transactional record capturing a point-in-time TMF completeness assessment for a study, capturing the assessment date, assessed by (QA or TMF manager), overall completeness percentage, number of expected artifacts, number of filed artifacts, number of missing artifacts, number of overdue artifacts, and completeness by TMF zone. Supports ongoing inspection readiness monitoring and DIA TMF Reference Model compliance reporting.
products.reference: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP Inspection Readiness

attributes.name: tmf_completeness_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trial Master File (TMF) Completeness Assessment ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each point-in-time TMF completeness assessment record. Primary key of this product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP); DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: prior_assessment_tmf_completeness_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding TMF completeness assessment record for this study, enabling trend analysis and completeness trajectory tracking over time.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: site_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: TMF completeness assessments are conducted at the site level and evaluate the completeness of the Investigator Site File (ISF). tmf_completeness already has study_site_id but lacks a direct reference
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this TMF completeness assessment was conducted. Links to the study master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: TMF completeness assessments are conducted at the site level (per DIA TMF Reference Model). Linking tmf_completeness to study_site enables site-level TMF gap reporting, per-site inspection readiness s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: assessed_by_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the individual who performed the TMF completeness assessment, such as TMF Manager, QA Specialist, Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Study Manager, or Regulatory Affairs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the TMF completeness assessment was performed. Represents the point-in-time snapshot date for this record.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: assessment_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period covered by this TMF completeness assessment. For periodic assessments, this defines the end of the reporting window.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: assessment_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period covered by this TMF completeness assessment. For periodic assessments, this defines the beginning of the reporting window.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: assessment_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number or code assigned to this completeness assessment, used for tracking and cross-referencing in Veeva Vault eTMF and inspection-readiness reports.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the completeness assessment record within Veeva Vault: draft (initiated but not yet submitted), in_progress (actively being assessed), completed (assessment data entry finished), reviewed (QA review completed), approved (formally approved by TMF manager or QA lead).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment trigger: scheduled (routine periodic), ad_hoc (unplanned), pre_inspection (triggered by regulatory inspection notice), milestone (triggered by a study milestone such as first patient in or database lock), or close_out (triggered by study close-out activities).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAPA record initiated in MasterControl as a result of critical TMF completeness gaps identified in this assessment. Null if no CAPA was required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: completeness_target_pct
attributes.description: The minimum completeness percentage threshold required for this study at this point in time, as defined in the TMF plan or sponsor SOP. Used to determine whether the study is inspection-ready.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: completeness_trend
attributes.description: Directional trend of TMF completeness compared to the prior assessment: improving (percentage increased), stable (no significant change), declining (percentage decreased), or not_applicable (first assessment for this study).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this TMF completeness assessment record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: critical_document_gap_count
attributes.description: Number of missing or overdue artifacts classified as 'critical' per the DIA TMF Reference Model or sponsor TMF plan (e.g., protocol, ethics approval, signed ICF). Critical gaps pose the highest inspection risk.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance

attributes.name: etmf_system_snapshot_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) System Snapshot ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the eTMF system snapshot or report generated in Veeva Vault at the time of this assessment. Enables traceability back to the source system record for audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: expected_artifact_count
attributes.description: Total number of TMF artifacts (documents) expected to be filed for this study at the time of assessment, based on the applicable DIA TMF Reference Model zones and study-specific TMF plan.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: filed_artifact_count
attributes.description: Total number of TMF artifacts that have been filed (uploaded and indexed) in the eTMF system (Veeva Vault) at the time of assessment.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative summarizing the key findings, gaps, and observations identified during this TMF completeness assessment. Supports inspection-readiness reporting and CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_risk
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating for inspection readiness based on completeness gaps, overdue artifacts, and zone-level deficiencies. Supports risk-based TMF monitoring and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: is_inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether the TMF is deemed inspection-ready based on the overall completeness percentage meeting or exceeding the completeness target. True = inspection-ready; False = not inspection-ready.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: missing_artifact_count
attributes.description: Number of expected TMF artifacts that have not yet been filed at the time of assessment. Calculated as expected_artifact_count minus filed_artifact_count, excluding overdue artifacts.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date

attributes.name: overdue_artifact_count

attributes.name: rejected_artifact_count

attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: remediation_action_required

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: review_date

attributes.name: study_phase

attributes.name: study_status_at_assessment

attributes.name: tmf_scope

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.description: Red-Amber-Green (RAG) traffic-light classification of overall inspection readiness. attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioresearch Monitoring (BIMO); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Inspectorate

products.name: site_filing
products.description: This association product represents the Site Filing event between site_file and tmf_document. It captures the act of filing a specific essential document into a specific investigational site's ISF or Regulatory Binder, as required by ICH GCP Section 8. Each record links one site_file to one tmf_document and carries filing-specific attributes — filing date, filing status, original-vs-copy designation, binder position, and CRA review date — that exist only in the context of this site-document filing relationship. This is the operational record used by CRAs during monitoring visits and by QA teams during inspection readiness assessments.. Existence Justification: In clinical trial operations, the same essential documents (protocol, Investigator's Brochure, ICF, IRB/IEC approval) must be physically filed at every participating investigational site's ISF/Regulatory Binder. A single TMF document (e.g., the approved protocol v3.0) is filed across dozens of sites simultaneously, and each site file contains hundreds of distinct TMF documents. The business actively manages this filing relationship — tracking whether each document has been filed at each site, whether it is an original or certified copy, its position in the binder, and its filing date — which is a core GCP compliance activity audited during regulatory inspections.

attributes.description: Indicates whether all required documentation, CAPA evidence, and response materials for this finding have been compiled and are ready for re-inspection or follow-up audit review. Supports inspection readiness programs and executive reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspection Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MasterControl

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal CAPA is required to address this inspection finding. Critical findings and major findings typically mandate a CAPA; 'other' findings may be addressed through a written commitment without a full CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally accepted the response and closed the inspection finding. Null if the finding remains open or under review. Used for regulatory commitment tracking and audit readiness metrics.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; FDA Warning Letter Closure Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection finding record was first created in the system (MasterControl or Databricks Silver Layer). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the finding compromises the integrity of clinical trial data submitted or to be submitted to regulatory authorities. 'Confirmed' data integrity findings may invalidate study data and affect regulatory submissions. Aligns with ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance (2018); MHRA Data Integrity Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection finding has escalated to a formal regulatory enforcement action. 'Warning_letter' indicates FDA has issued a Warning Letter. 'Consent_decree' indicates a legal agreement with FDA. 'Import_alert' indicates an FDA import restriction. 'Clinical_hold' indicates FDA has placed a clinical hold on the study. Null or 'none' if no escalation has occurred.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA Consent Decree Guidance; FDA Clinical Hold Guidance 21 CFR 312.42; EMA Enforcement Actions

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: Thematic or process category to which the finding belongs, used for trend analysis and CAPA prioritization (e.g., Informed Consent, Adverse Event Reporting, Protocol Compliance, Data Integrity, Investigational Product Management, Monitoring, Regulatory Submissions). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: informed_consent|adverse_event_reporting|protocol_compliance|data_integrity|investigational_product|monitoring|regulatory_submissions|subject_safety|record_keeping|staff_training — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; FDA GCP Inspection Classification

attributes.name: finding_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory severity classification of the inspection finding as assigned by the inspecting authority. 'Critical' indicates a condition that poses significant risk to subject safety or data integrity and may result in a Warning Letter or consent decree. 'Major' indicates a significant deficiency requiring corrective action. 'Other' (also termed 'minor' or 'observation' by some authorities) indicates a lesser deficiency. Aligns with EMA GCP inspection classification and FDA enforcement terminology.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Classification; FDA Warning Letter Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: finding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority formally issued or documented this finding during the inspection. This is the principal real-world event date (TRANSACTION_HEADER: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP at date granularity), distinct from the inspection start date and the response deadline.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Report; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the inspection finding as documented by the regulatory authority, including the specific deficiency observed, the regulatory standard violated, and any factual basis cited (e.g., verbatim text from FDA Form 483 observation or EMA GCP inspection report).
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Report; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned sequential identifier for this finding within the inspection, as issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA Form 483 observation number, EMA GCP inspection finding reference). Serves as the business-facing identifier for regulatory correspondence and response tracking.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection finding from issuance through resolution. 'Open' indicates the finding has been issued and awaits a formal response. 'Response_submitted' indicates the sponsor/CRO has submitted a written response. 'Under_review' indicates the authority is evaluating the response. 'Closed' indicates the authority has accepted the response and closed the finding. 'Escalated' indicates the finding has progressed to a Warning Letter, consent decree, or equivalent enforcement action.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: finding_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title or headline summarizing the nature of the inspection finding, as recorded in MasterControl. Used for executive dashboards and regulatory commitment registers.
attributes.references: MasterControl Quality Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gcp_principle_violated
attributes.description: The specific ICH GCP principle or section that the finding determines was violated (e.g., 'ICH E6(R2) 4.8 - Informed Consent', 'ICH E6(R2) 5.18 - Monitoring', 'ICH E6(R2) 6.4 - Protocol Amendments'). Supports regulatory submission quality and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspection Classification; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: inspection_authority
attributes.description: Regulatory authority that issued the inspection finding (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Determines the applicable response format, deadline, and escalation pathway. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|ANVISA|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Guidance; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: inspection_finding_source
attributes.description: The type of regulatory document in which this finding was formally issued. 'Form_483' refers to FDA Inspectional Observations. 'Warning_letter' refers to an FDA Warning Letter. 'EIR' refers to an FDA Establishment Inspection Report. 'GCP_inspection_report' refers to an EMA or MHRA GCP inspection report.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA EIR; EMA GCP Inspection Report; MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory inspector or lead inspector who identified and documented this finding. Recorded for correspondence and response addressing purposes. Classified as confidential as it identifies a government official in a regulatory context.
attributes.references: FDA GCP Inspection Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection finding is directly related to a protocol deviation or series of protocol deviations. Enables cross-domain linkage between compliance findings and protocol deviation management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Protocol Deviation Guidance; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: record_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual (typically a QA manager or Regulatory Affairs lead) responsible for managing the response and resolution of this inspection finding within the sponsor or CRO organization. Supports accountability tracking in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl Quality Management; FDA GCP Inspection Program

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory reference cited by the inspecting authority as the basis for the finding (e.g., '21 CFR 312.62(b)', 'ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9.0', 'EU CTR 536/2014 Article 47'). Critical for formal response drafting and legal review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ISO 14155

attributes.name: repeat_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a recurrence of a previously identified deficiency at the same site or sponsor level. Repeat findings signal systemic quality failures and may trigger escalated regulatory enforcement action.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_adequacy_assessment
attributes.description: The regulatory authority's assessment of whether the sponsor's formal response to the finding is adequate. 'Adequate' results in finding closure. 'Inadequate' or 'Partially_adequate' requires a supplemental response. 'Pending_review' indicates the authority has not yet issued its assessment.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Formal deadline by which the sponsor or CRO must submit a written response to the regulatory authority. For FDA Form 483 observations, this is typically 15 business days from the last day of inspection. For EMA GCP findings, deadlines vary by classification. Drives executive-level regulatory commitment management.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance (15 business days); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the formal written response to the inspection finding was submitted to the regulatory authority. Used to calculate response timeliness and compliance with regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trend analysis across findings. 'Process' indicates a procedural gap; 'Training' indicates inadequate staff training; 'System' indicates an EDC, CTMS, or IT system failure; 'Communication' indicates a breakdown in information flow; 'Resource' indicates insufficient staffing or budget; 'Oversight' indicates inadequate monitoring or QA oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Documented root cause of the deficiency identified in the inspection finding, as determined through the CAPA investigation process. Supports systemic quality improvement and recurrence prevention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sponsor_response_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the sponsor's or CRO's formal written response to the inspection finding, including the root cause identified, immediate corrective actions taken, and preventive measures committed. Stored in MasterControl and linked to the eTMF in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the finding has a direct or potential impact on subject safety. 'None' indicates no subject safety risk. 'Potential' indicates a theoretical risk that has not materialized. 'Confirmed' indicates documented harm or risk to enrolled subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: supplemental_response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of a supplemental or follow-up response when the initial response was assessed as inadequate or partially adequate by the regulatory authority. Null if no supplemental response is required.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inspection finding record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: warning_letter_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number of the FDA Warning Letter or equivalent regulatory enforcement communication issued in connection with this finding. Populated only when escalation_status is 'warning_letter'. Used for regulatory commitment tracking and legal response management.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA Enforcement Actions Database

products.name: capa

Captures CAPA reference number, root cause category, root cause description, corrective action plan, preventive action plan, responsible owner, target completion date, actual completion date, effectiveness check date, and CAPA status (open, in-progress, closed, overdue). Sourced from MasterControl CAPA module. SSOT for CAPA lifecycle.

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: A CAPA can be initiated directly from a regulatory inspection (source_type='inspection'). While inspection_finding->compliance_capa links findings to CAPAs, a CAPA may also reference the inspection it

attributes.name: sap_id

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study associated with this CAPA. Links the CAPA to the relevant study protocol for study-level quality tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigational site associated with this CAPA, if site-specific. Null for sponsor-level or cross-site CAPAs. Supports site-level quality performance analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: CAPAs produce corrective action documents (SOP revisions, training records, investigation reports) that must be filed in the TMF per GCP. A QA expert expects this link to verify CAPA closure documenta

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which all corrective and preventive actions were completed and verified. Null until CAPA is closed. Used to calculate cycle time and on-time closure rate KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAPA plan was formally approved by the authorized QA approver in MasterControl. Marks the transition from initiation to active execution phase.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: capa_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the action is corrective (addressing an existing non-conformance), preventive (addressing a potential non-conformance), or both. Drives workflow routing in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155

attributes.name: closure_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification provided by the responsible owner and QA approver at the time of CAPA closure, summarizing evidence that all actions were completed and the root cause was resolved. Required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: compliance_capa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CAPA record. Drives workflow routing, escalation triggers, and regulatory reporting. 'Overdue' is system-set when target completion date is passed without closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions planned or implemented to address the identified root cause and prevent recurrence of the quality issue. Core CAPA deliverable per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had an impact on clinical data integrity. Triggers data review, potential database query, and regulatory notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; EMA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the effectiveness of the implemented corrective and preventive actions will be or was verified. Required by GCP to confirm the CAPA resolved the root cause.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the methodology and findings from the effectiveness check, including evidence reviewed and conclusions drawn. Supports regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the effectiveness verification assessment confirming whether the implemented CAPA actions successfully resolved the root cause and prevented recurrence. Drives CAPA closure or re-opening decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: gcp_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact of the underlying quality issue on GCP compliance and data integrity. Drives CAPA priority, escalation, and regulatory reporting decisions. Aligned with FDA and EMA GCP inspection classification standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspections; EMA GCP Inspections; MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any immediate containment or interim actions taken at the time of CAPA initiation to mitigate the impact of the quality issue before the full corrective action is implemented.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the CAPA was formally initiated and entered into MasterControl. Serves as the start of the CAPA lifecycle clock for overdue tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by the MasterControl CAPA module. Used for source system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: preventive_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the preventive actions planned to eliminate the potential for recurrence of similar quality issues across the organization or study portfolio.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Risk-based priority level assigned to the CAPA, reflecting the severity and urgency of the underlying quality issue. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the quality issue, non-conformance, or finding that triggered the CAPA. Captures the 'what happened' narrative for audit trail and regulatory inspection purposes.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag

attributes.name: root_cause_description

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: capa_action_item_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific action to be taken, including scope, methodology, and expected outcome. Provides the full context required for the assigned owner to execute the action and for auditors to assess adequacy of the response.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item was formally closed in MasterControl following successful completion and verification. Null until the item reaches a terminal state (completed or cancelled). Used to calculate cycle time metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, progress updates, or contextual information entered by the action item owner or QA reviewer during the execution lifecycle. Supports ongoing communication and audit trail within MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item record was first created in MasterControl. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity. Supports ALCOA+ auditability and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: days_open
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this action item has been open, calculated from opened_timestamp to either actual_completion_date (if closed) or the current date (if still open). Used as a KPI for CAPA execution timeliness and audit readiness dashboards. Note: this is a business-captured operational metric from MasterControl, not a derived aggregate.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: due_date_extension_count
attributes.description: Number of times the planned completion date has been extended for this action item. A high extension count is a quality risk indicator and may trigger escalation or QA review. Tracked per MasterControl audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the effectiveness check for this action item must be completed. Null if effectiveness_check_required is False. Used to schedule and track post-implementation reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-completion effectiveness check is required for this action item to confirm the corrective or preventive action achieved its intended outcome. Typically mandated for critical or repeat findings per GCP quality standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the post-completion effectiveness check for this action item. 'Effective' confirms the action resolved the root cause; 'ineffective' triggers re-opening of the CAPA or creation of a new CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this action item was formally escalated. Null if escalation_flag is False. Used to measure escalation response time and management accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item has been escalated to senior management or QA leadership due to overdue status, repeated extensions, or high risk. Triggers escalation notifications and management review workflows in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evidence provided to demonstrate completion of the action item (e.g., 'Updated SOP-QA-012 v3.0 attached; training records for 12 staff members uploaded'). Supports QA verification and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: evidence_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the supporting evidence document stored in Veeva Vault or MasterControl (e.g., document ID, eTMF reference, SOP version number). Links the action item completion to the formal document management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault; MasterControl

attributes.name: extension_justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation provided by the action item owner or QA approver when the planned completion date is extended. Required for audit trail completeness and regulatory inspection readiness. Null if no extension has been granted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this action item record in MasterControl. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Required for change tracking and audit trail completeness per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by MasterControl to this action item in the source system. Used for cross-system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver layer and the MasterControl operational system of record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item was formally opened and assigned to an owner. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this TRANSACTION_LINE entity. Distinct from created_timestamp, which reflects system record creation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the action item is expected to be completed, as agreed upon during CAPA planning. Used to calculate overdue status, track CAPA execution timeliness, and report on compliance with committed timelines to sponsors and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this action item, reflecting urgency and risk impact. Critical and high-priority items are subject to expedited review and escalation procedures. Drives resource allocation and monitoring frequency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which this action item represents a formal commitment, if regulatory_commitment is True (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA). Null if this is an internal CAPA action item without a regulatory commitment dimension. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; EMA GCP Inspections; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: regulatory_commitment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item represents a formal commitment made to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) during an inspection or in a regulatory submission response. Regulatory commitment items are subject to heightened monitoring and escalation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; EMA GCP Inspections; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this action item within the parent CAPA plan (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Enables ordered display and reporting of action items within a CAPA. Serves as the LINE_SEQUENCE for this TRANSACTION_LINE entity.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the specific audit finding, inspection observation, protocol deviation, or nonconformance that this action item directly addresses (e.g., audit finding number, deviation ID). Provides traceability from action item back to the originating quality event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the action item (e.g., 'Revise SOP-QA-012 to include double-check step'). Used in dashboards, reports, and inspection-ready summaries within MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required training associated with this action item was completed and documented in MasterControl. Null if training_required is False or training has not yet been completed. Required as part of completion evidence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this action item requires associated staff training (e.g., training on a revised SOP). When True, training completion records in MasterControl must be linked as evidence before the action item can be verified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: verification_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the QA verifier during the evidence review, including rationale for rejection or conditions for acceptance. Provides the audit trail narrative required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the QA verifier confirmed the completion evidence was adequate and the action item was satisfactorily executed. Null until verification is completed. Required for regulatory inspection audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: verification_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the QA verification review of the action item completion evidence. 'Accepted' closes the verification loop; 'rejected' returns the item to the owner for rework; 'pending_revision' indicates partial acceptance with required amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether independent QA verification of completion evidence is required before this action item can be marked as completed. True for high-risk or critical action items per the CAPA procedure. Drives the QA review workflow in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

Distinct from safety events — deviations are GCP compliance events. Sourced from CTMS and EDC systems.

attributes.name: audit_readiness_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current audit readiness state of this deviation record, confirming that all required documentation, reporting, and CAPA activities are complete and the record is inspection-ready.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA Inspection Readiness; EMA GCP Inspection; MasterControl

attributes.name: corrective_action_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of the immediate corrective actions taken to address the deviation and prevent recurrence, prior to or independent of a formal CAPA. Captures site-level remediation steps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the protocol deviation record was first created in the source system (CTMS or EDC). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation compromised the integrity, reliability, or interpretability of study data. Informs decisions on data exclusion, sensitivity analyses, or database lock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; CDISC; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: detected_by
attributes.description: The method or source by which the deviation was detected. Indicates whether it was found during CRA monitoring visit, site self-identification, sponsor audit, regulatory inspection, central data review, or subject report. Used for monitoring effectiveness metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cra_monitoring|site_self_identified|sponsor_audit|regulatory_inspection|data_review|subject_report|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based QM

attributes.name: deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the deviation by severity and regulatory impact. 'Major' deviations directly affect subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance. 'Minor' deviations have minimal impact. 'Important' is used per ICH E3/EMA guidance for deviations affecting subject rights, safety, or data reliability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; EMA Guideline on GCP Inspection; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the protocol deviation, including what protocol requirement was not met, the circumstances under which it occurred, and any immediate actions taken. Sourced from the eCRF or CTMS deviation entry.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; CDISC SDTM DV Domain (DVTERM); FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: deviation_ref_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the protocol deviation record, typically generated by the CTMS (Oracle Siebel CTMS) or EDC (Medidata Rave). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.62; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the deviation record. 'Open' indicates newly identified; 'under_review' indicates active investigation; 'resolved' indicates corrective action completed; 'closed' indicates fully adjudicated and archived; 'escalated' indicates elevated to sponsor or regulatory authority; 'voided' indicates entered in error.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the deviation describing which protocol requirement was violated. Common types include: eligibility, dosing, visit_window, prohibited_medication, consent, randomization, assessments, sample_collection, concomitant_medication, data_collection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eligibility|dosing|visit_window|prohibited_medication|consent|randomization|assessments|sample_collection|concomitant_medication|data_collection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DV Domain; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation was first identified or discovered, which may differ from the occurrence date. Used to calculate detection lag and assess monitoring effectiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: ecrf_form_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific eCRF form or data point in Medidata Rave EDC that is associated with this deviation, enabling direct traceability to the source data record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DV Domain; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: include_in_csr_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Include in Clinical Study Report (CSR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be listed or summarized in the Clinical Study Report (CSR) per ICH E3 requirements. Major and important deviations are typically included.
attributes.references: ICH E3 Section 10.2; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on CSR

attributes.name: irb_iec_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the IRB/IEC. Used to verify compliance with reporting timelines and to support audit readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reporting Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) per applicable regulations and the IRB/IEC-approved protocol.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred (i.e., the date the protocol requirement was not met). This is the principal real-world event date per CDISC SDTM DVSTDTC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DV Domain (DVSTDTC); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: pi_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally notified of the deviation. Required for GCP compliance and site management accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.53; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_requirement_ref
attributes.description: Specific section, clause, or criterion number within the study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 5.3 Inclusion Criterion 2'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; CDISC SDTM DV Domain (DVCAT); FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the applicable regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), where regulatory reporting was required.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA CT-3 Guidance; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; PMDA

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA) as part of IND safety reporting or clinical trial notification obligations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA CT-3 Guidance; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17

attributes.name: repeat_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation is a recurrence of a previously identified deviation of the same type at the same site or by the same subject. Used for trend analysis and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on QM

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as required. Used to assess compliance with reporting timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was resolved and corrective actions were confirmed as complete. Marks the end of the active deviation lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorized root cause of the deviation as determined during investigation. attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA Module; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: root_cause_description

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this deviation record was sourced. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5

attributes.name: source_system_record_number
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave deviation ID or Oracle Siebel CTMS deviation record ID). Enables upstream reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5

attributes.name: sponsor_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally communicated to the sponsor. Used to verify compliance with sponsor notification timelines per the Clinical Trial Agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: sponsor_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be formally reported to the study sponsor per the Clinical Trial Agreement and sponsor SOPs.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Subject Excluded from Per Protocol (PP) Population Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation resulted in the exclusion of the subject from the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population, as determined by the biostatistics team per the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).

attributes.name: subject_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation had an impact on subject safety, rights, or well-being. Used to determine reporting obligations and CAPA urgency.

attributes.name: tmf_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the deviation documentation filed in the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) in Veeva Vault. Enables cross-system document traceability for inspection readiness.
